rows.source: From your first note to fingerstyle, blues and lead
rows.translation: Kutoka noti yako ya kwanza hadi fingerstyle, blues na gitaa la solo

rows.source: Hold it, tune it, play your first notes.
rows.translation: Lishike, rekebisha sauti, piga noti zako za kwanza.

rows.source: The thickest string is the lowest. It sits nearest your face when you play. We call it string 6.
rows.translation: Uzi mnene zaidi una sauti ya chini zaidi. Unakuwa karibu zaidi na uso wako unapopiga. Tunauita uzi 6.

rows.source: Each string has a tuning peg on the head. Turning it changes the pitch. Timbre listens and tells you which way.
rows.translation: Kila uzi una kigingi cha kurekebisha kwenye kichwa. Kukizungusha hubadili kimo cha sauti. Timbre husikiliza na kukuonyesha upande wa kuzungusha.

rows.source: Strings count from the thinnest (1) to the thickest (6).
rows.translation: Nyuzi huhesabiwa kutoka mwembamba zaidi (1) hadi mnene zaidi (6).

rows.source: Pluck the thickest string and let it ring.
rows.translation: Piga uzi mnene zaidi na uache ulie.

rows.source: E A D G B E
rows.translation: E A D G B E

rows.source: From thick to thin: E, A, D, G, B, E. Try: Every Amateur Does Get Better Eventually.
rows.translation: Kutoka mnene hadi mwembamba: E, A, D, G, B, E. Kumbuka kwa Kiingereza: Every Amateur Does Get Better Eventually.

rows.source: Play strings 6, 5 and 4, one at a time.
rows.translation: Piga nyuzi 6, 5 na 4, mmoja baada ya mwingine.
Ipi ina sauti ya juu zaidi?
Noti zako za kwanza kwenye freti

rows.source: Put your fingertip just behind the metal fret, not on top of it. Press firmly enough for a clean ring.
rows.translation: Weka ncha ya kidole nyuma kidogo ya freti ya chuma, si juu yake. Bonyeza vya kutosha ili sauti iwe safi.

rows.source: Open, fret 1, fret 3: E, F, G.
rows.translation: Wazi, freti 1, freti 3: E, F, G.

rows.source: Between two frets, in the middle

rows.translation: Kodi yako ya kwanza: E minori

rows.source: E minor uses two fingers on fret 2, strings 5 and 4. Every string rings.
rows.translation: E minori hutumia vidole viwili kwenye freti 2, nyuzi 5 na 4. Kila uzi unalia.

rows.source: Brush across all six strings from thick to thin, one smooth motion. Keep your wrist loose.
rows.translation: Piga nyuzi zote sita kwa mwendo mmoja laini, kutoka mnene hadi mwembamba. Legeza kifundo cha mkono.

rows.source: This challenge mixes the whole unit: the open strings, E, F and G on string 1, and E minor. Take a breath between steps.
rows.translation: Jaribio hili linachanganya kitengo kizima: nyuzi wazi, E, F na G kwenye uzi 1, na E minori. Vuta pumzi kati ya hatua.

rows.source: From thick to thin, the open strings are…
rows.translation: Kutoka mnene hadi mwembamba, nyuzi wazi ni…

rows.source: E B G D A E
rows.translation: E B G D A E

rows.source: A D G B E A
rows.translation: A D G B E A

rows.source: Every Amateur Does Get Better Eventually: E A D G B E, string 6 to string 1.
rows.translation: Kumbuka kwa Kiingereza: Every Amateur Does Get Better Eventually: E A D G B E, uzi 6 hadi uzi 1.
Ipi ina sauti ya chini zaidi?

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb: three notes
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb: noti tatu

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: open string 2 is B, fret 2 on string 3 is A, and open string 3 is G. Your second finger plays the A.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb inahitaji noti tatu: uzi 2 wazi ni B, freti 2 kwenye uzi 3 ni A, na uzi 3 wazi ni G. Kidole chako cha pili hupiga A.

rows.source: String 3, fret 2, second finger. That's A.
rows.translation: Uzi 3, freti 2, kidole cha pili. Hiyo ni A.

rows.source: B A G A B B B: open string 2, then string 3.
rows.translation: B A G A B B B: uzi 2 wazi, kisha uzi 3.

rows.source: Notes on strings 1 and 2, reading tab, and your first two tunes.
rows.translation: Noti kwenye nyuzi 1 na 2, kusoma tabulacha, na melodi zako mbili za kwanza.

rows.source: String 2 works like string 1. Open, it's B. Fret 1 with your first finger is C. Fret 3 with your third finger is D.
rows.translation: Uzi 2 hufanya kazi kama uzi 1. Ukiwa wazi, ni B. Freti 1 kwa kidole cha kwanza ni C. Freti 3 kwa kidole cha tatu ni D.
Piga uzi 2 wazi. Hiyo ni B.

rows.source: String 2, fret 1, first finger. That's C.
rows.translation: Uzi 2, freti 1, kidole cha kwanza. Hiyo ni C.

rows.source: String 2, fret 3, third finger. That's D.
rows.translation: Uzi 2, freti 3, kidole cha tatu. Hiyo ni D.

rows.source: One finger per fret: fret 1 gets finger 1, fret 2 gets finger 2, fret 3 gets finger 3.
rows.translation: Kidole kimoja kwa kila freti: freti 1 ni ya kidole 1, freti 2 ni ya kidole 2, freti 3 ni ya kidole 3.

rows.source: Rest your thumb on the back of the neck, behind your second finger. Your fingers can then arch and land on their tips.
rows.translation: Weka gumba nyuma ya shingo, mkabala na kidole chako cha pili. Hivyo vidole vinaweza kupinda na kutua kwa ncha zake.

rows.source: Tab draws six lines, one per string, with string 1 on top. A number on a line is the fret to press. A 0 means play that string open.
rows.translation: Tabulacha ina mistari sita, mmoja kwa kila uzi, uzi 1 ukiwa juu. Namba kwenye mstari ni freti ya kubonyeza. 0 inamaanisha upige uzi huo wazi.

rows.source: In tab, a 3 on the top line means…
rows.translation: Kwenye tabulacha, 3 mstari wa juu ni…

rows.source: The top line is string 1, the thinnest. The number is the fret.
rows.translation: Mstari wa juu ni uzi 1, mwembamba zaidi. Namba ni freti.

rows.source: A 0 on the second line means…
A note that lasts two beats
A half note rings for two beats. Pick once, count one, two, and let it sustain until the next note.
rows.translation: Noti nusu hulia kwa mapigo mawili. Piga mara moja, hesabu moja, mbili, na uache sauti iendelee hadi noti inayofuata.

rows.source: How long does a half note last?
rows.translation: Noti nusu hudumu kwa muda gani?

rows.source: Half of a four-beat bar is two beats. A quarter note lasts one beat.
rows.translation: Nusu ya kipimo cha mapigo manne ni mapigo mawili. Noti robo hudumu pigo moja.

rows.source: Going from string 2 to string 1 is a tiny move. Keep your picking hand close to the strings so the next note is ready.
rows.translation: Kutoka uzi 2 hadi uzi 1 ni mwendo mdogo sana. Weka mkono unaopiga karibu na nyuzi ili uwe tayari kwa noti inayofuata.

rows.source: Fret 3 on string 2, then open string 1. Lift your finger as you pick.
rows.translation: Freti 3 kwenye uzi 2, kisha uzi 1 wazi. Inua kidole unapopiga.

rows.source: C and D on string 2, then E, F and G on string 1.
rows.translation: C na D kwenye uzi 2, kisha E, F na G kwenye uzi 1.

rows.source: This melody comes from Beethoven's Ninth Symphony. It uses C, D, E, F and G, and it moves mostly one step at a time.
rows.translation: Melodi hii inatoka kwenye Simfoni ya Tisa ya Beethoven. Inatumia C, D, E, F na G, na kwa kawaida husogea hatua moja moja.

rows.source: The first line, slowly: E E F G G F E D.
rows.translation: Mstari wa kwanza, polepole: E E F G G F E D.

rows.source: Then: C C D E E D D.
rows.translation: Kisha: C C D E E D D.

rows.source: Each line ends with a lilt: a longer note, a quick one, then a held one. Count one-and-two, and slip the quick note in on the and.
rows.translation: Kila mstari huishia kwa mwendo unaobembea: noti ndefu, ya haraka, kisha ya kushikilia. Hesabu moja-na-mbili, ukiingiza noti ya haraka kwenye na.

rows.source: This nursery tune walks on C, D and E, then jumps up to G. The jump is open string 1 to fret 3.
rows.translation: Melodi hii ya watoto inatembea kwenye C, D na E, kisha huruka juu hadi G. Mruko ni kutoka uzi 1 wazi hadi freti 3.

rows.source: E D C D E E E: open string 1, down to string 2 and back.
rows.translation: E D C D E E E: uzi 1 wazi, shuka hadi uzi 2 na urudi.

rows.source: D D D on string 2, then E and G on string 1.
rows.translation: D D D kwenye uzi 2, kisha E na G kwenye uzi 1.

rows.source: Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox
rows.translation: Wimbo maalumu: Letters in a Shoebox

rows.source: Letters in a Shoebox is a Timbre Original, a slow ballad in C. Its chorus lives on strings 1 and 2, and its hook opens with the long, short lilt you played in Ode to Joy. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Letters in a Shoebox ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre, baladi ya polepole katika C. Kiitikio chake kiko kwenye nyuzi 1 na 2; kishazi chake cha kuvutia huanza kwa mwendo mrefu na mfupi uliopiga katika Ode to Joy. Wimbo mzima uko kwenye Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.

rows.source: The hook: C and D on string 2, then E, F and G on string 1, and back to D.
rows.translation: Kishazi cha kuvutia: C na D kwenye uzi 2, kisha E, F na G kwenye uzi 1, na kurudi D.

rows.source: Does the chorus end at home?
rows.translation: Je, kiitikio huishia kwenye noti msingi?

rows.source: No, it wants to go on
No new ideas: E, F and G on string 1, B, C and D on string 2. Start slow, then hold a steady tempo.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: E, F na G kwenye uzi 1, B, C na D kwenye uzi 2. Anza polepole, kisha dumisha tempo thabiti.

rows.source: Did the tune go up or down?
All six notes, low to high.
rows.translation: Noti zote sita, kutoka chini hadi juu.

rows.source: Ode to Joy, a little faster
rows.translation: Ode to Joy, kasi zaidi kidogo

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb, faster
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb, kasi zaidi

rows.source: E minor, E, A minor and A, played cleanly, and your first chord changes.
rows.translation: E minori, E, A minori na A kwa sauti safi, na mabadiliko yako ya kwanza ya kodi.

rows.source: Press with your fingertips, arched like a bridge, so no finger leans on the string below it. Short nails make this much easier.
rows.translation: Bonyeza kwa ncha za vidole, vikiwa vimepinda kama daraja, ili kidole kisiegemee uzi ulio chini yake. Kucha fupi hurahisisha sana.

rows.source: Pick the strings one at a time, thick to thin. A dull thud means a finger is touching that string. Adjust and pick it again.
rows.translation: Piga nyuzi mmoja mmoja, kutoka mnene hadi mwembamba. Sauti iliyozibwa ina maana kidole kinagusa uzi huo. Rekebisha na uupige tena.

rows.source: One string sounds dull. What's the likely cause?
rows.translation: Uzi mmoja una sauti iliyozibwa. Sababu ni nini?
Kijiti cha kupigia ni chembamba mno

rows.source: A fingertip leaning on a neighboring string stops it ringing. Arch your fingers more.
rows.translation: Ncha ya kidole ikiegemea uzi wa jirani huuzuia kulia. Pinda vidole zaidi.
E minori na kidole kimoja zaidi

rows.source: Keep your E minor shape and add your first finger on string 3, fret 1. That one note turns minor into major.
rows.translation: Shikilia umbo la E minori na ongeza kidole cha kwanza kwenye uzi 3, freti 1. Noti hiyo moja hugeuza minori kuwa meja.

rows.source: Major chords tend to sound bright and settled. Minor chords sound darker. E and E minor differ by just one note.
rows.translation: Kodi meja kwa kawaida husikika angavu na tulivu. Kodi minori zina sauti yenye giza zaidi. E na E minori hutofautiana kwa noti moja tu.

rows.source: A minor is the E shape moved one string thinner: fingers 2 and 3 on fret 2, finger 1 on string 2, fret 1.
rows.translation: A minori ni umbo la E lililosogezwa uzi mmoja kuelekea nyuzi nyembamba: vidole 2 na 3 kwenye freti 2, kidole 1 kwenye uzi 2, freti 1.

rows.source: The root is the note a chord is named after. In A minor it's open string 5, so start your strum there and skip string 6.
rows.translation: Noti msingi ndiyo huipa kodi jina. Katika A minori ni uzi 5 wazi, kwa hiyo anza kupiga nyuzi hapo na uruke uzi 6.

rows.source: Which string do you skip in A minor?
rows.translation: Unaruka uzi gani katika A minori?

rows.source: A minor's root is open string 5. Start the strum there.
rows.translation: Noti msingi ya A minori ni uzi 5 wazi. Anza kupiga nyuzi hapo.

rows.source: A packs fingers 1, 2 and 3 side by side on fret 2, on strings 4, 3 and 2. Strum from string 5.
rows.translation: A huweka vidole 1, 2 na 3 sambamba kwenye freti 2, nyuzi 4, 3 na 2. Anza kupiga kwenye uzi 5.

rows.source: If your fingers feel cramped, slant them so each sits just behind the fret at a slight angle. Keep string 1 clear so it rings.
rows.translation: Vidole vikibanana, vielekeze kwa pembe kidogo ili kila kimoja kiwe nyuma tu ya freti. Usiuguse uzi 1 ili ulie.

rows.source: Which fret holds all three fingers in A?
rows.translation: Vidole vyote vitatu viko freti gani kwa A?

rows.source: From E minor to A minor
rows.translation: Kutoka E minori hadi A minori

rows.source: Move the shape, not the fingers
rows.translation: Hamisha umbo, si vidole kimoja kimoja

rows.source: From E minor to A minor, fingers 2 and 3 hop together to strings 4 and 3. Then finger 1 lands on string 2. Your hand barely moves.
rows.translation: Kutoka E minori hadi A minori, vidole 2 na 3 huruka pamoja hadi nyuzi 4 na 3. Kisha kidole 1 hutua kwenye uzi 2. Mkono husogea kidogo tu.

rows.source: Strum once, then use the rest of the bar to change. Aim to land the new chord right on beat one. Speed comes later, by itself.
rows.translation: Piga nyuzi mara moja, kisha tumia kipimo kilichobaki kubadili kodi. Lenga kutua kwenye kodi mpya hasa kwenye pigo la kwanza. Kasi itakuja yenyewe baadaye.

rows.source: How should your fingers travel between chords?
rows.translation: Vidole vinapaswa kusogeaje kati ya kodi?

rows.source: Moving the fingers as a unit is faster and lands cleaner. Keep them low, just above the strings.
rows.translation: Kusogeza vidole pamoja ni haraka zaidi na hutoa sauti safi zaidi. Viweke chini, juu kidogo tu ya nyuzi.

rows.source: Every finger moves from A to E. Picture the E shape before you lift, then move all three together. Aim finger 2 at string 5.
rows.translation: Kila kidole husogea kutoka A hadi E. Fikiria umbo la E kabla ya kuinua vidole, kisha visogeze vyote vitatu pamoja. Elekeza kidole 2 kwenye uzi 5.

rows.source: Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard
rows.translation: Wimbo maalumu: Dust on the Dashboard

rows.source: Dust on the Dashboard is a Timbre Original: country in A. Every verse ends on two bars of E and two of A, the change you just learned. See the shape, move early and land on beat one. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Dust on the Dashboard ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: country katika A. Kila ubeti huishia kwa vipimo viwili vya E na viwili vya A, badiliko ulilojifunza. Fikiria umbo, sogea mapema na utue kwenye pigo la kwanza. Wimbo mzima uko kwenye Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.
Je, hii inaishia kwenye noti msingi?

rows.source: Over E: open B, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C sharp at fret 2, then G sharp at fret 1 on string 3.
rows.translation: Kwa E: B wazi, E wazi, D freti 3 uzi 2, C diesi freti 2, kisha G diesi freti 1 uzi 3.

rows.source: No new ideas: E minor, E, A minor and A. Land each shape cleanly, then keep the changes steady.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: E minori, E, A minori na A. Tua kwa usafi kwenye kila umbo, kisha badili kwa mwendo thabiti.

rows.source: Which finger turns E minor into E?
rows.translation: Kidole gani hugeuza E minori kuwa E?

rows.source: Finger 1 on string 3, fret 1 is the one note that makes E major.
rows.translation: Kidole 1 kwenye uzi 3, freti 1 hupiga noti pekee inayofanya kodi iwe E meja.

rows.source: Downstrokes, down-up eighths, accents and a strumming hand that never stops.
rows.translation: Mapigo chini, noti za nane chini-juu, mikazo na mkono wa kupiga usiosimama.
Piga nyuzi mara moja kwa kila pigo

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. Strum down on every beat and count out loud: one, two, three, four.
rows.translation: Noti robo hudumu pigo moja. Piga nyuzi chini kwa kila pigo na uhesabu kwa sauti: moja, mbili, tatu, nne.

rows.source: Let the motion come from a loose wrist and forearm, like shaking water off your hand. A stiff arm sounds harsh.
rows.translation: Mwendo utoke kwenye kifundo na sehemu ya mkono chini ya kiwiko vikiwa vimelegea, kama unakung'uta maji mkononi. Mkono uliokakamaa hutoa sauti kali.

rows.source: How many quarter-note strums fill a bar of four?
rows.translation: Ni mipigo mingapi ya noti robo hujaza kipimo cha mapigo manne?

rows.source: Split each beat in two. Strum down on the number and up on the and: one and two and. That's eight strums per bar.
rows.translation: Gawa kila pigo mara mbili. Piga chini kwenye namba na juu kwenye na: moja na mbili na. Hiyo ni mipigo minane ya nyuzi kwa kila kipimo.

rows.source: Where does the up strum fall?
rows.translation: Pigo la nyuzi kuelekea juu huja lini?

rows.source: Down on the number, up on the and. Your hand goes down and up once per beat.
rows.translation: Chini kwenye namba, juu kwenye na. Mkono hushuka na kupanda mara moja kwa kila pigo.

rows.source: Up strums are naturally softer. Brush just the thinner three or four strings on the way up. That gives the groove its lift.
rows.translation: Mapigo ya juu kwa kawaida ni mepesi zaidi. Gusa nyuzi nyembamba tatu au nne tu unapopanda. Hilo hupa mdundo uchangamfu.

rows.source: An accent is a note played a little louder. Strum beat one harder than the rest. It tells everyone where the bar begins.
rows.translation: Mkazo ni noti iliyopigwa kwa sauti kubwa kidogo. Piga nyuzi kwa nguvu zaidi kwenye pigo la kwanza. Hilo huwaonyesha wote kipimo kinapoanza.

rows.source: Beat one starts the bar. A slightly louder first strum keeps you, and anyone listening, in time.
rows.translation: Pigo la kwanza huanza kipimo. Kupiga nyuzi kwa sauti kubwa kidogo hapo hukusaidia wewe na wasikilizaji kufuata muda.

rows.source: Say the bar number on beat one: one, two, three, four; two, two, three, four. You always know where you are.
rows.translation: Sema namba ya kipimo kwenye pigo la kwanza: moja, mbili, tatu, nne; mbili, mbili, tatu, nne. Utajua ulipofika kila wakati.

rows.source: Your strumming hand swings down and up all the time, like a pendulum. To skip a strum, keep swinging and simply miss the strings.
rows.translation: Mkono wa kupiga hubembea chini na juu kila wakati, kama pendulamu. Kuruka pigo la nyuzi, endelea kubembea lakini usiguse nyuzi.

rows.source: To skip a strum, your hand…
rows.translation: Kuruka pigo la nyuzi, mkono wako…

rows.source: Keeps moving and misses the strings
A hand that never stops keeps steady time. The skipped strum is a swing that doesn't touch the strings.
rows.translation: Mkono usiosimama hudumisha muda thabiti. Pigo lililorukwa ni mwendo usiogusa nyuzi.

rows.source: This pattern drives countless songs. On beat three your hand swings down without touching the strings, then catches the up strum.
rows.translation: Mpangilio huu husukuma nyimbo nyingi sana. Kwenye pigo la tatu, mkono hushuka bila kugusa nyuzi, kisha huzipiga unapopanda.

rows.source: In this pattern, which beat has no strum on the number?
rows.translation: Katika mpangilio huu, ni pigo gani halipigi nyuzi kwenye namba?

rows.source: On three the hand swings down past the strings, then strums up on the and.
rows.translation: Kwenye tatu, mkono hushuka bila kugusa nyuzi, kisha huzipiga juu kwenye na.

rows.source: Low Tide Radio is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae on E minor and A. The guitar plays only the ands. Keep your hand swinging down and up, miss the strings on each number and catch every and. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Low Tide Radio ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: reggae tulivu kwa E minori na A. Gitaa hupiga kwenye na tu. Endelea kubembeza mkono chini na juu; usiguse nyuzi kwenye kila namba, uzipige kwenye kila na. Wimbo mzima uko kwenye Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.

rows.source: Where does the guitar play in Low Tide Radio?
rows.translation: Gitaa hupiga wapi katika Low Tide Radio?

rows.source: Bass and drums hold the numbers. The guitar answers between them, on the ands.
rows.translation: Besi na ngoma hushikilia namba. Gitaa hujibu katikati yake, kwenye na.

rows.source: No new ideas: quarters, eighths and the folk strum on the chords you know. Keep the hand swinging and lean on beat one.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: noti robo, noti za nane na mpigo wa folk kwa kodi unazojua. Endelea kubembeza mkono na kukazia pigo la kwanza.

rows.source: Down-up eighths: where are the up strums?
rows.translation: Noti za nane chini-juu: mapigo ya juu yako wapi?

rows.source: C, G, D and D minor, two classic progressions, and the one-minute change.
rows.translation: C, G, D na D minori, mifuatano miwili maarufu ya kodi, na kubadili kwa dakika moja.

rows.source: C climbs like a staircase: finger 3 on string 5, fret 3; finger 2 on string 4, fret 2; finger 1 on string 2, fret 1.
rows.translation: C hupanda kama ngazi: kidole 3 kwenye uzi 5, freti 3; kidole 2 kwenye uzi 4, freti 2; kidole 1 kwenye uzi 2, freti 1.

rows.source: Which string do you skip in C?
C's root is on string 5, fret 3. Start the strum there.
rows.translation: Noti msingi ya C iko kwenye uzi 5, freti 3. Anza kupiga nyuzi hapo.

rows.source: A minor to C: one finger
rows.translation: A minori hadi C: kidole kimoja

rows.source: Fingers 1 and 2 stay exactly where they are. Only finger 3 moves, from string 3 to string 5, fret 3.
rows.translation: Vidole 1 na 2 hubaki palepale. Kidole 3 tu ndicho husogea, kutoka uzi 3 hadi uzi 5, freti 3.

rows.source: G spreads out: finger 2 on string 6, fret 3; finger 1 on string 5, fret 2; finger 3 on string 1, fret 3. All six strings ring.
rows.translation: G hutandaza vidole: kidole 2 kwenye uzi 6, freti 3; kidole 1 kwenye uzi 5, freti 2; kidole 3 kwenye uzi 1, freti 3. Nyuzi zote sita hulia.

rows.source: In G, which strings ring open?
rows.translation: Katika G, ni nyuzi zipi hulia zikiwa wazi?

rows.source: When you change, land the finger for the lowest string first. It's the first note your strum hits, which buys a moment for the rest.
rows.translation: Unapobadili, tua kwanza kidole cha uzi wenye sauti ya chini zaidi. Ndiyo noti ya kwanza unapopiga nyuzi, hivyo unapata muda kidogo wa kuweka vilivyobaki.

rows.source: D lives on the thinnest three strings: finger 1 on string 3, fret 2; finger 3 on string 2, fret 3; finger 2 on string 1, fret 2.
rows.translation: D iko kwenye nyuzi tatu nyembamba zaidi: kidole 1 kwenye uzi 3, freti 2; kidole 3 kwenye uzi 2, freti 3; kidole 2 kwenye uzi 1, freti 2.

rows.source: Where does a D chord's strum start?
rows.translation: Unaanza kupiga nyuzi wapi kwa kodi D?

rows.source: D's root is open string 4. Strings 5 and 6 stay quiet.
rows.translation: Noti msingi ya D ni uzi 4 wazi. Nyuzi 5 na 6 hazipigwi.

rows.source: For D minor, the note on string 1 drops to fret 1. Reshuffle: finger 1 on string 1, finger 2 on string 3, finger 3 stays on string 2.
rows.translation: Kwa D minori, noti ya uzi 1 hushuka hadi freti 1. Panga upya: kidole 1 kwenye uzi 1, kidole 2 kwenye uzi 3, kidole 3 hubaki kwenye uzi 2.

rows.source: A key is a song's home base. In the key of G, the chords G, C and D do most of the work. Countless folk and rock songs use only these three.
rows.translation: Ufunguo ni msingi wa wimbo. Katika ufunguo wa G, kodi G, C na D hufanya kazi kubwa zaidi. Nyimbo nyingi sana za folk na rock hutumia hizi tatu tu.

rows.source: You keep landing late on a change. What helps most?
rows.translation: Unaendelea kuchelewa kubadili kodi. Nini kitasaidia zaidi?

rows.source: Slow, early changes build the habit. Speed follows on its own.
rows.translation: Kubadili polepole na mapema hujenga mazoea. Kasi hufuata yenyewe.

rows.source: A progression is a chord sequence that repeats. A minor, C, G, D starts dark and brightens as it climbs.
rows.translation: Mfuatano wa kodi ni mpangilio wa kodi unaorudiwa. A minori, C, G, D huanza kwa sauti yenye giza na kung'aa unapopanda.

rows.source: Away from the app, pick two chords and switch for one minute, one strum each. Count your clean changes and beat that score tomorrow. Start with D and D minor.
rows.translation: Bila kutumia programu, chagua kodi mbili na uzibadili kwa dakika moja, ukipiga nyuzi mara moja kwa kila kodi. Hesabu mabadiliko safi na uvuke idadi hiyo kesho. Anza na D na D minori.

rows.source: In a one-minute change, what do you count?
rows.translation: Unahesabu nini unapobadili kwa dakika moja?

rows.source: Kite Weather is a Timbre Original: bright campfire pop on G, D, E minor and C, around and around. Change early, and land the finger for the lowest string first. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Kite Weather ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: pop changamfu ya kuimba kuzunguka moto, kwa G, D, E minori na C, tena na tena. Badili mapema, ukitua kwanza kidole cha uzi wenye sauti ya chini zaidi. Wimbo mzima uko kwenye Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.

rows.source: Which chord in Kite Weather skips strings 5 and 6?
rows.translation: Kodi ipi katika Kite Weather huruka nyuzi 5 na 6?

rows.source: D's root is open string 4, so strings 5 and 6 stay quiet.
rows.translation: Noti msingi ya D ni uzi 4 wazi, kwa hiyo nyuzi 5 na 6 hazipigwi.

rows.source: The verse adds A on string 3, fret 2: the note finger 1 holds in D. Open G, A, then open B.
rows.translation: Ubeti unaongeza A kwenye uzi 3, freti 2: noti ya kidole 1 katika D. G wazi, A, kisha B wazi.

rows.source: No new ideas: C, G, D and D minor join E minor, E, A minor and A. Change early, strum steady and let each chord ring.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: C, G, D na D minori huungana na E minori, E, A minori na A. Badili mapema, piga kwa mwendo thabiti na uache kila kodi ilie.

rows.source: G and A on string 3, D, E and F on string 4, the C major scale and two traditional tunes.
rows.translation: G na A kwenye uzi 3, D, E na F kwenye uzi 4, skeli ya C meja na melodi mbili za jadi.

rows.source: Open string 3 is G. Put finger 2 on fret 2 and you get A. The same rule holds: the finger matches the fret.
rows.translation: Uzi 3 wazi ni G. Weka kidole 2 kwenye freti 2 kupata A. Kanuni ni ileile: kidole kinalingana na freti.
Piga uzi 3 wazi. Hiyo ni G.

rows.source: G and A on string 3, then B, C and D on string 2.
rows.translation: G na A kwenye uzi 3, kisha B, C na D kwenye uzi 2.

rows.source: G up to D and back
rows.translation: G hadi D juu na kurudi

rows.source: Open string 4 is D. Fret 2 is E and fret 3 is F. Keep your thumb low behind the neck so your fingers can reach.
rows.translation: Uzi 4 wazi ni D. Freti 2 ni E na freti 3 ni F. Weka gumba chini nyuma ya shingo ili vidole viweze kufikia nyuzi.
Piga uzi 4 wazi. Hiyo ni D.

rows.source: Fret 2, then fret 3: E, then F.
rows.translation: Freti 2, kisha freti 3: E, kisha F.

rows.source: Open string 4 and string 2, fret 3 share which name?
rows.translation: Uzi 4 wazi na uzi 2, freti 3 hutoa noti yenye jina gani moja?

rows.source: Both are D, an octave apart: the same note name, one higher than the other.
rows.translation: Zote ni D, zimetengana kwa oktava: jina lilelile la noti, moja ikiwa juu kuliko nyingine.
Ni D ipi iliyo juu zaidi?

rows.source: D, E and F on string 4, then G and A on string 3.
rows.translation: D, E na F kwenye uzi 4, kisha G na A kwenye uzi 3.

rows.source: Put finger 3 on string 5, fret 3. That's C, the note the C major scale starts on.
rows.translation: Weka kidole 3 kwenye uzi 5, freti 3. Hiyo ni C, noti inayoanza skeli ya C meja.

rows.source: String 5, fret 3, third finger. That's C.
rows.translation: Uzi 5, freti 3, kidole cha tatu. Hiyo ni C.

rows.source: A scale climbs note by note from one letter to the same letter an octave higher. C major uses only plain letter names: C D E F G A B C.
rows.translation: Skeli hupanda noti kwa noti kutoka herufi moja hadi herufi ileile oktava moja juu. C meja hutumia majina ya herufi pekee bila alama: C D E F G A B C.

rows.source: String 5 fret 3, then strings 4, 3 and 2. Go slowly.
rows.translation: Uzi 5 freti 3, kisha nyuzi 4, 3 na 2. Piga polepole.

rows.source: How many different letter names are in C major?
rows.translation: Kuna majina mangapi tofauti ya herufi katika C meja?

rows.source: C D E F G A B, then C again an octave higher.
rows.translation: C D E F G A B, kisha C tena oktava moja juu.

rows.source: When the Saints Go Marching In
rows.translation: When the Saints Go Marching In

rows.source: This traditional spiritual became a jazz standard. It uses C, D, E, F and G on strings 5, 4 and 3.
rows.translation: Wimbo huu wa kiroho wa jadi ulipata umaarufu katika jazz. Unatumia C, D, E, F na G kwenye nyuzi 5, 4 na 3.

rows.source: The opening: C, E, F, then open G.
rows.translation: Mwanzo: C, E, F, kisha G wazi.

rows.source: A pickup is a few notes that lead into a strong beat. Here beat one is silent, and C, E and F lead into a long G.
rows.translation: Noti za utangulizi ni noti chache zinazoelekea kwenye pigo lenye mkazo. Hapa pigo la kwanza ni kimya, na C, E na F huongoza hadi G ndefu.

rows.source: The chorus: E E D C, then C E G G G F.
rows.translation: Kiitikio: E E D C, kisha C E G G G F.

rows.source: Amazing Grace is in three: count one, two, three, with the weight on one. Its notes sit on strings 4, 3 and 2.
rows.translation: Neema ya Ajabu ina mapigo matatu: hesabu moja, mbili, tatu, ukiweka mkazo kwenye moja. Noti zake ziko kwenye nyuzi 4, 3 na 2.

rows.source: How many beats are in each bar here?
rows.translation: Kuna mapigo mangapi katika kila kipimo hapa?

rows.source: A bar of three feels like a gentle sway: strong, weak, weak.
rows.translation: Kipimo cha mapigo matatu kinabembea taratibu: lenye mkazo, jepesi, jepesi.

rows.source: The opening: D, G, B G, B, A. Open strings 4, 3 and 2, plus A.
rows.translation: Mwanzo: D, G, B G, B, A. Nyuzi 4, 3 na 2 wazi, pamoja na A.

rows.source: Then down: G, E, D, D.
rows.translation: Kisha shuka: G, E, D, D.

rows.source: The high part: open B up to D at fret 3, then down through B, G and A.
rows.translation: Sehemu ya juu: B wazi hadi D freti 3, kisha shuka kupitia B, G na A.

rows.source: Halogen is a Timbre Original: desert rock in D minor. Its riff uses the notes you just learned: open D, F at fret 3, open G, and C on string 5, fret 3. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Halogen ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: desert rock katika D minori. Riff yake hutumia noti ulizojifunza: D wazi, F freti 3, G wazi, na C kwenye uzi 5, freti 3. Wimbo mzima uko kwenye Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.

rows.source: Open string 4, F at fret 3, open string 3, then C at fret 3 on string 5.
rows.translation: Uzi 4 wazi, F freti 3, uzi 3 wazi, kisha C freti 3 kwenye uzi 5.
Jaribio la nyuzi za sauti ya chini

rows.source: No new ideas: every note from C on string 5 up to G on string 1, plus both tunes. Keep your thumb low and your fingers arched.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: kila noti kutoka C kwenye uzi 5 hadi G kwenye uzi 1, pamoja na melodi zote mbili. Weka gumba chini na vidole vimepinda.

rows.source: C major from string 5, up to G on string 1.
rows.translation: C meja kutoka uzi 5, hadi G kwenye uzi 1.

rows.source: A mini F, D7, and two traditional songs with both chords and melody.
rows.translation: F ndogo, D7, na nyimbo mbili za jadi zenye kodi na melodi.

rows.source: This small F uses four strings. Finger 1 lies flat across strings 1 and 2 at fret 1, finger 2 goes on string 3, fret 2, and finger 3 on string 4, fret 3.
rows.translation: F hii ndogo hutumia nyuzi nne. Kidole 1 hulala juu ya nyuzi 1 na 2 kwenye freti 1, kidole 2 huwa kwenye uzi 3, freti 2, na kidole 3 kwenye uzi 4, freti 3.

rows.source: Tilt finger 1 slightly onto its thumb side. The bonier edge presses two strings more easily. Check that string 2 rings.
rows.translation: Geuza kidole 1 kidogo kuelekea upande wa gumba. Ukingo wenye mfupa zaidi hubonyeza nyuzi mbili kwa urahisi. Hakikisha uzi 2 unalia.

rows.source: This progression climbs step by step from A minor and lands on your new F. Strum twice per chord and change early.
rows.translation: Mfuatano huu hupanda hatua kwa hatua kutoka A minori hadi F yako mpya. Piga nyuzi mara mbili kwa kila kodi na ubadili mapema.

rows.source: This English tune is over 400 years old. Its chords are all ones you know: A minor, C, G, E minor, F and E. It's in three: strum once per bar, then on every beat.
rows.translation: Melodi hii ya Kiingereza ina zaidi ya miaka 400. Kodi zake zote unazijua: A minori, C, G, E minori, F na E. Ina mapigo matatu: piga nyuzi mara moja kwa kipimo, kisha kwa kila pigo.

rows.source: Which strings does the mini F leave silent?
rows.translation: F ndogo huacha nyuzi zipi bila kupigwa?

rows.source: The mini F starts on string 4. Begin your strum there and skip strings 5 and 6.
rows.translation: F ndogo huanza kwenye uzi 4. Anza kupiga nyuzi hapo na uruke nyuzi 5 na 6.

rows.source: A sharp raises a note by one fret. Greensleeves uses G sharp on string 3, fret 1, and F sharp on string 4, fret 4. Reach that one with your little finger.
rows.translation: Diesi hupandisha noti kwa freti moja. Greensleeves hutumia G diesi kwenye uzi 3, freti 1, na F diesi kwenye uzi 4, freti 4. Ifikie hiyo kwa kidole chako kidogo.

rows.source: G sharp, A, B: string 3 at frets 1 and 2, then open string 2.
rows.translation: G diesi, A, B: uzi 3 kwenye freti 1 na 2, kisha uzi 2 wazi.

rows.source: The opening: A, C D, E F E, D B.
rows.translation: Mwanzo: A, C D, E F E, D B.

rows.source: Sharp means one fret higher. G sharp sits between G and A.
rows.translation: Diesi humaanisha freti moja juu. G diesi iko kati ya G na A.

rows.source: The chorus starts high: G on string 1, fret 3, then F sharp at fret 2.
rows.translation: Kiitikio huanza juu: G kwenye uzi 1, freti 3, kisha F diesi freti 2.

rows.source: A seventh chord adds a note that pulls toward home. D7 wants to move to G. Fingers: 2 on string 3, fret 2; 1 on string 2, fret 1; 3 on string 1, fret 2.
rows.translation: Kodi ya saba huongeza noti inayovuta kuelekea noti msingi. D7 hutaka kuelekea G. Vidole: 2 kwenye uzi 3, freti 2; 1 kwenye uzi 2, freti 1; 3 kwenye uzi 1, freti 2.

rows.source: This American ballad from the 1880s needs only G and D7. It's in three, like Amazing Grace. Strum once per bar, then on every beat.
rows.translation: Baladi hii ya Marekani ya miaka ya 1880 inahitaji G na D7 tu. Ina mapigo matatu, kama Neema ya Ajabu. Piga nyuzi mara moja kwa kipimo, kisha kwa kila pigo.

rows.source: Clementine's melody sits on strings 4, 3 and 2. Its last line uses F sharp again: string 4, fret 4, little finger.
rows.translation: Melodi ya Clementine iko kwenye nyuzi 4, 3 na 2. Mstari wake wa mwisho hutumia F diesi tena: uzi 4, freti 4, kidole kidogo.

rows.source: The opening: G G G, down to open D, up to open B.
rows.translation: Mwanzo: G G G, shuka hadi D wazi, panda hadi B wazi.

rows.source: D7's extra note leans toward G. When G arrives, the tension lets go.
rows.translation: Noti ya ziada ya D7 huelekea G. G inapofika, mvutano unaisha.

rows.source: The last line: A, open D, F sharp at fret 4, A, then home to G.
rows.translation: Mstari wa mwisho: A, D wazi, F diesi freti 4, A, kisha rudi kwenye G msingi.

rows.source: Ghost Light is a Timbre Original: a slow, dark ballad. Its verse walks A minor, F, C and E, so your mini F gets a song, and the G sharp in E pulls the tune back home. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Ghost Light ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: baladi ya polepole yenye sauti ya giza. Ubeti hupitia A minori, F, C na E; F yako ndogo inapata wimbo, na G diesi katika E huvuta melodi kurudi kwenye noti msingi. Wimbo mzima uko kwenye Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.

rows.source: Listen to the verse's last chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Sikiliza kodi ya mwisho ya ubeti. Meja au minori?

rows.source: The ballad strum: one big strum on beat one and let it ring, another on three, then down-up on four. The space after each strum is part of the song.
rows.translation: Mpigo wa baladi: piga nyuzi kwa nguvu kwenye pigo la kwanza na uache zilie, piga tena kwenye tatu, kisha chini-juu kwenye nne. Nafasi baada ya kila mpigo ni sehemu ya wimbo.

rows.source: The verse's last line: open B, C at fret 1, B, G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, B, then open E.
rows.translation: Mstari wa mwisho wa ubeti: B wazi, C freti 1, B, G diesi freti 1 kwenye uzi 3, B, kisha E wazi.

rows.source: No new ideas: the mini F, D7 and both songs from this unit. Change chords early and let the melodies sing.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: F ndogo, D7 na nyimbo zote mbili za kitengo hiki. Badili kodi mapema na uache melodi ziimbe.

rows.source: Which chord pulls hardest toward G?
rows.translation: Kodi ipi huvuta zaidi kuelekea G?

rows.source: E7, A7, G7 and B7, sus chords, the shuffle and your first 12-bar blues.
rows.translation: E7, A7, G7 na B7, kodi sus, shuffle na blues yako ya kwanza ya vipimo 12.

rows.source: Play E, then lift finger 3 off string 4. The open D that rings is the seventh, a note that adds bluesy tension.
rows.translation: Piga E, kisha inua kidole 3 kutoka uzi 4. D wazi inayolia ni noti ya saba, inayoleta mvutano wa blues.
Kodi ipi ina noti ya saba?

rows.source: Play A, then lift finger 2 off string 3. Open G rings, and A becomes A7.
rows.translation: Piga A, kisha inua kidole 2 kutoka uzi 3. G wazi hulia, na A inakuwa A7.

rows.source: How do you turn E into E7 here?
G7 keeps the low G but puts F on top: finger 3 on string 6, fret 3; finger 2 on string 5, fret 2; finger 1 on string 1, fret 1.
rows.translation: G7 hubaki na G ya chini lakini huweka F juu: kidole 3 kwenye uzi 6, freti 3; kidole 2 kwenye uzi 5, freti 2; kidole 1 kwenye uzi 1, freti 1.

rows.source: Build B7 from string 5: finger 2 at fret 2, finger 1 on string 4, fret 1, finger 3 on string 3, fret 2, little finger on string 1, fret 2. String 2 rings open.
rows.translation: Jenga B7 kutoka uzi 5: kidole 2 freti 2, kidole 1 kwenye uzi 4, freti 1, kidole 3 kwenye uzi 3, freti 2, kidole kidogo kwenye uzi 1, freti 2. Uzi 2 hulia wazi.

rows.source: Which chord does B7 lead to most naturally?
rows.translation: B7 huelekea kodi ipi kwa urahisi zaidi?

rows.source: B7 pulls toward E. Its tension melts into E minor or E.
rows.translation: B7 huvuta kuelekea E. Mvutano wake huyeyuka katika E minori au E.

rows.source: A shuffle splits each beat unevenly: a long strum down, a short one up. It's the heartbeat of the blues. Think hum-pty, dum-pty.
rows.translation: Shuffle hugawa kila pigo kwa sehemu zisizo sawa: mpigo mrefu chini, mfupi juu. Ndiyo mapigo ya moyo wa blues. Fikiria hum-pty, dum-pty.

rows.source: In a shuffle, each beat splits into…
rows.translation: Katika shuffle, kila pigo hugawanyika kuwa…
Vipimo kumi na viwili vya blues

rows.source: Many blues songs follow one 12-bar plan. In E: four bars of E7, two of A7, two of E7, then one each of B7, A7, E7 and B7.
rows.translation: Nyimbo nyingi za blues hufuata mpangilio mmoja wa vipimo 12. Katika E: vipimo vinne vya E7, viwili vya A7, viwili vya E7, kisha kimoja kila moja kwa B7, A7, E7 na B7.

rows.source: How many bars of E7 open the 12-bar blues?
rows.translation: Blues ya vipimo 12 huanza na vipimo vingapi vya E7?

rows.source: The last four bars move faster: B7, A7, E7, then B7, which turns you around to the top. Change early and keep the shuffle going.
rows.translation: Vipimo vinne vya mwisho hubadilika haraka: B7, A7, E7, kisha B7, inayokurudisha mwanzo. Badili mapema na udumishe shuffle.

rows.source: A sus chord swaps the note that makes it major or minor for a neighbor. It sounds open and unresolved until it settles home.
rows.translation: Kodi sus hubadilisha noti inayoifanya iwe meja au minori kwa noti ya jirani. Husikika wazi na yenye mvutano hadi itulie kwenye msingi.

rows.source: Lift finger 2 off string 1 to get Dsus2. For Asus4, play A and add your little finger on string 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: Inua kidole 2 kutoka uzi 1 kupata Dsus2. Kwa Asus4, piga A na uongeze kidole kidogo kwenye uzi 2, freti 3.

rows.source: Rust Belt Shuffle is a Timbre Original: a 12-bar blues in E, the plan you just strummed, with a swung tune on top. Keep the long-short feel in both hands. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Rust Belt Shuffle ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: blues ya vipimo 12 katika E, mpangilio uliopiga sasa hivi, ukiwa na melodi ya swing juu yake. Dumisha hisia ya ndefu-fupi katika mikono yote miwili. Wimbo mzima uko kwenye Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.

rows.source: Open G, then G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, then open B: the bluesy slide in bar two.
rows.translation: G wazi, kisha G diesi freti 1 kwenye uzi 3, kisha B wazi: slide ya blues katika kipimo cha pili.

rows.source: Bar two slides from G to G sharp. Which one belongs to E7?
rows.translation: Kipimo cha pili huteleza kutoka G hadi G diesi. Ipi ni sehemu ya E7?

rows.source: E7 is E, G sharp, B and D. G is the blue note: it rubs against the chord, then slides into it.
rows.translation: E7 ni E, G diesi, B na D. G ni noti ya blues: huleta mvutano dhidi ya kodi, kisha huteleza kuingia ndani yake.

rows.source: Bar nine, over B7: F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, D sharp at fret 4 on string 2 with your little finger, then B.
rows.translation: Kipimo cha tisa, kwa B7: F diesi freti 2 uzi 1, E wazi, D diesi freti 4 uzi 2 kwa kidole kidogo, kisha B.
Kodi za saba, sus na shuffle

rows.source: No new ideas: seventh chords, sus chords and the 12-bar shuffle. Keep the long-short swing steady through every change.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: kodi za saba, kodi sus na shuffle ya vipimo 12. Dumisha swing ya ndefu-fupi katika kila badiliko.

rows.source: Which chord uses all four fingers?
rows.translation: Kodi ipi hutumia vidole vyote vinne?

rows.source: Power chords, open and movable, palm muting and a riff of your own.
rows.translation: Kodi za tano, wazi na zinazohamishika, kufifisha kwa kiganja na riff yako mwenyewe.

rows.source: A power chord plays only the root and the fifth, the note five letters up. Neither major nor minor, it stays punchy, even loud. E5 is the bottom of E minor.
rows.translation: Kodi ya tano hupiga noti msingi na ya tano tu, iliyo herufi tano juu. Si meja wala minori; ina nguvu hata ikipigwa kwa sauti kubwa. E5 ni sehemu ya chini ya E minori.

rows.source: Move the same two fingers to strings 4 and 3. With open string 5, that's A5. Aim your strum at strings 5, 4 and 3 only.
rows.translation: Hamishia vidole vilevile viwili kwenye nyuzi 4 na 3. Pamoja na uzi 5 wazi, hiyo ni A5. Piga nyuzi 5, 4 na 3 pekee.

rows.source: Which notes make a power chord?
rows.translation: Ni noti zipi huunda kodi ya tano?

rows.source: Rest the edge of your hand
Lay the outer edge of your picking hand on the strings, right where they meet the bridge. Strum, and the notes turn short and chunky.
rows.translation: Laza ukingo wa nje wa mkono wa kupiga kwenye nyuzi, pale zinapokutana na daraja la nyuzi. Piga nyuzi; noti zinakuwa fupi na nzito.

rows.source: Where does your palm rest for palm muting?
rows.translation: Kiganja hukaa wapi unapofifisha sauti kwa kiganja?

rows.source: At the bridge the strings still sound, just shorter. Move forward and they go dead.
rows.translation: Kwenye daraja la nyuzi bado kuna sauti, lakini fupi zaidi. Ukisogeza mkono mbele, nyuzi hunyamaza.

rows.source: Rock often builds with muted eighths, then lands on an open chord. Lift your palm for the big strum and let it ring.
rows.translation: Rock mara nyingi hujenga msisimko kwa noti za nane zilizofifishwa, kisha hutua kwenye kodi inayolia wazi. Inua kiganja kwa mpigo mkubwa na uache ilie.

rows.source: Finger 1 on string 6, fret 3, then fingers 3 and 4 two frets higher on strings 5 and 4. That's G5. Slide it and the name follows the fret.
rows.translation: Kidole 1 kwenye uzi 6, freti 3, kisha vidole 3 na 4 freti mbili juu kwenye nyuzi 5 na 4. Hiyo ni G5. Hamisha umbo; jina hufuata freti.

rows.source: Your root is on string 6, fret 5. Which power chord is it?
rows.translation: Noti msingi iko kwenye uzi 6, freti 5. Ni kodi gani ya tano?

rows.source: Count up string 6: E open, F at 1, G at 3, A at 5.
rows.translation: Hesabu ukipanda uzi 6: E wazi, F kwenye 1, G kwenye 3, A kwenye 5.

rows.source: The same shape works from string 5. Finger 1 on string 5, fret 3 gives C5. Let the tip of finger 1 touch string 6 to keep it quiet.
rows.translation: Umbo lilelile hutumika kuanzia uzi 5. Kidole 1 kwenye uzi 5, freti 3 hutoa C5. Ncha ya kidole 1 iguse uzi 6 ili usilie.

rows.source: A riff is a short, catchy phrase that repeats. This one bounces off open low E. Rest your palm at the bridge to keep it tight.
rows.translation: Riff ni kishazi kifupi, cha kuvutia, kinachorudiwa. Hii hurudia E ya chini iliyo wazi. Laza kiganja kwenye daraja la nyuzi ili sauti iwe fupi na thabiti.

rows.source: Open E, string 6 at fret 3, then open A.
rows.translation: E wazi, uzi 6 freti 3, kisha A wazi.

rows.source: The second bar climbs string 5: fret 2, then fret 5 with your little finger, then back to fret 2. Keep finger 1 parked near fret 2.
rows.translation: Kipimo cha pili hupanda uzi 5: freti 2, kisha freti 5 kwa kidole kidogo, kisha rudi freti 2. Weka kidole 1 karibu na freti 2.

rows.source: String 5: fret 2, fret 5 with your little finger, fret 2 again.
rows.translation: Uzi 5: freti 2, freti 5 kwa kidole kidogo, freti 2 tena.

rows.source: What makes a riff a riff?
Songs often answer a riff with power chords. Play the riff, then hit the chords on one, the and of two, and four.
rows.translation: Nyimbo mara nyingi hujibu riff kwa kodi za tano. Piga riff, kisha piga kodi kwenye moja, na ya mbili, na nne.

rows.source: Slide G5 up two frets. What do you get?
rows.translation: Hamisha G5 freti mbili juu. Unapata nini?

rows.source: Two frets above G is A. The chord's name moves with its root.
rows.translation: Freti mbili juu ya G ni A. Jina la kodi husogea na noti yake msingi.

rows.source: Basement Weather is a Timbre Original: garage rock in A. A riff on the low strings opens it, then power chords punch back on one, the and of two, and four. Keep your palm at the bridge. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Basement Weather ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: garage rock katika A. Riff ya nyuzi za chini huanza, kisha kodi za tano hujibu kwa nguvu kwenye moja, na ya mbili, na nne. Weka kiganja kwenye daraja la nyuzi. Wimbo mzima uko kwenye Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.

rows.source: Open A, C at fret 3 on string 5, open D, then G at fret 3 on string 6 and open low E.
rows.translation: A wazi, C freti 3 kwenye uzi 5, D wazi, kisha G freti 3 kwenye uzi 6 na E ya chini wazi.

rows.source: You know C5, with finger 1 on string 5, fret 3. Slide the whole shape up two frets and it becomes D5. G5 sits at fret 3 too, one string lower than C5.
rows.translation: Unaijua C5, kidole 1 kwenye uzi 5, freti 3. Hamisha umbo zima freti mbili juu liwe D5. G5 pia iko freti 3, uzi mmoja wa sauti ya chini zaidi kuliko C5.

rows.source: No new ideas: power chords, open and movable, palm muting and your riff. Lock in with the click and keep the mutes tight.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: kodi za tano, wazi na zinazohamishika, kufifisha kwa kiganja na riff yako. Endana na mlio wa metronome na ufifishe kwa udhibiti.

rows.source: Your root is on string 5, fret 3. Which power chord is it?
rows.translation: Noti msingi iko kwenye uzi 5, freti 3. Ni kodi gani ya tano?

rows.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3.
rows.translation: Uzi 5 huhesabiwa kupanda kutoka A: B kwenye 2, C kwenye 3.

rows.source: Which one is a power chord?
The F barre and B minor, the A minor pentatonic scale and your first solo.
rows.translation: F ya bare na B minori, skeli ya pentatoniki ya A minori na solo yako ya kwanza.

rows.source: Full barre chords take weeks, so build up to them. You know the mini F. Next comes a five-string F, then the full barre.
rows.translation: Kodi kamili za bare huchukua wiki kujifunza, kwa hiyo zifikie hatua kwa hatua. Unaijua F ndogo. Inafuata F ya nyuzi tano, kisha bare kamili.

rows.source: Move finger 3 to string 5, fret 3, and put your little finger on string 4, fret 3. Five strings ring and the F sounds fuller.
rows.translation: Hamishia kidole 3 kwenye uzi 5, freti 3, na weka kidole kidogo kwenye uzi 4, freti 3. Nyuzi tano hulia na F inakuwa na sauti iliyojaa zaidi.

rows.source: Barre chords feel hard at first. What helps most?
rows.translation: Kodi za bare ni ngumu mwanzoni. Nini husaidia zaidi?

rows.source: Squeezing as hard as you can
Strength and feel build slowly. Short, daily practice beats one long, painful session.
rows.translation: Nguvu na uzoefu wa mguso hujengeka polepole. Mazoezi mafupi ya kila siku ni bora kuliko kipindi kimoja kirefu chenye maumivu.

rows.source: Lay finger 1 flat across all six strings at fret 1. Fingers 2, 3 and 4 make an E shape in front of it. F is E moved up one fret.
rows.translation: Laza kidole 1 juu ya nyuzi zote sita kwenye freti 1. Vidole 2, 3 na 4 huunda umbo la E mbele yake. F ni E iliyosogezwa freti moja juu.

rows.source: Let your arm's weight pull the barre in, as if gently drawing the neck toward you. Your thumb only steadies. Roll finger 1 onto its side.
rows.translation: Acha uzito wa mkono uvute bare ndani, kama unavuta shingo kwako taratibu. Gumba husaidia tu kuimarisha. Geuza kidole 1 kiwe kwenye ubavu wake.

rows.source: The F barre is which open shape, moved up a fret?
rows.translation: Bare ya F ni umbo gani wazi lililohamishwa freti moja juu?

rows.source: Finger 1 barres strings 1 to 5 at fret 2. Fingers 2, 3 and 4 build an A minor shape two frets higher. Skip string 6.
rows.translation: Kidole 1 hufanya bare kwenye nyuzi 1 hadi 5, freti 2. Vidole 2, 3 na 4 huunda umbo la A minori freti mbili juu. Ruka uzi 6.

rows.source: Not ready to barre? Play the top four strings only: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: Hujawa tayari kwa bare? Piga nyuzi nne za juu tu: freti 4 kwenye nyuzi 4 na 3, freti 3 kwenye uzi 2, freti 2 kwenye uzi 1.

rows.source: Which chord is E moved up one fret with a barre?
rows.translation: Ni kodi gani iliyo E iliyohamishwa freti moja juu kwa bare?

rows.source: The minor pentatonic scale has five notes. In A minor they're A, C, D, E and G. It's the sound of countless blues and rock solos.
rows.translation: Skeli ya pentatoniki minori ina noti tano. Katika A minori ni A, C, D, E na G. Ndiyo sauti ya solo nyingi sana za blues na rock.

rows.source: Finger 1 covers fret 5 on every string. Fingers 3 and 4 take frets 7 and 8. Two notes per string, one finger per fret.
rows.translation: Kidole 1 hushika freti 5 kwenye kila uzi. Vidole 3 na 4 hushika freti 7 na 8. Noti mbili kwa kila uzi, kidole kimoja kwa kila freti.

rows.source: Fret 5, fret 8 on string 6, then fret 5, fret 7 on string 5.
rows.translation: Freti 5, freti 8 kwenye uzi 6, kisha freti 5, freti 7 kwenye uzi 5.

rows.source: Which notes are in A minor pentatonic?
rows.translation: Ni noti zipi ziko katika pentatoniki ya A minori?

rows.source: A solo is a melody built from short phrases. Play a few notes, leave a gap, then answer. Ending on A, the root, sounds like a full stop.
rows.translation: Solo ni melodi iliyojengwa kwa vishazi vifupi. Piga noti chache, acha nafasi, kisha jibu. Kumalizia kwenye A, noti msingi, husikika kama nukta.

rows.source: Which note sounds most like a full stop in A minor?
rows.translation: Noti ipi husikika zaidi kama nukta katika A minori?

rows.source: A is the root, the home of A minor. Ending a phrase on it sounds finished.
rows.translation: A ni noti msingi ya A minori. Kumalizia kishazi hapo hukifanya kisikike kimekamilika.

rows.source: A power ballad with a barre

Glass Satellites is a Timbre Original: a power ballad on A minor, F, C and G. Your full F barre takes the second chord, and box 1 fits over the whole loop, so it gets a solo. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Glass Satellites ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: baladi yenye nguvu kwa A minori, F, C na G. Bare yako kamili ya F ni kodi ya pili, na umbo 1 linafaa mzunguko mzima, hivyo linapata solo. Wimbo mzima uko kwenye Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.

rows.source: Over the F chord, which box-1 notes belong to it?
rows.translation: Kwa kodi F, ni noti zipi za umbo-1 zilizo sehemu yake?

rows.source: F is F, A and C. Box 1 holds A and C, so they sound settled over F.
rows.translation: F ni F, A na C. Umbo 1 lina A na C, kwa hiyo husikika zimetulia zikipigwa pamoja na F.

rows.source: No new ideas: barre chords, B minor, the pentatonic box and your solo. Breathe, keep the beat, and play it like you mean it.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: kodi za bare, B minori, umbo la pentatoniki na solo yako. Pumua, dumisha mapigo na upige kwa hisia.

rows.source: Which finger covers fret 5 in box 1?
rows.translation: Kidole gani hushika freti 5 katika umbo 1?

rows.source: Thumb on the bass, p-i-m-a, Travis picking and a fingerpicked ballad.
rows.translation: Gumba kwenye besi, p-i-m-a, mtindo wa Travis na baladi inayopigwa kwa vidole.

rows.source: Fingerpicking means plucking with your fingers instead of a pick. Your thumb owns the bass strings, 6, 5 and 4, and plays on the beat like a bass drum.
rows.translation: Kupiga kwa vidole ni kupiga nyuzi kwa vidole badala ya kijiti cha kupigia. Gumba hushughulikia nyuzi za besi, 6, 5 na 4, na hupiga kwa kila pigo kama ngoma ya besi.

rows.source: Thumb only: push down through strings 6, 5 and 4, one at a time.
rows.translation: Gumba pekee: sukuma chini kupitia nyuzi 6, 5 na 4, mmoja mmoja.

rows.source: Which strings does your thumb usually play?
rows.translation: Gumba kwa kawaida hupiga nyuzi zipi?

rows.source: The thumb takes the bass strings. Your fingers take the thinner ones.
rows.translation: Gumba hushughulikia nyuzi za besi. Vidole vingine hushughulikia nyuzi nyembamba.

rows.source: Hold A minor. Your thumb plays the root on string 5, then rocks over to string 4, the chord's fifth. Root, fifth, root, fifth: that's an alternating bass.
rows.translation: Shikilia A minori. Gumba hupiga noti msingi kwenye uzi 5, kisha huhamia uzi 4, noti ya tano ya kodi. Msingi, tano, msingi, tano: hiyo ni besi ya kupokezana.

rows.source: Fingerstyle borrows Spanish names: p for the thumb, i index, m middle, a ring. Rest i on string 3, m on string 2 and a on string 1, ready to pluck.
rows.translation: Fingerstyle hukopa majina ya Kihispania: p ni gumba, i shahada, m cha kati, a cha pete. Weka i kwenye uzi 3, m kwenye uzi 2 na a kwenye uzi 1, tayari kupiga.

rows.source: i, m, a: index on string 3, middle on 2, ring on 1.
rows.translation: i, m, a: shahada kwenye uzi 3, cha kati kwenye 2, cha pete kwenye 1.

rows.source: p thumb, i index, m middle, a ring. The little finger usually rests.
rows.translation: p gumba, i shahada, m cha kati, a cha pete. Kidole kidogo kwa kawaida hupumzika.

rows.source: Each finger plucks up and slightly toward your palm, then relaxes. Keep your hand still above the strings and let the fingers do the moving.
rows.translation: Kila kidole hupiga juu na kidogo kuelekea kiganjani, kisha hulegea. Weka mkono umetulia juu ya nyuzi na uache vidole vifanye mwendo.

rows.source: Travis picking, named after Merle Travis, keeps the thumb alternating on every beat while the fingers pluck in between, on the ands.
rows.translation: Mtindo wa Travis, uliopewa jina la Merle Travis, hufanya gumba lipokezane kwenye kila pigo huku vidole vikipiga katikati, kwenye na.

rows.source: In Travis picking, what does the thumb do?
rows.translation: Katika mtindo wa Travis, gumba hufanya nini?
Hupiga kwenye pigo la kwanza tu

rows.source: Alternates bass notes on every beat
rows.translation: Hupokezana noti za besi kila pigo

rows.source: The thumb is the steady pulse: a bass note on every beat, rocking between two strings.
rows.translation: Gumba ndilo mpigo thabiti: noti ya besi kwa kila pigo, ikipokezana kati ya nyuzi mbili.

rows.source: Keep the thumb going. Between thumb notes, m plucks string 2 and i plucks string 3: thumb, m, thumb, i. Go slowly until it runs by itself.
rows.translation: Endelea na gumba. Kati ya noti za gumba, m hupiga uzi 2 na i hupiga uzi 3: gumba, m, gumba, i. Piga polepole hadi uzoee.

rows.source: Between thumb notes, which finger plucks string 2?
rows.translation: Kati ya noti za gumba, kidole gani hupiga uzi 2?

rows.source: In this pattern m takes string 2 and i takes string 3. The a finger rests for now.
rows.translation: Katika mpangilio huu m hupiga uzi 2 na i hupiga uzi 3. Kidole a hupumzika kwa sasa.

rows.source: When the chord changes, the thumb lands on the new root right on beat one. The fingers keep plucking strings 2 and 3 as before.
rows.translation: Kodi inapobadilika, gumba hutua kwenye noti mpya msingi hasa kwenye pigo la kwanza. Vidole vinaendelea kupiga nyuzi 2 na 3 kama awali.

rows.source: The chord changes. Where does your thumb go?

rows.translation: Kwenye noti msingi ya kodi mpya

rows.source: The bass tells the ear which chord you're on. Landing the root on beat one makes the change clear.
rows.translation: Besi huliambia sikio uko kwenye kodi gani. Kutua kwenye noti msingi kwa pigo la kwanza hufanya badiliko lisikike wazi.

rows.source: Hold each chord for the whole bar so every note rings into the next. Lift a finger only when the next shape needs it.
rows.translation: Shikilia kila kodi kwa kipimo kizima ili kila noti iendelee kulia hadi inayofuata. Inua kidole pale tu umbo linalofuata linapokihitaji.

rows.source: An arpeggio plays a chord one note at a time. This one rolls p, i, m, a, then back down m, i. Six notes fill a bar of three, two to a beat.
rows.translation: Arpeggio hupiga kodi noti moja moja. Hii hupitia p, i, m, a, kisha hushuka m, i. Noti sita hujaza kipimo cha mapigo matatu, mbili kwa kila pigo.

rows.source: After a plucks string 1, which finger comes next?
rows.translation: Baada ya a kupiga uzi 1, kidole gani hufuata?

rows.source: The roll turns around at the top: p, i, m, a, then m and i on the way back.
rows.translation: Mfuatano hugeuka unapofika juu: p, i, m, a, kisha m na i unaporudi.

rows.source: One bar each: A minor, F, C, G, then A minor, F, E, A minor. Your thumb finds each new root: strings 5, 4, 5 and 6.
rows.translation: Kipimo kimoja kila kodi: A minori, F, C, G, kisha A minori, F, E, A minori. Gumba hupata kila noti mpya msingi: nyuzi 5, 4, 5 na 6.

rows.source: Porchlight is a Timbre Original: a slow ballad in D. Fingerpick it: your thumb on each chord's root, then i, m and a up strings 3, 2 and 1. Let every note ring into the next. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Porchlight ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: baladi ya polepole katika D. Piga kwa vidole: gumba kwenye noti msingi ya kila kodi, kisha i, m na a kupanda nyuzi 3, 2 na 1. Acha kila noti ilie hadi inayofuata. Wimbo mzima uko kwenye Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.

rows.source: In D, which string does your thumb play?
rows.translation: Katika D, gumba hupiga uzi gani?

rows.source: D's root is open string 4. Strings 5 and 6 stay quiet in this chord.
rows.translation: Noti msingi ya D ni uzi 4 wazi. Nyuzi 5 na 6 hazipigwi katika kodi hii.

rows.source: No new ideas: the alternating bass, p-i-m-a, Travis picking and the ballad. Keep the thumb steady and let every note ring.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: besi ya kupokezana, p-i-m-a, mtindo wa Travis na baladi. Dumisha gumba kwa mwendo thabiti na uache kila noti ilie.

rows.source: In p-i-m-a, which letter is the thumb?
rows.translation: Katika p-i-m-a, herufi gani ni gumba?

rows.source: Between thumb notes, which finger plucks string 3?
rows.translation: Kati ya noti za gumba, kidole gani hupiga uzi 3?

rows.source: The 12-bar in A, the quick change, a boogie bass line, the turnaround and your first blues licks.
rows.translation: Vipimo 12 katika A, badiliko la mapema, mstari wa besi wa boogie, kurudi mwanzo na vishazi vyako vya kwanza vya blues.

rows.source: Blues chords sit on the first, fourth and fifth notes of the key. In E that's E7, A7 and B7. Move to the key of A and they become A7, D7 and E7.
rows.translation: Kodi za blues hujengwa kwenye noti ya kwanza, ya nne na ya tano ya ufunguo. Katika E ni E7, A7 na B7. Hamia ufunguo wa A ziwe A7, D7 na E7.

rows.source: In the key of A, which chord does the job B7 did in E?
rows.translation: Katika ufunguo wa A, ni kodi gani hufanya kazi ya B7 katika E?

rows.source: B7 is five letters up from E. Five letters up from A is E, so E7 takes its place.
rows.translation: B7 iko herufi tano juu ya E. Herufi tano juu ya A ni E, kwa hiyo E7 huchukua nafasi yake.
Vipimo kumi na viwili katika A

rows.source: Four bars of A7, two of D7, two of A7, then one each of E7, D7, A7 and E7. The last E7 turns you back to the top.
rows.translation: Vipimo vinne vya A7, viwili vya D7, viwili vya A7, kisha kimoja kila moja kwa E7, D7, A7 na E7. E7 ya mwisho hukurudisha mwanzo.

rows.source: In a quick change, bar 2 jumps to the four chord and straight back. In A: A7, D7, A7, A7. It adds motion right from the start.
rows.translation: Katika badiliko la mapema, kipimo 2 hurukia kodi ya nne kisha hurudi mara moja. Katika A: A7, D7, A7, A7. Hilo huleta mwendo tangu mwanzo.

rows.source: In a quick change in A, which chord is bar 2?
rows.translation: Katika badiliko la mapema katika A, kipimo 2 kina kodi gani?

rows.source: The four chord in A is D7. The quick change visits it in bar 2, then returns to A7.
rows.translation: Kodi ya nne katika A ni D7. Badiliko la mapema huifikia katika kipimo 2, kisha hurudi A7.

rows.source: The quick change works in any key. In E: E7, A7, E7, E7. Watch for B7 near the end, your four-finger chord.
rows.translation: Badiliko la mapema hufanya kazi katika ufunguo wowote. Katika E: E7, A7, E7, E7. Angalia B7 karibu na mwisho, kodi yako ya vidole vinne.

rows.source: A boogie line walks up the chord and back, each note twice, long-short like the shuffle. Over A7 it climbs A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, then walks back down.
rows.translation: Mstari wa boogie hupanda kodi na kurudi, kila noti mara mbili, ndefu-fupi kama shuffle. Kwa A7 hupanda A, C diesi, E, F diesi, G, kisha hushuka tena.

rows.source: Open A, fret 4 on string 5, frets 2 and 4 on string 4, then open G.
rows.translation: A wazi, freti 4 kwenye uzi 5, freti 2 na 4 kwenye uzi 4, kisha G wazi.

rows.source: How do the two notes of each pair feel?
rows.translation: Noti mbili za kila jozi zina mwendo gani?

rows.source: It's the shuffle again: a long note on the beat, a short one just before the next.
rows.translation: Ni shuffle tena: noti ndefu kwenye pigo, na fupi kabla kidogo ya linalofuata.

rows.source: Move it to D and E
The same walk starts from D on string 4 and from E on string 6. Over D7: D, F sharp, A, B, C. Over E7: E, G sharp, B, C sharp, D.
rows.translation: Mwendo uleule huanza kutoka D kwenye uzi 4 na E kwenye uzi 6. Kwa D7: D, F diesi, A, B, C. Kwa E7: E, G diesi, B, C diesi, D.

rows.source: Boogie, A to D and back
rows.translation: Boogie, A hadi D na kurudi

rows.source: A lick that turns you around
Bars 11 and 12 often get a turnaround, a short lick that leads back to the top. This one walks down from A to E, one fret at a time.
rows.translation: Vipimo 11 na 12 mara nyingi huwa na kishazi kifupi kinachorudisha mwanzo. Hiki hushuka kutoka A hadi E, freti moja moja.

rows.source: String 4: fret 4, then 3, then 2. Let the E ring.
rows.translation: Uzi 4: freti 4, kisha 3, kisha 2. Acha E ilie.

rows.source: Where does a turnaround usually go?
rows.translation: Kishazi cha kurudi mwanzo huwa wapi kwa kawaida?

rows.source: The last two bars. It leads the ear back to bar 1 for another time around.
rows.translation: Vipimo viwili vya mwisho. Huelekeza sikio kurudi kipimo 1 kwa mzunguko mwingine.

rows.source: Strum the first ten bars with the quick change, then switch to the lick for bars 11 and 12. That's how a blues band ends each time around.
rows.translation: Piga nyuzi kwa vipimo kumi vya kwanza ukiweka badiliko la mapema, kisha piga kishazi katika vipimo 11 na 12. Hivyo ndivyo bendi ya blues humaliza kila mzunguko.

rows.source: Your A minor pentatonic box fits right over a blues in A. Its C rubs against the C sharp in A7, and that rub is the sound of the blues.
rows.translation: Umbo lako la pentatoniki ya A minori linafaa kabisa kwenye blues katika A. C yake huleta mvutano dhidi ya C diesi katika A7, na huo ndio mvuto wa sauti ya blues.

rows.source: Over a blues in A, which note sounds most like home?
rows.translation: Katika blues ya A, noti ipi husikika zaidi kama msingi?

rows.source: A is the root of the key. Licks that end on A sound settled; G and C leave you hanging.
rows.translation: A ni noti msingi ya ufunguo. Vishazi vinavyoishia A husikika vimetulia; G na C huacha mvutano.

rows.source: Blues phrases talk to each other. Play lick 1 as the question, then answer with lick 2, which lands on the low A.
rows.translation: Vishazi vya blues huzungumza. Piga kishazi 1 kama swali, kisha jibu kwa kishazi 2, kinachotua kwenye A ya chini.
Vishazi vya blues, kwa kasi kamili

rows.source: Neon Laundromat is a Timbre Original: funk that sits on one chord, A7. Its hook slides from C to C sharp, the same rub your blues licks make, and its chorus drops to E7. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Neon Laundromat ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: funk inayokaa kwenye kodi moja, A7. Kishazi chake cha kuvutia huteleza kutoka C hadi C diesi, mvutano uleule wa vishazi vyako vya blues, na kiitikio hushukia E7. Wimbo mzima uko kwenye Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, then C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2, then open E.
rows.translation: A freti 2 kwenye uzi 3, kisha C na C diesi freti 1 na 2 kwenye uzi 2, kisha E wazi.

rows.source: Over A7, which note rubs against the chord?
rows.translation: Kwa A7, ni noti gani huleta mvutano dhidi ya kodi?

rows.source: A7 is A, C sharp, E and G. C, from your pentatonic box, rubs against its C sharp, and the hook slides from one to the other.
rows.translation: A7 ni A, C diesi, E na G. C ya umbo lako la pentatoniki huleta mvutano dhidi ya C diesi yake, na kishazi cha kuvutia huteleza kati yake.

rows.source: Neon Laundromat doesn't shuffle. Play your boogie walk in even eighths and it becomes a bass line under the A7: A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, and back down.
rows.translation: Neon Laundromat haina shuffle. Piga mwendo wako wa boogie kwa noti za nane sawa uwe mstari wa besi chini ya A7: A, C diesi, E, F diesi, G, kisha shuka tena.
Vipimo kumi na viwili, kwa namna yako

rows.source: No new ideas: the 12-bar in A and E, the quick change, the boogie line, the turnaround and your licks. Keep the shuffle swinging.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: vipimo 12 katika A na E, badiliko la mapema, mstari wa boogie, kurudi mwanzo na vishazi vyako. Dumisha mwendo wa shuffle.

rows.source: In a quick change in E, which chord is bar 2?
rows.translation: Katika badiliko la mapema katika E, kipimo 2 kina kodi gani?

rows.source: Hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, bends and vibrato, and a second pentatonic box.
rows.translation: Hammer-on, pull-off, slide, bend na vibrato, na umbo la pili la pentatoniki.

rows.source: A hammer-on sounds a second note with the fretting hand alone. Pick a note, then bring another finger down hard, just behind a higher fret. The string keeps ringing.
rows.translation: Hammer-on hutoa noti ya pili kwa mkono wa freti pekee. Piga noti, kisha tushia kidole kingine kwa nguvu nyuma kidogo ya freti iliyo juu zaidi. Uzi huendelea kulia.

rows.source: Pick open string 3, then hammer finger 2 onto fret 2. Don't pick the second note.
rows.translation: Piga uzi 3 wazi, kisha tushia kidole 2 kwenye freti 2. Usiupige uzi tena kwa noti ya pili.

rows.source: String 3: pick fret 5 with finger 1, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 7.
rows.translation: Uzi 3: shika freti 5 kwa kidole 1 na upige uzi; kisha tushia kidole 3 kwenye freti 7.

rows.source: What makes a hammer-on ring clearly?

rows.translation: Kupiga uzi kwa nguvu kwa noti zote mbili

rows.source: A fast, firm landing right behind the fret
rows.translation: Kutua haraka na imara nyuma tu ya freti

rows.source: Speed and aim matter more than force. Land on the fingertip, right behind the fret, and the string keeps singing.
rows.translation: Kasi na kulenga ni muhimu kuliko nguvu. Tua kwa ncha ya kidole nyuma tu ya freti, na uzi utaendelea kuimba.

rows.source: A pull-off drops to a lower note. With both fingers down, pick the higher note, then flick the top finger off sideways so it plucks the string as it leaves.
rows.translation: Pull-off hushuka kwenye noti ya chini zaidi. Vidole vyote viwili vikiwa vimebonyeza, piga noti ya juu, kisha ondoa kidole cha juu kwa kukivuta pembeni ili kiupige uzi kinapoondoka.

rows.source: Fret 2 on string 3, then flick finger 2 off to sound open G.
rows.translation: Freti 2 kwenye uzi 3, kisha vuta kidole 2 pembeni na kukiondoa ili G wazi ilie.

rows.source: Fingers 1 and 3 on frets 5 and 7. Pick, then pull finger 3 off.
rows.translation: Vidole 1 na 3 kwenye freti 5 na 7. Piga uzi, kisha ondoa kidole 3 kwa pull-off.

rows.source: In a pull-off, the top finger…
Flicks off sideways, plucking the string
Lifting straight up lets the note die. A small sideways flick plucks the lower note into life.
rows.translation: Kuinua moja kwa moja hukatisha sauti. Kuvuta kidole kidogo pembeni huifanya noti ya chini ilie.

rows.source: To slide, pick a note and keep pressing as you glide the same finger to a new fret. The pressure carries the sound; only the first note is picked.
rows.translation: Kufanya slide, piga noti na uendelee kubonyeza ukitelezesha kidole kilekile hadi freti mpya. Kubonyeza hudumisha sauti; unapiga uzi kwa noti ya kwanza tu.

rows.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 7. Pick, then slide up to fret 9 without lifting.
rows.translation: Kidole 3 kwenye uzi 3, freti 7. Piga uzi, kisha teleza juu hadi freti 9 bila kuinua.

rows.source: During a slide, what keeps the note sounding?
rows.translation: Wakati wa slide, nini huifanya noti iendelee kulia?

rows.source: Ease off and the note dies. Keep the same pressure all the way to the new fret.
rows.translation: Ukipunguza mbano, sauti hukatika. Bonyeza kwa nguvu ileile hadi freti mpya.

rows.source: Now back: pick fret 9 and slide down to fret 7.
rows.translation: Sasa rudi: piga freti 9 na uteleze chini hadi freti 7.

rows.source: A bend pushes the string across the fret to raise its pitch. A whole-step bend, the size of two frets, from fret 7 must sound exactly like fret 9.
rows.translation: Bend husukuma uzi pembeni kwenye freti ili kupandisha kimo cha sauti. Bend ya toni nzima, sawa na freti mbili, kutoka freti 7 lazima isikike sawa kabisa na freti 9.

rows.source: String 3, fret 9: this is your bend target. Let it ring and remember it.
rows.translation: Uzi 3, freti 9: hii ndiyo noti lengwa ya bend. Acha ilie na uikumbuke.

rows.source: Put finger 3 on fret 7 with fingers 1 and 2 behind it on the same string. Push all three toward the ceiling, turning your wrist as if turning a doorknob.
rows.translation: Weka kidole 3 kwenye freti 7, vidole 1 na 2 nyuma yake kwenye uzi huohuo. Sukuma vyote vitatu kuelekea darini, ukizungusha kifundo kama unazungusha kitasa cha mlango.

rows.source: Your bend from fret 7 sounds lower than fret 9. What now?
rows.translation: Bend kutoka freti 7 inasikika chini kuliko freti 9. Ufanye nini?

rows.source: A bend that falls short sounds sour. Push until it matches the target you heard.
rows.translation: Bend isiyofika noti lengwa husikika haipatani. Sukuma hadi ilingane na noti lengwa uliyosikia.

rows.source: Target, then a short bend. Same note or different?
rows.translation: Noti lengwa, kisha bend isiyofika juu vya kutosha. Noti ileile au tofauti?

rows.source: Vibrato is a small bend and release, repeated quickly on a held note. Keep it narrow and even so the note stays in tune.
rows.translation: Vibrato ni bend ndogo na kuachia, ukirudia haraka kwenye noti inayoshikiliwa. Mwendo uwe mdogo na sawa ili noti ibaki katika kimo sahihi.

rows.source: The same five notes repeat up the neck. Box 2 starts where box 1 ends: finger 1 at fret 7 on strings 5, 4 and 3, finger 2 at fret 8 on strings 6, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Noti zilezile tano hurudiwa juu ya shingo. Umbo 2 huanza umbo 1 linapoishia: kidole 1 freti 7 kwenye nyuzi 5, 4 na 3, kidole 2 freti 8 kwenye nyuzi 6, 2 na 1.

rows.source: String 6: frets 8 and 10. String 5: frets 7 and 10.
rows.translation: Uzi 6: freti 8 na 10. Uzi 5: freti 7 na 10.
Ni noti zipi ziko katika umbo 2?

rows.source: The same five notes as box 1, A C D E G, in a new place on the neck.
rows.translation: Noti tano zilezile za umbo 1, A C D E G, mahali papya kwenye shingo.

rows.source: To travel from box 1 to box 2, slide finger 3 from fret 7 to fret 9 on string 3. You arrive in box 2 with your hand already in place.
rows.translation: Kutoka umbo 1 hadi umbo 2, telezesha kidole 3 kutoka freti 7 hadi freti 9 kwenye uzi 3. Unafika umbo 2 mkono ukiwa tayari mahali pake.
Solo juu ya mdundo wa reggae

rows.source: Saltwater Sunday is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae in A minor, where Am7 and D7 trade bars. Both pentatonic boxes fit over them. Hammer, pull and slide, and land on a chord note as each bar begins. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Saltwater Sunday ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: reggae tulivu katika A minori, Am7 na D7 zikipokezana vipimo. Maumbo yote mawili ya pentatoniki yanafaa. Fanya hammer-on, pull-off na slide; tua kwenye noti ya kodi kila kipimo kinapoanza. Wimbo mzima uko Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.

rows.source: Over D7, which of these box notes belongs to the chord?
rows.translation: Kwa D7, ni noti ipi ya maumbo haya iliyo sehemu ya kodi?

rows.source: D7 is D, F sharp, A and C. C, its seventh, sounds settled; E and G only pass through.
rows.translation: D7 ni D, F diesi, A na C. C, noti yake ya saba, husikika imetulia; E na G hupita tu.

rows.source: Your break over Am7 and D7
rows.translation: Solo yako kwa Am7 na D7

rows.source: No new ideas: hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, bend targets, vibrato and both boxes. Play each phrase cleanly, then make it sing.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: hammer-on, pull-off, slide, noti lengwa za bend, vibrato na maumbo yote mawili. Piga kila kishazi kwa usafi, kisha kifanye kiimbe.

rows.source: A whole-step bend from fret 7 should match…
rows.translation: Bend ya toni nzima kutoka freti 7 ilingane na…

rows.source: Target, then a bend. Same note or different?
rows.translation: Noti lengwa, kisha bend. Noti ileile au tofauti?

rows.source: E and A shapes up the neck, major and minor, the closer shape, and a progression in A.
rows.translation: Maumbo ya E na A juu ya shingo, meja na minori, umbo la karibu zaidi na mfuatano katika A.

rows.source: Your F barre is an E shape with a barre at fret 1. Slide the whole thing up and the name follows the root on string 6: at fret 3 it's G, at fret 5 it's A.
rows.translation: Bare yako ya F ni umbo la E lenye bare kwenye freti 1. Hamisha umbo zima juu; jina hufuata noti msingi kwenye uzi 6: freti 3 ni G, freti 5 ni A.

rows.source: An E-shape barre at fret 5. Which chord?
rows.translation: Bare ya umbo la E kwenye freti 5. Kodi gani?

rows.source: String 6 counts up from E: F at 1, G at 3, A at 5. The barre's fret names the chord.
rows.translation: Uzi 6 huhesabiwa kupanda kutoka E: F kwenye 1, G kwenye 3, A kwenye 5. Freti ya bare ndiyo huipa kodi jina.

rows.source: Lift finger 2 and let the barre cover string 3. That's the E minor shape, and it moves the same way: F sharp minor at fret 2, A minor at fret 5.
rows.translation: Inua kidole 2 na uache bare ishike uzi 3. Hilo ni umbo la E minori, na huhama vivyo hivyo: F diesi minori freti 2, A minori freti 5.
Umbo la A, msingi kwenye uzi 5

rows.source: B minor was an A minor shape with a barre. The major A shape moves too: barre strings 1 to 5, then lay finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2, two frets higher.
rows.translation: B minori ilikuwa umbo la A minori lenye bare. Umbo la A meja huhama pia: fanya bare kwenye nyuzi 1 hadi 5, kisha laza kidole 3 juu ya nyuzi 4, 3 na 2, freti mbili juu.

rows.source: An A-shape barre at fret 3. Which chord?
rows.translation: Bare ya umbo la A kwenye freti 3. Kodi gani?

rows.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
rows.translation: Uzi 5 huhesabiwa kupanda kutoka A: B kwenye 2, C kwenye 3, D kwenye 5.

rows.source: The minor A shape moves too
rows.translation: Umbo la A minori huhama pia

rows.source: For minor, use your B minor fingers: 2, 3 and 4 build the A minor pattern in front of the barre. At fret 3 that's C minor.
rows.translation: Kwa minori, tumia vidole vya B minori: 2, 3 na 4 huunda mpangilio wa A minori mbele ya bare. Kwenye freti 3 hiyo ni C minori.
Umbo la E au la A?

rows.source: Most chords can be an E shape, root on string 6, or an A shape, root on string 5. Pick whichever sits closer to where your hand already is.
rows.translation: Kodi nyingi zinaweza kuwa umbo la E, msingi kwenye uzi 6, au umbo la A, msingi kwenye uzi 5. Chagua lililo karibu zaidi na mkono wako ulipo.

rows.source: You're playing G at fret 3. Where's the closest C?
rows.translation: Unapiga G kwenye freti 3. C ya karibu zaidi iko wapi?

rows.source: C's root is on string 5, fret 3. Stay at fret 3 and switch to the A shape.
rows.translation: Noti msingi ya C iko kwenye uzi 5, freti 3. Baki freti 3 na ubadili kuwa umbo la A.

rows.source: Keep the barre, swap the shape
From G to C at fret 3, finger 1 stays on the barre. Only the fingers in front of it change. It's the smoothest barre change there is.
rows.translation: Kutoka G hadi C kwenye freti 3, kidole 1 hubaki kwenye bare. Vidole vya mbele yake tu ndivyo hubadilika. Hili ndilo badiliko laini zaidi la bare.

rows.source: D as an A shape sits at which fret?
rows.translation: D ya umbo la A iko kwenye freti gani?

rows.source: String 5: A open, B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
rows.translation: Uzi 5: A wazi, B kwenye 2, C kwenye 3, D kwenye 5.

rows.source: F sharp minor, D, A, E
rows.translation: F diesi minori, D, A, E

rows.source: F sharp minor, D, A and E all live in the key of A. Start with F sharp minor as a barre and the other three open.
rows.translation: F diesi minori, D, A na E zote ziko katika ufunguo wa A. Anza na F diesi minori kama bare na kodi nyingine tatu zikiwa wazi.

rows.source: F sharp minor as an E-shape barre sits at…
rows.translation: F diesi minori kama bare ya umbo la E iko…

rows.source: String 6: F at fret 1, F sharp at fret 2.
rows.translation: Uzi 6: F kwenye freti 1, F diesi kwenye freti 2.

rows.source: Play it up the neck: F sharp minor at fret 2, D as an A shape at fret 5, A as an E shape at fret 5, and E as an A shape at fret 7.
rows.translation: Piga juu ya shingo: F diesi minori freti 2, D kwa umbo la A freti 5, A kwa umbo la E freti 5, na E kwa umbo la A freti 7.

rows.source: Let the barre go soft for an instant as you move, then squeeze as you land. Gripping hard all the way tires your hand and slows the change.
rows.translation: Legeza bare kwa muda mfupi unaposogea, kisha bonyeza unapotua. Kukaza njiani kote huchosha mkono na kuchelewesha badiliko.

rows.source: When should your fretting hand squeeze?
rows.translation: Mkono wa freti unapaswa kubonyeza lini?
Wakati wa kutua kwenye kodi tu

rows.source: Squeeze to land, relax to move. Constant force wears out your hand in minutes.
rows.translation: Bonyeza kutua, legeza kusogea. Nguvu ya daima huchosha mkono ndani ya dakika chache.

rows.source: On the last up strum before a change, lift the barre and keep strumming. The open strings sound for a moment, the rhythm never stops, and you land on time.
