rows.translation: Kwenye mpigo wa mwisho wa juu kabla ya badiliko, inua bare na uendelee kupiga. Nyuzi wazi hulia kwa muda mfupi, mdundo hausimami, na unatua kwa wakati.

rows.source: Spray Paint Sunrise is a Timbre Original: indie pop in E on E, B, C sharp minor and A. B and C sharp minor are both A-shape barres, two frets apart, so one hand shape does most of the work. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Spray Paint Sunrise ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: indie pop katika E kwa E, B, C diesi minori na A. B na C diesi minori ni bare za umbo la A, zikitengana kwa freti mbili; umbo moja la mkono hufanya kazi kubwa zaidi. Wimbo mzima uko kwenye Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.

rows.source: C sharp minor as an A minor shape barre sits at…
rows.translation: C diesi minori kama bare ya umbo la A minori iko…

rows.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3, C sharp at 4.
rows.translation: Uzi 5 huhesabiwa kupanda kutoka A: B kwenye 2, C kwenye 3, C diesi kwenye 4.

rows.source: No new ideas: E and A shapes, major and minor, choosing the closer shape and smooth changes. Relax between chords and land on beat one.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: maumbo ya E na A, meja na minori, kuchagua umbo la karibu na kubadili kwa ulaini. Legeza kati ya kodi na utue kwenye pigo la kwanza.

rows.source: An E-shape barre at fret 3 is…
rows.translation: Bare ya umbo la E kwenye freti 3 ni…

rows.source: Root on string 5 means which shape?
rows.translation: Noti msingi kwenye uzi 5 ina maana umbo gani?

rows.source: Funk sixteenths and scratches, the reggae chop, country boom-chick and a syncopated pop strum.
rows.translation: Noti za kumi na sita na mikwaruzo ya funk, chop ya reggae, boom-chick ya country na mpigo wa pop wa sinkopa.

rows.source: Sixteenth notes split each beat in four: one-e-and-a, two-e-and-a. Your strumming hand doubles its speed, down-up-down-up inside every beat.
rows.translation: Noti za kumi na sita hugawa kila pigo mara nne: moja-e-na-a, mbili-e-na-a. Mkono wa kupiga huwa na kasi maradufu, chini-juu-chini-juu ndani ya kila pigo.

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes fill one beat?
rows.translation: Noti ngapi za kumi na sita hujaza pigo moja?

rows.source: One-e-and-a: four even slices of every beat.
rows.translation: Moja-e-na-a: sehemu nne sawa za kila pigo.

rows.source: Funk loves the ninth chord. Finger 2 on string 5, fret 7, finger 1 on string 4, fret 6, and finger 3 flat across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7.
rows.translation: Funk hupenda kodi ya tisa. Kidole 2 kwenye uzi 5, freti 7, kidole 1 kwenye uzi 4, freti 6, na kidole 3 kimelala juu ya nyuzi 3, 2 na 1 kwenye freti 7.

rows.source: Keep your hand moving in sixteenths, but relax your fretting fingers so most strums are dead, scratchy clicks. Press down only for the hits.
rows.translation: Endelea kusogeza mkono kwa noti za kumi na sita, lakini legeza vidole vya freti ili mapigo mengi yawe milio mifupi ya kukwaruza. Bonyeza tu kwenye mapigo ya kodi.

rows.source: Fretting fingers resting lightly on the strings
rows.translation: Vidole vya freti kugusa nyuzi kwa upole

rows.source: Touching without pressing stops the strings from ringing. The strum turns into a crisp, percussive click.
rows.translation: Kugusa bila kubonyeza huzuia nyuzi kulia. Mpigo unakuwa mlio mfupi na safi wa kugonga.

rows.source: Squeeze for each hit, then relax right away so it stays short. Slide the whole E9 shape down two frets and you have D9.
rows.translation: Bonyeza kwa kila pigo, kisha legeza mara moja ili liwe fupi. Hamisha umbo zima la E9 freti mbili chini kupata D9.

rows.source: Reggae guitar answers the drums with short, bright chords on beats two and four. Strum just the thin strings and cut each chord off right away.
rows.translation: Gitaa la reggae hujibu ngoma kwa kodi fupi, angavu kwenye mapigo ya pili na ya nne. Piga nyuzi nyembamba tu na ukatishe kila kodi mara moja.
Maumbo madogo ya sauti ya juu

rows.source: Use the top four strings only. This A minor is the top of your A minor barre at fret 5: finger 3 on string 4, fret 7, finger 1 barring the rest.
rows.translation: Tumia nyuzi nne za juu tu. A minori hii ni sehemu ya juu ya bare yako ya A minori freti 5: kidole 3 kwenye uzi 4, freti 7, kidole 1 kikiwa bare kwenye zilizobaki.

rows.source: How long should a reggae chop ring?
rows.translation: Chop ya reggae inapaswa kulia kwa muda gani?

rows.source: Squeeze, strum, release. The chop is a short bark, and the space after it is the groove.
rows.translation: Bonyeza, piga, achia. Chop ni mlio mfupi mkali, na nafasi baada yake ndiyo huleta mdundo.

rows.source: Now the top of your D barre: finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 7, finger 1 on string 1 at fret 5.
rows.translation: Sasa sehemu ya juu ya bare yako ya D: kidole 3 kimelala juu ya nyuzi 4, 3 na 2 freti 7, kidole 1 kwenye uzi 1 freti 5.

rows.source: Country rhythm splits the bar: a single bass note on beats one and three, a quick strum of the thin strings on two and four. Boom, chick, boom, chick.
rows.translation: Mdundo wa country hugawa kipimo: noti moja ya besi kwenye mapigo ya kwanza na ya tatu, mpigo wa haraka wa nyuzi nyembamba kwenye pili na nne. Boom, chick, boom, chick.

rows.source: In boom-chick, what happens on beats two and four?
rows.translation: Katika boom-chick, nini hutokea kwenye mapigo ya pili na ya nne?

rows.source: A short strum of the thin strings
Move the second boom to another string: in G, string 6 then string 4. In C, string 5 then 4. In D, string 4 then open string 5.
rows.translation: Hamishia boom ya pili kwenye uzi mwingine: katika G, uzi 6 kisha uzi 4. Katika C, uzi 5 kisha 4. Katika D, uzi 4 kisha uzi 5 wazi.

rows.source: Booms in G, C and D
rows.translation: Boom katika G, C na D

rows.source: Syncopation puts the strum where you don't expect it. Down on one, up on the and of two, up on the and of three, then down-up on four.
rows.translation: Sinkopa huweka mpigo wa nyuzi mahali usipoutarajia. Chini kwenye moja, juu kwenye na ya mbili, juu kwenye na ya tatu, kisha chini-juu kwenye nne.

rows.source: In this pattern, what does your hand do on beat two?
rows.translation: Katika mpangilio huu, mkono hufanya nini kwenye pigo la pili?

rows.source: The pendulum never stops. On two the hand swings down without touching, ready for the up strum.
rows.translation: Pendulamu haisimami kamwe. Kwenye mbili mkono hushuka bila kugusa nyuzi, tayari kwa mpigo wa juu.

rows.source: Pop players often change chords on the last up strum, the and of four, so the new chord arrives a hair early. It pushes the song forward.
rows.translation: Wapigaji wa pop mara nyingi hubadili kodi kwenye mpigo wa mwisho wa juu, na ya nne, ili kodi mpya ifike mapema kidogo. Hilo husukuma wimbo mbele.

rows.source: The pop strum on four chords
rows.translation: Mpigo wa pop kwa kodi nne

rows.source: Sparkler Season is a Timbre Original: a summer anthem in C on C, G, A minor and F. Give it the syncopated pop strum, and change a hair early, on the and of four. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Sparkler Season ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: wimbo wa pamoja wa kiangazi katika C kwa C, G, A minori na F. Upe mpigo wa pop wa sinkopa na ubadili mapema kidogo, kwenye na ya nne. Wimbo mzima uko kwenye Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.

rows.source: Open E and D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, then G at fret 3 on string 1, and back down to D.
rows.translation: E wazi na D freti 3 kwenye uzi 2, mara mbili, kisha G freti 3 kwenye uzi 1, na shuka tena hadi D.

rows.source: Why change chords on the and of four?
rows.translation: Kwa nini ubadili kodi kwenye na ya nne?

rows.source: So the new chord rings on beat one
rows.translation: Ili kodi mpya ilie kwenye pigo la kwanza

rows.source: Moving on the last up strum gets your hand there a hair early, so the new chord is ready for beat one.
rows.translation: Kusogea kwenye mpigo wa mwisho wa juu hufikisha mkono mapema kidogo, hivyo kodi mpya huwa tayari kwa pigo la kwanza.

rows.source: No new ideas: funk sixteenths, the reggae chop, boom-chick and the syncopated pop strum. Keep the hand swinging and change only what it hits.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: noti za kumi na sita za funk, chop ya reggae, boom-chick na mpigo wa pop wa sinkopa. Endelea kubembeza mkono na ubadili tu kinachopigwa.

rows.source: Reggae chops land on which beats?
rows.translation: Chop za reggae hutua kwenye mapigo gani?

rows.source: A capo, G and D shapes on capo 2, and Oh! Susanna arranged with a verse and a chorus.
rows.translation: Kapo, maumbo ya G na D kwa kapo 2, na Oh! Susanna iliyopangwa kwa ubeti na kiitikio.

rows.source: A capo clamps every string at one fret. On fret 2, each open string sounds two frets higher, and your open chord shapes all move up with it.
rows.translation: Kapo hubana kila uzi kwenye freti moja. Ikiwa freti 2, kila uzi wazi husikika freti mbili juu, na maumbo yako yote ya kodi wazi hupanda nayo.

rows.source: Before the capo: pluck strings 1 and 2 open. That's E and B.
rows.translation: Kabla ya kapo: piga nyuzi 1 na 2 wazi. Hizo ni E na B.

rows.source: Now clamp the capo just behind fret 2 and pluck them again: F sharp and C sharp.
rows.translation: Sasa bana kapo nyuma kidogo ya freti 2 na uzipige tena: F diesi na C diesi.

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. You play a G shape. Which chord sounds?
rows.translation: Kapo freti 2. Unapiga umbo la G. Kodi gani inasikika?

rows.source: Two frets up from G is A. The shape stays G; the sound moves up with the capo.
rows.translation: Freti mbili juu ya G ni A. Umbo hubaki G; sauti hupanda pamoja na kapo.

rows.source: With a capo you still think G, C and D, the shapes you know. The diagrams here name the chord you actually hear, so a G shape on capo 2 reads A.
rows.translation: Ukiwa na kapo bado unafikiria G, C na D, maumbo unayojua. Michoro hapa hutaja kodi unayosikia kweli, kwa hiyo umbo la G kwa kapo 2 huitwa A.

rows.source: G and D shapes on capo 2
rows.translation: Maumbo ya G na D kwa kapo 2

rows.source: The G family, two frets up
rows.translation: Familia ya G, freti mbili juu

rows.source: On capo 2, G, C, D and E minor shapes sound as A, D, E and F sharp minor. Same fingers, new key: A major.
rows.translation: Kwa kapo 2, maumbo ya G, C, D na E minori husikika kama A, D, E na F diesi minori. Vidole vilevile, ufunguo mpya: A meja.

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. A D shape sounds as…
rows.translation: Kapo freti 2. Umbo la D husikika kama…

rows.source: Two frets above D is E.
rows.translation: Freti mbili juu ya D ni E.

rows.source: D shapes work the same way. On capo 2, D, G and A shapes sound as E, A and B: the key of E with easy open fingerings.
rows.translation: Maumbo ya D hufanya kazi vivyo hivyo. Kwa kapo 2, maumbo ya D, G na A husikika kama E, A na B: ufunguo wa E kwa upangaji rahisi wa vidole wa kodi wazi.

rows.source: Most songs alternate two sections. The verse tells the story; the chorus repeats the hook. Stephen Foster's Oh! Susanna (1848) has both. Capo off: it's in G.
rows.translation: Nyimbo nyingi hupokezana sehemu mbili. Ubeti husimulia; kiitikio hurudia kishazi cha kuvutia. Oh! Susanna ya Stephen Foster (1848) ina zote mbili. Ondoa kapo: iko katika G.

rows.source: The pickup and first bar: open G, A at fret 2, then open B, D at fret 3 twice, and open E.
rows.translation: Utangulizi na kipimo cha kwanza: G wazi, A freti 2, kisha B wazi, D freti 3 mara mbili, na E wazi.

rows.source: Which section usually comes back with the same words?
rows.translation: Sehemu gani kwa kawaida hurudi na maneno yaleyale?

rows.source: Verses change their words as the story moves on. The chorus returns unchanged, and that's what people sing along to.
rows.translation: Beti hubadili maneno kadiri hadithi inavyoendelea. Kiitikio hurudi bila kubadilika, na hicho ndicho watu huimba pamoja nacho.

rows.source: Back the verse with G and D7, boom-chick style: bass on one, strum on two. Three bars of G, one of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
rows.translation: Sindikiza ubeti kwa G na D7, mtindo wa boom-chick: besi kwenye moja, nyuzi kwenye mbili. Vipimo vitatu vya G, kimoja cha D7, viwili vya G, kisha D7 na G.

rows.source: The chorus opens on C, string 2, fret 1, then jumps to open E. Its chords are C, G and D7, and its second half matches the verse's ending.
rows.translation: Kiitikio huanza kwenye C, uzi 2, freti 1, kisha huruka hadi E wazi. Kodi zake ni C, G na D7, na nusu yake ya pili inafanana na mwisho wa ubeti.

rows.source: The opening: C twice on string 2, fret 1, then open E three times.
rows.translation: Mwanzo: C mara mbili kwenye uzi 2, freti 1, kisha E wazi mara tatu.

rows.source: Then down: D twice, open B, open G, and A at fret 2.
rows.translation: Kisha shuka: D mara mbili, B wazi, G wazi, na A freti 2.

rows.source: The three E's go short, long, short. Where does the long one start?
rows.translation: Noti tatu za E ni fupi, ndefu, fupi. Ile ndefu huanza wapi?

rows.source: It starts on the and and rings across the next beat. That push is syncopation, like your pop strum.
rows.translation: Huanza kwenye na na huendelea kulia katika pigo linalofuata. Msukumo huo ni sinkopa, kama mpigo wako wa pop.

rows.source: An arrangement decides what you play, and when. Yours: a Travis-picked intro, the verse as melody, the chorus strummed boom-chick, then the chorus melody to finish.
rows.translation: Mpangilio huamua unachopiga na wakati wa kukipiga. Wako: utangulizi kwa mtindo wa Travis, ubeti kama melodi, kiitikio kwa boom-chick, kisha melodi ya kiitikio kumalizia.

rows.source: Sets the key and tempo before the melody
rows.translation: Huanzisha ufunguo na tempo kabla ya melodi

rows.source: A few bars of chords tell everyone where home is and how fast to go.
rows.translation: Vipimo vichache vya kodi huwaambia wote noti msingi ni ipi na kasi ni ipi.

rows.source: Finish with the chorus melody and let the last G ring. Ending on the tune everyone just heard feels complete.
rows.translation: Malizia kwa melodi ya kiitikio na uache G ya mwisho ilie. Kumalizia kwa melodi ambayo wote wamesikia sasa hivi huleta ukamilifu.

rows.source: Gravel Road Two-Step is a Timbre Original: dance-hall country in A, on A, D and E. Clamp the capo on fret 2 and play it with G, C and D shapes, the ones you know best. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Gravel Road Two-Step ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: country ya dansi katika A, kwa A, D na E. Bana kapo kwenye freti 2 na upige kwa maumbo ya G, C na D, unayoyajua vizuri zaidi. Wimbo mzima uko kwenye Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. Which shape sounds as E?
rows.translation: Kapo freti 2. Umbo gani husikika kama E?

rows.source: Two frets above D is E. On capo 2 the G shape gives A, and the C shape gives D.
rows.translation: Freti mbili juu ya D ni E. Kwa kapo 2, umbo la G hutoa A, na umbo la C hutoa D.

rows.source: Pick the chord's root on beats one and three, and strum on two and four, each with a quick up after it. Boom, chick-a, boom, chick-a: the dancers' steps.
rows.translation: Piga noti msingi ya kodi kwenye mapigo ya kwanza na ya tatu, na nyuzi kwenye pili na nne, kila moja likifuatwa haraka na pigo la juu. Boom, chick-a, boom, chick-a: hatua za wachezaji dansi.

rows.source: No new ideas: the capo, G and D shapes, and your Oh! Susanna arrangement. Play it as if someone's listening. Maybe someone is.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: kapo, maumbo ya G na D, na mpangilio wako wa Oh! Susanna. Piga kana kwamba mtu anakusikiliza. Labda yupo.

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. A C shape sounds as…
rows.translation: Kapo freti 2. Umbo la C husikika kama…

rows.source: Five open shapes become five places to play G, and chords that stay near your hand.
rows.translation: Maumbo matano wazi yanakuwa sehemu tano za kupiga G, na kodi zilizo karibu na mkono wako.

rows.source: Every major chord can borrow the shape of open C, A, G, E or D, moved up the neck. Climbing from any one, the shapes come in that order, C A G E D, and each locks onto the next.
rows.translation: Kila kodi meja inaweza kukopa umbo la C, A, G, E au D wazi, likihamishwa juu ya shingo. Ukipanda kuanzia umbo lolote, hufuata mpangilio huo, C A G E D, na kila moja huungana na linalofuata.

rows.source: C, A, G, E and D: the five open shapes that every major chord can borrow, anywhere on the neck.
rows.translation: C, A, G, E na D: maumbo matano wazi ambayo kila kodi meja inaweza kukopa popote kwenye shingo.

rows.source: Climb from open G and the next shape is the E shape: your G barre at fret 3. Its root on string 6 is the same G as in the open chord.
rows.translation: Panda kutoka G wazi; umbo linalofuata ni la E: bare yako ya G freti 3. Noti yake msingi kwenye uzi 6 ni G ileile ya kodi wazi.

rows.source: Open D moved up five frets is G. Finger 1 holds string 4 at fret 5, where the nut used to be. Fingers 2, 4 and 3 rebuild the D triangle above it.
rows.translation: D wazi ikihamishwa freti tano juu huwa G. Kidole 1 hushika uzi 4 freti 5, kikichukua nafasi ya nati ya nyuzi. Vidole 2, 4 na 3 huunda upya pembetatu ya D juu yake.

rows.source: The D shape, string by string
rows.translation: Umbo la D, uzi kwa uzi

rows.source: Where is the D shape's root?
rows.translation: Noti msingi ya umbo la D iko wapi?

rows.source: Open D's root is open string 4. Moved up, finger 1 holds it: G at fret 5. String 2, fret 8 is a G too.
rows.translation: Noti msingi ya D wazi ni uzi 4 wazi. Ikihamishwa juu, kidole 1 huishika: G freti 5. Uzi 2, freti 8 pia ni G.

rows.source: The E shape at fret 3 and the D shape at fret 5 share one note: G on string 4, fret 5. Keep your eyes on it as you move between them.
rows.translation: Umbo la E freti 3 na umbo la D freti 5 hushiriki noti moja: G kwenye uzi 4, freti 5. Itazame unapohama kati ya maumbo hayo.

rows.source: Open C moved up seven frets is G. Finger 1 lies across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7, finger 2 takes string 2 at fret 8, and fingers 3 and 4 stretch to strings 4 and 5.
rows.translation: C wazi ikihamishwa freti saba juu huwa G. Kidole 1 hulala juu ya nyuzi 3, 2 na 1 freti 7, kidole 2 hushika uzi 2 freti 8, na vidole 3 na 4 hunyooshwa hadi nyuzi 4 na 5.

rows.source: The C shape, string by string
rows.translation: Umbo la C, uzi kwa uzi

rows.source: Like open C, the C shape's root is on…
rows.translation: Kama C wazi, noti msingi ya umbo la C iko kwenye…

rows.source: Open C's root is string 5, fret 3. Here your little finger holds it: G at fret 10.
rows.translation: Noti msingi ya C wazi iko uzi 5, freti 3. Hapa kidole kidogo huishika: G freti 10.

rows.source: Slide the C shape down to fret 2 and it's D, with its root on string 5, fret 5. The name always follows the root.
rows.translation: Hamisha umbo la C chini hadi freti 2 liwe D, msingi wake ukiwa uzi 5, freti 5. Jina hufuata noti msingi daima.

rows.source: The A shape, and around again
rows.translation: Umbo la A, na mzunguko tena

rows.source: Barre strings 5 to 1 at fret 10 and lay finger 3 across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 12. It's your A-shape barre, and it's G again.
rows.translation: Fanya bare kwenye nyuzi 5 hadi 1 freti 10 na ulaze kidole 3 juu ya nyuzi 4, 3 na 2 freti 12. Ni bare yako ya umbo la A, na ni G tena.

rows.source: Past the A shape, the G shape comes back at fret 12: open G, one octave higher. From there the five shapes repeat in the same order.
rows.translation: Baada ya umbo la A, umbo la G hurudi freti 12: G wazi, oktava moja juu. Kutoka hapo maumbo matano hurudiwa kwa mpangilio uleule.

rows.source: Going up the neck, which shape comes after A?
rows.translation: Ukipanda shingo, umbo gani hufuata A?

rows.source: The order loops: C, A, G, E, D, then C again. After A comes G.
rows.translation: Mpangilio hurudiwa: C, A, G, E, D, kisha C tena. Baada ya A huja G.
Ni G ipi iliyo juu zaidi?

rows.source: With CAGED you rarely have to jump. Around fret 5, G is the D shape, C is the G shape and D is the A shape. Three chords, one spot.
rows.translation: Kwa CAGED huhitaji kuruka mara nyingi. Karibu na freti 5, G ni umbo la D, C ni umbo la G, na D ni umbo la A. Kodi tatu, sehemu moja.

rows.source: Which shape plays C right beside the D-shape G?
rows.translation: Umbo gani hupiga C karibu kabisa na G ya umbo la D?

rows.source: C's G shape uses frets 5 and 8, right where your hand already is.
rows.translation: Umbo la G la kodi C hutumia freti 5 na 8, palepale mkono wako ulipo.

rows.source: The same idea works lower: G as the E shape at fret 3, C as the A shape at fret 3, and D as the C shape at fret 2.
rows.translation: Wazo lilelile hufanya kazi chini: G kwa umbo la E freti 3, C kwa umbo la A freti 3, na D kwa umbo la C freti 2.

rows.source: Lantern Hill is a Timbre Original: a campfire sing-along on G, C and D. Play its chorus open, then near fret 5, then near fret 3, and the same song moves around the neck. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Lantern Hill ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: wa kuimba pamoja kuzunguka moto kwa G, C na D. Piga kiitikio kwa kodi wazi, kisha karibu na freti 5, kisha freti 3, na wimbo uleule huhama kwenye shingo. Wimbo mzima uko kwenye Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.

rows.source: Near fret 5, which shape plays C?
rows.translation: Karibu na freti 5, umbo gani hupiga C?

rows.source: C's G shape uses frets 5 and 8, right beside the D-shape G and the A-shape D.
rows.translation: Umbo la G la kodi C hutumia freti 5 na 8, karibu kabisa na G ya umbo la D na D ya umbo la A.

rows.source: No new ideas: G in all five shapes, and G, C and D near fret 3 and fret 5. Name each shape as you land it.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: G katika maumbo yote matano, na G, C na D karibu na freti 3 na freti 5. Taja kila umbo unapotua.

rows.source: G with the D shape sits at…
rows.translation: G kwa umbo la D iko kwenye…
Kodi za noti tatu juu ya shingo

rows.source: Three-note chords on the top strings: major and minor, every inversion, and progressions that barely move.
rows.translation: Kodi za noti tatu kwenye nyuzi za juu: meja na minori, kila mgeuzo, na mifuatano inayosogea kidogo sana.
Kodi za noti tatu kwenye nyuzi za juu

rows.source: A triad is the smallest full chord: a root, a third and a fifth. On strings 3, 2 and 1, triads ring clear and bright, and they work anywhere on the neck.
rows.translation: Kodi ya noti tatu ndiyo kodi kamili ndogo zaidi: noti msingi, ya tatu na ya tano. Kwenye nyuzi 3, 2 na 1, kodi hizi hulia kwa usafi na uangavu na hutumika popote kwenye shingo.

rows.source: Which notes make a C major triad?
rows.translation: Ni noti zipi huunda kodi ya noti tatu ya C meja?

rows.source: Root, third, fifth: from C, skip a letter to E, then skip another to G.
rows.translation: Msingi, ya tatu, ya tano: kutoka C, ruka herufi moja hadi E, kisha ruka nyingine hadi G.

rows.source: Move the lowest note to the top and you get an inversion. With E at the bottom, C sits at frets 9, 8 and 8. With G at the bottom, it's the top of your open C.
rows.translation: Hamishia noti ya chini zaidi juu upate mgeuzo. E ikiwa chini, C iko freti 9, 8 na 8. G ikiwa chini, ni sehemu ya juu ya C yako wazi.

rows.source: Every major triad on these strings uses one of three shapes, one per inversion. Learn them on G and D and you can find any major chord.
rows.translation: Kila kodi meja ya noti tatu kwenye nyuzi hizi hutumia moja ya maumbo matatu, moja kwa kila mgeuzo. Yajifunze kwa G na D uweze kupata kodi yoyote meja.

rows.source: G at frets 4, 3 and 3 has the same shape as…
rows.translation: G kwenye freti 4, 3 na 3 ina umbo sawa na…

rows.source: Both put the third at the bottom: one fret up on string 3, the other two level. Same shape, five frets apart.
rows.translation: Zote huweka noti ya tatu chini: freti moja juu kwenye uzi 3, nyingine mbili zikiwa sawa. Umbo lilelile, zimetengana freti tano.

rows.source: D at frets 7, 7 and 5 has the root-position shape of your C at fret 5. Lower down, frets 2, 3 and 2 are the top of your open D.
rows.translation: D kwenye freti 7, 7 na 5 ina umbo lenye noti msingi chini kama C yako freti 5. Chini zaidi, freti 2, 3 na 2 ni sehemu ya juu ya D yako wazi.

rows.source: A minor triad is a major triad with its third one fret lower. On these strings, A minor at frets 2, 1 and 0 is the top of your open A minor.
rows.translation: Kodi minori ya noti tatu ni kodi meja ambayo noti yake ya tatu imeshushwa freti moja. Kwenye nyuzi hizi, A minori freti 2, 1 na 0 ni sehemu ya juu ya A minori yako wazi.

rows.source: Barre fret 5 across strings 3, 2 and 1 and you have A minor with C at the bottom. One finger, three notes.
rows.translation: Fanya bare kwenye freti 5 juu ya nyuzi 3, 2 na 1 kupata A minori yenye C chini. Kidole kimoja, noti tatu.

rows.source: E minor at frets 4, 5 and 3 puts B at the bottom. It sits right beside A minor at fret 5, so the change is tiny.
rows.translation: E minori kwenye freti 4, 5 na 3 huweka B chini. Iko karibu kabisa na A minori freti 5, hivyo badiliko ni dogo sana.
Mfuatano wa kodi za noti tatu

rows.source: Pick the inversion closest to your hand and a progression barely moves. G, E minor, C and D all live between frets 2 and 5.
rows.translation: Chagua mgeuzo wa karibu zaidi na mkono ili mfuatano usogee kidogo sana. G, E minori, C na D zote ziko kati ya freti 2 na 5.

rows.source: From G at frets 4, 3, 3 to E minor at 4, 5, 3, which notes stay?
rows.translation: Kutoka G freti 4, 3, 3 hadi E minori freti 4, 5, 3, ni noti zipi hubaki?

rows.source: B on string 3 and G on string 1 stay put. Only string 2 moves, from D up to E.
rows.translation: B kwenye uzi 3 na G kwenye uzi 1 hubaki palepale. Uzi 2 tu hubadilika, kutoka D hadi E juu.

rows.source: The same four chords sit higher too: G at frets 7, 8 and 7, E minor at 9, 8 and 7, C at 9, 8 and 8, and D at 7, 7 and 5.
rows.translation: Kodi zilezile nne ziko juu pia: G freti 7, 8 na 7, E minori freti 9, 8 na 7, C freti 9, 8 na 8, na D freti 7, 7 na 5.
Arpeggio za kodi za noti tatu

rows.source: Play a triad's notes one at a time and you have an arpeggio. Through a progression, the notes make a melody of their own.
rows.translation: Piga noti za kodi ya noti tatu moja moja upate arpeggio. Katika mfuatano wa kodi, noti huunda melodi yake yenyewe.

rows.source: A chord played one note at a time
The top notes here run G, G, G, F sharp: almost still while the chords change under them. A note that two chords share is a common tone, and it's why triads sound so smooth.
rows.translation: Noti za juu hapa ni G, G, G, F diesi: karibu hazisogei huku kodi zikibadilika chini yake. Noti ambayo kodi mbili hushiriki ndiyo noti ya pamoja, na ndiyo hufanya kodi za noti tatu zisikike laini.

rows.source: Did the top note go up or down?
rows.translation: Noti ya juu ilipanda au ilishuka?
Kodi za noti tatu ukumbini mwa dansi

rows.source: Roller Rink is a Timbre Original: retro dance pop on G, E minor, C and D, your four triads between frets 2 and 5. Small shapes on the top strings sound bright and tight, like a second guitar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Roller Rink ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: pop ya dansi ya mtindo wa zamani kwa G, E minori, C na D, kodi zako za noti tatu kati ya freti 2 na 5. Maumbo madogo kwenye nyuzi za juu husikika angavu na thabiti, kama gitaa la pili. Wimbo mzima uko Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.

rows.source: Roller Rink's loop is the one, six, four and five of G. Which chord is the six?
rows.translation: Mzunguko wa Roller Rink ni moja, sita, nne na tano za G. Kodi ipi ni sita?

rows.source: Count up G major: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. The chord on 6 is minor: E minor.
rows.translation: Hesabu ukipanda G meja: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. Kodi kwenye 6 ni minori: E minori.
Kodi za noti tatu, kutoka uzi wa juu
Jaribio la kodi za noti tatu

rows.source: No new ideas: major and minor triads, their inversions, G, E minor, C and D in two places, and the arpeggios. Keep every move small.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: kodi meja na minori za noti tatu, mageuzo yake, G, E minori, C na D sehemu mbili, na arpeggio. Kila mwendo uwe mdogo.

rows.source: A minor triad is a major triad with…
rows.translation: Kodi minori ya noti tatu ni kodi meja yenye…
Noti ya tatu freti moja chini
Kodi za saba na upangaji wa jazz

rows.source: Major, minor and dominant sevenths, open and barred, the ii–V–I, and swing comping.
rows.translation: Kodi za saba meja, minori na dominanti, wazi na za bare, ii–V–I, na usindikizaji wa swing.

rows.source: A major seventh chord adds the note one fret below the root's octave. It turns a plain major chord soft and dreamy. Open Cmaj7 is C with finger 1 lifted.
rows.translation: Kodi ya saba meja huongeza noti iliyo freti moja chini ya oktava ya noti msingi. Huifanya kodi meja ya kawaida iwe laini na ya ndotoni. Cmaj7 wazi ni C ikiwa kidole 1 kimeinuliwa.

rows.source: Cmaj7 is C plus which note?
rows.translation: Cmaj7 ni C yenye noti gani ya ziada?

rows.source: The major seventh sits one fret below the root's octave: B, just under C.
rows.translation: Noti ya saba meja iko freti moja chini ya oktava ya noti msingi: B, chini kidogo ya C.

rows.source: Play the mini F, but let finger 1 press string 2 only. Open string 1, E, is the major seventh of F.
rows.translation: Piga F ndogo, lakini kidole 1 kibonyeze uzi 2 tu. Uzi 1 wazi, E, ni noti ya saba meja ya F.

rows.source: A minor seventh chord adds the note two frets below the root's octave. It sounds mellow, between dark and bright. Am7 is A minor with finger 3 lifted.
rows.translation: Kodi ya saba minori huongeza noti iliyo freti mbili chini ya oktava ya noti msingi. Husikika tulivu, kati ya giza na uangavu. Am7 ni A minori ikiwa kidole 3 kimeinuliwa.

rows.source: Dm7: finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, and finger 1 flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1. Em7: just finger 2 on string 5, fret 2.
rows.translation: Dm7: kidole 2 kwenye uzi 3, freti 2, na kidole 1 kimelala juu ya nyuzi 2 na 1 freti 1. Em7: kidole 2 pekee kwenye uzi 5, freti 2.

rows.source: Am7 is A minor plus which note?
rows.translation: Am7 ni A minori yenye noti gani ya ziada?

rows.source: The minor seventh sits two frets below the root's octave: G, two frets under A.
rows.translation: Noti ya saba minori iko freti mbili chini ya oktava ya noti msingi: G, freti mbili chini ya A.

rows.source: Sevenths with the root on string 5
rows.translation: Kodi za saba, msingi kwenye uzi 5

rows.source: Finger 1 holds string 5 at fret 3 and lies across to string 1. Finger 3 takes string 4, finger 2 string 3 and finger 4 string 2.
rows.translation: Kidole 1 hushika uzi 5 freti 3 na hulala hadi uzi 1. Kidole 3 hushika uzi 4, kidole 2 uzi 3 na kidole 4 uzi 2.

rows.source: Dm7 is your A minor barre with the little finger lifted. D7 is the A-shape barre with fingers 3 and 4 on strings 4 and 2. Both are named after string 5.
rows.translation: Dm7 ni bare yako ya A minori ikiwa kidole kidogo kimeinuliwa. D7 ni bare ya umbo la A yenye vidole 3 na 4 kwenye nyuzi 4 na 2. Zote hupata jina kutoka uzi 5.

rows.source: Dm7 at fret 5. Where is its root?
rows.translation: Dm7 kwenye freti 5. Noti yake msingi iko wapi?

rows.source: Like every A-shape chord, it's named after its note on string 5.
rows.translation: Kama kila kodi ya umbo la A, hupata jina kutoka noti yake kwenye uzi 5.

rows.source: Jazz's favorite move: the chord on the second note of the key, then the fifth, then home. In C that's Dm7, G7 and Cmaj7.
rows.translation: Mwendo pendwa wa jazz: kodi kwenye noti ya pili ya ufunguo, kisha ya tano, kisha msingi. Katika C ni Dm7, G7 na Cmaj7.

rows.source: Play the E7 shape as a barre at fret 3: finger 1 across all six strings, finger 3 on string 5 and finger 2 on string 3. Its root is on string 6.
rows.translation: Piga umbo la E7 kama bare kwenye freti 3: kidole 1 juu ya nyuzi zote sita, kidole 3 kwenye uzi 5 na kidole 2 kwenye uzi 3. Noti msingi iko kwenye uzi 6.

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is the ii?
rows.translation: Katika ufunguo wa C, kodi ipi ni ii?

rows.source: Count up from C: C is one, D is two. The seventh chord built on D is D minor seven.
rows.translation: Hesabu ukipanda kutoka C: C ni moja, D ni mbili. Kodi ya saba inayojengwa kwenye D ni D minori saba.

rows.source: Jazz players often let each chord ring for just a moment. Squeeze as you strum, ease off right after, and the chords start to swing.
rows.translation: Wapigaji wa jazz mara nyingi huacha kila kodi ilie kwa muda mfupi tu. Bonyeza unapopiga, legeza mara moja baada yake, na kodi zitaanza kuwa na swing.

rows.source: Swing guitarists comp: short chords that answer the band. The Charleston rhythm hits beat one and the swung and of two, then leaves space.
rows.translation: Wapigaji wa gitaa la swing husindikiza bendi kwa kodi fupi zinazoijibu. Mdundo wa Charleston hupiga kwenye pigo la kwanza na na ya pili yenye swing, kisha huacha nafasi.

rows.source: In G, the two, five, one is Am7, D7 and Gmaj7. Am7 is the E minor seven barre at fret 5; Gmaj7 skips string 5, with its root on string 6, fret 3.
rows.translation: Katika G, mbili, tano, moja ni Am7, D7 na Gmaj7. Am7 ni bare ya E minori saba freti 5; Gmaj7 huruka uzi 5, msingi wake ukiwa uzi 6, freti 3.

rows.source: Late Checkout is a Timbre Original: lo-fi in C on Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 and Am7. That's a ii–V–I, plus the six chord to start it over. Comp it with your barred sevenths and the Charleston. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Late Checkout ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: lo-fi katika C kwa Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 na Am7. Huo ni ii–V–I pamoja na kodi ya sita kurudia mwanzo. Sindikiza kwa kodi zako za saba za bare na Charleston. Wimbo mzima uko kwenye Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.

rows.source: In Late Checkout, which chord is the V?
rows.translation: Katika Late Checkout, kodi ipi ni V?

rows.source: Count up C major: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5. The seventh chord on G is G7.
rows.translation: Hesabu ukipanda C meja: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5. Kodi ya saba kwenye G ni G7.

rows.source: No new ideas: major, minor and dominant sevenths, open and barred, and the ii–V–I in C and G. Keep the chords short and the swing steady.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: kodi za saba meja, minori na dominanti, wazi na za bare, na ii–V–I katika C na G. Kodi ziwe fupi na swing iwe thabiti.

rows.source: Which seventh sits one fret below the root's octave?
rows.translation: Noti gani ya saba iko freti moja chini ya oktava ya noti msingi?
Skeli ya meja, mkono sehemu moja

rows.source: G major in two octaves at fret 2, scale degrees and chords, and the Dorian and Mixolydian modes.
rows.translation: G meja kwa oktava mbili freti 2, madaraja ya skeli na kodi, na modi za Dorian na Mixolydian.

rows.source: A half step is one fret, a whole step two. Every major scale climbs whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half. That pattern gives major its sound.
rows.translation: Nusu toni ni freti moja, toni nzima ni mbili. Kila skeli meja hupanda nzima, nzima, nusu, nzima, nzima, nzima, nusu. Mpangilio huo huipa meja sauti yake.

rows.source: Put finger 1 at fret 2 and give each finger its own fret, up to fret 5. From G on string 6, fret 3, the scale climbs across strings 6, 5 and 4.
rows.translation: Weka kidole 1 freti 2 na kila kidole kiwe na freti yake hadi freti 5. Kutoka G kwenye uzi 6, freti 3, skeli hupanda kupitia nyuzi 6, 5 na 4.

rows.source: String 6: frets 3 and 5, fingers 2 and 4. String 5: frets 2 and 3, fingers 1 and 2.
rows.translation: Uzi 6: freti 3 na 5, vidole 2 na 4. Uzi 5: freti 2 na 3, vidole 1 na 2.

rows.source: String 5, fret 5, then string 4: frets 2, 4 and 5. Home on G.
rows.translation: Uzi 5, freti 5, kisha uzi 4: freti 2, 4 na 5. Rudi kwenye G msingi.

rows.source: Where do the half steps fall in a major scale?
rows.translation: Nusu toni ziko wapi katika skeli meja?
Kati ya noti 3 na 4, na 7 na 8

rows.source: Whole, whole, half: the first half step is from 3 to 4. Whole, whole, whole, half: the second is from 7 to 8.
rows.translation: Nzima, nzima, nusu: nusu toni ya kwanza ni kutoka 3 hadi 4. Nzima, nzima, nzima, nusu: ya pili ni kutoka 7 hadi 8.

rows.source: The same position carries on: A, B and C on string 3, D and E on string 2, F sharp and G on string 1. Your hand never moves.
rows.translation: Nafasi ileile inaendelea: A, B na C kwenye uzi 3, D na E kwenye uzi 2, F diesi na G kwenye uzi 1. Mkono hauhami.

rows.source: String 3: frets 2, 4, 5. String 2: frets 3, 5. String 1: frets 2, 3.
rows.translation: Uzi 3: freti 2, 4, 5. Uzi 2: freti 3, 5. Uzi 1: freti 2, 3.

rows.source: In this position, which finger plays fret 5?
rows.translation: Katika nafasi hii, kidole gani hupiga freti 5?

rows.source: Finger 1 sits at fret 2, so fret 5 belongs to finger 4, your little finger.
rows.translation: Kidole 1 kiko freti 2, kwa hiyo freti 5 ni ya kidole 4, kidole chako kidogo.

rows.source: A carol built on the scale
Joy to the World, arranged by Lowell Mason in 1839, opens with the G major scale straight down from the top. You know every note already.
rows.translation: Joy to the World, iliyopangwa na Lowell Mason mwaka 1839, huanza kwa skeli ya G meja ikishuka moja kwa moja kutoka juu. Tayari unajua kila noti.

rows.source: Joy to the World, in position
rows.translation: Joy to the World, mkono sehemu moja

rows.source: Number the scale from G: G is 1, A is 2, and so on up to F sharp, 7. Musicians use these numbers to talk about melodies and chords in any key.
rows.translation: Hesabu skeli kutoka G: G ni 1, A ni 2, na kuendelea hadi F diesi, 7. Wanamuziki hutumia namba hizi kuzungumzia melodi na kodi katika ufunguo wowote.

rows.source: In G major, which note is 5?
rows.translation: Katika G meja, noti ipi ni 5?

rows.source: Count up from G: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.
rows.translation: Hesabu ukipanda kutoka G: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.

rows.source: Stack every other scale note on each degree and you get the key's chords. Chords on 1, 4 and 5 are major; on 2, 3 and 6 they're minor. In G: G, C and D, then A minor, B minor and E minor.
rows.translation: Jenga kodi kwenye kila daraja kwa kuruka noti moja moja ya skeli upate kodi za ufunguo huo. Kodi za 1, 4 na 5 ni meja; za 2, 3 na 6 ni minori. Katika G: G, C na D, kisha A minori, B minori na E minori.

rows.source: In G major, which chord is built on 6?
rows.translation: Katika G meja, kodi ipi hujengwa kwenye 6?

rows.source: The sixth note is E, and chords on 2, 3 and 6 are minor. Stack E, G and B: E minor.
rows.translation: Noti ya sita ni E, na kodi za 2, 3 na 6 ni minori. Unganisha E, G na B: E minori.

rows.source: Play G major's notes but treat A as home, and the scale turns minor. This sound is A Dorian, a mode of G major: same position, new starting note.
rows.translation: Piga noti za G meja lakini ufanye A kuwa msingi, na skeli itakuwa minori. Sauti hii ni A Dorian, modi ya G meja: nafasi ileile, noti mpya ya kuanzia.

rows.source: Start on A, string 6, fret 5, with finger 4, and climb the same frets to A on string 3.
rows.translation: Anza kwenye A, uzi 6, freti 5, kwa kidole 4, na upande freti zilezile hadi A kwenye uzi 3.

rows.source: Which note makes A Dorian brighter than plain A minor?
rows.translation: Noti gani hufanya A Dorian iwe angavu kuliko A minori ya kawaida?

rows.source: Plain A minor has F. Dorian keeps G major's F sharp: a bright spot in a minor scale.
rows.translation: A minori ya kawaida ina F. Dorian hubaki na F diesi ya G meja: mwangaza katika skeli minori.
Melodi ya A Dorian, kwa mtiririko

rows.source: Now treat D as home. G major's notes from D to D make D Mixolydian: a major scale with its seventh one fret lower. It's all over folk, rock and fiddle tunes.
rows.translation: Sasa fanya D kuwa msingi. Noti za G meja kutoka D hadi D huunda D Mixolydian: skeli meja yenye noti ya saba freti moja chini. Inatumika sana katika folk, rock na melodi za fiddle.

rows.source: From D on string 5, fret 5, up the same position to D on string 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: Kutoka D kwenye uzi 5, freti 5, panda katika nafasi ileile hadi D kwenye uzi 2, freti 3.

rows.source: D major has C sharp. D Mixolydian has…
rows.translation: D meja ina C diesi. D Mixolydian ina…

rows.source: Mixolydian lowers the seventh by one fret, so G major's C becomes its flavor note.
rows.translation: Mixolydian hushusha noti ya saba kwa freti moja, kwa hiyo C ya G meja ndiyo huipa ladha yake.

rows.source: Any note of the major scale can be home. From G it's major, from A Dorian, from D Mixolydian, from E plain minor. Same frets, different moods.
rows.translation: Noti yoyote ya skeli meja inaweza kuwa msingi. Kutoka G ni meja, kutoka A ni Dorian, kutoka D ni Mixolydian, kutoka E ni minori ya kawaida. Freti zilezile, hisia tofauti.
Kishazi cha kuvutia nafasi ya pili

rows.source: Market Day is a Timbre Original: sunny pop in G with a highlife bounce, the bright guitar music of West Africa. Its hook uses only G major's notes, so it sits inside your second-position scale. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Market Day ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: pop changamfu katika G yenye mwendo wa highlife, muziki angavu wa gitaa wa Afrika Magharibi. Kishazi chake cha kuvutia hutumia noti za G meja tu, ndani ya skeli yako ya nafasi ya pili. Wimbo mzima uko Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.

rows.source: Market Day's chords are G, B minor, C and D. Which scale degrees are they on?
rows.translation: Kodi za Market Day ni G, B minori, C na D. Ziko kwenye madaraja gani ya skeli?

rows.source: G is 1, B is 3, C is 4 and D is 5. The chord on 3 is minor in every major key: B minor.
rows.translation: G ni 1, B ni 3, C ni 4 na D ni 5. Kodi kwenye 3 ni minori katika kila ufunguo meja: B minori.

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, B at fret 4 on string 3, D again, E at fret 5 with finger 4, then D and B.
rows.translation: D freti 3 uzi 2, B freti 4 uzi 3, D tena, E freti 5 kwa kidole 4, kisha D na B.

rows.source: No new ideas: G major in two octaves, the scale in thirds, A Dorian and D Mixolydian. Keep one finger per fret.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: G meja kwa oktava mbili, skeli kwa miruko ya tatu, A Dorian na D Mixolydian. Kidole kimoja kwa kila freti.

rows.source: Whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half spells…
rows.translation: Nzima, nzima, nusu, nzima, nzima, nzima, nusu huunda…

rows.source: Which mode starts on the second note of G major?
rows.translation: Modi gani huanza kwenye noti ya pili ya G meja?
Pentatoniki meja na solo yenye hisia

rows.source: The major pentatonic, country hammer-ons and slides, trills, phrasing, and sweet and sour over the blues.
rows.translation: Pentatoniki meja, hammer-on na slide za country, trili, upangaji wa vishazi, na utamu na ukakasi katika blues.

rows.source: Move your minor pentatonic box from fret 5 down to fret 2 and treat A as home: it turns sweet and major. That's A major pentatonic: A, B, C sharp, E and F sharp.
rows.translation: Hamisha umbo lako la pentatoniki minori kutoka freti 5 hadi freti 2 chini na ufanye A kuwa msingi: litakuwa tamu na la meja. Hiyo ni pentatoniki ya A meja: A, B, C diesi, E na F diesi.

rows.source: From A on string 6, fret 5, then frets 2 and 4 on strings 5 and 4, and A at fret 2 on string 3.
rows.translation: Kutoka A kwenye uzi 6, freti 5, kisha freti 2 na 4 kwenye nyuzi 5 na 4, na A freti 2 kwenye uzi 3.

rows.source: Which notes are in A major pentatonic?
rows.translation: Ni noti zipi ziko katika pentatoniki ya A meja?

rows.source: A, B, C sharp, E, F sharp
rows.translation: A, B, C diesi, E, F diesi

rows.source: Five notes of the A major scale, its two half steps left out. The minor box at fret 5 holds A, C, D, E and G.
rows.translation: Noti tano za skeli ya A meja, nusu toni zake mbili zimeachwa. Umbo minori freti 5 lina A, C, D, E na G.

rows.source: A major pentatonic, up and down
rows.translation: Pentatoniki ya A meja, panda na ushuke

rows.source: This box at fret 2 is also F sharp minor pentatonic, from its F sharp. The note you treat as home decides which one you're playing.
rows.translation: Umbo hili freti 2 pia ni pentatoniki ya F diesi minori, kuanzia F diesi yake. Noti unayoifanya kuwa msingi ndiyo huamua skeli unayopiga.

rows.source: Country players love hammer-ons inside this box: E to F sharp on string 4, A to B on string 3. Pick the first note, then hammer the second.
rows.translation: Wapigaji wa country hupenda hammer-on ndani ya umbo hili: E hadi F diesi kwenye uzi 4, A hadi B kwenye uzi 3. Piga noti ya kwanza, kisha fanya hammer-on kwa ya pili.

rows.source: String 4: pick fret 2, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 4.
rows.translation: Uzi 4: piga freti 2, kisha tushia kidole 3 kwenye freti 4.

rows.source: Now slide finger 3 on string 3 from fret 4 to fret 6, B up to C sharp, then glide back into the box.
rows.translation: Sasa telezesha kidole 3 kwenye uzi 3 kutoka freti 4 hadi freti 6, B kupanda hadi C diesi, kisha teleza urudi ndani ya umbo.

rows.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 4. Pick, then slide to fret 6 without lifting.
rows.translation: Kidole 3 kwenye uzi 3, freti 4. Piga uzi, kisha teleza hadi freti 6 bila kuinua.

rows.source: A trill flutters between two notes: one pick, then hammer-on, pull-off, over and over. Keep it even before you make it fast.
rows.translation: Trili hupokezana haraka kati ya noti mbili: piga uzi mara moja, kisha hammer-on, pull-off, tena na tena. Dumisha mwendo sawa kabla ya kuongeza kasi.

rows.source: String 3: frets 2 and 4. Pick once, then hammer and pull with finger 3.
rows.translation: Uzi 3: freti 2 na 4. Piga mara moja, kisha fanya hammer-on na pull-off kwa kidole 3.

rows.source: Start one fret below the note you want and slide up into it as you pick. The target is what counts: land it right on the beat.
rows.translation: Anza freti moja chini ya noti unayotaka na uteleze juu kuifikia unapopiga. Noti lengwa ndiyo muhimu: tua hapo hasa kwenye pigo.

rows.source: When you slide into a note, which one lands on the beat?
rows.translation: Unapoteleza kuingia kwenye noti, ipi hutua kwenye pigo?

rows.source: The slide starts just before the beat, so the note you're aiming for arrives right on it.
rows.translation: Slide huanza kabla kidogo ya pigo ili noti unayolenga ifike hasa kwenye pigo hilo.

rows.source: Over a blues in A, both boxes work. Major pentatonic at fret 2 sounds sweet; minor at fret 5 sounds tough. Good players move between them.
rows.translation: Katika blues ya A, maumbo yote mawili yanafaa. Pentatoniki meja freti 2 husikika tamu; minori freti 5 husikika kali. Wapigaji wazuri huhama kati yake.

rows.source: Which box sounds sweeter over A7?
rows.translation: Umbo lipi husikika tamu zaidi likipigwa pamoja na A7?

rows.source: The major pentatonic holds C sharp, the third of A7. The minor box's C rubs against it, and that rub is the blues.
rows.translation: Pentatoniki meja ina C diesi, noti ya tatu ya A7. C ya umbo minori huleta mvutano dhidi yake, na mvutano huo ndio blues.

rows.source: Ask a tough question at fret 5, then answer it sweetly at fret 2. Shift your hand on the long note, and land both phrases on A.
rows.translation: Uliza swali kali freti 5, kisha lijibu kwa utamu freti 2. Hamisha mkono kwenye noti ndefu, na umalizie vishazi vyote viwili kwenye A.

rows.source: Great solos breathe. Play a short phrase, rest about as long as it lasted, then answer. The silence makes the next notes count.
rows.translation: Solo nzuri hupumua. Piga kishazi kifupi, pumzika kwa muda unaokaribia uleule, kisha jibu. Kimya huzipa noti zinazofuata umuhimu.

rows.source: After a two-beat phrase, how long might you rest?
rows.translation: Baada ya kishazi cha mapigo mawili, unaweza kupumzika kwa muda gani?

rows.source: Play a phrase twice the same way, then change only its ending. Listeners hear the repeat and lean in for the twist.
rows.translation: Piga kishazi mara mbili kwa namna ileile, kisha badili mwisho wake tu. Wasikilizaji husikia mrudio na kusikiliza kwa makini mabadiliko.

rows.source: Hold each long note and rock it with a small, even push and release. Keep it narrow: the pitch should waver, never wander off.
rows.translation: Shikilia kila noti ndefu na uibembeze kwa kusukuma na kuachia kidogo kwa mwendo sawa. Mwendo uwe mdogo: kimo cha sauti kitetereke, kisipotee.

rows.source: Slow Motion Strobe is a Timbre Original: synth-pop in A on F sharp minor, D, A and E. Your box at fret 2 fits the whole loop: A major pentatonic, which is F sharp minor pentatonic too. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Slow Motion Strobe ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: synth-pop katika A kwa F diesi minori, D, A na E. Umbo lako freti 2 linafaa mzunguko mzima: pentatoniki ya A meja, ambayo pia ni ya F diesi minori. Wimbo mzima uko kwenye Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.

rows.source: Listen to the first chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Sikiliza kodi ya kwanza. Meja au minori?

rows.source: Over F sharp minor and D
rows.translation: Kwa F diesi minori na D

rows.source: Which box notes belong to the E chord?
rows.translation: Ni noti zipi za umbo hili zilizo sehemu ya kodi E?

rows.source: E is E, G sharp and B. The box holds E and B but no G sharp, so lean on those two over E.
rows.translation: E ni E, G diesi na B. Umbo lina E na B lakini halina G diesi, kwa hiyo kazia hizo mbili unapopiga pamoja na E.

rows.source: No new ideas: the major pentatonic, hammer-ons, slides, trills and both boxes over the blues. Leave space, and finish on A.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: pentatoniki meja, hammer-on, slide, trili na maumbo yote mawili katika blues. Acha nafasi, na umalizie kwenye A.

rows.source: Slide the minor box from fret 5 to fret 2 and it plays…
rows.translation: Hamisha umbo minori kutoka freti 5 hadi freti 2 nalo hupiga…

rows.source: Verse, chorus and AABA, intros and tags, texture and fills, and your own arrangement of Down by the Riverside.
rows.translation: Ubeti, kiitikio na AABA, utangulizi na miisho, muundo wa sauti na fill, na mpangilio wako wa Down by the Riverside.

rows.source: Most songs are built from a few sections: verses that tell the story, a chorus that repeats the hook, and sometimes a bridge for contrast. Knowing the plan keeps you from getting lost.
rows.translation: Nyimbo nyingi hujengwa kwa sehemu chache: beti zinazosimulia, kiitikio kinachorudia kishazi cha kuvutia, na wakati mwingine daraja la kuleta tofauti. Kujua mpangilio hukuzuia kupotea.

rows.source: What does a chorus usually carry?
The chorus returns with the same words and tune. It's the part people remember and sing along to.
rows.translation: Kiitikio hurudi na maneno na melodi zilezile. Ndicho watu hukumbuka na kuimba pamoja nacho.

rows.source: Many older songs use AABA: a tune, the same tune again, a contrasting bridge, then the tune once more. Each section often runs eight bars; here they run four.
rows.translation: Nyimbo nyingi za zamani hutumia AABA: melodi, melodi ileile tena, daraja tofauti, kisha melodi mara nyingine. Kila sehemu mara nyingi huwa vipimo vinane; hapa ni vinne.

rows.source: In AABA form, which section is the bridge?
rows.translation: Katika muundo wa AABA, sehemu gani ni daraja?

rows.source: The easiest intro is the song's last line, played before the first verse. It sets the key, the tempo and the mood, and the singer knows exactly where to come in.
rows.translation: Utangulizi rahisi zaidi ni mstari wa mwisho wa wimbo, ukipigwa kabla ya ubeti wa kwanza. Huanzisha ufunguo, tempo na hisia, na mwimbaji hujua hasa pa kuingia.

rows.source: An intro from the last line
Why start with the song's last line?
rows.translation: Kwa nini uanze na mstari wa mwisho wa wimbo?

rows.source: It sets the key and tempo
To end, repeat the last line, often twice more, and let the final chord ring. A tag tells everyone the song is closing.
rows.translation: Kumalizia, rudia mstari wa mwisho, mara nyingi mara mbili zaidi, na uache kodi ya mwisho ilie. Mrudio wa mwisho huwaambia wote wimbo unaisha.
Ubeti kwa vidole, kiitikio nyuzi pamoja

rows.source: Arrangers lift a chorus by changing what the guitar does. Fingerpick the verse softly, then strum the chorus, and the same chords suddenly sound bigger.
rows.translation: Wapangaji wa muziki huinua kiitikio kwa kubadili kazi ya gitaa. Piga ubeti kwa vidole kwa upole, kisha piga nyuzi pamoja katika kiitikio, na kodi zilezile ghafla zitasikika kubwa zaidi.

rows.source: Verse: Travis on G and D7
rows.translation: Ubeti: Travis kwa G na D7

rows.source: Each section can add a little: a picked verse, a strummed chorus, then triads up the neck for the last chorus. Save your biggest sound for the end.
rows.translation: Kila sehemu inaweza kuongeza kidogo: ubeti kwa vidole, kiitikio kwa nyuzi pamoja, kisha kodi za noti tatu juu ya shingo kwa kiitikio cha mwisho. Hifadhi sauti kubwa zaidi kwa mwisho.

rows.source: When the melody holds a long note, a solo guitarist fills the space: a bass note or two from the chord, then back to the tune in time.
rows.translation: Melodi inaposhikilia noti ndefu, mpiga gitaa wa solo hujaza nafasi: noti moja au mbili za besi kutoka kwenye kodi, kisha hurudia melodi kwa wakati.

rows.source: On top of every melody note
rows.translation: Juu ya kila noti ya melodi

rows.source: Fill with notes of the chord under the long note. Over G: G, B and D. Over D7: D, F sharp, A and C. They can't clash with the band.
rows.translation: Jaza kwa noti za kodi iliyo chini ya noti ndefu. Kwa G: G, B na D. Kwa D7: D, F diesi, A na C. Haziwezi kutopatana na bendi.

rows.source: Down by the Riverside: your arrangement
rows.translation: Down by the Riverside: mpangilio wako

rows.source: Down by the Riverside, a spiritual first printed in 1918, gets the full treatment: a Travis-picked intro, two verses and choruses, a pentatonic solo, and a tag.
rows.translation: Down by the Riverside, wimbo wa kiroho uliochapishwa kwanza mwaka 1918, hupata mpangilio kamili: utangulizi kwa Travis, beti na viitikio viwili, solo ya pentatoniki, na mrudio wa mwisho.

rows.source: Intro: Travis on G and D7
rows.translation: Utangulizi: Travis kwa G na D7

rows.source: A solo in G major pentatonic
rows.translation: Solo ya pentatoniki ya G meja

rows.source: The solo uses G major pentatonic in open position: G, A, B, D and E. It follows the verse's chords and ends a beat early, so the singer can come back in.
rows.translation: Solo hutumia pentatoniki ya G meja katika nafasi ya wazi: G, A, B, D na E. Hufuata kodi za ubeti na huisha pigo moja mapema ili mwimbaji aweze kurudi.

rows.source: Which parts of this arrangement have no words?
rows.translation: Sehemu zipi za mpangilio huu hazina maneno?
AABA, mtindo wa miaka ya hamsini

rows.source: Jukebox Moon is a Timbre Original: a fifties slow dance in AABA form, a verse, the verse again, a bridge on F, then the verse once more. Strum every beat, with a quick swung up into each new bar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Jukebox Moon ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: dansi ya polepole ya miaka ya hamsini kwa AABA, ubeti, ubeti tena, daraja kwa F, kisha ubeti mara nyingine. Piga kila pigo, ukiweka pigo la juu la haraka la swing kuelekea kila kipimo kipya. Wimbo mzima uko Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.

rows.source: In Jukebox Moon, which section is the B?
rows.translation: Katika Jukebox Moon, sehemu gani ni B?

rows.source: The verses share one tune: A, A. The bridge brings new chords and a new tune, B, then the verse returns.
rows.translation: Beti hushiriki melodi moja: A, A. Daraja huleta kodi mpya na melodi mpya, B, kisha ubeti hurudi.

rows.source: No new ideas: form, intros, tags, texture, fills and your Down by the Riverside. Play it straight through, like a set.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: muundo, utangulizi, miisho, muundo wa sauti, fill na Down by the Riverside yako. Piga bila kusimama, kama onyesho.

rows.source: In AABA, how many times does the A tune come?
rows.translation: Katika AABA, melodi A huja mara ngapi?

rows.source: From G C E A to new keys, fingerpicking and a stage set
rows.translation: Kutoka G C E A hadi funguo mpya, kupiga kwa vidole na onyesho la jukwaani

rows.source: Hold it, meet G C E A, play your first notes, your first chord and a song.
rows.translation: Ishike, fahamu G C E A, piga noti zako za kwanza, kodi yako ya kwanza na wimbo.

rows.source: Rest the body against your chest with the neck pointing left. The string nearest the floor is string 1. It plays the highest open note.
rows.translation: Egemeza kiwiliwili kifuani, shingo ikielekea kushoto. Uzi ulio karibu zaidi na sakafu ni uzi 1. Hupiga noti wazi ya juu zaidi.
Ulio karibu zaidi na uso wako

rows.source: Strings count up from the floor side: 1, 2, 3, 4.
rows.translation: Nyuzi huhesabiwa kupanda kutoka upande wa sakafu: 1, 2, 3, 4.

rows.source: Pluck string 1 with your thumb and let it ring.
rows.translation: Piga uzi 1 kwa gumba na uache ulie.

rows.source: Now string 2, the next one up.
G C E A, the open strings
rows.translation: G C E A, nyuzi wazi

rows.source: From string 4 down to string 1, the open strings are G, C, E, A. Try: Good Cooks Eat Apples.
rows.translation: Kutoka uzi 4 chini hadi uzi 1, nyuzi wazi ni G, C, E, A. Kumbuka kwa Kiingereza: Good Cooks Eat Apples.

rows.source: Play strings 4 and 3, one at a time.
On most instruments the strings get lower as you go up. On ukulele, string 4 (G) is higher than string 3 (C). This is called re-entrant tuning.
rows.translation: Kwa ala nyingi, ukisogea juu kutoka uzi mmoja hadi mwingine, sauti huzidi kuwa ya chini. Kwa ukulele, uzi 4 (G) una sauti ya juu kuliko uzi 3 (C). Huu huitwa upangaji wa sauti wa re-entrant.

rows.source: The high G keeps every chord close together and bright. It is the sweet, ringing sound people know as ukulele.
rows.translation: G ya juu huweka noti za kila kodi karibu na kuifanya iwe angavu. Ndiyo sauti tamu inayolia ambayo watu huitambua kuwa ya ukulele.

rows.source: String 3, then string 4. Hear the jump up?
rows.translation: Uzi 3, kisha uzi 4. Unasikia mruko wa juu?

rows.source: Which open string plays the lowest note?
rows.translation: Uzi upi wazi hupiga noti ya chini zaidi?

rows.source: With re-entrant tuning, C on string 3 is the lowest note on the ukulele.
rows.translation: Kwa upangaji wa sauti wa re-entrant, C kwenye uzi 3 ndiyo noti ya chini zaidi ya ukulele.

rows.source: Open, fret 2, fret 3: A, B, C.
rows.translation: Wazi, freti 2, freti 3: A, B, C.

rows.source: Fret 2 on string 3 is D. Fret 1 on string 2 is F. Fret 3 on string 2 is G, the same note as open string 4.
rows.translation: Freti 2 kwenye uzi 3 ni D. Freti 1 kwenye uzi 2 ni F. Freti 3 kwenye uzi 2 ni G, noti ileile ya uzi 4 wazi.

rows.source: Fret 3 on string 2 matches which open string?
rows.translation: Freti 3 kwenye uzi 2 inalingana na uzi upi wazi?

rows.source: Both are G. Two places, one note.
rows.translation: Zote ni G. Sehemu mbili, noti moja.

rows.source: Open strings, the high G and your first fretted notes. Take it slowly and let each note ring.
rows.translation: Nyuzi wazi, G ya juu na noti zako za kwanza kwenye freti. Piga polepole na uache kila noti ilie.

rows.source: Name the open strings from 4 to 1.
Which one is the open G string?
rows.translation: Ipi ni uzi wa G wazi?

rows.source: Your fretted notes: D, F, B, C.
rows.translation: Noti zako kwenye freti: D, F, B, C.

rows.source: C uses your third finger on fret 3 of string 1. The other three strings ring open.
rows.translation: C hutumia kidole chako cha tatu kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 1. Nyuzi nyingine tatu hulia wazi.

rows.source: Brush down across all four strings with the pad of your thumb, from string 4 to string 1. Keep your wrist loose.
rows.translation: Pitisha sehemu laini ya gumba chini juu ya nyuzi zote nne, kutoka uzi 4 hadi uzi 1. Legeza kifundo cha mkono.

rows.source: Which finger plays the C chord?
Your third finger reaches fret 3 without a stretch.
rows.translation: Kidole chako cha tatu hufikia freti 3 bila kunyooshwa.

rows.source: Row, Row, Row Your Boat needs only C. Strum it on the two big beats of every bar, then play the tune on strings 1 to 3.
rows.translation: Row, Row, Row Your Boat inahitaji C tu. Piga kodi hiyo kwenye mapigo mawili makuu ya kila kipimo, kisha piga melodi kwenye nyuzi 1 hadi 3.

rows.source: The tune's five notes: C and D on string 3, E, F and G on string 2.
rows.translation: Noti tano za melodi: C na D kwenye uzi 3, E, F na G kwenye uzi 2.

rows.source: A minor, F, G7 and G: with C, the chords behind countless songs.
rows.translation: A minori, F, G7 na G: pamoja na C, kodi zinazotumika katika nyimbo nyingi sana.

rows.source: A minor and your first change
rows.translation: A minori na badiliko lako la kwanza

rows.source: Put your second finger on fret 2 of string 4 and strum all four strings. A minor sounds darker than C.
rows.translation: Weka kidole cha pili kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 4 na upige nyuzi zote nne. A minori husikika yenye giza zaidi kuliko C.
Kodi ipi husikika yenye giza zaidi?

rows.source: Lift the finger you don't need and place the new one while the last strum still rings. Look ahead to the next chord.
rows.translation: Inua kidole usichohitaji na uweke kipya wakati mpigo wa mwisho bado unalia. Tazama kodi inayofuata mapema.

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second finger on fret 2 of string 4. Strings 3 and 1 ring open.
rows.translation: Kidole cha kwanza kwenye freti 1 ya uzi 2, cha pili kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 4. Nyuzi 3 na 1 hulia wazi.

rows.source: Which chord shares a finger with F?
rows.translation: Kodi ipi hushiriki kidole na F?

rows.source: Your second finger sits on fret 2 of string 4 for both. Keep it down when you change.
rows.translation: Kidole chako cha pili kiko kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 4 kwa zote mbili. Kibakize chini unapobadili.

rows.source: G7, the chord that leads home
First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second on fret 2 of string 3, third on fret 2 of string 1. Strum all four.
rows.translation: Kidole cha kwanza kwenye freti 1 ya uzi 2, cha pili freti 2 ya uzi 3, cha tatu freti 2 ya uzi 1. Piga nyuzi zote nne.

rows.source: A chord that wants to go home
G7 sounds unfinished. Play C after it and the tension lets go. That pull is why so many songs put G7 before C.
rows.translation: G7 husikika haijakamilika. Piga C baada yake na mvutano utaisha. Mvuto huo ndio hufanya nyimbo nyingi ziweke G7 kabla ya C.

rows.source: Does this end at home or leave you hanging?
rows.translation: Hii inaishia kwenye msingi au inaacha mvutano?

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of string 3, second on fret 2 of string 1, third on fret 3 of string 2. Arch your fingers so string 4 rings.
rows.translation: Kidole cha kwanza kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 3, cha pili freti 2 ya uzi 1, cha tatu freti 3 ya uzi 2. Pinda vidole ili uzi 4 ulie.

rows.source: G and G7 both press which spot?
rows.translation: G na G7 zote hubonyeza sehemu gani?

rows.source: Both chords put a finger on fret 2 of string 3. Use it as your anchor.
rows.translation: Kodi zote mbili huweka kidole kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 3. Kitumie kama nanga yako.

rows.source: Which one is G7, the one with more tension?
rows.translation: Ipi ni G7, yenye mvutano zaidi?

rows.source: C, A minor, F, G7 and G cover hundreds of songs. Make each shape clean, then keep the beat as you change.
rows.translation: C, A minori, F, G7 na G hutumika katika mamia ya nyimbo. Fanya kila umbo litoe sauti safi, kisha dumisha mapigo unapobadili.

rows.source: Which chord uses only one finger?
rows.translation: Kodi ipi hutumia kidole kimoja tu?

rows.source: Steady downs, down-ups and the island strum.
rows.translation: Mapigo ya chini thabiti, chini-juu na mpigo wa visiwani.
Mapigo ya nyuzi chini kwa uthabiti

rows.source: Strum down on every beat: 1, 2, 3, 4. Use the nail of your index finger. When you change chords, your hand keeps moving.
rows.translation: Piga nyuzi chini kwa kila pigo: 1, 2, 3, 4. Tumia ukucha wa shahada. Unapobadili kodi, mkono unaendelea kusogea.

rows.source: What should your hand do while you change chords?
A late chord is better than a broken beat. Keep strumming, even if a string buzzes.
rows.translation: Kodi iliyochelewa ni bora kuliko kupoteza mapigo. Endelea kupiga nyuzi, hata uzi ukikwaruza.
Mapigo ya juu yako kati ya mapigo

rows.source: Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Strum down on the numbers, up on each and. Your hand never stops moving.
rows.translation: Hesabu 1 na 2 na 3 na 4 na. Piga chini kwenye namba, juu kwenye kila na. Mkono hauachi kusogea.

rows.source: Up strums mostly catch strings 1 and 2. Brush them with the pad of your finger, a little softer than the downs.
rows.translation: Mapigo ya juu hugusa hasa nyuzi 1 na 2. Zipige kwa sehemu laini ya kidole, kwa upole kidogo kuliko mapigo ya chini.
Mapigo ya nyuzi juu huja lini?

rows.source: Only at the end of a bar
Down on 1, down-up on 2, down on 3, down-up on 4. Your hand still swings up after 1 and 3; it just misses the strings.
rows.translation: Chini kwenye 1, chini-juu kwenye 2, chini kwenye 3, chini-juu kwenye 4. Mkono bado hupanda baada ya 1 na 3; hauzigusi tu nyuzi.

rows.source: What does your hand do on the and of 1?
rows.translation: Mkono hufanya nini kwenye na ya 1?

rows.source: A silent up stroke keeps your hand in time for the next down.
rows.translation: Mwendo wa juu usio na sauti hudumisha muda wa mkono kwa pigo la chini linalofuata.

rows.source: Down on 1, down-up on 2, skip the down on 3, then up, down-up. The missing down gives it a lilt.
rows.translation: Chini kwenye 1, chini-juu kwenye 2, ruka chini kwenye 3, kisha juu, chini-juu. Pigo la chini linalokosekana huleta mwendo wa kubembea.

rows.source: Which strum do you skip in the island strum?
rows.translation: Unaruka pigo gani katika mpigo wa visiwani?

rows.source: Your hand still moves down on 3, it just misses the strings. That keeps the up after it in time.
rows.translation: Mkono bado hushuka kwenye 3, lakini haugusi nyuzi. Hivyo pigo la juu linalofuata linabaki kwa wakati.
Mpigo wa visiwani na kubadili kodi
Badili kwenye pigo la mwisho la juu

rows.source: The last up strum of a bar can be loose or open. Use it to move to the next chord, so beat 1 lands clean.
rows.translation: Pigo la mwisho la juu la kipimo linaweza kuwa legevu au la nyuzi wazi. Litumie kuhamia kodi inayofuata ili pigo 1 litue kwa usafi.

rows.source: Downs, down-ups and the island strum. Keep your hand moving and let the chords come to you.
rows.translation: Mapigo ya chini, chini-juu na mpigo wa visiwani. Endelea kusogeza mkono na uache kodi zije zenyewe.

rows.source: Which pattern is the island strum?
rows.translation: Mpangilio upi ni mpigo wa visiwani?

rows.source: Play tunes note by note on strings 1 to 3.
rows.translation: Piga melodi noti kwa noti kwenye nyuzi 1 hadi 3.

rows.source: C D E F G A B C. Start on open string 3 and climb across strings 2 and 1. Every note sits in the first three frets.
rows.translation: C D E F G A B C. Anza kwenye uzi 3 wazi na upande kupitia nyuzi 2 na 1. Kila noti iko katika freti tatu za kwanza.

rows.source: String 3 open and fret 2, then string 2 open and fret 1.
rows.translation: Uzi 3 wazi na freti 2, kisha uzi 2 wazi na freti 1.

rows.source: String 2 fret 3, then string 1: open, fret 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: Uzi 2 freti 3, kisha uzi 1: wazi, freti 2, freti 3.

rows.source: How many different note names are in the scale?
rows.translation: Kuna majina mangapi tofauti ya noti katika skeli?

rows.source: C to C is eight notes, but the top C repeats the first. Seven names, then they start again.
rows.translation: C hadi C ni noti nane, lakini C ya juu hurudia ya kwanza. Majina saba, kisha huanza tena.

rows.source: Beethoven wrote this tune in 1824. It moves mostly by step, from one note to the next, on strings 2 and 3.
rows.translation: Beethoven aliandika melodi hii mwaka 1824. Kwa kawaida husogea kwa hatua, kutoka noti moja hadi inayofuata, kwenye nyuzi 2 na 3.

rows.source: The opening: E E F G, G F E D.
rows.translation: Mwanzo: E E F G, G F E D.
Ode to Joy, mstari wa kwanza

rows.source: The first line ends on D. Where does the second line end?
rows.translation: Mstari wa kwanza huishia D. Wa pili huishia wapi?

rows.source: Same start, different finish. The second line comes home to C.
rows.translation: Mwanzo uleule, mwisho tofauti. Mstari wa pili hurudi kwenye C msingi.
Ode to Joy, mstari wa pili

rows.source: This traditional tune leaps from C up to G, then walks back down one note at a time. Every line ends on a longer note.
rows.translation: Melodi hii ya jadi huruka kutoka C hadi G juu, kisha hushuka noti moja moja. Kila mstari huishia kwa noti ndefu zaidi.

rows.source: Open string 3, string 2 fret 3, open string 1.
rows.translation: Uzi 3 wazi, uzi 2 freti 3, uzi 1 wazi.

rows.source: Does this phrase go up or down?
A quarter note lasts one beat, a half note two, a whole note four. Hold each one until the next note starts.
rows.translation: Noti robo hudumu pigo moja, noti nusu mawili, noti nzima manne. Shikilia kila moja hadi noti inayofuata ianze.

rows.source: A dot adds half the note's length. A dotted half note lasts three beats; a dotted quarter lasts one and a half.
rows.translation: Nukta huongeza nusu ya muda wa noti. Noti nusu yenye nukta hudumu mapigo matatu; noti robo yenye nukta hudumu pigo moja na nusu.

rows.source: How many beats does a dotted half note last?
rows.translation: Noti nusu yenye nukta hudumu mapigo mangapi?
Wimbo wa mapenzi wa polepole wa 1861

rows.source: "Aura Lee" was published in 1861, with music by George R. Poulton. Play it slowly and let each note ring into the next.
rows.translation: “Aura Lee” ilichapishwa mwaka 1861, muziki wake ukiwa wa George R. Poulton. Piga polepole na uache kila noti ilie hadi inayofuata.

rows.source: Fret 2 on string 2 is F sharp, one fret above F. A sharp raises a note by one fret.
rows.translation: Freti 2 kwenye uzi 2 ni F diesi, freti moja juu ya F. Diesi hupandisha noti kwa freti moja.

rows.source: A sharp sign raises a note by how much?
rows.translation: Alama ya diesi hupandisha noti kwa kiasi gani?

rows.source: Watch the note highway and keep your place, even if you miss a note. The beat goes on, so you do too.
rows.translation: Tazama njia ya noti na uendelee kufuatilia ulipo, hata ukikosa noti. Mapigo yanaendelea, kwa hiyo nawe endelea.

rows.source: Where is F sharp on string 2?
rows.translation: F diesi iko wapi kwenye uzi 2?

rows.source: D minor, E minor, D, A and E7, then the four-chord song.
rows.translation: D minori, E minori, D, A na E7, kisha wimbo wa kodi nne.
Dm: F na kidole kimoja zaidi

rows.source: Second finger on fret 2 of string 4, third on fret 2 of string 3, first on fret 1 of string 2. String 1 rings open.
rows.translation: Kidole cha pili kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 4, cha tatu freti 2 ya uzi 3, cha kwanza freti 1 ya uzi 2. Uzi 1 hulia wazi.

rows.source: Which chord is D minor closest to?
rows.translation: D minori inafanana zaidi na kodi ipi?

rows.source: D minor is F with one more finger, on fret 2 of string 3.
rows.translation: D minori ni F yenye kidole kimoja zaidi, kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 3.

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of string 1, second on fret 3 of string 2, third on fret 4 of string 3. String 4 rings open.
rows.translation: Kidole cha kwanza kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 1, cha pili freti 3 ya uzi 2, cha tatu freti 4 ya uzi 3. Uzi 4 hulia wazi.

rows.source: E minor and G both leave which string open?
rows.translation: E minori na G zote huacha uzi upi wazi?

rows.source: Put fingers 1, 2 and 3 side by side on fret 2 of strings 4, 3 and 2. String 1 rings open.
rows.translation: Weka vidole 1, 2 na 3 sambamba kwenye freti 2 ya nyuzi 4, 3 na 2. Uzi 1 hulia wazi.

rows.source: Second finger on fret 2 of string 4, first finger on fret 1 of string 3. Strings 2 and 1 ring open.
rows.translation: Kidole cha pili kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 4, cha kwanza freti 1 ya uzi 3. Nyuzi 2 na 1 hulia wazi.

rows.source: Which chord has three fingers on the same fret?
rows.translation: Kodi ipi ina vidole vitatu kwenye freti moja?

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 4, second on fret 2 of string 3, third on fret 2 of string 1. String 2 rings open.
rows.translation: Kidole cha kwanza kwenye freti 1 ya uzi 4, cha pili freti 2 ya uzi 3, cha tatu freti 2 ya uzi 1. Uzi 2 hulia wazi.

rows.source: G7 pulls toward C. In the same way, E7 pulls toward A minor. Play them back to back and listen for the release.
rows.translation: G7 huvuta kuelekea C. Vivyo hivyo, E7 huvuta kuelekea A minori. Zipige moja baada ya nyingine na usikilize mvutano unavyoisha.

rows.source: Number the notes of the C scale and you can name chords by number: C is I, G is V, A minor is vi, F is IV. This order runs through countless songs.
rows.translation: Zipe noti za skeli ya C namba uweze kutaja kodi kwa namba: C ni I, G ni V, A minori ni vi, F ni IV. Mpangilio huu hupatikana katika nyimbo nyingi sana.

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Katika ufunguo wa C, kodi ipi ni IV?

rows.source: Count up the scale from C: C, D, E, F. F is the fourth note, so F is the IV chord.
rows.translation: Hesabu skeli ukipanda kutoka C: C, D, E, F. F ni noti ya nne, kwa hiyo F ndiyo kodi IV.

rows.source: Which chord is vi in C?
rows.translation: Kodi ipi ni vi katika C?

rows.source: Lowercase numbers mean minor chords. The sixth note of C major is A.
rows.translation: Namba za Kirumi za herufi ndogo humaanisha kodi minori. Noti ya sita ya C meja ni A.

rows.source: C, A minor, F, G, G7, D minor, E minor, D, A and E7. Clean shapes first, then steady strums.
rows.translation: C, A minori, F, G, G7, D minori, E minori, D, A na E7. Maumbo safi kwanza, kisha mapigo thabiti ya nyuzi.

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Katika ufunguo wa C, kodi ipi ni V?

rows.source: Four public-domain songs with melody and chords.
rows.translation: Nyimbo nne zisizo na hakimiliki zenye melodi na kodi.

rows.source: Stephen Foster wrote this song in 1848. It counts in two: 1 and 2 and. Most notes are quick eighth notes.
rows.translation: Stephen Foster aliandika wimbo huu mwaka 1848. Una mapigo mawili: 1 na 2 na. Noti nyingi ni noti za nane za haraka.

rows.source: The opening: C D E G, G A G E.
rows.translation: Mwanzo: C D E G, G A G E.

rows.source: Another Foster song, from 1850. The melody bounces between G and E, and a short two-note call answers each line.
rows.translation: Wimbo mwingine wa Foster, wa mwaka 1850. Melodi hubembea kati ya G na E, na mwito mfupi wa noti mbili hujibu kila mstari.

rows.source: G G E G A G E.
rows.translation: G G E G A G E.

rows.source: Like most songs in C, it comes home to C.
rows.translation: Kama nyimbo nyingi katika C, hurudi kwenye C msingi.

rows.source: Count 1 2 3, 1 2 3, with the weight on 1. This is waltz time. "Clementine", first printed in 1884, sways in three.
rows.translation: Hesabu 1 2 3, 1 2 3, ukiweka mkazo kwenye 1. Haya ni mapigo ya waltz. “Clementine”, iliyochapishwa kwanza mwaka 1884, hubembea kwa mapigo matatu.

rows.source: String 2 fret 1, open 3, open 1, then string 1 frets 3 and 1.
rows.translation: Uzi 2 freti 1, uzi 3 wazi, uzi 1 wazi, kisha uzi 1 freti 3 na 1.

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 1. With F, it carries the whole song.
rows.translation: Kidole cha kwanza kwenye freti 1 ya uzi 1. Pamoja na F, hubeba wimbo mzima.
Wimbo wa polepole wa wachunga ng'ombe

rows.source: This traditional tune was in print by 1896. Each line ends on a long note, so count it out before the next one.
rows.translation: Melodi hii ya jadi ilikuwa imechapishwa kufikia mwaka 1896. Kila mstari huishia kwa noti ndefu, kwa hiyo hesabu muda wake wote kabla ya inayofuata.

rows.source: Open 3, string 2 fret 1, open 1, string 2 fret 3, string 1 frets 1 and 3.
rows.translation: Uzi 3 wazi, uzi 2 freti 1, uzi 1 wazi, uzi 2 freti 3, uzi 1 freti 1 na 3.

rows.source: The last line starts D, C sharp, C. How do those notes move?
rows.translation: Mstari wa mwisho huanza D, C diesi, C. Noti hizo husogeaje?

rows.source: Down one fret at a time
Each note is one fret lower on string 3: fret 2, fret 1, open.
rows.translation: Kila noti iko freti moja chini kwenye uzi 3: freti 2, freti 1, wazi.

rows.source: When you strum a song, the melody lives in your head or in a friend's voice. Change chords where the tune leans, and keep the strum steady.
rows.translation: Unapopiga kodi za wimbo, melodi iko kichwani mwako au katika sauti ya rafiki. Badili kodi pale melodi inapoelekea, na udumishe mpigo thabiti wa nyuzi.

rows.source: A song in F usually ends on which chord?
rows.translation: Wimbo katika F kwa kawaida huishia kwa kodi ipi?

rows.source: Songs come home to their key chord. In F, that's F.
rows.translation: Nyimbo hurudi kwenye kodi ya ufunguo wake. Katika F, hiyo ni F.
Orodha yako ya kwanza ya nyimbo

rows.source: Four songs, a handful of chords and three strums. Play them like a small concert: count in, keep going, finish strong.
rows.translation: Nyimbo nne, kodi chache na mitindo mitatu ya kupiga. Zipige kama tamasha dogo: hesabu kuanza, endelea, maliza kwa nguvu.

rows.source: B flat, D7, B minor and G minor, the keys of G, F and D, and moving a song to any key.
rows.translation: B bemoli, D7, B minori na G minori, funguo za G, F na D, na kuhamishia wimbo ufunguo wowote.

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1. Finger 2 goes on string 3, fret 2, and finger 3 on string 4, fret 3.
rows.translation: Laza kidole 1 juu ya nyuzi 2 na 1 kwenye freti 1. Kidole 2 huwekwa kwenye uzi 3, freti 2, na kidole 3 kwenye uzi 4, freti 3.

rows.source: Which chord shares finger 1's spot on string 2 with B flat?
rows.translation: Kodi ipi hushiriki nafasi ya kidole 1 kwenye uzi 2 na B bemoli?

rows.source: F also puts finger 1 on string 2, fret 1. Keep it there as you change.
rows.translation: F pia huweka kidole 1 kwenye uzi 2, freti 1. Kibakize hapo unapobadili.

rows.source: D7 and the key of G
D7: a barre and one finger
Lay finger 1 across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 2, and put finger 2 on string 1, fret 3.
rows.translation: Laza kidole 1 juu ya nyuzi 4, 3 na 2 freti 2, na weka kidole 2 kwenye uzi 1, freti 3.

rows.source: In G, the chords G, C and D7 do most of the work, with E minor for a darker color. D7 pulls back to G the way G7 pulls to C.
rows.translation: Katika G, kodi G, C na D7 hufanya kazi kubwa zaidi, pamoja na E minori kwa sauti yenye giza. D7 huvuta kurudi G kama G7 inavyovuta kuelekea C.

rows.source: B minor and the key of D
rows.translation: B minori na ufunguo wa D

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 2, then reach finger 3 to string 4, fret 4.
rows.translation: Laza kidole 1 juu ya nyuzi 3, 2 na 1 freti 2, kisha nyoosha kidole 3 hadi uzi 4, freti 4.

rows.source: D and B minor both press fret 2 on which strings?
rows.translation: D na B minori zote hubonyeza freti 2 kwenye nyuzi zipi?

rows.source: Both chords hold fret 2 on strings 3 and 2. Only the outer strings change.
rows.translation: Kodi zote mbili hushika freti 2 kwenye nyuzi 3 na 2. Nyuzi za nje tu ndizo hubadilika.

rows.source: In D, the chords D, G and A7 carry the song, and B minor adds a sad one. A7 is a single finger: string 3, fret 1.
rows.translation: Katika D, kodi D, G na A7 hubeba wimbo, na B minori huongeza huzuni. A7 hutumia kidole kimoja: uzi 3, freti 1.

rows.source: A song's chords are steps of its key: I, IV and V. Change key and the numbers stay. In C that's C, F and G7; in G, it's G, C and D7; in F, F, B flat and C7.
rows.translation: Kodi za wimbo ni madaraja ya ufunguo wake: I, IV na V. Ukibadili ufunguo, namba hubaki. Katika C ni C, F na G7; katika G, ni G, C na D7; katika F, ni F, B bemoli na C7.

rows.source: In the key of F, which chord is IV?
