rows.source: C is the thickest string and the lowest. Strings count from A (1) to C (4).
rows.translation: C ni uzi mnene zaidi na wenye sauti ya chini zaidi. Nyuzi huhesabiwa kutoka A (1) hadi C (4).

rows.source: Pluck string 1, the A, and let it ring.
rows.translation: Piga uzi 1, yaani A, kwa kidole na uache usikike.

rows.source: Now the thickest string, the C. Let it rumble.
rows.translation: Sasa uzi mnene zaidi, yaani C. Acha uvume.

rows.source: Sit near the front edge of a chair, feet flat and knees apart, as if you could stand up easily. The cello rests between your knees.
rows.translation: Keti karibu na ukingo wa mbele wa kiti, nyayo sakafuni na magoti yakitengana, kana kwamba unaweza kusimama kwa urahisi. Cello hukaa kati ya magoti.

rows.source: Pull out the endpin until the cello's top edge meets your chest at the breastbone and the C peg sits near your left ear. Tighten the screw. A rest or strap keeps it from sliding.
rows.translation: Vuta mguu wa cello nje hadi ukingo wake wa juu uguse kifua kwenye mfupa wa kidari, na kigingi cha C kiwe karibu na sikio la kushoto. Kaza skrubu. Kizuizi au kamba huzuia mguu kuteleza.

rows.source: Where does the top edge of the cello touch you?
rows.translation: Ukingo wa juu wa cello hugusa sehemu ipi ya mwili wako?

rows.source: The cello leans back against your chest, and your knees steady it lightly from the sides.
rows.translation: Cello huegemea nyuma kifuani, na magoti huishikilia kwa upole kutoka pembeni.

rows.source: Sitting tall, pluck D, then G. Keep your shoulders loose.
rows.translation: Ukiwa umeketi wima, piga D kwa kidole, kisha G. Mabega yabaki yamelegea.

rows.source: Bend your thumb and set its tip where the frog meets the stick, across from your middle finger. Drape all four fingers over the stick and let the hand hang heavy.
rows.translation: Pinda gumba, uweke ncha yake panapokutana frog na fimbo, mkabala na kidole cha kati. Tandaza vidole vyote vinne juu ya fimbo na uache uzito wa mkono ushuke.

rows.source: Set the bow on the D string, halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Pull it slowly to the right.
rows.translation: Weka upinde kwenye uzi wa D, katikati ya daraja la nyuzi na ubao wa vidole. Uvute polepole kwenda kulia.

rows.source: Now the A string. Move your whole arm to its level, then pull slowly.
rows.translation: Sasa uzi wa A. Sogeza mkono mzima hadi kimo chake, kisha uvute polepole.

rows.source: From low to high: C, G, D, A. Each string is five letter names above the last, an interval called a fifth. Try: Cats Go Dancing Around.
rows.translation: Kutoka sauti ya chini hadi juu: C, G, D, A. Kila uzi uko majina matano ya herufi juu ya uliotangulia; umbali huo huitwa wa tano. Kumbuka kwa Kiingereza: Cats Go Dancing Around.

rows.source: Your right arm sets which string the bow plays. Each string has its own arm level, like the steps of a stair. Move the whole arm, not just the hand.
rows.translation: Mkono wa kulia huamua upinde utapiga uzi upi. Kila uzi una kimo chake cha mkono, kama ngazi za kupandia. Sogeza mkono mzima, si sehemu ya kiganja tu.

rows.source: Bow the C string, then G. Let your arm settle at each level.
rows.translation: Piga uzi wa C kwa upinde, kisha G. Acha mkono utulie kwenye kila kimo.

rows.source: Orchestras tune to A. Timbre shows how far each string is from its note in cents; 100 cents make a half step, the smallest step on a piano. Tune A, then D, G and C.
rows.translation: Okestra hurekebisha sauti kwa A. Timbre huonyesha kwa senti jinsi kila uzi ulivyo mbali na noti yake; senti 100 ni nusu toni, hatua ndogo zaidi kwenye piano. Rekebisha A, kisha D, G na C.

rows.source: Now D, G and C. Tune each one, then bow it and hold it.
rows.translation: Sasa D, G na C. Rekebisha kila uzi, kisha upige kwa upinde na ushikilie sauti.

rows.source: Sit tall with the endpin set, soft bow hold, bow halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Now play everything from this unit.
rows.translation: Keti wima, mguu wa cello ukiwa umewekwa. Shika upinde kwa upole, uuweke katikati ya daraja la nyuzi na ubao wa vidole. Sasa piga yote uliyojifunza katika kitengo hiki.

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the D string: open D, first finger a whole step up for E, third finger two whole steps up for F sharp. Pluck it first, then bow it.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb uko kwenye uzi wa D: D wazi, kidole cha kwanza toni nzima juu kwa E, cha tatu toni nzima mbili juu kwa F diesi. Piga kwanza kwa kidole, kisha kwa upinde.

rows.source: First finger on the D string, a whole step up. That's E.
rows.translation: Kidole cha kwanza kwenye uzi wa D, toni nzima juu. Hiyo ni E.

rows.source: Third finger, a whole step above your first. That's F sharp.
rows.translation: Kidole cha tatu, toni nzima juu ya cha kwanza. Hiyo ni F diesi.

rows.source: F sharp, E, D, E, then F sharp three times.
rows.translation: F diesi, E, D, E, kisha F diesi mara tatu.

rows.source: One slow down-bow, then one slow up-bow on D. Keep the sound even to the end.
rows.translation: Pigo moja la chini polepole, kisha la juu polepole kwenye D. Sauti ibaki sawa hadi mwisho.
Noti robo kwenye D na A

rows.source: D, A, D, A. Let your arm rock between the two levels.
rows.translation: D, A, D, A. Acha mkono ubadilishane kati ya vimo viwili.

rows.source: Going from C to D skips the G string, so your arm makes a bigger move. Travel smoothly and don't let the middle string sound.
rows.translation: Kutoka C kwenda D huruka uzi wa G, hivyo mkono hufanya mwendo mkubwa zaidi. Sogea kwa ulaini na usiache uzi wa katikati usikike.
Nafasi ya kwanza: D na A

rows.source: One finger per half step: play D major and your first melodies.
rows.translation: Kidole kimoja kwa kila nusu toni: piga D meja na melodi zako za kwanza.
Kidole kimoja kwa kila nusu toni

rows.source: A half step is the smallest step in music. In first position your fingers sit a half step apart, starting a whole step (two half steps) above the open string. Thumb behind the neck, across from second finger.
rows.translation: Nusu toni ni hatua ndogo zaidi katika muziki. Katika nafasi ya kwanza, vidole hutengana kwa nusu toni, vikianzia toni nzima (nusu toni mbili) juu ya uzi wazi. Gumba nyuma ya shingo, mkabala na kidole cha pili.

rows.source: Open D, then E with your first finger. Hold E until it settles in tune.
rows.translation: D wazi, kisha E kwa kidole cha kwanza. Shikilia E hadi itulie kwenye sauti sahihi.

rows.source: Same finger on the A string: open A, then B.
rows.translation: Kidole kilekile kwenye uzi wa A: A wazi, kisha B.

rows.source: Open D, then E. How far apart?
rows.translation: D wazi, kisha E. Zimetengana kwa kiasi gani?

rows.source: First finger on D and A
rows.translation: Kidole cha kwanza kwenye D na A

rows.source: Third finger plays F sharp, a whole step above E. Let second finger hover over its spot between 1 and 3, so your hand keeps its shape.
rows.translation: Kidole cha tatu hupiga F diesi, toni nzima juu ya E. Kidole cha pili kikae juu ya nafasi yake kati ya 1 na 3 bila kubonyeza, ili mkono udumishe umbo lake.

rows.source: D, E, F sharp. Keep first finger down while third plays.
rows.translation: D, E, F diesi. Acha kidole cha kwanza chini cha tatu kinapopiga.

rows.source: From E to the next note: what kind of step?
rows.translation: Kutoka E hadi noti inayofuata: ni hatua ya aina gani?

rows.source: Why does second finger stay over its spot?
rows.translation: Kwa nini kidole cha pili hukaa juu ya nafasi yake?

rows.source: Each finger owns a half step. Keeping all four in place makes every note land in the same spot each time.
rows.translation: Kila kidole kina nusu toni yake. Kuviacha vyote vinne mahali pake hufanya kila noti itue sehemu ileile kila mara.

rows.source: Same fingers on the A string: open A, B, C sharp.
rows.translation: Vidole vilevile kwenye uzi wa A: A wazi, B, C diesi.

rows.source: Fourth finger plays G, a half step above F sharp. D, E, F sharp, G is the first half of the D major scale: open, 1, 3, 4.
rows.translation: Kidole cha nne hupiga G, nusu toni juu ya F diesi. D, E, F diesi, G ni nusu ya kwanza ya skeli ya D meja: wazi, 1, 3, 4.

rows.source: D, E, F sharp, G: open, 1, 3, 4.
rows.translation: D, E, F diesi, G: wazi, 1, 3, 4.

rows.source: Fourth-finger G on the D string is an octave above the open G string: the same letter, eight notes higher. When it's in tune, the G string hums along.
rows.translation: G ya kidole cha nne kwenye uzi wa D iko oktava moja juu ya uzi wa G wazi: herufi ileile, noti nane juu. Sauti ikiwa sahihi, uzi wa G huvuma pamoja nayo.

rows.source: Fourth-finger G, open G, then fourth-finger G again. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: G ya kidole cha nne, G wazi, kisha G ya kidole cha nne tena. Sikiliza mwangwi wa uzi.

rows.source: Play D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, then A, B, C sharp, D on the A string. The same fingers twice: open, 1, 3, 4.
rows.translation: Piga D, E, F diesi, G kwenye uzi wa D, kisha A, B, C diesi, D kwenye uzi wa A. Vidole vilevile mara mbili: wazi, 1, 3, 4.

rows.source: Which fingers play D major on each string?
rows.translation: Vidole vipi hupiga D meja kwenye kila uzi?

rows.source: This French melody from the 1700s uses only notes you've learned: D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, and A and B on the A string.
rows.translation: Melodi hii ya Kifaransa ya karne iliyoanza mwaka 1700 hutumia noti ulizojifunza tu: D, E, F diesi, G kwenye uzi wa D, na A na B kwenye uzi wa A.

rows.source: Which finger plays B on the A string?
rows.translation: Kidole kipi hupiga B kwenye uzi wa A?
Cha tatu, kwenye uzi wa D
Cha pili, kwenye uzi wa D
Cha kwanza, kwenye uzi wa A

rows.source: Open, 1, 3, 4 on the D and A strings. Keep the hand's shape, land each note in tune, and let the octaves ring.
rows.translation: Wazi, 1, 3, 4 kwenye nyuzi za D na A. Dumisha umbo la mkono, fikia sauti sahihi ya kila noti, na uache oktava zilingane kwa sauti.

rows.source: Third finger to fourth: what kind of step?
rows.translation: Kidole cha tatu hadi cha nne: ni hatua ya aina gani?

rows.source: Two octave checks: G with open G, then fourth-finger D with open D.
rows.translation: Majaribio mawili ya oktava: G na G wazi, kisha D ya kidole cha nne na D wazi.

rows.source: Which finger plays C sharp on the A string?
rows.translation: Kidole kipi hupiga C diesi kwenye uzi wa A?

rows.source: Two low strings, C major and G major scales, and three classic melodies.
rows.translation: Nyuzi mbili za chini, skeli za C meja na G meja, na melodi tatu maarufu za kale.
Vidole vilevile, uzi wa chini zaidi

rows.source: On the G string, first finger plays A, third finger B, and fourth finger C. Same spacing as on D. Let your arm settle at the G string level.
rows.translation: Kwenye uzi wa G, kidole cha kwanza hupiga A, cha tatu B, na cha nne C. Nafasi kati ya vidole ni zilezile za D. Acha mkono utulie kwenye kimo cha uzi wa G.

rows.source: G, A, B, C on the G string plus D, E, F sharp, G on the D string make the G major scale. Same fingers on both strings.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C kwenye uzi wa G pamoja na D, E, F diesi, G kwenye uzi wa D huunda skeli ya G meja. Vidole vilevile kwenye nyuzi zote mbili.

rows.source: Which finger plays C on the G string?
rows.translation: Kidole kipi hupiga C kwenye uzi wa G?

rows.source: On the C string, first finger plays D, third finger E, and fourth finger F. The thick string needs a slow, heavy bow to speak.
rows.translation: Kwenye uzi wa C, kidole cha kwanza hupiga D, cha tatu E, na cha nne F. Uzi mnene huhitaji upinde wa polepole wenye uzito ili utoe sauti.

rows.source: C, D, E, F: open, 1, 3, 4. Give each note time to speak.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F: wazi, 1, 3, 4. Ipe kila noti muda wa kusikika.

rows.source: C, D, E, F on the C string plus G, A, B, C on the G string is the C major scale. It has no sharps at all.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F kwenye uzi wa C pamoja na G, A, B, C kwenye uzi wa G ni skeli ya C meja. Haina diesi hata moja.

rows.source: Up the C major scale. At the top, listen for C ringing with the open C string.
rows.translation: Panda skeli ya C meja. Ukifika juu, sikiliza C ikiimba pamoja na uzi wa C wazi.

rows.source: Second finger plays F natural on the D string, a half step below F sharp, and C natural on the A string. C major needs both.
rows.translation: Kidole cha pili hupiga F asilia kwenye uzi wa D, nusu toni chini ya F diesi, na C asilia kwenye uzi wa A. C meja inahitaji zote mbili.

rows.source: D, E, F, G: open, 1, 2, 4. Second finger sits right next to first.
rows.translation: D, E, F, G: wazi, 1, 2, 4. Kidole cha pili hukaa karibu kabisa na cha kwanza.

rows.source: E, then second finger or third?
rows.translation: E, kisha kidole cha pili au cha tatu?

rows.source: Cellists give each finger its own half step, so F takes second finger and F sharp takes third. A note just past the hand, like F sharp on the C string, needs an extension, a wider hand. This course picks keys that avoid it.
rows.translation: Wapiga cello hukipa kila kidole nusu toni yake, hivyo F hutumia cha pili, F diesi cha tatu. Noti iliyo nje kidogo ya mkono, kama F diesi kwenye uzi wa C, huhitaji kunyoosha nafasi kati ya vidole. Kozi hii huchagua funguo zisizohitaji hivyo.

rows.source: C major, second octave: second finger for F and for the top C.
rows.translation: C meja, oktava ya pili: kidole cha pili kwa F na C ya juu.

rows.source: Ode to Joy, an octave up
rows.translation: Ode to Joy, oktava moja juu

rows.source: Brahms wrote this lullaby in 1868. It rocks in three on the G and D strings. Use long, slow bows and let each phrase breathe.
rows.translation: Brahms alitunga wimbo huu wa kubembeleza mwaka 1868. Unayumba kwa mapigo matatu kwenye nyuzi za G na D. Tumia mipigo mirefu ya polepole ya upinde na uache kila kishazi kipumue.

rows.source: G, F sharp, E: fingers 4, 3, 1. This is the lullaby's high point.
rows.translation: G, F diesi, E: vidole 4, 3, 1. Hapa ndipo wimbo wa kubembeleza unapofika juu zaidi.

rows.source: Au clair de la lune is a French folk song from the 1700s. It lives on the G and D strings, with C under your fourth finger.
rows.translation: Au clair de la lune ni wimbo wa jadi wa Kifaransa wa karne iliyoanza mwaka 1700. Uko kwenye nyuzi za G na D, C ikiwa chini ya kidole cha nne.

rows.source: D, C, B, A, G: open D, then fingers 4, 3, 1 and open G.
rows.translation: D, C, B, A, G: D wazi, kisha vidole 4, 3, 1 na G wazi.

rows.source: Which notes in this tune are open strings?
rows.translation: Noti zipi katika melodi hii ni nyuzi wazi?

rows.source: Open, 1, 3, 4 on every string, with second finger for F and C natural. Slow, heavy bows on the low strings.
rows.translation: Wazi, 1, 3, 4 kwenye kila uzi, pamoja na kidole cha pili kwa F na C asilia. Upinde wa polepole wenye uzito kwenye nyuzi za chini.

rows.source: Two octave checks: C with open C, then G with open G.
rows.translation: Majaribio mawili ya oktava: C na C wazi, kisha G na G wazi.

rows.source: Which of these keys has no sharps?
rows.translation: Ni ufunguo upi hapa hauna diesi?

rows.source: Slide to fourth position, check it by ear, and play The Swan and Amazing Grace.
rows.translation: Teleza hadi nafasi ya nne, kagua kwa sikio, na upige The Swan na Neema ya Ajabu.

rows.source: A shift moves your whole hand to a new place on the string. Lighten the finger, slide it along the string without lifting, and let your thumb travel with the hand.
rows.translation: Kuhama nafasi husogeza mkono mzima kwenda sehemu mpya kwenye uzi. Punguza mgandamizo wa kidole, kitelezeshe kwenye uzi bila kukiinua, na uache gumba lisafiri pamoja na mkono.

rows.source: In fourth position, first finger plays D on the A string, the note fourth finger played in first position. Your thumb settles where the neck curves into the body.
rows.translation: Katika nafasi ya nne, kidole cha kwanza hupiga D kwenye uzi wa A, noti iliyopigwa na cha nne katika nafasi ya kwanza. Gumba hutulia pale shingo inapopinda kuingia mwilini mwa ala.

rows.source: B with first finger, then slide that finger up to D. Keep it light on the way.
rows.translation: B kwa kidole cha kwanza, kisha telezesha kidole hicho juu hadi D. Kisibane unapohama.

rows.source: Moving the hand as one unit keeps your finger spacing, so the next notes land in tune too.
rows.translation: Kusogeza mkono kama kitu kimoja hudumisha nafasi kati ya vidole, hivyo noti zinazofuata pia hutua kwa sauti sahihi.

rows.source: Shift up, back, and up again on first finger. Land each note in tune.
rows.translation: Hama juu, urudi, kisha juu tena kwa kidole cha kwanza. Fikia sauti sahihi ya kila noti.

rows.source: In fourth position on the A string, first finger plays D, third finger E, and fourth finger F. Same frame as first position: one finger per half step.
rows.translation: Katika nafasi ya nne kwenye uzi wa A, kidole cha kwanza hupiga D, cha tatu E, na cha nne F. Umbo lilelile la nafasi ya kwanza: kidole kimoja kwa kila nusu toni.

rows.source: D, E, F: fingers 1, 3, 4. Up here the notes sit a little closer together.
rows.translation: D, E, F: vidole 1, 3, 4. Huku juu noti ziko karibu zaidi kidogo.

rows.source: Open A, B, shift on first finger to D, then E with third.
rows.translation: A wazi, B, hama kwa kidole cha kwanza hadi D, kisha E kwa cha tatu.

rows.source: In fourth position on the A string, which finger plays E?
rows.translation: Katika nafasi ya nne kwenye uzi wa A, kidole kipi hupiga E?

rows.source: Up to fourth position and back
rows.translation: Kupanda nafasi ya nne na kurudi

rows.source: Check it with the open A
rows.translation: Kagua kwa kulinganisha na A wazi

rows.source: In fourth position on the D string, first finger plays G and third plays A, the same note as the open A string. Play them one after the other and match them.
rows.translation: Katika nafasi ya nne kwenye uzi wa D, kidole cha kwanza hupiga G na cha tatu A, noti ileile ya uzi wa A wazi. Zipige moja baada ya nyingine na uzilinganishe.

rows.source: First-finger G, then third-finger A, both on the D string.
rows.translation: G ya kidole cha kwanza, kisha A ya cha tatu, zote kwenye uzi wa D.

rows.source: Fourth-position A, open A, fourth-position A. Make them one sound.
rows.translation: A ya nafasi ya nne, A wazi, A ya nafasi ya nne. Zifanye ziwe sauti moja.
Hama nafasi kwenye uzi wa D

rows.source: Play E with first finger in first position, then slide that finger up to G. That's three half steps, the same distance as B to D on the A string.
rows.translation: Piga E kwa kidole cha kwanza katika nafasi ya kwanza, kisha telezesha kidole hicho juu hadi G. Hizo ni nusu toni tatu, umbali uleule wa B hadi D kwenye uzi wa A.

rows.source: First-finger E, then slide to first-finger G. Let the thumb travel too.
rows.translation: E ya kidole cha kwanza, kisha teleza hadi G kwa kidole hichohicho. Acha gumba nalo lisogee.
Kuhama nafasi kwenye uzi wa D

rows.source: The Swan comes from The Carnival of the Animals, written by Camille Saint-Saëns in 1886. This is its opening phrase, an octave lower and simplified.
rows.translation: The Swan inatoka The Carnival of the Animals, iliyotungwa na Camille Saint-Saëns mwaka 1886. Hiki ni kishazi chake cha mwanzo, kilichorahisishwa na kushushwa oktava moja.

rows.source: Long notes need slow bows. Keep the bow close to the bridge and spread it evenly, so each note lasts to its very end without fading.
rows.translation: Noti ndefu huhitaji upinde wa polepole. Weka upinde karibu na daraja la nyuzi na ugawanye mwendo kwa usawa, ili kila noti idumu hadi mwisho wake bila kupungua sauti.

rows.source: G, F sharp, B: fourth and third finger on D, then third finger on G.
rows.translation: G, F diesi, B: kidole cha nne na cha tatu kwenye D, kisha cha tatu kwenye G.

rows.source: How do you keep a long note from fading?
rows.translation: Unazuiaje sauti ya noti ndefu isipungue?
Gawanya mwendo wa upinde kwa usawa

rows.source: In Amazing Grace, the high D comes right after open A. While the A rings, slide your hand up to fourth position and land on D with first finger.
rows.translation: Katika Neema ya Ajabu, D ya juu huja mara tu baada ya A wazi. A inapolia, telezesha mkono juu hadi nafasi ya nne na utue kwenye D kwa kidole cha kwanza.

rows.source: B, open A, then first-finger D in fourth position. Move while the A sounds.
rows.translation: B, A wazi, kisha D ya kidole cha kwanza katika nafasi ya nne. Hama A inapolia.

rows.source: When is the easiest moment to shift?
rows.translation: Ni wakati gani rahisi zaidi wa kuhama nafasi?

rows.source: In the middle of a long note
While an open string sounds, your left hand is free, so the shift can't be heard.
rows.translation: Uzi wazi unapolia, mkono wa kushoto uko huru, kwa hiyo kuhama hakusikiki.

rows.source: Lighten the finger, move hand and thumb together, and check where you land. The open strings will tell you if you're right.
rows.translation: Punguza mgandamizo wa kidole, sogeza mkono na gumba pamoja, kisha kagua unapotua. Nyuzi wazi zitakuambia kama sauti ni sahihi.

rows.source: Fourth-position A on the D string, then open A. Match them.
rows.translation: A ya nafasi ya nne kwenye uzi wa D, kisha A wazi. Zilinganishe.

rows.source: In fourth position, which note does first finger play on the A string?
rows.translation: Katika nafasi ya nne, kidole cha kwanza hupiga noti ipi kwenye uzi wa A?
Neema ya Ajabu, kishazi cha kwanza

rows.source: From paired strings to fiddle tunes and the bluegrass chop
rows.translation: Kutoka jozi za nyuzi hadi melodi za fiddle na chop ya bluegrass

rows.source: Meet the paired strings, tune them and play all four open notes.
rows.translation: Fahamu jozi za nyuzi, rekebisha sauti zake na upige noti zote nne wazi.

rows.source: A mandolin has eight strings in four pairs, called courses. The two strings of a pair are tuned to the same note and played together, so you treat each pair as one string.
rows.translation: Mandolin ina nyuzi nane katika jozi nne, zinazoitwa courses. Nyuzi mbili za jozi hurekebishwa kuwa noti ileile na hupigwa pamoja, hivyo unachukulia kila jozi kama uzi mmoja.

rows.source: The pair nearest your face is the lowest, pair 4. The pair nearest the floor is the highest, pair 1. When a lesson says string 3, it means the third pair.
rows.translation: Jozi iliyo karibu zaidi na uso wako ina sauti ya chini zaidi, jozi 4. Iliyo karibu zaidi na sakafu ina sauti ya juu zaidi, jozi 1. Somo likisema uzi 3, linamaanisha jozi ya tatu.

rows.source: How do you play a pair?
Both strings at once, as one note
rows.translation: Nyuzi zote mbili pamoja, kama noti moja

rows.source: The two strings sit close together, so one pick stroke catches both. Together they ring as one fuller note.
rows.translation: Nyuzi mbili ziko karibu, hivyo mpigo mmoja wa kijiti huzigusa zote. Pamoja hulia kama noti moja yenye sauti iliyojaa zaidi.

rows.source: Pick the lowest pair, pair 4, and let it ring.
rows.translation: Piga jozi ya chini zaidi, jozi 4, na uache isikike.
Sasa jozi ya juu zaidi, jozi 1.
Nyuzi mbili, kimo kimoja cha sauti

rows.source: Each pair has to match the tuner and match itself. If its two strings disagree, you hear a slow wobble. Tune one string, then bring its partner to the same note.
rows.translation: Kila jozi lazima ilingane na kipima sauti na nyuzi zake zilingane zenyewe. Nyuzi zake mbili zisipolingana, utasikia sauti ikiyumba polepole. Rekebisha uzi mmoja, kisha ulete mwenzake kwenye noti ileile.

rows.source: Pair 3, the D pair. Tune both strings until the wobble stops.
rows.translation: Jozi 3, jozi ya D. Rekebisha nyuzi zote mbili hadi kuyumba kukome.

rows.source: One pair has a slow wobble. What is wrong?
rows.translation: Jozi moja ina sauti inayoyumba polepole. Tatizo ni nini?
Kijiti cha kupigia ni kinene mno

rows.source: That wobble is called beating: the two strings are slightly apart. Tune them until it smooths out.
rows.translation: Kuyumba huko huitwa beating, mapigo ya mwingiliano: sauti za nyuzi mbili zimetengana kidogo. Zirekebishe hadi sauti itulie.

rows.source: Loosen a little below the note, then tighten up to it. Approaching from below keeps the string from slipping flat later.
rows.translation: Legeza hadi chini kidogo ya noti, kisha kaza kupanda hadi uifikie. Kukaribia kutoka chini huzuia uzi kuteleza na kushuka sauti baadaye.

rows.source: Pair 4, then pair 1. Bring each string up to the note from below.
rows.translation: Jozi 4, kisha jozi 1. Pandisha kila uzi hadi noti yake kutoka chini.

rows.source: Hold the pick between the pad of your thumb and the side of your curled index finger. Let only the tip show. Keep your wrist loose, as if shaking water off your hand.
rows.translation: Shika kijiti kati ya sehemu laini ya gumba na ubavu wa kidole cha shahada kilichopinda. Ncha pekee ionekane. Kifundo kibaki kimelegea, kama unapokung'uta maji mkononi.

rows.source: How much of the pick should show?
rows.translation: Kiasi gani cha kijiti kinapaswa kuonekana?

rows.source: A short tip gives you control and a clean sound. Too much pick snags on the paired strings.
rows.translation: Ncha fupi hukupa udhibiti na sauti safi. Kijiti kikitokeza sana hukwama kwenye jozi za nyuzi.

rows.source: Push the pick down through both strings of a pair in one small motion and stop just past them. Rest the heel of your hand lightly near the bridge.
rows.translation: Sukuma kijiti chini kupitia nyuzi zote mbili za jozi kwa mwendo mmoja mdogo, usimame baada tu ya kuzipita. Egemeza sehemu ya chini ya kiganja kwa upole karibu na daraja la nyuzi.

rows.source: From low to high, the pairs are G, D, A and E. Try: Good Dogs Always Eat. A violin is tuned the same way, so fiddle tunes sit naturally on a mandolin.
rows.translation: Kutoka sauti ya chini hadi juu, jozi ni G, D, A na E. Kumbuka kwa Kiingereza: Good Dogs Always Eat. Violini hupangwa sauti vivyo hivyo, kwa hiyo melodi za fiddle hufaa kwa urahisi kwenye mandolin.

rows.source: Low to high: G, D, A, E.
rows.translation: Kutoka sauti ya chini hadi juu: G, D, A, E.
Jozi ipi ina sauti ya chini zaidi?

rows.source: Now high to low: E, A, D, G.
rows.translation: Sasa kutoka sauti ya juu hadi chini: E, A, D, G.

rows.source: Tuned pairs, a relaxed pick and four open notes. Play each one cleanly, with both strings of the pair ringing.
rows.translation: Jozi zenye sauti sahihi, kijiti kilichoshikwa bila kubana, na noti nne wazi. Piga kila moja kwa usafi, nyuzi zote mbili za jozi zikilia.

rows.source: Which pair is the highest in pitch?
rows.translation: Jozi ipi ina kimo cha sauti cha juu zaidi?

rows.source: Pairs count from the highest, pair 1, to the lowest, pair 4.
rows.translation: Jozi huhesabiwa kutoka ya sauti ya juu zaidi, jozi 1, hadi ya chini zaidi, jozi 4.

rows.source: A, G, E, D. Find each pair by its name.
rows.translation: A, G, E, D. Tafuta kila jozi kwa jina lake.

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the D pair: open D, E at fret 2 with your first finger, and F sharp at fret 4 with your second.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb uko kwenye jozi ya D: D wazi, E kwenye freti 2 kwa kidole cha kwanza, na F diesi kwenye freti 4 kwa cha pili.

rows.source: Pair 3, fret 2, first finger. That's E.
rows.translation: Jozi 3, freti 2, kidole cha kwanza. Hiyo ni E.

rows.source: Pair 3, fret 4, second finger. That's F sharp.
rows.translation: Jozi 3, freti 4, kidole cha pili. Hiyo ni F diesi.

rows.source: Fret notes cleanly, learn two frets per finger and play the D major scale.
rows.translation: Shika noti za freti zisikike safi, jifunze freti mbili kwa kila kidole na upige skeli ya D meja.

rows.source: Press both strings of a pair with one fingertip, just behind the metal fret. Mandolin strings are tight, so use the very tip and press only as hard as a clean note needs.
rows.translation: Bonyeza nyuzi zote mbili za jozi kwa ncha moja ya kidole, nyuma tu ya freti ya chuma. Nyuzi za mandolin zimekaza, hivyo tumia ncha kabisa na ubonyeze kwa nguvu inayotosha kutoa noti safi tu.
Ncha ya kidole chako hukaa wapi?

rows.source: Right behind the fret takes the least pressure and gives the cleanest note.
rows.translation: Nyuma tu ya freti huhitaji mgandamizo mdogo zaidi na hutoa noti safi zaidi.

rows.source: Open, fret 2, fret 4: D, E, F♯.
rows.translation: Wazi, freti 2, freti 4: D, E, F♯.

rows.source: Mandolin frets are close together, so each finger covers two. First finger plays frets 1 and 2, second finger 3 and 4, third finger 5 and 6, little finger 7.
rows.translation: Freti za mandolin ziko karibu, hivyo kila kidole hushughulikia mbili. Cha kwanza hupiga freti 1 na 2, cha pili 3 na 4, cha tatu 5 na 6, kidole kidogo 7.

rows.source: Each finger covers two frets on mandolin, so the second finger handles frets 3 and 4.
rows.translation: Kila kidole hushughulikia freti mbili kwenye mandolin, kwa hiyo cha pili hushughulikia freti 3 na 4.

rows.source: The A pair works the same way: open is A, fret 2 is B, fret 4 is C♯ and fret 5 is D. Your hand stays where it is.
rows.translation: Jozi ya A hufanya vivyo hivyo: wazi ni A, freti 2 ni B, freti 4 ni C♯ na freti 5 ni D. Mkono unabaki palepale.

rows.source: Open, then first, second and third fingers on pair 2.
rows.translation: Wazi, kisha vidole vya kwanza, pili na tatu kwenye jozi 2.

rows.source: Join the two shapes and you have the D major scale: D, E, F♯, G on pair 3, then A, B, C♯, D on pair 2. It is home for a great many fiddle tunes.
rows.translation: Unganisha maumbo mawili upate skeli ya D meja: D, E, F♯, G kwenye jozi 3, kisha A, B, C♯, D kwenye jozi 2. Huu ni ufunguo wa melodi nyingi sana za fiddle.

rows.source: What comes after G in the D major scale?
rows.translation: Nini hufuata baada ya G katika skeli ya D meja?

rows.source: After G on pair 3 comes A. Play it on the open A pair rather than reaching for fret 7.
rows.translation: Baada ya G kwenye jozi 3 huja A. Ipige kwenye jozi ya A wazi badala ya kunyoosha kufikia freti 7.

rows.source: Beethoven's melody uses only the first five notes of D major, on pairs 3 and 2. Keep your fingers hovering close to the strings between notes.
rows.translation: Melodi ya Beethoven hutumia noti tano za kwanza za D meja tu, kwenye jozi 3 na 2. Weka vidole karibu na nyuzi bila kuzigusa kati ya noti.

rows.source: F♯ and G on pair 3, then the open A pair.
rows.translation: F♯ na G kwenye jozi 3, kisha jozi ya A wazi.

rows.source: Where does the second phrase land?
The first phrase stops on E and sounds unfinished. The second lands on D and sounds like home.
rows.translation: Kishazi cha kwanza husimama kwenye E na kusikika hakijakamilika. Cha pili hutua kwenye D na kusikika kimerudi kwenye msingi.

rows.source: On the E pair, fret 2 is F♯, fret 3 is G and fret 5 is A. First, second and third fingers, just as before.
rows.translation: Kwenye jozi ya E, freti 2 ni F♯, freti 3 ni G na freti 5 ni A. Vidole vya kwanza, pili na tatu, kama awali.

rows.source: Fret 3 sits in the second finger's zone, frets 3 and 4.
rows.translation: Freti 3 iko katika eneo la kidole cha pili, freti 3 na 4.

rows.source: A to A over two pairs
rows.translation: A hadi A kupitia jozi mbili

rows.source: Fingers one, two and three on frets 2, 4 and 5, with open pairs in between. Play smoothly and let each note ring until the next.
rows.translation: Vidole vya kwanza, pili na tatu kwenye freti 2, 4 na 5, pamoja na jozi wazi katikati. Piga kwa ulaini na uache kila noti ilie hadi inayofuata.

rows.source: Every other note of the scale: D, F♯, A, D.
rows.translation: Ruka noti moja moja katika skeli: D, F♯, A, D.

rows.source: You need C♯ on pair 2. Which fret?
rows.translation: Unahitaji C♯ kwenye jozi 2. Freti ipi?

rows.source: On pair 2, fret 2 is B, fret 3 is C and fret 4 is C♯.
rows.translation: Kwenye jozi 2, freti 2 ni B, freti 3 ni C na freti 4 ni C♯.

rows.source: Does the tune go up or down?
D all the way up to A
Ode to Joy, up to speed
rows.translation: Ode to Joy, kwa kasi kamili

rows.source: Alternate your pick in eighth notes and make long notes sing with tremolo.
rows.translation: Badilishana pigo chini na juu kwa noti za nane, na udumishe noti ndefu kwa tremolo.

rows.source: Down on the beat, up between
Pick down on each beat and up on the and in between. Your hand swings like a pendulum, down, up, down, up, even when a note waits.
rows.translation: Piga chini kwenye kila pigo na juu kwenye na katikati. Mkono unayumba kama pendulamu, chini, juu, chini, juu, hata noti inaposubiri.

rows.source: Which stroke lands on the beat?
Down on the beat and up in between keeps your hand in time, like a drummer's sticks.
rows.translation: Chini kwenye pigo kuu na juu katikati hufanya mkono ufuate muda, kama vijiti vya mpiga ngoma.
Noti za nane kwenye jozi wazi

rows.source: When you move to another pair, your hand keeps its down-up swing. The forearm carries you across; the wrist keeps the beat.
rows.translation: Unapohamia jozi nyingine, mkono huendelea na mwendo wake wa chini-juu. Sehemu ya mkono chini ya kiwiko hukuvusha; kifundo hudumisha mapigo.

rows.source: You cross to a new pair on an and. Which stroke?
rows.translation: Unavuka kwenye jozi mpya wakati wa na. Mpigo upi?

rows.source: Every and gets an up stroke. Let the pendulum decide, not the string.
rows.translation: Kila na hupata mpigo wa juu. Acha mwendo wa kuyumba uamue, si uzi.
D meja kwa noti za nane

rows.source: A mandolin note fades quickly. Tremolo keeps it singing: pick down and up fast and evenly on one pair, so the note sounds unbroken.
rows.translation: Noti ya mandolin hupungua haraka. Tremolo huiendeleza: piga chini na juu haraka na kwa usawa kwenye jozi moja, ili noti isikike bila kukatika.
Noti za nane thabiti kwenye A
Noti za kumi na sita kwenye A

rows.source: Keep the pick close to the strings and the strokes even. Speed comes later, once the motion is relaxed.
rows.translation: Weka kijiti karibu na nyuzi, mipigo ikiwa sawa. Kasi itakuja baadaye, mwendo ukiwa umelegea.

rows.source: Start by counting four strokes to each beat. As it gets easier, stop counting and keep the motion quick and steady. The beat lives in your foot, not in your pick.
rows.translation: Anza kwa kuhesabu mipigo minne ya kijiti kwa kila pigo kuu. Ikianza kuwa rahisi, acha kuhesabu, udumishe mwendo wa haraka na thabiti. Mguu hudumisha mapigo, si kijiti chako.

rows.source: Amazing Grace moves in three beats to the bar. Tremolo through each long note and change notes right on the beat. Two notes are new: A and B on the G pair.
rows.translation: Neema ya Ajabu ina mapigo matatu kwa kipimo. Dumisha tremolo katika kila noti ndefu, ubadili noti sawasawa kwenye pigo. Noti mbili ni mpya: A na B kwenye jozi ya G.

rows.source: Pair 4, fret 2 with your first finger, then fret 4 with your second.
rows.translation: Jozi 4, freti 2 kwa kidole cha kwanza, kisha freti 4 kwa cha pili.

rows.source: How do you hold the long A at the end?
A single pick fades long before three beats are up. Tremolo keeps it ringing to the end of the bar.
rows.translation: Mpigo mmoja wa kijiti hupoteza sauti muda mrefu kabla mapigo matatu hayajaisha. Tremolo huiendeleza hadi mwisho wa kipimo.

rows.source: Down on the beat, up in between, and tremolo whenever a note needs to last. Keep every stroke small.
rows.translation: Chini kwenye pigo kuu, juu katikati, na tremolo kila noti inapohitaji kudumu. Kila mpigo ubaki mdogo.
Noti za nane kupanda hadi A

rows.source: Which stroke plays the and of beat 2?
rows.translation: Mpigo upi hupiga na ya pigo 2?

rows.source: Every and gets an up stroke, wherever the note is.
rows.translation: Kila na hupata mpigo wa juu, popote noti ilipo.
Noti za kumi na sita, noti mbili

rows.source: G, D, C, E minor and A, then the short, choked chord that drives bluegrass.
rows.translation: G, D, C, E minori na A, kisha kodi fupi inayokatishwa ambayo husukuma bluegrass.

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of pair 2, second finger on fret 3 of pair 1. Pairs 4 and 3 ring open.
rows.translation: Kidole cha kwanza kwenye freti 2 ya jozi 2, cha pili kwenye freti 3 ya jozi 1. Jozi 4 na 3 hulia wazi.

rows.source: Brush the pick down across all four pairs in one smooth motion, low to high. Small and light is enough; mandolin chords are bright.
rows.translation: Pitisha kijiti chini juu ya jozi zote nne kwa mwendo mmoja laini, kutoka sauti ya chini hadi juu. Mwendo mdogo mwepesi unatosha; kodi za mandolin zina sauti angavu.

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of pair 4, second finger on fret 2 of pair 1. Pairs 3 and 2 ring open.
rows.translation: Kidole cha kwanza kwenye freti 2 ya jozi 4, cha pili kwenye freti 2 ya jozi 1. Jozi 3 na 2 hulia wazi.

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of pair 3, second finger on fret 3 of pair 2. Pairs 4 and 1 ring open.
rows.translation: Kidole cha kwanza kwenye freti 2 ya jozi 3, cha pili kwenye freti 3 ya jozi 2. Jozi 4 na 1 hulia wazi.

rows.source: From C, slide your second finger back to fret 2. The chord turns darker, though only one finger moved.
rows.translation: Kutoka C, telezesha kidole cha pili nyuma hadi freti 2. Kodi hupata hisia nzito zaidi, ingawa kidole kimoja tu kimesogea.

rows.source: Fret 2 on pairs 4 and 3, fret 4 on pair 2, fret 5 on pair 1: fingers one, two, three and four. No pair rings open.
rows.translation: Freti 2 kwenye jozi 4 na 3, freti 4 kwenye jozi 2, freti 5 kwenye jozi 1: vidole vya kwanza, pili, tatu na nne. Hakuna jozi inayolia wazi.

rows.source: Why does it matter that no pair rings open?
rows.translation: Kwa nini ni muhimu kwamba hakuna jozi inayolia wazi?
Huifanya kodi iwe na sauti kubwa zaidi

rows.source: You can silence it by easing off
It keeps the chord in tune
With every pair held down, relaxing your fingers stops the sound at once. That is the secret of the chop.
rows.translation: Jozi zote zikiwa zimebonyezwa, kulegeza vidole husimamisha sauti mara moja. Hiyo ndiyo siri ya chop.

rows.source: The chop is a short chord on beats 2 and 4. Strum down, then ease your fretting fingers off the strings without lifting them, so the sound stops right away.
rows.translation: Chop ni kodi fupi kwenye mapigo 2 na 4. Piga chini, kisha punguza mgandamizo wa vidole vya freti bila kuviinua kutoka kwenye nyuzi, ili sauti ikome mara moja.

rows.source: Bass and guitar take beats 1 and 3. The mandolin answers on 2 and 4, like a snare drum.
rows.translation: Besi na gitaa hupiga mapigo 1 na 3. Mandolin hujibu kwenye 2 na 4, kama ngoma ya snare.

rows.source: Let the chord sound for only a moment. If it hangs on, relax your fingers sooner. Your fingertips stay touching the strings the whole time.
rows.translation: Acha kodi isikike kwa muda mfupi tu. Ikiendelea kulia, legeza vidole mapema zaidi. Ncha za vidole hubaki zikigusa nyuzi muda wote.

rows.source: Chops in G, C and D
rows.translation: Chop katika G, C na D

rows.source: Your A shape works anywhere on the neck. Slide it up three frets for C and five frets for D. Keep all four fingers in place as you move.
rows.translation: Umbo lako la A hufaa popote kwenye shingo. Litelezeshe juu freti tatu kwa C na freti tano kwa D. Vidole vyote vinne vibaki katika mpangilio wake unapohama.

rows.source: G needs a new stretch: first finger fret 2 on pair 2, second finger fret 3 on pair 1, third finger fret 5 on pair 3, little finger fret 7 on pair 4.
rows.translation: G inahitaji mtandazo mpya: cha kwanza freti 2 kwenye jozi 2, cha pili freti 3 kwenye jozi 1, cha tatu freti 5 kwenye jozi 3, kidole kidogo freti 7 kwenye jozi 4.

rows.source: Strum open chords to learn the sound, then chop on 2 and 4 to drive the band. Keep the beat steady through every change.
rows.translation: Piga kodi wazi ujifunze sauti yake, kisha chop kwenye 2 na 4 kuisukuma bendi. Dumisha mapigo thabiti katika kila badiliko.

rows.source: Your chop keeps ringing. What fixes it?
rows.translation: Chop yako inaendelea kulia. Unawezaje kurekebisha?

rows.source: Lift your fingers off the neck
Ease off with your fretting fingers sooner
rows.translation: Punguza mgandamizo wa vidole vya freti mapema

rows.source: The chop is choked by the fretting hand. Relax the pressure but keep your fingertips on the strings.
rows.translation: Mkono wa freti ndio hukatisha chop. Legeza mgandamizo lakini ncha za vidole zibaki juu ya nyuzi.

rows.source: Five traditional jam tunes, simplified, from Boil Them Cabbage Down to Old Joe Clark.
rows.translation: Melodi tano za jadi za kupiga pamoja, zilizorahisishwa, kutoka Boil Them Cabbage Down hadi Old Joe Clark.
Melodi ya kwanza ya kupiga pamoja

rows.source: This one lives on the E and A pairs and keeps coming back to F♯. Pick down on the beat and up in between, just like your eighth-note drills.
rows.translation: Hii iko kwenye jozi za E na A na hurudia F♯ mara kwa mara. Piga chini kwenye pigo kuu na juu katikati, kama katika mazoezi ya noti za nane.

rows.source: F♯, G and A on pair 1 at frets 2, 3 and 5, then D on pair 2, fret 5.
rows.translation: F♯, G na A kwenye jozi 1 freti 2, 3 na 5, kisha D kwenye jozi 2, freti 5.

rows.source: Where does the tune come to rest?
Like most tunes in D, it ends on D, the home note.
rows.translation: Kama melodi nyingi katika D, inaishia kwenye D, noti msingi.

rows.source: The low part of Angeline the Baker uses only D, E, F♯, A and B. Both parts end on A instead of D, which sends the tune around again.
rows.translation: Sehemu ya chini ya Angeline the Baker hutumia D, E, F♯, A na B tu. Sehemu zote mbili huisha kwenye A badala ya D, hivyo kuirudisha melodi mwanzo tena.
Sehemu ya chini, nusu ya kwanza
Sehemu ya chini, nusu ya pili

rows.source: Which note do both parts end on?
rows.translation: Sehemu zote mbili zinaishia kwenye noti ipi?

rows.source: Ending on A instead of D leaves the tune hanging, so it rolls straight into the next time through.
rows.translation: Kuishia kwenye A badala ya D huacha melodi ikisubiri kuendelea, hivyo inaingia moja kwa moja katika mzunguko unaofuata.

rows.source: Soldier's Joy was in print in Scotland by 1780 and has filled American jams ever since. Its first part bounces between D, F♯ and A.
rows.translation: Soldier's Joy ilikuwa imechapishwa Scotland kufikia 1780 na imepigwa sana katika mikusanyiko ya muziki Marekani tangu hapo. Sehemu yake ya kwanza huruka kati ya D, F♯ na A.

rows.source: Open A pair, pair 3 fret 4, open D, then fret 4 again.
rows.translation: Jozi ya A wazi, jozi 3 freti 4, D wazi, kisha freti 4 tena.

rows.source: D, F♯ and A together spell which chord?
rows.translation: D, F♯ na A pamoja huunda kodi ipi?

rows.source: D, F♯ and A are the three notes of D major. Fiddle tunes often trace their chords like this.
rows.translation: D, F♯ na A ni noti tatu za D meja. Melodi za fiddle mara nyingi hupitia noti za kodi zake hivi.
Sehemu ya chini, sehemu ya juu

rows.source: Arkansas Traveler starts low, down on the G pair, then jumps up to the E pair for a part that tumbles down the scale. It was in print by the 1840s.
rows.translation: Arkansas Traveler huanza chini, kwenye jozi ya G, kisha huruka hadi jozi ya E kwa sehemu inayoshuka kupitia skeli. Ilikuwa imechapishwa kufikia miaka ya 1840.

rows.source: Pair 4, frets 2 and 4, then the open D pair.
rows.translation: Jozi 4, freti 2 na 4, kisha jozi ya D wazi.

rows.source: Where does the high part begin?
On A, fret 5 of the E pair
rows.translation: Kwenye A, freti 5 ya jozi ya E

rows.source: It opens on A at fret 5 of pair 1, then walks down through G, F♯ and E.
rows.translation: Huanza kwenye A katika freti 5 ya jozi 1, kisha hushuka kupitia G, F♯ na E.
Sehemu ya juu, nusu ya kwanza

rows.source: A new key and a twist
Old Joe Clark is in A, so you use C♯ and G♯. In the second part, G♯ drops to plain G on fret 3 of the E pair. That one note gives the tune its old-time sound.
rows.translation: Old Joe Clark iko katika A, hivyo unatumia C♯ na G♯. Katika sehemu ya pili, G♯ hushuka hadi G asilia kwenye freti 3 ya jozi ya E. Noti hiyo moja huipa melodi sauti yake ya mtindo wa zamani.

rows.source: G♯ on pair 3, fret 6; the open A pair; then G on pair 1, fret 3.
rows.translation: G♯ kwenye jozi 3, freti 6; jozi ya A wazi; kisha G kwenye jozi 1, freti 3.

rows.source: Which note gives the second part its old-time sound?
rows.translation: Noti ipi huipa sehemu ya pili sauti yake ya mtindo wa zamani?

rows.source: A major uses G♯. Lowering it to G gives the mixolydian sound that runs through old-time and bluegrass music.
rows.translation: A meja hutumia G♯. Kuishusha hadi G huleta sauti ya Mixolydian inayotumika katika muziki wa old-time na bluegrass.

rows.source: Play each tune through at a steady tempo. If a note slips, keep your picking hand moving and catch the next beat. That is how real jams work.
rows.translation: Piga kila melodi nzima kwa tempo thabiti. Ukikosa noti, endelea kusogeza mkono wa kupigia na ukamate pigo linalofuata. Hivyo ndivyo upigaji halisi wa pamoja unavyofanya kazi.
Angeline the Baker, sehemu ya chini

rows.source: Which tune swaps G♯ for G?
rows.translation: Melodi ipi hubadili G♯ kuwa G?

rows.source: Old Joe Clark is in A but uses G in its second part. That lowered note is its signature.
rows.translation: Old Joe Clark iko katika A lakini hutumia G katika sehemu ya pili. Noti hiyo iliyoshushwa ndio utambulisho wake.

rows.source: Add the left-hand moves and rolling right hand that make a tune sound like bluegrass.
rows.translation: Ongeza mbinu za mkono wa kushoto na mifuatano ya kulia inayoifanya melodi isikike kama bluegrass.

rows.source: Pick a note, then keep pressing as you glide the same finger up to a higher fret. The new note sounds without a second pick stroke. Light, steady pressure is the trick.
rows.translation: Piga noti, kisha endelea kubonyeza unapotelezesha kidole kilekile juu hadi freti ya juu zaidi. Noti mpya husikika bila mpigo wa pili wa kijiti. Siri ni mgandamizo mwepesi na thabiti.

rows.source: What sounds the second note in a slide?
rows.translation: Nini hutoa sauti ya noti ya pili katika slide?

rows.source: Your finger pressing as it moves
Only the first note is picked. Keep pressure on the string as you slide, or the note dies on the way.
rows.translation: Noti ya kwanza pekee hupigwa kwa kijiti. Endelea kubonyeza uzi unapoteleza, la sivyo sauti ya noti itaisha njiani.

rows.source: Pick an open pair, then snap a fingertip down just behind fret 2. The new note sounds from the tap alone, with no second pick stroke.
rows.translation: Piga jozi wazi, kisha tushia ncha ya kidole kwa kasi nyuma tu ya freti 2. Noti mpya husikika kutokana na mguso huo pekee, bila mpigo wa pili wa kijiti.

rows.source: The reverse: with a finger on fret 2, pick, then pull the finger slightly sideways as you lift. That flick plucks the open note below.
rows.translation: Kinyume chake: kidole kikiwa kwenye freti 2, piga, kisha kivute kidogo pembeni unapokiinua. Mguso huo hupiga noti wazi iliyo chini.

rows.source: Which moves sound a note without the pick?
rows.translation: Mbinu zipi hutoa noti bila kijiti?

rows.source: All three sound a second note with the fretting hand. The pick plays only the first.
rows.translation: Zote tatu hutoa noti ya pili kwa mkono wa freti. Kijiti hupiga ya kwanza tu.

rows.source: Fiddle tunes come alive with small ornaments. Here the two plain A notes that open Old Joe Clark become A, B, A: a hammer-on and a pull-off.
rows.translation: Melodi za fiddle hupata uhai kwa mapambo madogo. Hapa noti mbili za kawaida za A mwanzoni mwa Old Joe Clark huwa A, B, A: hammer-on na pull-off.

rows.source: In A, B, A, how many times do you pick?
rows.translation: Katika A, B, A, unapiga kwa kijiti mara ngapi?

rows.source: Pick the first A, hammer on to B and pull off back to A. One pick, three notes.
rows.translation: Piga A ya kwanza, fanya hammer-on hadi B na pull-off kurudi A. Mpigo mmoja wa kijiti, noti tatu.

rows.source: Crosspicking picks single notes across three pairs in a repeating pattern, so a chord sounds like a ripple. Eight notes split three, three and two.
rows.translation: Crosspicking hupiga noti mojamoja kupitia jozi tatu kwa mfumo unaorudiwa, kodi ikisikika kama wimbi. Noti nane hugawanyika tatu, tatu na mbili.

rows.source: How are the eight notes of a crosspicking bar grouped?
rows.translation: Noti nane za kipimo cha crosspicking hupangwa katika makundi gani?

rows.source: A three-note pattern repeated across a bar of eight makes the accent shift each time. That is the rolling feel.
rows.translation: Mfumo wa noti tatu unaorudiwa katika kipimo cha noti nane husogeza mkazo kila mara. Hilo ndilo huleta hisia ya mfuatano unaozunguka.

rows.source: Ripple through G, C and D
rows.translation: Wimbi kupitia G, C na D

rows.source: Slides, hammer-ons, chops and crosspicking. Take each one at your own pace, and keep the beat steady above all.
rows.translation: Slide, hammer-on, chop na crosspicking. Fanya kila moja kwa kasi yako, na zaidi ya yote dumisha mapigo thabiti.

rows.source: Which beats does the chop land on?
Five-string, open G: rolls, old-time tunes and clawhammer
rows.translation: Nyuzi tano, G wazi: mifuatano, melodi za old-time na clawhammer

rows.source: Meet the five strings, tune to open G, find the drone string and play a song.
rows.translation: Fahamu nyuzi tano, rekebisha ziwe G wazi, tafuta uzi wa mvumo na upige wimbo.

rows.source: A banjo has four full-length strings and a fifth that starts partway up the neck, at its own little tuning peg. That short string is the banjo's signature sound.
rows.translation: Banjo ina nyuzi nne za urefu kamili na wa tano unaoanzia katikati ya shingo, kwenye kigingi chake kidogo cha kurekebisha. Uzi huo mfupi ndio huipa banjo sauti yake ya pekee.

rows.source: String 1 is the thin one nearest the floor. Strings 2, 3 and 4 follow toward your face. The short one on top is string 5.
rows.translation: Uzi 1 ni mwembamba ulio karibu zaidi na sakafu. Nyuzi 2, 3 na 4 hufuata kuelekea uso wako. Mfupi ulio juu ni uzi 5.

rows.source: Which string is the short one?
The fifth string lies next to string 4 but starts at the fifth fret, with its peg on the side of the neck.
rows.translation: Uzi wa tano uko karibu na uzi 4 lakini huanzia freti ya tano, kigingi chake kikiwa ubavuni mwa shingo.

rows.source: Pluck string 1, the thin one nearest the floor.
rows.translation: Piga uzi 1 kwa kidole, mwembamba ulio karibu zaidi na sakafu.

rows.source: Now the short string, string 5. Pluck it with your thumb.
rows.translation: Sasa uzi mfupi, uzi 5. Upige kwa gumba.
Upangaji wa sauti wa G wazi

rows.source: Standard banjo tuning is open G. From string 4 to string 1 it reads D, G, B, D, and the short fifth string is a high G. Strummed open, they make a G chord.
rows.translation: Upangaji wa kawaida wa banjo ni G wazi. Kutoka uzi 4 hadi uzi 1 ni D, G, B, D, na uzi mfupi wa tano ni G ya juu. Zikipigwa wazi pamoja, huunda kodi ya G.

rows.source: Strings 4, 3, 2 and 1: D, G, B, D.
rows.translation: Nyuzi 4, 3, 2 na 1: D, G, B, D.

rows.source: What chord do the open strings make?
G, B and D are the notes of a G chord. That is why this tuning is called open G.
rows.translation: G, B na D ni noti za kodi ya G. Ndiyo maana upangaji huu huitwa G wazi.

rows.source: Bluegrass banjo uses a plastic thumb pick and two metal finger picks, on index and middle. The finger picks point down, curving the same way as your fingertips.
rows.translation: Banjo ya bluegrass hutumia kijiti cha plastiki cha gumba na viwili vya chuma vya kuvaa kwenye shahada na kidole cha kati. Vya vidole huelekea chini, vikipinda upande uleule wa ncha za vidole.

rows.source: For now your thumb plays strings 3, 4 and 5, your index plays string 2 and your middle plays string 1. Rest your ring and little fingers lightly on the head.
rows.translation: Kwa sasa gumba hupiga nyuzi 3, 4 na 5, shahada hupiga uzi 2 na cha kati hupiga uzi 1. Egemeza cha pete na kidole kidogo kwa upole juu ya ngozi ya banjo.

rows.source: Thumb takes strings 3, 4 and 5, index takes string 2 and middle takes string 1.
rows.translation: Gumba huchukua nyuzi 3, 4 na 5, shahada uzi 2 na cha kati uzi 1.

rows.source: The fifth string is a drone: you play it open, between melody notes, and it rings over everything. In these lessons you never fret it.
rows.translation: Uzi wa tano ni wa mvumo: unaupiga wazi kati ya noti za melodi, ukilia juu ya sauti zote. Katika masomo haya huubonyezi kwenye freti kamwe.

rows.source: First string 5, then string 1. Which is higher?
rows.translation: Kwanza uzi 5, kisha uzi 1. Upi una sauti ya juu zaidi?

rows.source: Why does the fifth string sound so high?
rows.translation: Kwa nini uzi wa tano una sauti ya juu sana?

rows.source: It is short and tuned to high G
rows.translation: Ni mfupi na umepangwa uwe G ya juu

rows.source: Being short lets it hold a high G. It sits on top of the melody like a bell.
rows.translation: Ufupi wake huuwezesha kutoa G ya juu. Husikika juu ya melodi kama kengele.

rows.source: Tuned to open G, picks on, thumb ready for the drone. Play each string cleanly and let it ring.
rows.translation: Sauti zimepangwa G wazi, vijiti vimevaliwa, gumba liko tayari kwa uzi wa mvumo. Piga kila uzi kwa usafi na uache usikike.

rows.source: B, high G, low D, high D, G. Find each string by its note.
rows.translation: B, G ya juu, D ya chini, D ya juu, G. Tafuta kila uzi kwa noti yake.

rows.source: String 3, then string 5. Which is higher?
rows.translation: Uzi 3, kisha uzi 5. Upi una sauti ya juu zaidi?

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: open string 2 is B, fret 2 on string 3 is A, and open string 3 is G. Your second finger frets the A; your thumb picks string 3.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb unahitaji noti tatu: uzi 2 wazi ni B, freti 2 kwenye uzi 3 ni A, na uzi 3 wazi ni G. Kidole cha pili hubonyeza A; gumba hupiga uzi 3.

rows.source: The right-hand patterns behind the rolling bluegrass sound: pinch, alternating thumb and forward roll.
rows.translation: Mifumo ya mkono wa kulia ya sauti ya bluegrass: pinch, gumba linalopokezana na forward roll.

rows.source: A pinch is your thumb and middle finger plucking at the same moment, on strings 5 and 1. It sounds like a little two-note chord and often starts or ends a phrase.
rows.translation: Pinch ni gumba na kidole cha kati kupiga wakati uleule, kwenye nyuzi 5 na 1. Husikika kama kodi ndogo ya noti mbili, na mara nyingi huanza au kumaliza kishazi.

rows.source: Pinch, or one note at a time?
rows.translation: Pinch, au noti moja baada ya nyingine?

rows.source: Which strings does a pinch play?
Thumb on the short fifth string and middle on string 1, at the same moment.
rows.translation: Gumba kwenye uzi mfupi wa tano na cha kati kwenye uzi 1, wakati uleule.

rows.source: This roll is eight even notes: thumb on 3, index on 2, thumb on 5, middle on 1, then thumb on 4, index on 2, thumb on 5, middle on 1.
rows.translation: Mfuatano huu una noti nane zilizo sawa: gumba kwenye 3, shahada 2, gumba 5, kati 1, kisha gumba 4, shahada 2, gumba 5, kati 1.

rows.source: Which finger plays every other note?
rows.translation: Kidole kipi hupiga kila noti ya pili?

rows.source: Thumb, index, thumb, middle: the thumb plays every other note, which gives the roll its name.
rows.translation: Gumba, shahada, gumba, kati: gumba hupiga kila noti ya pili, jambo linaloupa mfuatano jina lake.

rows.source: The forward roll moves one way, thumb then index then middle, over and over. Eight notes make thumb, index, middle twice, then thumb, index.
rows.translation: Forward roll huelekea upande mmoja, gumba kisha shahada kisha kati, tena na tena. Kwa noti nane ni gumba, shahada, kati mara mbili, kisha gumba, shahada.

rows.source: How does a forward roll fit into eight notes?
rows.translation: Forward roll hutimiaje katika noti nane?

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle twice, then thumb, index. The accent shifts as it goes, which makes the rolling sound.
rows.translation: Gumba, shahada, kati mara mbili, kisha gumba, shahada. Mkazo huhama mfuatano unapoendelea, ukileta sauti yake ya kuzunguka.

rows.source: A roll is only as good as its timing. Keep all eight notes even, like a ticking clock, and land the first note of each bar right on the beat.
rows.translation: Ubora wa mfuatano hutegemea muda sahihi. Noti zote nane ziwe sawa, kama saa inayotia tiki, na noti ya kwanza ya kila kipimo itue sawasawa kwenye pigo.

rows.source: You lose the beat in the middle of a roll. What now?
rows.translation: Unapoteza mapigo katikati ya mfuatano. Ufanye nini?

rows.source: Stop and start the bar over
Slow down until it feels right
rows.translation: Punguza kasi hadi uhisi iko sawa

rows.source: Keep the right hand moving and rejoin
rows.translation: Endelea kusogeza mkono wa kulia na ujiunge tena

rows.source: In a band the beat never waits. Keep the pattern going and catch the next bar.
rows.translation: Katika bendi, mapigo hayasubiri. Endeleza mfumo na ukamate kipimo kinachofuata.

rows.source: Pinch, alternating thumb and forward roll, all on open strings. Keep the eighths even and let every string ring.
rows.translation: Pinch, gumba linalopokezana na forward roll, zote kwenye nyuzi wazi. Noti za nane ziwe sawa na kila uzi uachwe ulie.

rows.source: Which roll goes thumb, index, middle, over and over?
rows.translation: Mfuatano upi ni gumba, shahada, kati, tena na tena?

rows.source: Fret G, C, D7 and E minor and keep the roll going through the changes.
rows.translation: Shika G, C, D7 na E minori, na uendeleze mfuatano unapobadili kodi.

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second finger on fret 2 of string 4, third finger on fret 2 of string 1. Strings 3 and 5 ring open.
rows.translation: Kidole cha kwanza kwenye freti 1 ya uzi 2, cha pili kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 4, cha tatu kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 1. Nyuzi 3 na 5 hulia wazi.

rows.source: Do you fret the fifth string for C?
rows.translation: Je, unabonyeza uzi wa tano kwenye freti kwa C?

rows.source: The open high G belongs to the C chord, so it rings as it is. You never fret it in these lessons.
rows.translation: G ya juu wazi ni sehemu ya kodi ya C, hivyo hulia kama ilivyo. Huubonyezi kwenye freti kamwe katika masomo haya.

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second finger on fret 2 of string 3. Strings 4 and 1 ring open. Leave the fifth string out; its G clashes with D7.
rows.translation: Kidole cha kwanza kwenye freti 1 ya uzi 2, cha pili kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 3. Nyuzi 4 na 1 hulia wazi. Acha uzi wa tano; G yake haipatani na D7.

rows.source: The full D7, if you like
The two-finger D7 has no F sharp. Add your little finger at fret 4 of string 1 and all four notes of D7 ring. Either shape works in the songs; the full one sounds richer.
rows.translation: D7 ya vidole viwili haina F diesi. Ongeza kidole kidogo kwenye freti 4 ya uzi 1, noti zote nne za D7 zitasikika. Umbo lolote linafaa katika nyimbo; lililo kamili lina sauti iliyojaa zaidi.

rows.source: Which chord wants to move on?
What does your thumb do on D7?
rows.translation: Gumba lako hufanya nini kwenye D7?

rows.source: The open G of string 5 isn't part of D7. For now your thumb keeps to strings 3 and 4.
rows.translation: G wazi ya uzi 5 si sehemu ya D7. Kwa sasa gumba hubaki kwenye nyuzi 3 na 4.

rows.source: G is home, C steps away and D7 pulls you back. Change on the first beat of each bar and keep your right hand moving.
rows.translation: G ni msingi, C huenda mbali nao na D7 hukuvuta urudi. Badili kwenye pigo la kwanza la kila kipimo, mkono wa kulia ukiendelea kusogea.

rows.source: Which chord pulls you back to G?
D7 contains C, which leans down to B in the G chord. That pull is why so many songs end D7 to G.
rows.translation: D7 ina C, inayovutia kushuka hadi B katika kodi ya G. Ndiyo maana nyimbo nyingi humalizia D7 kwenda G.

rows.source: Make C, then lift your first finger off string 2. Two fingers stay on fret 2, strings 4 and 1, and the chord turns darker: E minor.
rows.translation: Shika C, kisha inua kidole cha kwanza kutoka uzi 2. Vidole viwili vinabaki kwenye freti 2, nyuzi 4 na 1, na kodi hupata hisia nzito zaidi: E minori.

rows.source: Four chords and two rolls. Keep the right hand steady even while the left hand is busy changing.
rows.translation: Kodi nne na mifuatano miwili. Mkono wa kulia ubaki thabiti hata wa kushoto unapokuwa na shughuli za kubadili.

rows.source: Which string sits out on D7?
Alternating thumb: G, C, D7, G
rows.translation: Gumba linalopokezana: G, C, D7, G

rows.source: Forward roll: G, E minor, C, D7, G
rows.translation: Forward roll: G, E minori, C, D7, G

rows.source: Four traditional tunes, with the drone string ringing in among the melody.
rows.translation: Melodi nne za jadi, uzi wa mvumo ukilia katikati ya noti za melodi.

rows.source: Here the melody is the main event: pick each note with the finger that owns its string. Strings 3, 2 and 1 carry this whole tune.
rows.translation: Hapa melodi ndiyo kuu: piga kila noti kwa kidole kinachohusika na uzi wake. Nyuzi 3, 2 na 1 hubeba melodi hii nzima.

rows.source: String 2 open, string 3 fret 2, string 3 open, string 2 fret 1, string 1 open.
rows.translation: Uzi 2 wazi, uzi 3 freti 2, uzi 3 wazi, uzi 2 freti 1, uzi 1 wazi.

rows.source: Which note does the tune end on?
Tunes in G come home to G, here the open third string.
rows.translation: Melodi katika G hurudi kwenye G, hapa uzi wa tatu wazi.
Sehemu ya juu, sehemu ya chini

rows.source: Cripple Creek has a high part that uses the fifth string as a melody note, and a low part down on strings 3 and 4. Take each part slowly first.
rows.translation: Cripple Creek ina sehemu ya juu inayotumia uzi wa tano kama noti ya melodi, na ya chini kwenye nyuzi 3 na 4. Anza kila sehemu polepole.

rows.source: String 5 open, then string 1 at fret 4 and fret 2.
rows.translation: Uzi 5 wazi, kisha uzi 1 kwenye freti 4 na freti 2.

rows.source: Where does the high G in the first bar come from?
rows.translation: G ya juu katika kipimo cha kwanza inatoka wapi?

rows.source: The drone doubles as a melody note here. Your thumb plays it, right on the beat.
rows.translation: Uzi wa mvumo pia hutoa noti ya melodi hapa. Gumba huupiga sawasawa kwenye pigo.

rows.source: A tune named for a mountain pass
rows.translation: Melodi yenye jina la njia milimani

rows.source: Cumberland Gap is the pass early settlers took into Kentucky. The tune climbs to E and F♯ on string 1, so your second and fourth fingers get busy.
rows.translation: Cumberland Gap ni njia ambayo walowezi wa mwanzo walipitia kuingia Kentucky. Melodi hupanda hadi E na F♯ kwenye uzi 1, hivyo vidole vya pili na nne vina kazi nyingi.

rows.source: String 1: fret 2, fret 4, fret 2, then open.
rows.translation: Uzi 1: freti 2, freti 4, freti 2, kisha wazi.

rows.source: Where do you play F♯ in this tune?
rows.translation: Unapiga F♯ wapi katika melodi hii?

rows.source: F♯ is four frets above the open D of string 1. The fifth string is never fretted here.
rows.translation: F♯ iko freti nne juu ya D wazi ya uzi 1. Uzi wa tano haubonyezwi kwenye freti hapa.

rows.source: Shady Grove has the dark, old sound players call mountain minor. It comes to rest on A instead of G, and the high G of the fifth string sings against it.
rows.translation: Shady Grove ina sauti nzito ya zamani ambayo wapigaji huiita mountain minor. Hutulia kwenye A badala ya G, huku G ya juu ya uzi wa tano ikiimba dhidi yake.

rows.source: String 3 fret 2, string 2 open, string 1 open, string 1 fret 2.
rows.translation: Uzi 3 freti 2, uzi 2 wazi, uzi 1 wazi, uzi 1 freti 2.

rows.source: Which tune comes to rest on A instead of G?
rows.translation: Melodi ipi hutulia kwenye A badala ya G?

rows.source: Shady Grove is in mountain minor, centered on A. The others come home to G.
rows.translation: Shady Grove iko katika mountain minor, msingi wake ukiwa A. Nyingine hurudi kwenye G.

rows.source: Sound notes with the fretting hand, then use them in Old Joe Clark.
rows.translation: Toa noti kwa mkono wa freti, kisha uzitumie katika Old Joe Clark.

rows.source: Pick an open string, then snap a fingertip down just behind fret 2. The new note sounds from the tap alone, with no second pick.
rows.translation: Piga uzi wazi, kisha tushia ncha ya kidole kwa kasi nyuma tu ya freti 2. Noti mpya husikika kutokana na mguso huo pekee, bila kupiga tena kwa kijiti.

rows.source: Pick string 3 open, then hammer fret 2 with your second finger.
rows.translation: Piga uzi 3 wazi, kisha fanya hammer-on kwenye freti 2 kwa kidole cha pili.

rows.source: How many times do you pick for a hammer-on?
rows.translation: Unapiga kwa kijiti mara ngapi katika hammer-on?
Mara mbili, mara moja kwa kila noti
Mara moja, kwa noti ya kwanza

rows.source: The pick sounds the first note. The second comes from your finger striking the string.
rows.translation: Kijiti hutoa sauti ya noti ya kwanza. Ya pili hutokana na kidole chako kugonga uzi.

rows.source: Fret a note, pick it, then pull your finger slightly sideways as you lift. That flick plucks the open string, so a second note sounds without the pick.
rows.translation: Shika noti ya freti, ipige, kisha vuta kidole kidogo pembeni unapokiinua. Mguso huo hupiga uzi wazi, hivyo noti ya pili husikika bila kijiti.

rows.source: Pick string 1 at fret 2, then pull off to open.
rows.translation: Piga uzi 1 kwenye freti 2, kisha fanya pull-off hadi wazi.

rows.source: Which way does your finger move in a pull-off?
rows.translation: Kidole husogea upande upi katika pull-off?
Juu moja kwa moja, kutoka kwenye uzi

rows.source: Along the string to the next fret
rows.translation: Kando ya uzi hadi freti inayofuata

rows.source: Lifting straight up only stops the note. A small sideways flick plucks the open string.
rows.translation: Kuinua juu moja kwa moja husimamisha noti tu. Kuvuta kidogo pembeni hupiga uzi wazi.

rows.source: Fret string 3 at fret 2, pick it, and slide the same finger up to fret 4 while pressing. A to B in one smooth glide is a classic banjo sound.
rows.translation: Shika uzi 3 kwenye freti 2, upige, kisha telezesha kidole kilekile juu hadi freti 4 huku ukibonyeza. A hadi B kwa mtelezo mmoja laini ni sauti ya kawaida ya banjo.

rows.source: Only the first note is picked. Keep pressing as you glide, or the note dies on the way.
rows.translation: Noti ya kwanza pekee hupigwa kwa kijiti. Endelea kubonyeza unapoteleza, la sivyo sauti ya noti itaisha njiani.

rows.source: Old Joe Clark is in G, but its second part uses F instead of F♯, on string 1 at fret 3. That lowered note gives the tune its old-time sound.
rows.translation: Old Joe Clark iko katika G, lakini sehemu yake ya pili hutumia F badala ya F♯, kwenye uzi 1 freti 3. Noti hiyo iliyoshushwa huipa melodi sauti yake ya mtindo wa zamani.

rows.source: String 1: fret 2, fret 3, fret 2, open. Try hammering from 2 to 3.
rows.translation: Uzi 1: freti 2, freti 3, freti 2, wazi. Jaribu hammer-on kutoka 2 hadi 3.

rows.source: Which note gives the second part its old-time color?
rows.translation: Noti ipi huipa sehemu ya pili ladha yake ya mtindo wa zamani?

rows.source: G major uses F♯. Lowering it to F gives the mixolydian sound that runs through old-time and bluegrass music.
rows.translation: G meja hutumia F♯. Kuishusha hadi F huleta sauti ya Mixolydian inayotumika katika muziki wa old-time na bluegrass.
Mkono wa kushoto na wa kulia pamoja

rows.source: Hammer-ons, pull-offs and slides, then Old Joe Clark. Pick only where you need to and let your fretting hand do the rest.
rows.translation: Hammer-on, pull-off na slide, kisha Old Joe Clark. Piga kwa kijiti pale tu panapohitajika, mkono wa freti ufanye mengine.

rows.source: Which move glides a fretted note up to a higher fret?
rows.translation: Mbinu ipi huteleza noti ya freti hadi freti ya juu zaidi?

rows.source: A different right hand: strike down with a fingernail and catch the drone with your thumb.
rows.translation: Mkono wa kulia tofauti: piga chini kwa ukucha na ukamate uzi wa mvumo kwa gumba.
Mbinu mpya ya mkono wa kulia

rows.source: Clawhammer uses no picks. Curl your hand into a loose claw and strike down on a string with the back of your index or middle fingernail, moving from the wrist and forearm.
rows.translation: Clawhammer haitumii vijiti. Pinda mkono kwa upole kama ukucha wa mnyama, kisha piga chini kwenye uzi kwa upande wa nje wa ukucha wa shahada au cha kati, ukisogeza kifundo na sehemu ya mkono chini ya kiwiko.

rows.source: As your hand strikes, the thumb comes to rest on the fifth string. On the next beat it pushes through that string as your hand lifts.
rows.translation: Mkono unapopiga, gumba hutua kwenye uzi wa tano. Kwenye pigo linalofuata, husukuma na kuupita uzi huo mkono unapoinuka.

rows.source: Which way does your fingernail move in clawhammer?
rows.translation: Ukucha wako husogea upande upi katika clawhammer?

rows.source: Clawhammer strikes down with the nail. The fingers never pluck upward.
rows.translation: Clawhammer hupiga chini kwa ukucha. Vidole havipigi kwa kuvuta juu kamwe.

rows.source: The basic clawhammer rhythm sounds like its name. Bum: strike one note on the beat. Dit: brush down across the strings. Ty: your thumb plays string 5.
rows.translation: Mdundo wa msingi wa clawhammer husikika kama jina lake. Bum: piga noti moja kwenye pigo kuu. Dit: pitisha ukucha chini kupitia nyuzi. Ty: gumba hupiga uzi 5.

rows.source: Which part of bum-ditty does the thumb play?
rows.translation: Gumba hupiga sehemu ipi ya bum-ditty?

rows.source: Bum is a single note, dit is a brush and ty is the thumb on the fifth string.
rows.translation: Bum ni noti moja, dit ni mpigo kupitia nyuzi na ty ni gumba kwenye uzi wa tano.

rows.source: In clawhammer the melody notes fall on the bum strikes. The brush and thumb fill in around them, so tune and rhythm come out together.
rows.translation: Katika clawhammer, noti za melodi huangukia mipigo ya bum. Mpigo kupitia nyuzi na gumba hujaza nafasi zake, hivyo melodi na mdundo hutoka pamoja.

rows.source: Where do the melody notes go in bum-ditty?
rows.translation: Noti za melodi huwekwa wapi katika bum-ditty?
Kwenye bum, pigo la noti moja

rows.source: The bum lands on the beat, so that is where the melody goes. Dit and ty keep the rhythm rolling.
rows.translation: Bum huangukia pigo kuu, kwa hiyo hapo ndipo melodi hukaa. Dit na ty huendeleza mdundo.

rows.source: Skip to My Lou was a party game in the 1840s. In clawhammer each melody note is a bum, followed by a brush and the thumb on string 5.
rows.translation: Skip to My Lou ulikuwa mchezo wa sherehe katika miaka ya 1840. Katika clawhammer kila noti ya melodi ni bum, ikifuatiwa na mpigo kupitia nyuzi na gumba kwenye uzi 5.

rows.source: What does your thumb play after each brush?
rows.translation: Gumba hupiga nini baada ya kila mpigo kupitia nyuzi?

rows.source: Bum, dit, ty: the ty is always the thumb on the short fifth string.
rows.translation: Bum, dit, ty: ty daima ni gumba kwenye uzi mfupi wa tano.

rows.source: Everything in clawhammer comes back to bum-ditty. Keep the motion loose and the thumb ready, and the melody takes care of itself.
rows.translation: Kila kitu katika clawhammer hurudi kwenye bum-ditty. Mwendo ubaki umelegea na gumba liwe tayari, nayo melodi itafuata.

rows.source: Which hand shape does clawhammer use?
rows.translation: Clawhammer hutumia umbo lipi la mkono?
Vidole vilivyopinda kwa upole, vikipiga chini

rows.source: Hear intervals and chords, and sing back what you hear
rows.translation: Sikia umbali wa noti na kodi, kisha imba ulichosikia

rows.source: Tell which of two notes is higher, from wide leaps down to the smallest step.
rows.translation: Tambua noti ipi kati ya mbili iko juu zaidi, kutoka miruko mikubwa hadi hatua ndogo zaidi.

rows.source: Pitch is how high or low a note sounds. On a keyboard, low notes sit on the left and high notes on the right. Your ear already knows the difference; here you sharpen it.
rows.translation: Kimo cha sauti ni jinsi noti inavyosikika juu au chini. Kwenye kinanda, noti za chini ziko kushoto na za juu kulia. Sikio lako tayari linajua tofauti; hapa unalinoa.

rows.source: When the second note is higher, the melody moves up. When it's lower, it moves down. Trace the direction in the air with your hand as you listen.
rows.translation: Noti ya pili ikiwa juu zaidi, melodi hupanda. Ikiwa chini zaidi, hushuka. Fuata mwelekeo hewani kwa mkono unaposikiliza.

rows.source: Does the second note go up or down?
rows.translation: Noti ya pili inapanda au kushuka?

rows.source: The closer two notes are, the harder they are to tell apart. Let each note finish before you answer. Every answer, right or wrong, trains your ear.
rows.translation: Noti mbili zikiwa karibu zaidi, ni vigumu zaidi kuzitofautisha. Acha kila noti iishe kabla ya kujibu. Kila jibu, sahihi au si sahihi, hufundisha sikio lako.

rows.source: Not sure? Hum the first note, then slide your voice to the second. Feel whether your voice climbs or sinks. Your body knows the direction.
rows.translation: Huna uhakika? Vuma noti ya kwanza, kisha telezesha sauti hadi ya pili. Hisi kama sauti yako inapanda au kushuka. Mwili wako unajua mwelekeo.

rows.source: Many melodies move to the very next note of the scale: a small step. Steps sound smooth and close. Listen for a gentle lift or dip instead of a jump.
rows.translation: Melodi nyingi huenda kwenye noti inayofuata kabisa ya skeli: hatua ndogo. Hatua husikika laini na karibu. Sikiliza kupanda au kushuka kidogo badala ya mruko.

rows.source: Hold the first note in your head while the second one plays. Then compare them, like checking two heights side by side.
rows.translation: Shikilia noti ya kwanza akilini ya pili inapopigwa. Kisha zilinganishe, kama kukagua vimo viwili kando kwa kando.

rows.source: The smallest step in most music is the half step, also called a semitone: from one key on a keyboard to the very next. It's a tiny move, and you can learn to hear it.
rows.translation: Hatua ndogo zaidi katika muziki mwingi ni nusu toni, pia huitwa semitone: kutoka kitufe kimoja cha kinanda hadi kinachofuata kabisa. Ni mwendo mdogo sana, na unaweza kujifunza kuusikia.

rows.source: With tiny steps, your first impression is usually right. Answer, and don't talk yourself out of it.
rows.translation: Kwa hatua ndogo sana, hisia yako ya kwanza kwa kawaida huwa sahihi. Jibu, bila kujishawishi ubadili.

rows.source: Wide leaps, small steps and half steps, high and low, all mixed together. Take a breath before each one.
rows.translation: Miruko mikubwa, hatua ndogo na nusu toni, juu na chini, vyote vimechanganywa. Vuta pumzi kabla ya kila moja.

rows.source: Hear when two notes match, then match a note with your voice or instrument.
rows.translation: Sikia noti mbili zinapolingana, kisha linganisha noti kwa sauti yako au ala.

rows.source: Two notes match when they have exactly the same pitch. Listen for whether the second note lands right on the first or slips away from it.
rows.translation: Noti mbili hulingana zikiwa na kimo kilekile kabisa cha sauti. Sikiliza kama ya pili inatua sawasawa kwenye ya kwanza au inasogea mbali nayo.

rows.source: Two voices sing exactly the same pitch. What's that called?
rows.translation: Sauti mbili zinaimba kimo kilekile kabisa. Hiyo huitwaje?

rows.source: Singing in unison means singing the very same note.
rows.translation: Kuimba kwa unisoni ni kuimba noti ileile kabisa.

rows.source: To match a pitch, listen, hear the note again in your head, then sing or play it. Timbre shows whether you're high or low. Slide until you land on it.
rows.translation: Kulinganisha kimo cha sauti, sikiliza, sikia noti tena akilini, kisha iimbe au ipige. Timbre huonyesha kama uko juu au chini. Teleza hadi uifikie.

rows.source: Sing or play back the note you just heard.
rows.translation: Imba au piga tena noti uliyosikia sasa hivi.

rows.source: Sing or play back the second note you heard.
rows.translation: Imba au piga tena noti ya pili uliyosikia.

rows.source: If you're off, don't stop. Slide slowly up or down until the note locks in. That slide is how your ear and voice learn to agree.
rows.translation: Usipolingana, usisimame. Teleza polepole juu au chini hadi noti itulie kwenye kimo sahihi. Mtelezo huo hufundisha sikio na sauti yako kupatana.

rows.source: Before you sing, replay the note silently in your head. Musicians call this audiation: hearing music that isn't sounding. It's the heart of a good ear.
rows.translation: Kabla ya kuimba, sikia noti tena kimya kimya akilini. Wanamuziki huita hili audiation: kusikia muziki ambao hausikiki nje. Huu ndio msingi wa sikio zuri.

rows.source: Sing or play back the higher note.
rows.translation: Imba au piga tena noti ya juu zaidi.

rows.source: Sing or play back the lower note.
rows.translation: Imba au piga tena noti ya chini zaidi.

rows.source: Now match two notes in a row. Sing the first, then move to the second. Notice whether your voice climbs or drops to get there.
rows.translation: Sasa linganisha noti mbili mfululizo. Imba ya kwanza, kisha nenda kwenye ya pili. Tambua kama sauti yako inapanda au kushuka kuifikia.

rows.source: Sing or play back the notes you just heard, in order.
rows.translation: Imba au piga tena noti ulizosikia sasa hivi, kwa mpangilio wake.

rows.source: Same or different, single notes and pairs. Listen all the way through before you sing, and slide until each note settles.
rows.translation: Sawa au tofauti, noti mojamoja na jozi. Sikiliza hadi mwisho kabla ya kuimba, na uteleze hadi kila noti itulie.

rows.source: Hear half steps and whole steps, then the wider skip of a third.
rows.translation: Sikia nusu toni na toni nzima, kisha mruko mpana zaidi wa umbali wa tatu.
Hatua za nusu toni na toni nzima

rows.source: A half step moves to the very next key. A whole step skips one key, so it equals two half steps. Both sound like steps, but a whole step opens a little wider.
rows.translation: Nusu toni huenda kwenye kitufe kinachofuata kabisa. Toni nzima huruka kitufe kimoja, hivyo ni sawa na nusu toni mbili. Zote husikika kama hatua, lakini toni nzima ina nafasi pana zaidi kidogo.

rows.source: How many half steps make a whole step?
rows.translation: Nusu toni ngapi huunda toni nzima?

rows.source: A whole step skips one key, so it's two half steps.
rows.translation: Toni nzima huruka kitufe kimoja, hivyo ni nusu toni mbili.

rows.source: Musicians call a step a second, because it moves to the next letter: C to D. A half step is a minor second. A whole step is a major second.
rows.translation: Wanamuziki huita hatua umbali wa pili, kwa kuwa huhamia herufi inayofuata: C hadi D. Nusu toni ni umbali wa pili wa minori. Toni nzima ni umbali wa pili wa meja.

rows.source: E up to F is a...
E and F have no key between them: a half step, so a minor second.
rows.translation: E na F hazina kitufe katikati yake: nusu toni, hivyo umbali wa pili wa minori.

rows.source: C up to D is a...
C to D skips the black key between them: a whole step, so a major second.
rows.translation: C hadi D huruka kitufe cheusi kati yake: toni nzima, hivyo umbali wa pili wa meja.

rows.source: A step moves to the next letter. A skip jumps over one, like C to E, skipping D. That gap is called a third. Skips sound more open than steps.
rows.translation: Hatua huenda kwenye herufi inayofuata. Mruko huruka moja, kama C hadi E, ukiruka D. Nafasi hiyo huitwa umbali wa tatu. Miruko husikika yenye nafasi pana zaidi kuliko hatua.

rows.source: D up to F is a...
D to F jumps over E, so it's a skip: a third.
rows.translation: D hadi F huruka E, hivyo ni mruko: umbali wa tatu.
Umbali wa tatu wa meja na minori
Ukubwa wa aina mbili wa umbali wa tatu

rows.source: A major third spans four half steps and sounds bright. A minor third spans three and sounds darker, a little wistful. Listen for the brightness.
