rows.translation: Umbali wa tatu wa meja una nusu toni nne na husikika angavu. Wa minori una tatu na husikika wenye hisia nzito zaidi, za majonzi kidogo. Sikiliza uangavu.

rows.source: C up to E spans how many half steps?
rows.translation: C kupanda hadi E ina nusu toni ngapi?

rows.source: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: four half steps, so it's a major third.
rows.translation: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: nusu toni nne, hivyo ni umbali wa tatu wa meja.

rows.source: Half steps, whole steps and thirds, rising and falling. Decide step or skip first, then the exact size.
rows.translation: Nusu toni, toni nzima na umbali wa tatu, kupanda na kushuka. Amua kwanza kama ni hatua au mruko, kisha ukubwa halisi.

rows.source: Unison, octave, fifth and fourth, each linked to a tune you can hum.
rows.translation: Unisoni, oktava, umbali wa tano na nne, kila mmoja ukihusishwa na melodi unayoweza kuvuma.

rows.source: An interval is the distance between two notes. A unison is no distance at all: the same note twice. An octave runs from one letter to the same letter above, like C to C. It sounds like one note, only brighter.
rows.translation: Umbali wa noti ni nafasi kati ya noti mbili. Unisoni haina nafasi kabisa: noti ileile mara mbili. Oktava ni kutoka herufi moja hadi ileile juu, kama C hadi C. Husikika kama noti moja, lakini angavu zaidi.

rows.source: Jingle Bells opens on one note repeated: a unison. Take Me Out to the Ball Game opens with a leap up an octave. Hum each opening to recall the sound.
rows.translation: Jingle Bells huanza na noti moja inayorudiwa: unisoni. Take Me Out to the Ball Game huanza kwa kuruka oktava moja juu. Vuma mwanzo wa kila moja kukumbuka sauti.

rows.source: Why is it called an octave?
C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C: eight letter names, counting both ends.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C: majina manane ya herufi, ukihesabu mwanzo na mwisho.

rows.source: A perfect fifth spans seven half steps, like C up to G. It sounds open and strong. Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star leaps up a fifth after its first two notes.
rows.translation: Umbali wa tano kamili una nusu toni saba, kama C kupanda hadi G. Husikika wazi na imara. Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star huruka umbali wa tano juu baada ya noti zake mbili za kwanza.

rows.source: What's a perfect fifth above D?
rows.translation: Noti ipi iko umbali wa tano kamili juu ya D?

rows.source: Count five letters: D, E, F, G, A. D to A spans seven half steps.
rows.translation: Hesabu herufi tano: D, E, F, G, A. D hadi A ina nusu toni saba.

rows.source: A perfect fourth spans five half steps, like C up to F. It sounds like a call to attention. Amazing Grace opens with a rising fourth.
rows.translation: Umbali wa nne kamili una nusu toni tano, kama C kupanda hadi F. Husikika kama mwito wa kusikiliza. Neema ya Ajabu huanza na umbali wa nne unaopanda.

rows.source: Both sound open. The fifth is wider and feels settled. The fourth feels like it wants to move on. If you're unsure, hum the tune for each.
rows.translation: Zote mbili husikika wazi. Umbali wa tano ni mpana zaidi na huhisiwa umetulia. Wa nne huhisiwa unataka kuendelea. Ukiwa huna uhakika, vuma melodi ya kila mmoja.

rows.source: A fifth spans seven half steps; a fourth spans five.
rows.translation: Umbali wa tano una nusu toni saba; wa nne una tano.
Umbali wa noti huenda pande zote

rows.source: An interval keeps its name whether it rises or falls. G down to C is still a fifth. Listen to the size of the gap, not the direction.
rows.translation: Umbali wa noti hubaki na jina lake ukipanda au kushuka. G kushuka hadi C bado ni umbali wa tano. Sikiliza ukubwa wa nafasi, si mwelekeo.

rows.source: When two notes sound together, listen to the blend. An octave melts into one sound. A fifth sounds hollow and strong. A fourth sounds open but restless.
rows.translation: Noti mbili zikisikika pamoja, sikiliza mchanganyiko. Oktava huyeyuka kuwa sauti moja. Umbali wa tano husikika wenye nafasi na imara. Wa nne husikika wazi lakini haujatulia.

rows.source: Sing or play a falling fifth: G down to C.
rows.translation: Imba au piga umbali wa tano unaoshuka: G chini hadi C.
Changamoto ya umbali wa noti I
Umbali wa aina nne, kila namna

rows.source: Unison, octave, fifth and fourth, rising, falling and together. If you get stuck, hum the tune for each.
rows.translation: Unisoni, oktava, umbali wa tano na nne, kupanda, kushuka na pamoja. Ukikwama, vuma melodi ya kila mmoja.

rows.source: Thirds, sixths and seconds in their major and minor sizes.
rows.translation: Umbali wa tatu, sita na pili katika ukubwa wake wa meja na minori.

rows.source: When the Saints Go Marching In opens with a major third, bright and bold. Greensleeves opens with a minor third, softer and sadder. Hum both to fix the sounds.
rows.translation: When the Saints Go Marching In huanza na umbali wa tatu wa meja, angavu na jasiri. Greensleeves huanza na wa minori, laini na wenye huzuni zaidi. Vuma zote mbili ili uzikumbuke.

rows.source: How many half steps are in a minor third?
rows.translation: Umbali wa tatu wa minori una nusu toni ngapi?

rows.source: A minor third spans three half steps, like A to C. A major third spans four.
rows.translation: Umbali wa tatu wa minori una nusu toni tatu, kama A hadi C. Wa meja una nne.

rows.source: A major sixth spans nine half steps; My Bonnie Lies Over the Ocean opens with one. A minor sixth spans eight and sounds darker. The Entertainer leaps up one right after its quick opening notes.
rows.translation: Umbali wa sita wa meja una nusu toni tisa; My Bonnie Lies Over the Ocean huanza nao. Wa minori una nane na husikika wenye hisia nzito zaidi. The Entertainer huruka nao juu baada tu ya noti zake za haraka za mwanzo.

rows.source: C up to A is which interval?
rows.translation: C kupanda hadi A ni umbali upi wa noti?

rows.source: C to A spans nine half steps: a major sixth.
rows.translation: C hadi A ina nusu toni tisa: umbali wa sita wa meja.

rows.source: Frère Jacques opens with a major second, a whole step up. Für Elise opens by rocking down and up a minor second, a half step. Small sizes, big difference.
rows.translation: Frère Jacques huanza na umbali wa pili wa meja, toni nzima juu. Für Elise huanza kwa kushuka na kupanda umbali wa pili wa minori, nusu toni. Ukubwa mdogo, tofauti kubwa.

rows.source: Which interval is a half step?
rows.translation: Umbali upi wa noti ni nusu toni?

rows.source: A minor second is one half step. A major second is two.
rows.translation: Umbali wa pili wa minori ni nusu toni moja. Wa meja ni mbili.

rows.source: Sing or play the rocking half step: E, D♯, E.
rows.translation: Imba au piga nusu toni ya kushuka na kupanda: E, D♯, E.

rows.source: First judge the size: a step, a skip or a wide leap. Then judge the color: bright for major, darker for minor. Two easy choices beat one hard guess.
rows.translation: Kwanza amua ukubwa: hatua, mruko mdogo au mkubwa. Kisha hisia: angavu kwa meja, nzito zaidi kwa minori. Maamuzi mawili rahisi ni bora kuliko kubahatisha jambo moja gumu.

rows.source: Minor intervals sound darker than their major partners.
rows.translation: Umbali wa minori husikika wenye hisia nzito zaidi kuliko wa meja unaolingana nao.
Changamoto ya umbali wa noti II

rows.source: Seconds, thirds and sixths, major and minor, mixed with the fourths and fifths you already know.
rows.translation: Umbali wa pili, tatu na sita, wa meja na minori, ukichanganywa na wa nne na tano unaoujua tayari.

rows.source: Hear major and minor chords, then diminished, augmented and dominant seventh.
rows.translation: Sikia kodi za meja na minori, kisha diminished, augmented na dominant ya saba.

rows.source: A chord is three or more notes sounding together. A major chord sounds bright and settled. A minor chord sounds darker. Only the middle note differs between them.
rows.translation: Kodi ni noti tatu au zaidi zinazolia pamoja. Kodi ya meja husikika angavu na tulivu. Ya minori husikika yenye hisia nzito zaidi. Noti ya katikati tu ndiyo hutofautiana.

rows.source: A major chord turns minor. How many of its notes change?
rows.translation: Kodi ya meja inakuwa minori. Noti zake ngapi hubadilika?

rows.source: Only the middle note, the third, drops a half step: C E G becomes C E♭ G.
rows.translation: Noti ya katikati tu, ya tatu, hushuka nusu toni: C E G huwa C E♭ G.

rows.source: Sing or play back the chord's notes, low to high.
rows.translation: Imba au piga tena noti za kodi, kutoka chini hadi juu.

rows.source: Unsure? Focus on the middle note. In a major chord it sits four half steps above the bottom. In minor it sits one half step lower, which darkens everything.
rows.translation: Huna uhakika? Zingatia noti ya katikati. Katika kodi ya meja iko nusu toni nne juu ya ya chini. Katika minori iko nusu toni moja chini zaidi, ikileta hisia nzito katika kodi nzima.

rows.source: Which notes spell a C minor chord?
rows.translation: Noti zipi huunda kodi ya C minori?

rows.source: Lower the middle note of C major by a half step: E becomes E♭.
rows.translation: Shusha noti ya katikati ya C meja kwa nusu toni: E huwa E♭.

rows.source: A diminished chord stacks two minor thirds and sounds tight and uneasy. An augmented chord stacks two major thirds and sounds stretched, like a question left hanging.
rows.translation: Kodi ya diminished hupanga umbali wa tatu wa minori mara mbili na husikika yenye kubana na wasiwasi. Ya augmented hupanga wa meja mara mbili na husikika iliyotanuka, kama swali lisilojibiwa.

rows.source: Which kind of chord is this?
rows.translation: Hii ni kodi ya aina gani?

rows.source: Which chord stacks two major thirds?
rows.translation: Kodi ipi hupanga umbali wa tatu wa meja mara mbili?

rows.source: A major third plus a major third, like C E G♯, makes an augmented chord.
rows.translation: Umbali wa tatu wa meja pamoja na mwingine wa meja, kama C E G♯, huunda kodi ya augmented.

rows.source: A dominant seventh chord is a major chord plus one more note on top: a minor seventh above the root, the note the chord is named for. It sounds bluesy and restless.
rows.translation: Kodi ya dominant ya saba ni kodi ya meja yenye noti moja zaidi juu: umbali wa saba wa minori juu ya noti msingi, ambayo huipa kodi jina. Husikika ya blues na isiyotulia.

rows.source: G7 is G major (G B D) plus F, a minor seventh above G.
rows.translation: G7 ni G meja (G B D) pamoja na F, umbali wa saba wa minori juu ya G.

rows.source: Major, minor, diminished, augmented and dominant seventh: bright, dark, tight, stretched, restless. Name the color, then the chord.
rows.translation: Meja, minori, diminished, augmented na dominant ya saba: angavu, nzito, zinazobana, zilizotanuka, zisizotulia. Taja hisia, kisha kodi.

rows.source: Hear each note's place in a key, from do, the home note, to ti.
rows.translation: Sikia nafasi ya kila noti katika ufunguo, kuanzia do, noti msingi, hadi ti.

rows.source: Every key has a home note called the tonic. Singers call it do. Here you'll hear a chord that sets the key, then a single note to place.
rows.translation: Kila ufunguo una noti msingi inayoitwa toniki. Waimbaji huiita do. Hapa utasikia kodi inayobainisha ufunguo, kisha noti moja ya kutambua nafasi yake.

rows.source: Is the last note do, the home note?
rows.translation: Je, noti ya mwisho ni do, noti msingi?

rows.source: The notes of a major scale are do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, then do again. Each is a scale degree, numbered from do: do is 1, re is 2, up to ti, 7.
rows.translation: Noti za skeli meja ni do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, kisha do tena. Kila moja ni daraja la skeli, zikihesabiwa kutoka do: do ni 1, re ni 2, hadi ti, 7.

rows.source: Which scale degree is the last note?
rows.translation: Noti ya mwisho ni daraja lipi la skeli?

rows.source: Sing or play do, re, mi in C major: C, D, E.
rows.translation: Imba au piga do, re, mi katika C meja: C, D, E.

rows.source: Do, mi and sol are the notes of the home chord, so they sound stable and at rest. Mi sounds sweet, sol sounds strong and open, and do sounds finished.
rows.translation: Do, mi na sol ni noti za kodi ya msingi, hivyo husikika imara na tulivu. Mi husikika tamu, sol imara na wazi, na do iliyokamilika.

rows.source: In C major, which note is sol?
rows.translation: Katika C meja, sol ni noti ipi?

rows.source: Count up from do: C do, D re, E mi, F fa, G sol.
rows.translation: Hesabu kutoka do: C do, D re, E mi, F fa, G sol.

rows.source: Sing or play do, mi, sol in G major: G, B, D.
rows.translation: Imba au piga do, mi, sol katika G meja: G, B, D.

rows.source: Re, fa, la and ti sound unfinished. Ti sits a half step below do and pulls hard upward. Fa leans down to mi. Re and la want to step to a neighbor.
rows.translation: Re, fa, la na ti husikika hazijakamilika. Ti iko nusu toni chini ya do na huvutia sana kupanda. Fa huvutia kushuka hadi mi. Re na la hutaka kwenda kwenye noti jirani.

rows.source: Which note pulls most strongly up to do?
rows.translation: Noti ipi huvutia zaidi kupanda hadi do?

rows.source: Ti sits just a half step below do, so it leans hard toward it.
rows.translation: Ti iko nusu toni tu chini ya do, hivyo huvutia sana kuielekea.

rows.source: Sing or play ti rising to do in C major: B, then C.
rows.translation: Imba au piga ti ikipanda hadi do katika C meja: B, kisha C.

rows.source: Set the key with a cadence
A cadence is a short chord pattern that ends a phrase. Hearing one sets the key firmly. Sing do quietly to yourself, then measure the new note from there.
rows.translation: Kadensi ni mfuatano mfupi wa kodi unaomaliza kishazi. Kuisikia hubainisha ufunguo vizuri. Jiimbie do kwa sauti ndogo, kisha pima noti mpya kuanzia hapo.

rows.source: Why play a cadence before the note?
rows.translation: Kwa nini upige kadensi kabla ya noti?

rows.source: The chords point to do, so you can hear every other note in relation to it.
rows.translation: Kodi huelekeza kwenye do, hivyo unaweza kusikia uhusiano wa kila noti nyingine nayo.

rows.source: Sing or play up the scale from do in C major: C, D, E, F, G.
rows.translation: Imba au piga ukipanda skeli kutoka do katika C meja: C, D, E, F, G.

rows.source: Chords set the key, then one note plays. Find do first, then name the note. Every key works the same way.
rows.translation: Kodi hubainisha ufunguo, kisha noti moja hupigwa. Tafuta do kwanza, kisha taja noti. Kila ufunguo hufanya vivyo hivyo.

rows.source: Sing or play do, ti, do in D major: D, C♯, D.
rows.translation: Imba au piga do, ti, do katika D meja: D, C♯, D.

rows.source: Hear short melodies, pick out the one you heard, and sing it back.
rows.translation: Sikia melodi fupi, chagua uliyosikia, kisha uiimbe tena.

rows.source: Dictation means hearing a melody and writing it down. Here you pick it from a list. Find do from the chord, then follow each move: up or down, step or skip.
rows.translation: Dikte ni kusikia melodi na kuiandika. Hapa unaichagua kwenye orodha. Tafuta do kutoka kwenye kodi, kisha fuata kila mwendo: kupanda au kushuka, hatua au mruko.

rows.source: Before naming notes, trace the shape with your hand: up, down or bending. Most wrong answers have the wrong shape, so you can rule them out fast.
rows.translation: Kabla ya kutaja noti, fuata umbo kwa mkono: juu, chini au likigeuka. Majibu mengi yasiyo sahihi yana umbo lisilo sahihi, hivyo unaweza kuyaondoa haraka.

rows.source: Steps sound smooth; skips jump out. When you hear a jump, check whether it lands on a note of the home chord: do, mi or sol.
rows.translation: Hatua husikika laini; miruko hujitokeza. Ukisikia mruko, kagua kama unatulia kwenye noti ya kodi ya msingi: do, mi au sol.

rows.source: A melody goes do, mi, sol. How does it move?
rows.translation: Melodi inaenda do, mi, sol. Inasogeaje?

rows.source: Do to mi skips re, and mi to sol skips fa.
rows.translation: Do hadi mi huruka re, na mi hadi sol huruka fa.

rows.source: Longer melodies use the same tools. Lock in the first note against do, then take the rest one move at a time.
rows.translation: Melodi ndefu hutumia mbinu zilezile. Linganisha noti ya kwanza na do, kisha fuata nyingine hatua moja baada ya nyingine.

rows.source: A melody stops on ti. How does it sound?
Ti leans up to do, so a melody that stops on ti feels like it's waiting.
rows.translation: Ti huvutia kupanda hadi do, hivyo melodi inayosimama kwenye ti huhisiwa inasubiri.

rows.source: Melodies often dip under do to ti, la or sol below. They're the same notes, just lower. Many tunes start on sol below and leap up to do.
rows.translation: Melodi mara nyingi hushuka chini ya do hadi ti, la au sol ya chini. Ni noti zilezile, ila ziko chini zaidi. Melodi nyingi huanza kwenye sol ya chini na kuruka hadi do.

rows.source: Amazing Grace starts on sol below do and leaps up. To which note?
rows.translation: Neema ya Ajabu huanza kwenye sol chini ya do na kuruka juu. Hadi noti ipi?

rows.source: Sol up to do is a perfect fourth, the interval you learned with this tune.
rows.translation: Sol kupanda hadi do ni umbali wa nne kamili, umbali uliojifunza kwa melodi hii.

rows.source: Hear it, find it, sing it
Chords first, then the melody. Find do, trace the shape, name each note, then sing or play it back.
rows.translation: Kwanza kodi, kisha melodi. Tafuta do, fuata umbo, taja kila noti, kisha uiimbe au uipige tena.

rows.source: How music works, from note names to the chords behind songs
rows.translation: Jinsi muziki unavyofanya kazi, kutoka majina ya noti hadi kodi za nyimbo

rows.source: Seven letters, repeating octaves, and where every note lives on a keyboard.
rows.translation: Herufi saba, oktava zinazojirudia, na mahali pa kila noti kwenye kinanda.

rows.source: Music names its notes with just seven letters: A, B, C, D, E, F, G. After G the alphabet starts again at A, a little higher each time around.
rows.translation: Muziki hutaja noti kwa herufi saba tu: A, B, C, D, E, F, G. Baada ya G alfabeti huanza tena kwenye A, ikiwa juu kidogo kila inapozunguka.

rows.source: The musical alphabet stops at G and starts again at A.
rows.translation: Alfabeti ya muziki huisha kwenye G na kuanza tena kwenye A.

rows.source: Which letter comes just before C?
rows.translation: Herufi ipi huja kabla tu ya C?

rows.source: Going down, the alphabet runs C, B, A, then G.
rows.translation: Ukishuka, alfabeti ni C, B, A, kisha G.

rows.source: Moving forward through the letters, A to B to C, the notes go up. Moving backward, they go down. The letters loop like the hours on a clock.
rows.translation: Ukienda mbele katika herufi, A hadi B hadi C, noti hupanda. Ukirudi nyuma, hushuka. Herufi huzunguka kama saa kwenye uso wa saa.

rows.source: What are the next two letters after F?
rows.translation: Herufi mbili zinazofuata baada ya F ni zipi?

rows.source: F, G, then back around to A.
rows.translation: F, G, kisha kuzunguka kurudi A.

rows.source: Backward through the alphabet means lower notes: E, D, C, B.
rows.translation: Kwenda nyuma katika alfabeti kunamaanisha noti za chini zaidi: E, D, C, B.

rows.source: Play or sing C, D, E, climbing up the alphabet.
rows.translation: Piga au imba C, D, E, ukipanda alfabeti.

rows.source: Notes that share a letter sound alike even when one is higher. The distance from one C to the next C is an octave. The higher note vibrates exactly twice as fast.
rows.translation: Noti zenye herufi ileile husikika zinazofanana hata moja ikiwa juu zaidi. Umbali kutoka C moja hadi C inayofuata ni oktava. Noti ya juu hutetemeka kwa kasi mara mbili kamili.

rows.source: Do these two notes share a letter name?
rows.translation: Noti hizi mbili zina jina lilelile la herufi?

rows.source: A4 vibrates 440 times a second. How fast does A5 vibrate?
rows.translation: A4 hutetemeka mara 440 kwa sekunde. A5 hutetemeka kwa kasi gani?

rows.source: An octave up doubles the vibration: 440 becomes 880.
rows.translation: Oktava moja juu huongeza kasi ya mtetemo mara mbili: 440 huwa 880.

rows.source: Notes carry a number that tells you which octave they're in. Middle C, near the center of a piano, is C4. The number goes up by one at every C.
rows.translation: Noti zina namba inayoonyesha ziko katika oktava ipi. C ya katikati, karibu na katikati ya piano, ni C4. Namba huongezeka kwa moja katika kila C.

rows.source: Which note is just above B3?
rows.translation: Noti ipi iko juu tu ya B3?

rows.source: Octave numbers change at C, so the next note up from B3 is C4.
rows.translation: Namba za oktava hubadilika kwenye C, hivyo noti inayofuata juu ya B3 ni C4.

rows.source: Play or sing middle C, then the C an octave higher.
rows.translation: Piga au imba C ya katikati, kisha C ya oktava moja juu.

rows.source: A keyboard's black keys come in groups of two and three. They're your map. C is the white key just left of each group of two.
rows.translation: Vitufe vyeusi vya kinanda huja katika makundi ya mbili na tatu. Hiyo ndiyo ramani yako. C ni kitufe cheupe kilicho kushoto tu ya kila kundi la viwili.

rows.source: C sits just left of the group of two black keys.
rows.translation: C iko kushoto tu ya kundi la vitufe viwili vyeusi.

rows.source: F and the group of three
F is the white key just left of each group of three black keys. Find C and F first, and every other white key is a short count away.
rows.translation: F ni kitufe cheupe kilicho kushoto tu ya kila kundi la vitufe vitatu vyeusi. Tafuta C na F kwanza, na kila kitufe kingine cheupe kiko umbali wa kuhesabu kidogo tu.

rows.source: F sits just left of the group of three black keys.
rows.translation: F iko kushoto tu ya kundi la vitufe vitatu vyeusi.

rows.source: D sits between the two black keys of the pair.
rows.translation: D iko kati ya vitufe viwili vyeusi vya jozi.

rows.source: B is the white key just right of the group of three black keys.
rows.translation: B ni kitufe cheupe kilicho kulia tu ya kundi la vitufe vitatu vyeusi.

rows.source: Play or sing F, G, A, starting from the F you just found.
rows.translation: Piga au imba F, G, A, kuanzia F uliyopata sasa hivi.

rows.source: From C, the white keys run C, D, E, F, G, A, B, then C again. Seven white keys hold one of each letter.
rows.translation: Kutoka C, vitufe vyeupe ni C, D, E, F, G, A, B, kisha C tena. Vitufe saba vyeupe vina kila herufi mara moja.

rows.source: G sits between the first two black keys of the group of three.
rows.translation: G iko kati ya vitufe viwili vyeusi vya kwanza katika kundi la vitatu.

rows.source: E is the white key just right of the group of two black keys.
rows.translation: E ni kitufe cheupe kilicho kulia tu ya kundi la vitufe viwili vyeusi.

rows.source: A sits between the last two black keys of the group of three.
rows.translation: A iko kati ya vitufe viwili vyeusi vya mwisho katika kundi la vitatu.

rows.source: How many white keys run from one C up to the next B?
rows.translation: Kuna vitufe vingapi vyeupe kutoka C moja kupanda hadi B inayofuata?

rows.source: C, D, E, F, G, A, B: seven letters, seven white keys.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F, G, A, B: herufi saba, vitufe saba vyeupe.

rows.source: Play or sing up the white keys from middle C to the next C.
rows.translation: Piga au imba ukipanda vitufe vyeupe kutoka C ya katikati hadi C inayofuata.

rows.source: The alphabet, octaves and the keyboard map, all together. Use the black-key groups to find your way.
rows.translation: Alfabeti, oktava na ramani ya kinanda, vyote pamoja. Tumia makundi ya vitufe vyeusi kutafuta njia yako.

rows.source: Which two letters come right after E?
rows.translation: Herufi mbili zinazofuata mara tu baada ya E ni zipi?

rows.source: E, F, G: forward through the alphabet.
rows.translation: E, F, G: mbele katika alfabeti.

rows.source: Middle C is C4. What's the C an octave above it?
rows.translation: C ya katikati ni C4. C ya oktava moja juu ni ipi?

rows.source: Each octave up adds one to the number.
rows.translation: Kila oktava moja juu huongeza moja kwenye namba.

rows.source: Play or sing G, A, B, C. The alphabet wraps from G back to A.
rows.translation: Piga au imba G, A, B, C. Alfabeti huzunguka kutoka G kurudi A.

rows.source: The black keys, the smallest step, and notes with two names.
rows.translation: Vitufe vyeusi, hatua ndogo zaidi, na noti zenye majina mawili.

rows.source: A half step moves from one key to the very next, black or white, with nothing in between. It's the smallest distance on a keyboard and in most music.
rows.translation: Nusu toni husogea kutoka kitufe kimoja hadi kinachofuata kabisa, cheusi au cheupe, bila kingine katikati. Ni umbali mdogo zaidi kwenye kinanda na katika muziki mwingi.

rows.source: What is a half step above E?
rows.translation: Noti ipi iko nusu toni juu ya E?

rows.source: E and F have no black key between them.
rows.translation: E na F hazina kitufe cheusi katikati yake.
Nusu toni mbili za vitufe vyeupe

rows.source: Look for the gaps with no black key: E to F and B to C. These white keys sit right next to each other, so they're only a half step apart.
rows.translation: Tafuta nafasi zisizo na kitufe cheusi: E hadi F na B hadi C. Vitufe hivi vyeupe viko jirani kabisa, hivyo vimetengana kwa nusu toni tu.

rows.source: Which pair of white keys is a half step apart?
rows.translation: Jozi ipi ya vitufe vyeupe imetengana kwa nusu toni?

rows.source: B and C have no black key between them.
rows.translation: B na C hazina kitufe cheusi katikati yake.

rows.source: How many half steps from C up to E?
rows.translation: Kuna nusu toni ngapi kutoka C kupanda hadi E?

rows.source: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: four moves of one key each.
rows.translation: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: hatua nne za kitufe kimoja kila moja.

rows.source: Play or sing the two white-key half steps: E to F, then B to C.
rows.translation: Piga au imba nusu toni mbili za vitufe vyeupe: E hadi F, kisha B hadi C.

rows.source: A sharp (♯) raises a note by a half step. A flat (♭) lowers it by a half step. The black key just above C is C♯; the one just below D is D♭.
rows.translation: Diesi (♯) huinua noti kwa nusu toni. Bemoli (♭) huishusha kwa nusu toni. Kitufe cheusi kilicho juu tu ya C ni C♯; kilicho chini tu ya D ni D♭.

rows.source: What does a sharp do to a note?
This black key sits just above F. What's its sharp name?
rows.translation: Kitufe hiki cheusi kiko juu tu ya F. Jina lake la diesi ni lipi?

rows.source: Raise F by a half step and you get F♯.
rows.translation: Inua F kwa nusu toni upate F♯.

rows.source: The same key sits just below G. What's its flat name?
rows.translation: Kitufe kilekile kiko chini tu ya G. Jina lake la bemoli ni lipi?

rows.source: Lower G by a half step and you get G♭.
rows.translation: Shusha G kwa nusu toni upate G♭.

rows.source: Each black key can be named from the white key below it, with a sharp, or the white key above it, with a flat. C♯ and D♭ are the same key.
rows.translation: Kila kitufe cheusi kinaweza kupewa jina kutoka kitufe cheupe kilicho chini yake, kwa diesi, au cheupe kilicho juu yake, kwa bemoli. C♯ na D♭ ni kitufe kilekile.

rows.source: What is a half step below B?
rows.translation: Noti ipi iko nusu toni chini ya B?

rows.source: Lower B by a half step and you get B♭.
rows.translation: Shusha B kwa nusu toni upate B♭.

rows.source: It's the right-hand key of the pair, just above D: D♯.
rows.translation: Ni kitufe cha kulia katika jozi, juu tu ya D: D♯.

rows.source: Play or sing C, C♯, D: two half steps up.
rows.translation: Piga au imba C, C♯, D: nusu toni mbili juu.

rows.source: A whole step equals two half steps: it skips exactly one key. C to D is a whole step, with C♯ in between. E to F♯ is too.
rows.translation: Toni nzima ni sawa na nusu toni mbili: huruka kitufe kimoja tu. C hadi D ni toni nzima, C♯ ikiwa katikati. E hadi F♯ pia.

rows.source: What is a whole step above C?
rows.translation: Noti ipi iko toni nzima juu ya C?

rows.source: C to D skips one key, C♯.
rows.translation: C hadi D huruka kitufe kimoja, C♯.

rows.source: What is a whole step above E?
rows.translation: Noti ipi iko toni nzima juu ya E?

rows.source: E to F is only a half step, so a whole step up is F♯.
rows.translation: E hadi F ni nusu toni tu, hivyo toni nzima juu ni F♯.

rows.source: What is a whole step above B?
rows.translation: Noti ipi iko toni nzima juu ya B?

rows.source: B to C is a half step, so a whole step up is C♯.
rows.translation: B hadi C ni nusu toni, hivyo toni nzima juu ni C♯.

rows.source: What is a whole step below F?
rows.translation: Noti ipi iko toni nzima chini ya F?

rows.source: F down to E is a half step; one more key down is E♭.
rows.translation: F kushuka hadi E ni nusu toni; kitufe kimoja zaidi chini ni E♭.

rows.source: Play or sing two whole steps up from E: E, F♯, G♯.
rows.translation: Piga au imba toni nzima mbili juu kutoka E: E, F♯, G♯.

rows.source: Two names for the same pitch are called enharmonic. C♯ and D♭ are one key with two names. Which name you use depends on the key you're in.
rows.translation: Majina mawili ya kimo kilekile cha sauti huitwa enharmoniki. C♯ na D♭ ni kitufe kimoja chenye majina mawili. Jina unalotumia hutegemea ufunguo wa muziki uliomo.

rows.source: Which pair names the same key?
C♯ is a half step above C; D♭ is a half step below D. Same key.
rows.translation: C♯ iko nusu toni juu ya C; D♭ iko nusu toni chini ya D. Kitufe kilekile.
Jina lingine la G♯ ni lipi?

rows.source: G♯ and A♭ are the same black key.
rows.translation: G♯ na A♭ ni kitufe kilekile cheusi.

rows.source: White keys can have sharp or flat names as well. E and F are a half step apart, so E♯ is the same key as F, and F♭ is the same key as E.
rows.translation: Vitufe vyeupe pia vinaweza kuwa na majina ya diesi au bemoli. E na F zimetengana kwa nusu toni, hivyo E♯ ni kitufe kilekile cha F, na F♭ ni kitufe kilekile cha E.

rows.source: E♯ is played on which key?
E♯ is a half step above E, which is F.
rows.translation: E♯ iko nusu toni juu ya E, yaani F.
Jina lingine la C ni lipi?

rows.source: B♯ is a half step above B, which is C.
rows.translation: B♯ iko nusu toni juu ya B, yaani C.

rows.source: The black key between F and G is F♯. What's its other name?
rows.translation: Kitufe cheusi kati ya F na G ni F♯. Jina lake lingine ni lipi?

rows.source: Play or sing B♭, C, D. B♭ is the same key as A♯.
rows.translation: Piga au imba B♭, C, D. B♭ ni kitufe kilekile cha A♯.

rows.source: Half steps, whole steps, sharps, flats and two-name notes, all mixed together. Picture the keyboard as you answer.
rows.translation: Nusu toni, toni nzima, diesi, bemoli na noti zenye majina mawili, vyote vimechanganywa. Wazia kinanda unapojibu.

rows.source: What is a half step above B?
rows.translation: Noti ipi iko nusu toni juu ya B?

rows.source: What is a whole step above A?
rows.translation: Noti ipi iko toni nzima juu ya A?

rows.source: A to B skips one key, A♯.
rows.translation: A hadi B huruka kitufe kimoja, A♯.
Jina lingine la E♭ ni lipi?

rows.source: E♭ and D♯ are the same black key.
rows.translation: E♭ na D♯ ni kitufe kilekile cheusi.

rows.source: It's the top key of the group of three, just below B: A♯, also called B♭.
rows.translation: Ni kitufe cha juu kabisa katika kundi la vitatu, chini tu ya B: A♯, pia huitwa B♭.

rows.source: What is a whole step below D?
rows.translation: Noti ipi iko toni nzima chini ya D?

rows.source: D to C skips one key, C♯.
rows.translation: D hadi C huruka kitufe kimoja, C♯.

rows.source: Play or sing D, E, F♯, G: whole, whole, then half.
rows.translation: Piga au imba D, E, F♯, G: toni nzima, nzima, kisha nusu.

rows.source: Treble clef lines and spaces, ledger lines, and a first look at bass clef.
rows.translation: Mistari na nafasi za klefu ya trebo, mistari ya ziada, na utangulizi wa klefu ya besi.

rows.source: Music is written on a staff: five lines with four spaces between them. Notes sit on a line or in a space. The higher a note sits, the higher it sounds.
rows.translation: Muziki huandikwa kwenye stafu: mistari mitano yenye nafasi nne katikati yake. Noti hukaa kwenye mstari au ndani ya nafasi. Noti ikiwa juu zaidi, sauti yake pia huwa juu zaidi.

rows.source: How many lines does a staff have?
Five lines, with four spaces between them.
rows.translation: Mistari mitano, yenye nafasi nne katikati yake.

rows.source: It sits higher on the staff, so it sounds higher.
rows.translation: Iko juu zaidi kwenye stafu, hivyo sauti yake iko juu zaidi.

rows.source: Moving up one letter moves from a line to the next space, or from a space to the next line. Notes on neighboring lines are two letters apart.
rows.translation: Kupanda herufi moja husogeza noti kutoka mstari hadi nafasi inayofuata, au kutoka nafasi hadi mstari unaofuata. Noti kwenye mistari jirani zimetengana kwa hatua mbili za herufi.

rows.source: A note on a line moves up one letter. Where does it land?
rows.translation: Noti kwenye mstari inapanda herufi moja. Inatua wapi?

rows.source: Letters alternate: line, space, line, space.
rows.translation: Herufi hupokezana: mstari, nafasi, mstari, nafasi.

rows.source: The treble clef, or G clef, curls around the second line from the bottom. That line is the G above middle C. Higher instruments and voices read it.
rows.translation: Klefu ya trebo, au klefu ya G, huzunguka mstari wa pili kutoka chini. Mstari huo ni G juu ya C ya katikati. Ala na sauti za juu huitumia kusoma noti.

rows.source: Which note is on the second line of the treble staff?
rows.translation: Noti ipi iko kwenye mstari wa pili wa stafu ya trebo?

rows.source: The treble clef curls around that line to mark G.
rows.translation: Klefu ya trebo huzunguka mstari huo kuonyesha G.

rows.source: From bottom to top, the treble staff's lines are E, G, B, D, F. Remember them as Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.translation: Kutoka chini hadi juu, mistari ya stafu ya trebo ni E, G, B, D, F. Ikumbuke kwa maneno ya Kiingereza Every Good Boy Does Fine.

rows.source: The bottom line is E, the Every of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.translation: Mstari wa chini ni E, herufi ya kwanza ya Every katika Every Good Boy Does Fine.

rows.source: The middle line is B, the Boy of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.translation: Mstari wa katikati ni B, herufi ya kwanza ya Boy katika Every Good Boy Does Fine.

rows.source: The top line is F, the Fine of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.translation: Mstari wa juu ni F, herufi ya kwanza ya Fine katika Every Good Boy Does Fine.

rows.source: The fourth line up is D, the Does of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.translation: Mstari wa nne kutoka chini ni D, herufi ya kwanza ya Does katika Every Good Boy Does Fine.

rows.source: Play or sing the bottom three lines: E, G, B.
rows.translation: Piga au imba mistari mitatu ya chini: E, G, B.

rows.source: The four spaces of the treble staff spell a word from bottom to top: F, A, C, E. The spaces spell FACE.
rows.translation: Nafasi nne za stafu ya trebo huunda neno kutoka chini hadi juu: F, A, C, E. Nafasi huunda neno la Kiingereza FACE.

rows.source: The bottom space is F, the first letter of FACE.
rows.translation: Nafasi ya chini ni F, herufi ya kwanza ya FACE.

rows.source: The third space up is C: F, A, C.
rows.translation: Nafasi ya tatu kutoka chini ni C: F, A, C.

rows.source: The second space up is A: F, A.
rows.translation: Nafasi ya pili kutoka chini ni A: F, A.

rows.source: Put them together and the staff climbs E, F, G, A, B, C, D, E, F: line, space, line, space, all the way up.
rows.translation: Ziunganishe, stafu itapanda E, F, G, A, B, C, D, E, F: mstari, nafasi, mstari, nafasi, hadi juu.

rows.source: The top space is E, the last letter of FACE.
rows.translation: Nafasi ya juu ni E, herufi ya mwisho ya FACE.

rows.source: The second line up is G, where the treble clef curls.
rows.translation: Mstari wa pili kutoka chini ni G, pale klefu ya trebo inapozunguka.

rows.source: Play or sing the spaces from bottom to top: F, A, C, E.
rows.translation: Piga au imba nafasi kutoka chini hadi juu: F, A, C, E.
Mistari ya ziada na C ya katikati

rows.source: When a note goes above or below the staff, short extra lines called ledger lines extend it. Middle C sits on one ledger line just below the treble staff.
rows.translation: Noti inapokwenda juu au chini ya stafu, mistari mifupi ya ziada huiendeleza. C ya katikati hukaa kwenye mstari mmoja wa ziada ulio chini tu ya stafu ya trebo.

rows.source: One ledger line below the treble staff is middle C.
rows.translation: Mstari mmoja wa ziada chini ya stafu ya trebo ni C ya katikati.

rows.source: D hangs in the space just below the bottom line.
rows.translation: D iko kwenye nafasi iliyo chini tu ya mstari wa chini.

rows.source: Above the top line, the pattern keeps going. G sits just above the top line, and A sits on the first ledger line above.
rows.translation: Juu ya mstari wa juu, mpangilio unaendelea. G iko juu tu ya mstari wa juu, na A kwenye mstari wa kwanza wa ziada juu yake.

rows.source: One ledger line above the treble staff is A.
rows.translation: Mstari mmoja wa ziada juu ya stafu ya trebo ni A.

rows.source: Count down: middle C on the first ledger line, B below it, A on the second ledger line.
rows.translation: Hesabu kushuka: C ya katikati kwenye mstari wa kwanza wa ziada, B chini yake, A kwenye wa pili.

rows.source: Play or sing middle C, then D and E, climbing from the ledger line onto the staff.
rows.translation: Piga au imba C ya katikati, kisha D na E, ukipanda kutoka mstari wa ziada hadi kwenye stafu.

rows.source: Low instruments and voices read the bass clef, or F clef. Its two dots surround the fourth line up, marking the F below middle C.
rows.translation: Ala na sauti za chini husoma klefu ya besi, au klefu ya F. Nukta zake mbili huzunguka mstari wa nne kutoka chini, zikionyesha F chini ya C ya katikati.

rows.source: Which note do the bass clef's dots mark?
rows.translation: Nukta za klefu ya besi huonyesha noti ipi?

rows.source: The bass clef is the F clef: its dots frame the F line.
rows.translation: Klefu ya besi ni klefu ya F: nukta zake ziko pande mbili za mstari wa F.

rows.source: The bass staff's lines, bottom to top, are G, B, D, F, A: Good Boys Do Fine Always. The spaces are A, C, E, G: All Cows Eat Grass.
rows.translation: Mistari ya stafu ya besi, chini hadi juu, ni G, B, D, F, A: kwa Kiingereza Good Boys Do Fine Always. Nafasi ni A, C, E, G: All Cows Eat Grass.

rows.source: The bottom line of the bass staff is G, the Good of Good Boys Do Fine Always.
rows.translation: Mstari wa chini wa stafu ya besi ni G, herufi ya kwanza ya Good katika Good Boys Do Fine Always.

rows.source: The second space up is C: All Cows.
rows.translation: Nafasi ya pili kutoka chini ni C: All Cows.

rows.source: The top line of the bass staff is A, the Always of Good Boys Do Fine Always.
rows.translation: Mstari wa juu wa stafu ya besi ni A, herufi ya kwanza ya Always katika Good Boys Do Fine Always.

rows.source: Where is middle C in bass clef?
rows.translation: C ya katikati iko wapi katika klefu ya besi?

rows.source: On a ledger line above the staff
rows.translation: Kwenye mstari wa ziada juu ya stafu

rows.source: Middle C sits one ledger line above the bass staff, and one below the treble staff.
rows.translation: C ya katikati iko mstari mmoja wa ziada juu ya stafu ya besi, na mmoja chini ya stafu ya trebo.

rows.source: Play or sing the bass clef spaces: A, C, E, G.
rows.translation: Piga au imba nafasi za klefu ya besi: A, C, E, G.

rows.source: Lines, spaces, ledger lines and both clefs. Use your memory sentences, then try to recognize each note at a glance.
rows.translation: Mistari, nafasi, mistari ya ziada na klefu zote mbili. Tumia sentensi za kukumbuka, kisha jaribu kutambua kila noti kwa kuitazama tu.

rows.source: The third space up in bass clef is E: All Cows Eat.
rows.translation: Nafasi ya tatu kutoka chini katika klefu ya besi ni E: All Cows Eat.

rows.source: Play or sing middle C, then E, G, and the C in the third space.
rows.translation: Piga au imba C ya katikati, kisha E, G, na C katika nafasi ya tatu.

rows.source: Note values from whole to sixteenth, dots and rests, and the meters 4/4, 3/4 and 6/8.
rows.translation: Thamani za noti kutoka nzima hadi ya kumi na sita, nukta na mapumziko, na vipimo vya 4/4, 3/4 na 6/8.

rows.source: The beat is the steady pulse you tap your foot to. Beats are grouped into bars, also called measures. In most music, each bar holds four beats.
rows.translation: Pigo ni mwendo thabiti unaoufuata kwa kugonga mguu. Mapigo hukusanywa katika vipimo, vinavyoitwa bars au measures kwa Kiingereza. Katika muziki mwingi, kila kipimo kina mapigo manne.

rows.source: Count each bar out loud: 1, 2, 3, 4. Beat 1, the downbeat, usually feels strongest. Lean into it a little.
rows.translation: Hesabu kila kipimo kwa sauti: 1, 2, 3, 4. Pigo 1, la kwanza, kwa kawaida huhisiwa lenye nguvu zaidi. Likazie kidogo.

rows.source: What's another word for a bar?
rows.translation: Neno la Kiingereza bar lina maana gani?

rows.source: Bar and measure mean the same thing.
rows.translation: Bar na measure humaanisha kitu kilekile: kipimo.
Pigo lipi kwa kawaida huhisiwa lenye nguvu zaidi?

rows.source: Beat 1, the downbeat, starts each bar.
rows.translation: Pigo 1, la kwanza, huanza kila kipimo.

rows.source: A note's shape tells you how long it lasts. In a four-beat bar, a whole note lasts all four beats, a half note two, and a quarter note one.
rows.translation: Umbo la noti hukuambia inachukua muda gani. Katika kipimo cha mapigo manne, noti nzima hudumu yote manne, noti nusu mawili, na robo moja.

rows.source: How many beats does a half note last?
Two half notes fill a four-beat bar.
rows.translation: Noti nusu mbili hujaza kipimo cha mapigo manne.

rows.source: How many quarter notes fill a bar of four beats?
rows.translation: Noti robo ngapi hujaza kipimo cha mapigo manne?

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat, so four fill the bar.
rows.translation: Noti robo hudumu pigo moja, hivyo nne hujaza kipimo.

rows.source: A whole note lasts four beats, a half note two, a quarter note one.
rows.translation: Noti nzima hudumu mapigo manne, noti nusu mawili, na robo moja.

rows.source: A bar can mix values, as long as they add up. A half note plus two quarter notes fills four beats: 2 + 1 + 1.
rows.translation: Kipimo kinaweza kuchanganya thamani, mradi zijumlishe ipasavyo. Noti nusu pamoja na robo mbili hujaza mapigo manne: 2 + 1 + 1.
Noti za nane na za kumi na sita

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in each beat. Count them 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and, saying and between the beats.
rows.translation: Noti ya nane hudumu nusu ya pigo, hivyo mbili hutimia katika kila pigo. Zihesabu 1 na 2 na 3 na 4 na, ukisema na kati ya mapigo.

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat.
rows.translation: Noti ya nane hudumu nusu ya pigo.

rows.source: A sixteenth note lasts a quarter of a beat, so four fit in each beat. Count them 1 e and a, 2 e and a.
rows.translation: Noti ya kumi na sita hudumu robo ya pigo, hivyo nne hutimia katika kila pigo. Zihesabu 1 e na a, 2 e na a.

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes equal one quarter note?
rows.translation: Noti ngapi za kumi na sita ni sawa na noti robo moja?

rows.source: A quarter note is one beat, and four sixteenths fit in a beat.
rows.translation: Noti robo ni pigo moja, na noti nne za kumi na sita hutimia katika pigo.

rows.source: How many eighth notes fill a bar of four beats?
rows.translation: Noti ngapi za nane hujaza kipimo cha mapigo manne?

rows.source: Two per beat, four beats: eight eighth notes.
rows.translation: Mbili kwa pigo, mapigo manne: noti nane za nane.

rows.source: A dot after a note adds half its value. A half note lasts two beats, so a dotted half lasts three. A dotted quarter lasts one and a half.
rows.translation: Nukta baada ya noti huongeza nusu ya thamani yake. Noti nusu hudumu mapigo mawili, hivyo yenye nukta hudumu matatu. Noti robo yenye nukta hudumu pigo moja na nusu.

rows.source: Half of two is one, so the dot adds one beat: 2 + 1 = 3.
rows.translation: Nusu ya mbili ni moja, hivyo nukta huongeza pigo moja: 2 + 1 = 3.

rows.source: A rest is a measured silence. Each note value has a matching rest: a quarter rest lasts one beat, a half rest two. Keep counting through them.
rows.translation: Pumziko ni ukimya wenye muda uliopimwa. Kila thamani ya noti ina pumziko linalolingana: pumziko robo hudumu pigo moja, nusu mawili. Endelea kuhesabu wakati wake.

rows.source: A quarter is one beat; the dot adds half of that.
rows.translation: Noti robo ni pigo moja; nukta huongeza nusu yake.

rows.source: A four-beat bar has a half note and a quarter note. What fills the gap?
rows.translation: Kipimo cha mapigo manne kina noti nusu na noti robo. Nini hujaza nafasi iliyobaki?

rows.source: 2 + 1 = 3, so one beat is left: a quarter rest.
rows.translation: 2 + 1 = 3, hivyo pigo moja limebaki: pumziko robo.

rows.source: The two stacked numbers at the start of a piece are the time signature. The top number counts beats per bar. The bottom shows which note gets one beat: 4 means a quarter note.
rows.translation: Namba mbili zilizo moja juu ya nyingine mwanzoni mwa kipande ni alama ya kipimo. Ya juu huhesabu mapigo kwa kipimo. Ya chini huonyesha noti inayopata pigo moja: 4 humaanisha noti robo.

rows.source: In 4/4, how many quarter-note beats are in a bar?
rows.translation: Katika 4/4, kipimo kina mapigo mangapi ya noti robo?

rows.source: The top 4 means four beats; the bottom 4 makes each one a quarter note.
rows.translation: 4 ya juu humaanisha mapigo manne; 4 ya chini hufanya kila moja kuwa noti robo.

rows.source: In 3/4, each bar holds three quarter-note beats. Count 1, 2, 3, with the weight on 1. It's the lilt of a waltz.
rows.translation: Katika 3/4, kila kipimo kina mapigo matatu ya noti robo. Hesabu 1, 2, 3, mkazo ukiwa kwenye 1. Huo ndio mwendo wa kuyumba wa waltz.

rows.source: Which time signature is a waltz usually in?
rows.translation: Waltz kwa kawaida huwa katika alama ipi ya kipimo?
Waltz huhesabiwa kwa makundi ya tatu: 1, 2, 3.

rows.source: In 6/8, each bar holds six eighth notes in two groups of three. It feels like two big beats, each split in three: 1 2 3, 4 5 6.
rows.translation: Katika 6/8, kila kipimo kina noti sita za nane katika makundi mawili ya tatu. Huhisiwa kama mapigo mawili makubwa, kila moja likigawanywa mara tatu: 1 2 3, 4 5 6.

rows.source: Two beats, each split in three
rows.translation: Mapigo mawili, kila moja limegawanywa mara tatu

rows.source: Three beats, each split in two
rows.translation: Mapigo matatu, kila moja limegawanywa mara mbili

rows.source: The eighths group 1 2 3, 4 5 6, so you feel two strong pulses per bar.
rows.translation: Noti za nane hupangwa 1 2 3, 4 5 6, hivyo unahisi mapigo mawili yenye nguvu kwa kipimo.

rows.source: In 3/4, which single note fills a whole bar?
rows.translation: Katika 3/4, noti ipi moja hujaza kipimo kizima?

rows.source: Three beats: a half note (2) plus its dot (1).
rows.translation: Mapigo matatu: noti nusu (2) pamoja na nukta yake (1).

rows.source: Note values, dots, rests and time signatures together. Count out loud as you tap; your voice keeps your hands honest.
rows.translation: Thamani za noti, nukta, mapumziko na alama za kipimo pamoja. Hesabu kwa sauti unapogonga; sauti yako husaidia mikono kufuata muda sahihi.

rows.source: How many beats does a whole note last in 4/4?
rows.translation: Noti nzima hudumu mapigo mangapi katika 4/4?

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes fit in one beat?
rows.translation: Noti ngapi za kumi na sita hutimia katika pigo moja?

rows.source: What does a dot add to a note?
A bar of 3/4 has a quarter note and a quarter rest. What's missing?
rows.translation: Kipimo cha 3/4 kina noti robo na pumziko robo. Nini kinakosekana?

rows.source: 3/4 holds three beats; 1 + 1 = 2, so one beat remains.
rows.translation: 3/4 ina mapigo matatu; 1 + 1 = 2, hivyo pigo moja limebaki.

rows.source: How many eighth notes are in a bar of 6/8?
rows.translation: Kipimo cha 6/8 kina noti ngapi za nane?

rows.source: The whole-and-half-step recipe, four major keys, and their key signatures.
rows.translation: Mpangilio wa toni nzima na nusu toni, funguo nne za meja na alama zake za ufunguo.

rows.source: A scale is a set of notes climbing in order from a home note to the same note an octave up. C major uses only white keys: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C.
rows.translation: Skeli ni mkusanyiko wa noti zinazopanda kwa mpangilio kutoka noti msingi hadi noti ileile oktava moja juu. C meja hutumia vitufe vyeupe tu: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C.

rows.source: How many different letters are in a major scale?
rows.translation: Skeli meja ina herufi ngapi tofauti?

rows.source: Seven letters, then the first one returns an octave higher.
rows.translation: Herufi saba, kisha ya kwanza hurudi oktava moja juu.

rows.source: Is this scale going up or down?
In C major, most neighbors are a whole step apart. Only E to F and B to C are half steps. That uneven spacing gives the scale its sound.
rows.translation: Katika C meja, noti nyingi jirani zimetengana kwa toni nzima. E hadi F na B hadi C tu ndizo nusu toni. Nafasi hizo zisizo sawa huipa skeli sauti yake.

rows.source: In C major, which steps are half steps?
rows.translation: Katika C meja, hatua zipi ni nusu toni?

rows.source: C to D and F to G
rows.translation: C hadi D na F hadi G

rows.source: E to F and B to C
rows.translation: E hadi F na B hadi C

rows.source: D to E and A to B
rows.translation: D hadi E na A hadi B

rows.source: E and F, and B and C, have no black key between them.
rows.translation: E na F, na B na C, hazina kitufe cheusi katikati yake.

rows.source: What's the home note of C major?
rows.translation: Noti msingi ya C meja ni ipi?

rows.source: The home note, called the tonic, gives the scale its name.
rows.translation: Noti msingi, inayoitwa toniki, huipa skeli jina lake.

rows.source: Play or sing the C major scale, up from middle C.
rows.translation: Piga au imba skeli ya C meja, ukipanda kutoka C ya katikati.

rows.source: Every major scale follows one recipe of steps: whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half. Start on any note, follow it, and you build a major scale.
rows.translation: Kila skeli meja hufuata mpangilio mmoja wa hatua: toni nzima, nzima, nusu, nzima, nzima, nzima, nusu. Anza kwenye noti yoyote, ufuate mpangilio huo, utaunda skeli meja.

rows.source: Which is the major scale recipe? (W = whole, H = half)
rows.translation: Mpangilio wa skeli meja ni upi? (W = toni nzima, H = nusu toni)

rows.source: W W H W W W H
rows.translation: W W H W W W H

rows.source: W H W W H W W
rows.translation: W H W W H W W

rows.source: W W W H W W H
rows.translation: W W W H W W H

rows.source: Whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half.
rows.translation: Toni nzima, nzima, nusu, nzima, nzima, nzima, nusu.

rows.source: Number the scale's notes 1 to 8. Where are the half steps?
rows.translation: Zipe noti za skeli namba 1 hadi 8. Nusu toni ziko wapi?

rows.source: Whole, whole, then half from 3 to 4; whole, whole, whole, then half from 7 to 8.
rows.translation: Toni nzima, nzima, kisha nusu kutoka 3 hadi 4; nzima, nzima, nzima, kisha nusu kutoka 7 hadi 8.

rows.source: Starting on G, a whole step up lands on...
rows.translation: Ukianza kwenye G, toni nzima juu hutua kwenye…

rows.source: G to A skips one key, G♯.
rows.translation: G hadi A huruka kitufe kimoja, G♯.

rows.source: Play or sing the first four notes of D major: whole, whole, half.
rows.translation: Piga au imba noti nne za kwanza za D meja: toni nzima, nzima, nusu.

rows.source: Start on G and follow the recipe: G, A, B, C, D, E, then a whole step to F♯ and a half step home to G. G major has one sharp: F♯.
rows.translation: Anza kwenye G, ufuate mpangilio: G, A, B, C, D, E, kisha toni nzima hadi F♯ na nusu toni kurudi G. G meja ina diesi moja: F♯.

rows.source: Why does G major need F♯ instead of F?
rows.translation: Kwa nini G meja inahitaji F♯ badala ya F?

rows.source: F is too low to sing
E to F is only a half step
rows.translation: E hadi F ni nusu toni tu

rows.source: The recipe needs a whole step from note 6 to 7, then a half step from 7 up to G.
rows.translation: Mpangilio unahitaji toni nzima kutoka noti 6 hadi 7, kisha nusu toni kutoka 7 kupanda hadi G.

rows.source: Which note is in G major?
rows.translation: Noti ipi iko katika G meja?

rows.source: G major's seventh note is F♯.
rows.translation: Noti ya saba ya G meja ni F♯.

rows.source: How many sharps are in G major?
Play or sing the G major scale. Remember the F♯.
rows.translation: Piga au imba skeli ya G meja. Kumbuka F♯.

rows.source: From D, the recipe gives D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯, D. D major has two sharps: F♯ and C♯.
rows.translation: Kutoka D, mpangilio hutoa D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯, D. D meja ina diesi mbili: F♯ na C♯.

rows.source: Which two sharps are in D major?
rows.translation: Diesi zipi mbili ziko katika D meja?

rows.source: Following the recipe from D lands on F♯ as note 3 and C♯ as note 7.
rows.translation: Kufuata mpangilio kutoka D hufikia F♯ kama noti 3 na C♯ kama noti 7.

rows.source: From F, the recipe needs a half step from A to the fourth note, so it's B♭, not B. F major: F, G, A, B♭, C, D, E, F. One flat: B♭.
rows.translation: Kutoka F, mpangilio unahitaji nusu toni kutoka A hadi noti ya nne, hivyo ni B♭, si B. F meja: F, G, A, B♭, C, D, E, F. Bemoli moja: B♭.

rows.source: Which note is in F major?
rows.translation: Noti ipi iko katika F meja?

rows.source: F major's fourth note is B♭, a half step above A.
rows.translation: Noti ya nne ya F meja ni B♭, nusu toni juu ya A.

rows.source: Which major key has two sharps?
rows.translation: Ufunguo upi wa meja una diesi mbili?

rows.source: D major has F♯ and C♯.
rows.translation: D meja ina F♯ na C♯.

rows.source: Play or sing up F major from F to C. The fourth note is B♭.
rows.translation: Piga au imba ukipanda F meja kutoka F hadi C. Noti ya nne ni B♭.

rows.source: Rather than writing F♯ every time, music in G major puts one sharp at the start of each line. That's the key signature: it lists the notes that are always sharp or flat.
rows.translation: Badala ya kuandika F♯ kila mara, muziki katika G meja huweka diesi moja mwanzoni mwa kila mstari. Hiyo ni alama ya ufunguo: huorodhesha noti ambazo daima zina diesi au bemoli.

rows.source: A key signature has one sharp, F♯. Which major key is it?
rows.translation: Alama ya ufunguo ina diesi moja, F♯. Ni ufunguo upi wa meja?

rows.source: G major is the major key with just F♯.
rows.translation: G meja ndio ufunguo wa meja wenye F♯ tu.

rows.source: A key signature has one flat, B♭. Which major key is it?
rows.translation: Alama ya ufunguo ina bemoli moja, B♭. Ni ufunguo upi wa meja?

rows.source: F major is the major key with just B♭.
rows.translation: F meja ndio ufunguo wa meja wenye B♭ tu.

rows.source: Sharps always appear in the same order: F♯, C♯, G♯, and so on. The last sharp is a half step below the key's name. One sharp, F♯: G major.
rows.translation: Diesi daima huonekana kwa mpangilio uleule: F♯, C♯, G♯, na kadhalika. Diesi ya mwisho iko nusu toni chini ya jina la ufunguo. Diesi moja, F♯: G meja.

rows.source: A key signature has two sharps, F♯ and C♯. Which major key is it?
rows.translation: Alama ya ufunguo ina diesi mbili, F♯ na C♯. Ni ufunguo upi wa meja?

rows.source: The last sharp, C♯, is a half step below D.
rows.translation: Diesi ya mwisho, C♯, iko nusu toni chini ya D.

rows.source: Which major key has no sharps or flats?
rows.translation: Ufunguo upi wa meja hauna diesi wala bemoli?

rows.source: C major uses only white keys.
rows.translation: C meja hutumia vitufe vyeupe tu.

rows.source: The key signature shows B♭. Which Bs are played as B♭?
rows.translation: Alama ya ufunguo inaonyesha B♭. Ni B zipi hupigwa kama B♭?

rows.source: A key signature applies to every B in every octave, unless the music marks otherwise.
rows.translation: Alama ya ufunguo inahusu kila B katika kila oktava, isipokuwa muziki uonyeshe vinginevyo.

rows.source: Play or sing D major, with its two sharps: F♯ and C♯.
rows.translation: Piga au imba D meja, yenye diesi zake mbili: F♯ na C♯.

rows.source: The recipe, four keys and their signatures. When unsure, build the scale from its home note: whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half.
rows.translation: Mpangilio, funguo nne na alama zake. Ukiwa huna uhakika, unda skeli kuanzia noti msingi: toni nzima, nzima, nusu, nzima, nzima, nzima, nusu.

rows.source: Which note belongs in G major?
rows.translation: Noti ipi ni sehemu ya G meja?

rows.source: G major's only sharp is F♯.
rows.translation: Diesi pekee ya G meja ni F♯.

rows.source: Which major key has one flat?
rows.translation: Ufunguo upi wa meja una bemoli moja?

rows.source: F major's one flat is B♭.
rows.translation: Bemoli pekee ya F meja ni B♭.

rows.source: Which scale has the notes D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯?
rows.translation: Skeli ipi ina noti D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯?

rows.source: In every major scale, which step is a half step?
rows.translation: Katika kila skeli meja, hatua ipi ni nusu toni?

rows.source: Whole, whole, half: the first half step falls between notes 3 and 4.
rows.translation: Toni nzima, nzima, nusu: nusu toni ya kwanza iko kati ya noti 3 na 4.

rows.source: Which key signature belongs to G major?
rows.translation: Alama ipi ya ufunguo ni ya G meja?

rows.source: Play or sing F major, with its B♭.
rows.translation: Piga au imba F meja, yenye B♭ yake.

rows.source: Name the distance between two notes by number and quality, and measure it in half steps.
rows.translation: Taja umbali kati ya noti mbili kwa namba na aina yake, na uupime kwa nusu toni.
Kuhesabu namba za umbali wa noti

rows.source: An interval's number comes from counting letter names, including both ends. C up to E counts C, D, E: three letters, so it's a third.
rows.translation: Namba ya umbali wa noti hutokana na kuhesabu majina ya herufi, ukijumuisha mwanzo na mwisho. C kupanda hadi E huhesabu C, D, E: herufi tatu, hivyo ni umbali wa tatu.

rows.source: C up to G is a...
C, D, E, F, G: five letters.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F, G: herufi tano.
Huu ni umbali upi wa noti?

rows.source: E, F, G, A: four letters.
rows.translation: E, F, G, A: herufi nne.

rows.source: Sharps and flats don't change an interval's number. C to E♭ and C to E are both thirds: C, D, E either way. They differ in size, which comes next.
rows.translation: Diesi na bemoli hazibadili namba ya umbali wa noti. C hadi E♭ na C hadi E zote ni umbali wa tatu: C, D, E kwa vyovyote. Zinatofautiana kwa ukubwa, ambao unafuata.

rows.source: F up to D is a...
F, G, A, B, C, D: six letters.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B, C, D: herufi sita.

rows.source: A up to E♭ is a...
A, B, C, D, E: five letters. The flat doesn't change the count.
rows.translation: A, B, C, D, E: herufi tano. Bemoli haibadili hesabu.

rows.source: G up to the next G is a...
rows.translation: G kupanda hadi G inayofuata ni…

rows.source: G, A, B, C, D, E, F, G: eight letters, an octave.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C, D, E, F, G: herufi nane, oktava.

rows.source: Two intervals with the same number can differ in size. To measure exactly, count half steps. C up to E is four; C up to E♭ is three.
rows.translation: Aina mbili za umbali zenye namba ileile zinaweza kuwa na ukubwa tofauti. Kupima kwa usahihi, hesabu nusu toni. C kupanda hadi E ni nne; C kupanda hadi E♭ ni tatu.

rows.source: How many half steps from D up to F?
rows.translation: Kuna nusu toni ngapi kutoka D kupanda hadi F?

rows.source: D, D♯, E, F: three moves.
rows.translation: D, D♯, E, F: hatua tatu.

rows.source: A third of four half steps is a major third, like C to E. A third of three is a minor third, like C to E♭ or A to C.
rows.translation: Umbali wa tatu wenye nusu toni nne ni wa meja, kama C hadi E. Wenye tatu ni wa minori, kama C hadi E♭ au A hadi C.

rows.source: E up to G♯ is a...
E to G♯ spans four half steps.
rows.translation: E hadi G♯ ina nusu toni nne.

rows.source: A up to C is a...
A to C spans three half steps.
rows.translation: A hadi C ina nusu toni tatu.

rows.source: G up to B♭ is a...
G to B♭ spans three half steps.
rows.translation: G hadi B♭ ina nusu toni tatu.

rows.source: Unisons, fourths, fifths and octaves are called perfect. A perfect fourth spans five half steps, a perfect fifth seven, and an octave twelve.
rows.translation: Unisoni, umbali wa nne, tano na oktava huitwa kamili. Umbali wa nne kamili una nusu toni tano, wa tano kamili saba, na oktava kumi na mbili.

rows.source: How many half steps are in a perfect fifth?
rows.translation: Umbali wa tano kamili una nusu toni ngapi?

rows.source: C up to G: seven half steps.
rows.translation: C kupanda hadi G: nusu toni saba.

rows.source: C up to F is a...
C to F spans five half steps.
rows.translation: C hadi F ina nusu toni tano.

rows.source: Watch out for B and F
Most white-key fifths are perfect, but B up to F spans only six half steps. It's called a diminished fifth. When in doubt, count half steps.
rows.translation: Umbali mwingi wa tano wa vitufe vyeupe ni kamili, lakini B kupanda hadi F una nusu toni sita tu. Huitwa umbali wa tano wa diminished. Ukiwa na shaka, hesabu nusu toni.

rows.source: Which of these fifths is smaller than perfect?
rows.translation: Ni umbali upi wa tano hapa ulio mdogo kuliko kamili?

rows.source: B to F spans six half steps; a perfect fifth needs seven.
rows.translation: B hadi F ina nusu toni sita; umbali wa tano kamili unahitaji saba.

rows.source: A up to D is a...
A, B, C, D: four letters, five half steps.
rows.translation: A, B, C, D: herufi nne, nusu toni tano.
Umbali wa pili, sita na saba

rows.source: Seconds, thirds, sixths and sevenths come in major and minor sizes. Minor is always one half step smaller than major.
rows.translation: Umbali wa pili, tatu, sita na saba una ukubwa wa meja na minori. Minori daima ni nusu toni moja ndogo kuliko meja.

rows.source: Minor second 1, major second 2. Minor third 3, major third 4. Minor sixth 8, major sixth 9. Minor seventh 10, major seventh 11.
rows.translation: Umbali wa pili: minori 1, meja 2. Wa tatu: minori 3, meja 4. Wa sita: minori 8, meja 9. Wa saba: minori 10, meja 11.

rows.source: C up to A is a...
C to A spans nine half steps.
rows.translation: C hadi A ina nusu toni tisa.

rows.source: C up to B♭ is a...
C to B♭ spans ten half steps.
rows.translation: C hadi B♭ ina nusu toni kumi.

rows.source: E to F is a single half step.
rows.translation: E hadi F ni nusu toni moja tu.

rows.source: How many half steps are in a major seventh?
rows.translation: Umbali wa saba wa meja una nusu toni ngapi?

rows.source: One half step short of an octave.
rows.translation: Nusu toni moja pungufu ya oktava.

rows.source: E up to C is a...
E, F, G, A, B, C makes a sixth. It spans eight half steps, so it's minor.
rows.translation: E, F, G, A, B, C huunda umbali wa sita. Una nusu toni nane, kwa hiyo ni wa minori.

rows.source: Count letters for the number. Count half steps for the size. Together they name any interval.
rows.translation: Hesabu herufi kupata namba. Hesabu nusu toni kupata ukubwa. Pamoja hutaja umbali wowote wa noti.

rows.source: F up to A is a...
F, G, A is a third, and four half steps makes it major.
rows.translation: F, G, A ni umbali wa tatu, na nusu toni nne huufanya wa meja.

rows.source: D up to A is a...
D to A spans seven half steps.
rows.translation: D hadi A ina nusu toni saba.

rows.source: B up to D is a...
B, C, D is a third of three half steps: minor.
rows.translation: B, C, D ni umbali wa tatu wenye nusu toni tatu: minori.

rows.source: How many half steps are in a major sixth?
rows.translation: Umbali wa sita wa meja una nusu toni ngapi?

rows.source: G up to F is a...
G to F covers seven letters and ten half steps: a minor seventh.
rows.translation: G hadi F ina herufi saba na nusu toni kumi: umbali wa saba wa minori.

rows.source: Stack thirds into triads, build major and minor chords, and number the chords of a key.
rows.translation: Panga umbali wa tatu kuunda kodi za noti tatu, unda kodi za meja na minori, na zipe kodi za ufunguo namba.

rows.source: A triad is three notes stacked in thirds. Start on any note, skip a letter, take the next, skip again. C, skip D, E, skip F, G: C E G.
rows.translation: Kodi ya noti tatu hupanga noti kwa umbali wa tatu. Anza na noti yoyote, ruka herufi moja, chukua inayofuata, ruka tena. C, ruka D, E, ruka F, G: C E G.

rows.source: Which notes make a triad built on G?
rows.translation: Noti zipi huunda kodi ya noti tatu inayojengwa kwenye G?

rows.source: G, skip A, B, skip C, D.
rows.translation: G, ruka A, B, ruka C, D.
Noti msingi, ya tatu, ya tano

rows.source: The note a triad is built on is its root. The middle note is the third and the top note is the fifth, named for their distance above the root.
rows.translation: Noti ambayo kodi ya noti tatu hujengwa juu yake ni noti msingi. Ya katikati ni ya tatu na ya juu ni ya tano, majina yakitokana na umbali wake juu ya msingi.

rows.source: In the triad F A C, which note is the root?
rows.translation: Katika kodi ya noti tatu F A C, noti msingi ni ipi?

rows.source: F is the bottom note the triad is built on.
rows.translation: F ni noti ya chini ambayo kodi hiyo hujengwa juu yake.

rows.source: In the triad D F A, which note is the fifth?
rows.translation: Katika kodi ya noti tatu D F A, noti ya tano ni ipi?

rows.source: D up to A is a fifth: D, E, F, G, A.
rows.translation: D kupanda hadi A ni umbali wa tano: D, E, F, G, A.

rows.source: Using only white keys, which triad is built on E?
rows.translation: Kwa kutumia vitufe vyeupe tu, kodi ipi ya noti tatu hujengwa kwenye E?

rows.source: E, skip F, G, skip A, B.
rows.translation: E, ruka F, G, ruka A, B.

rows.source: Play or sing the C triad one note at a time: C, E, G.
rows.translation: Piga au imba kodi ya C noti moja baada ya nyingine: C, E, G.
Kodi za noti tatu za meja na minori
Kodi za noti tatu za meja

rows.source: A major triad has a major third on the bottom, four half steps, then a minor third on top. C E G is major. So are F A C and G B D.
rows.translation: Kodi ya noti tatu ya meja ina umbali wa tatu wa meja chini, nusu toni nne, kisha wa minori juu. C E G ni meja. F A C na G B D pia.

rows.source: Flip the thirds and you get minor: a minor third on the bottom, then a major third. Lower the middle note of C major and you get C minor: C E♭ G.
rows.translation: Geuza mpangilio wa umbali wa tatu upate minori: wa minori chini, kisha wa meja juu. Shusha noti ya katikati ya C meja upate C minori: C E♭ G.

rows.source: D to F is a minor third; F to A is a major third.
rows.translation: D hadi F ni umbali wa tatu wa minori; F hadi A ni wa meja.

rows.source: E to G♯ is a major third; G♯ to B is a minor third.
rows.translation: E hadi G♯ ni umbali wa tatu wa meja; G♯ hadi B ni wa minori.

rows.source: Is A C E major or minor?
rows.translation: A C E ni meja au minori?

rows.source: A to C is a minor third, three half steps.
rows.translation: A hadi C ni umbali wa tatu wa minori, nusu toni tatu.

rows.source: Play or sing A minor one note at a time: A, C, E.
rows.translation: Piga au imba A minori noti moja baada ya nyingine: A, C, E.

rows.source: Build a triad on each note of a scale, using only that scale's notes, and you get the key's family of chords. C major has seven, one per note.
rows.translation: Jenga kodi ya noti tatu kwenye kila noti ya skeli, ukitumia noti za skeli hiyo tu, upate familia ya kodi za ufunguo huo. C meja ina saba, moja kwa kila noti.

rows.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on D?
rows.translation: Kwa kutumia noti za C meja tu, kodi ipi ya noti tatu hujengwa kwenye D?

rows.source: D F A: a minor third, then a major third.
rows.translation: D F A: umbali wa tatu wa minori, kisha wa meja.

rows.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on G?
rows.translation: Kwa kutumia noti za C meja tu, kodi ipi ya noti tatu hujengwa kwenye G?

rows.source: G B D: a major third, then a minor third.
rows.translation: G B D: umbali wa tatu wa meja, kisha wa minori.

rows.source: The triad on B is different: B D F. Both thirds are minor, so it's a diminished triad. It sounds tense and wants to move.
rows.translation: Kodi ya noti tatu kwenye B ni tofauti: B D F. Nafasi zote mbili za tatu ni za minori, hivyo ni kodi ya diminished. Husikika yenye mvutano na inataka kuendelea.

rows.source: In C major, which chords are major?
rows.translation: Katika C meja, kodi zipi ni meja?

rows.source: C E G, F A C and G B D each have a major third on the bottom.
rows.translation: C E G, F A C na G B D kila moja ina umbali wa tatu wa meja chini.

rows.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on A?
rows.translation: Kwa kutumia noti za C meja tu, kodi ipi ya noti tatu hujengwa kwenye A?

rows.source: A C E: a minor third, then a major third.
rows.translation: A C E: umbali wa tatu wa minori, kisha wa meja.

rows.source: Play or sing the diminished triad on B: B, D, F.
rows.translation: Piga au imba kodi ya noti tatu ya diminished kwenye B: B, D, F.

rows.source: Musicians number a key's chords with Roman numerals: I for the chord on note 1, up to vii for note 7. Uppercase means major, lowercase minor, and ° diminished.
rows.translation: Wanamuziki huzipa kodi za ufunguo namba za Kirumi: I kwa kodi kwenye noti 1, hadi vii kwa noti 7. Herufi kubwa humaanisha meja, ndogo minori, na ° diminished.

rows.source: Every major key follows one pattern: I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, vii°. In C major that's C, D minor, E minor, F, G, A minor and B diminished.
rows.translation: Kila ufunguo wa meja hufuata mpangilio mmoja: I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, vii°. Katika C meja ni C, D minori, E minori, F, G, A minori na B diminished.

rows.source: In C major, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Katika C meja, kodi ya IV ni ipi?

rows.source: The fourth note of C major is F.
rows.translation: Noti ya nne ya C meja ni F.

rows.source: In C major, which chord is vi?
rows.translation: Katika C meja, kodi ya vi ni ipi?

rows.source: The sixth note is A, and lowercase vi means minor.
rows.translation: Noti ya sita ni A, na vi yenye herufi ndogo humaanisha minori.

rows.source: In G major, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Katika G meja, kodi ya V ni ipi?

rows.source: Count up from G: G, A, B, C, D. The fifth note is D, and V is major.
rows.translation: Hesabu kutoka G: G, A, B, C, D. Noti ya tano ni D, na V ni meja.

rows.source: Why is ii written in lowercase?
rows.translation: Kwa nini ii imeandikwa kwa herufi ndogo?
Inapigwa kwa sauti ya juu zaidi

rows.source: In G major, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Katika G meja, kodi ya IV ni ipi?

rows.source: G, A, B, C: the fourth note is C.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C: noti ya nne ni C.

rows.source: Spell it, hear it, number it
rows.translation: Taja noti zake, isikie, ipe namba

rows.source: Stack thirds, check their sizes, then place the chord in its key: major on I, IV and V, minor on ii, iii and vi, diminished on vii°.
rows.translation: Panga umbali wa tatu, kagua ukubwa wake, kisha weka kodi katika ufunguo wake: meja kwenye I, IV na V, minori kwenye ii, iii na vi, diminished kwenye vii°.

rows.source: In C major, which chord is ii?
rows.translation: Katika C meja, kodi ya ii ni ipi?

rows.source: In F major, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Katika F meja, kodi ya V ni ipi?

rows.source: F, G, A, B♭, C: the fifth note is C.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B♭, C: noti ya tano ni C.
Kodi ipi ya noti tatu ni ya diminished?

rows.source: B to D and D to F are both minor thirds.
rows.translation: B hadi D na D hadi F zote ni umbali wa tatu wa minori.

rows.source: Play or sing the G major triad: G, B, D.
rows.translation: Piga au imba kodi ya noti tatu ya G meja: G, B, D.

rows.source: How chords move in songs: I–IV–V, the pop loop, ii–V–I, the 12-bar blues and cadences.
rows.translation: Kodi zinavyosogea katika nyimbo: I–IV–V, mzunguko wa pop, ii–V–I, blues ya vipimo 12 na kadensi.

rows.source: Countless folk, rock and country songs use just three chords: I, IV and V. In C major, that's C, F and G. Together they hold every note of the scale.
rows.translation: Nyimbo nyingi sana za jadi, rock na country hutumia kodi tatu tu: I, IV na V. Katika C meja ni C, F na G. Pamoja zina kila noti ya skeli.

rows.source: In G major, what are I, IV and V?
rows.translation: Katika G meja, I, IV na V ni zipi?

rows.source: Count up from G: note 1 is G, note 4 is C, note 5 is D.
rows.translation: Hesabu kutoka G: noti 1 ni G, noti 4 ni C, noti 5 ni D.

rows.source: Does this end on the home chord?
rows.translation: Je, hii inaishia kwenye kodi ya msingi?

rows.source: I feels like home. IV moves away. V builds tension that pulls back to I. That trip, out and back again, shapes a huge number of songs.
rows.translation: I huhisiwa kama msingi. IV huenda mbali. V hujenga mvutano unaovutia kurudi I. Safari hiyo, kutoka na kurudi tena, huunda nyimbo nyingi sana.

rows.source: Which chord pulls most strongly back to I?
rows.translation: Kodi ipi huvutia zaidi kurudi I?

rows.source: V builds tension that resolves to I.
rows.translation: V hujenga mvutano unaotulia kwenye I.

rows.source: In D major, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Katika D meja, kodi ya IV ni ipi?

rows.source: D, E, F♯, G: the fourth note is G.
rows.translation: D, E, F♯, G: noti ya nne ni G.

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of I, IV, V, I in C: C, F, G, C.
rows.translation: Piga au imba noti msingi za I, IV, V, I katika C: C, F, G, C.

rows.source: This four-chord loop runs under a huge number of pop songs. In C major it's C, G, A minor, F. The minor vi adds a touch of shade before IV lifts back toward home.
rows.translation: Mzunguko huu wa kodi nne hutumika katika nyimbo nyingi sana za pop. Katika C meja ni C, G, A minori, F. vi ya minori huongeza hisia nzito kidogo kabla IV haijaelekea kurudi msingi.

rows.source: In G major, what is I–V–vi–IV?
rows.translation: Katika G meja, I–V–vi–IV ni zipi?

rows.source: In G: I is G, V is D, vi is E minor, IV is C.
rows.translation: Katika G: I ni G, V ni D, vi ni E minori, IV ni C.

rows.source: Start the same loop on vi and you get vi–IV–I–V: A minor, F, C, G. The chords are identical, but beginning on minor makes it sound more serious.
rows.translation: Anza mzunguko uleule kwenye vi upate vi–IV–I–V: A minori, F, C, G. Kodi ni zilezile, lakini kuanza kwa minori huleta hisia nzito zaidi.

rows.source: In F major, which chord is vi?
rows.translation: Katika F meja, kodi ya vi ni ipi?

rows.source: F, G, A, B♭, C, D: the sixth note is D, and vi is minor.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B♭, C, D: noti ya sita ni D, na vi ni minori.

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of I–V–vi–IV in C: C, G, A, F.
rows.translation: Piga au imba noti msingi za I–V–vi–IV katika C: C, G, A, F.

rows.source: ii–V–I is the most common progression in jazz. In C major: D minor, G, C. Each root falls a fifth to the next, so the move feels like coming home.
rows.translation: ii–V–I ndio mfuatano unaotumika zaidi katika jazz. Katika C meja: D minori, G, C. Kila noti msingi hushuka umbali wa tano hadi inayofuata, hivyo mwendo huhisiwa kama kurudi msingi.

rows.source: In C major, what is ii–V–I?
rows.translation: Katika C meja, ii–V–I ni zipi?

rows.source: ii is D minor, V is G, and I is C.
rows.translation: ii ni D minori, V ni G, na I ni C.

rows.source: Jazz players usually add sevenths: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7. The extra notes make each move even smoother. The roots and the trip home stay the same.
rows.translation: Wapiga jazz kwa kawaida huongeza noti za saba: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7. Noti za ziada hufanya kila badiliko liwe laini zaidi. Noti msingi na safari ya kurudi hubaki vilevile.

rows.source: In F major, what is ii–V–I?
rows.translation: Katika F meja, ii–V–I ni zipi?

rows.source: F, G, A, B♭, C: ii is G minor and V is C.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B♭, C: ii ni G minori na V ni C.

rows.source: In ii–V–I, how do the roots move?

rows.translation: Chini umbali wa tano kila mara

rows.source: D down to G, then G down to C: a fifth each time.
rows.translation: D kushuka hadi G, kisha G kushuka hadi C: umbali wa tano kila mara.

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of ii–V–I in C: D, down to G, up to C.
rows.translation: Piga au imba noti msingi za ii–V–I katika C: D, shuka hadi G, panda hadi C.

rows.source: The 12-bar blues is a chord plan, twelve bars long, behind countless blues, rock and jazz tunes. It uses I, IV and V, often all as dominant seventh chords for a bluesy edge.
rows.translation: Blues ya vipimo 12 ni mpangilio wa kodi wenye urefu wa vipimo kumi na viwili, unaotumika katika melodi nyingi za blues, rock na jazz. Hutumia I, IV na V, mara nyingi zote kama dominant ya saba ili kuleta ladha ya blues.

rows.source: Four bars of I. Two of IV, two of I. One of V, one of IV, two of I. Then it repeats. In A: A7 four times, D7 twice, A7 twice, E7, D7, A7 twice.
rows.translation: Vipimo vinne vya I. Viwili vya IV, viwili vya I. Kimoja cha V, kimoja cha IV, viwili vya I. Kisha hurudia. Katika A: A7 mara nne, D7 mara mbili, A7 mara mbili, E7, D7, A7 mara mbili.

rows.source: How many bars of I open the 12-bar blues?
rows.translation: Blues ya vipimo 12 huanza na vipimo vingapi vya I?

rows.source: Four bars of I, then IV arrives in bar 5.
rows.translation: Vipimo vinne vya I, kisha IV huja kwenye kipimo 5.

rows.source: In the 12-bar blues, which chord is in bar 9?
rows.translation: Katika blues ya vipimo 12, kodi ipi iko kwenye kipimo 9?

rows.source: Bar 9 is the one bar of V, before IV in bar 10.
rows.translation: Kipimo 9 ndicho kipimo kimoja cha V, kabla ya IV kwenye kipimo 10.

rows.source: In the key of E, what are the three blues chords?
rows.translation: Katika ufunguo wa E, kodi tatu za blues ni zipi?

rows.source: In E, I is E, IV is A and V is B.
rows.translation: Katika E, I ni E, IV ni A na V ni B.

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of the blues in A: A, D, E, back to A.
rows.translation: Piga au imba noti msingi za blues katika A: A, D, E, urudi A.

rows.source: A cadence is the chord move that ends a phrase, like punctuation. V to I is the strongest, a full stop. It's called an authentic cadence.
rows.translation: Kadensi ni badiliko la kodi linalomaliza kishazi, kama alama ya uakifishaji. V kwenda I lina nguvu zaidi, kama nukta. Huitwa kadensi kamili.

rows.source: IV to I is a plagal cadence, the soft amen at the end of many hymns. Stopping on V is a half cadence, like a comma. V to vi is deceptive: you expect home and get a surprise.
rows.translation: IV kwenda I ni kadensi ya plagali, amina laini mwishoni mwa tenzi nyingi. Kusimama kwenye V ni kadensi nusu, kama koma. V kwenda vi ni danganyifu: unatarajia msingi, lakini unapata mshangao.

rows.source: Which cadence ends a phrase on V?
rows.translation: Kadensi ipi humaliza kishazi kwenye V?

rows.source: A half cadence pauses on V, like a comma.
rows.translation: Kadensi nusu husimama kwenye V, kama koma.

rows.source: Which cadence is called the amen cadence?
rows.translation: Kadensi ipi huitwa kadensi ya amina?

rows.source: IV to I is the soft amen at the end of many hymns.
rows.translation: IV kwenda I ni amina laini mwishoni mwa tenzi nyingi.

rows.source: Home, away and back again. Name the progression, then the cadence that ends it. Listen for where the music wants to rest.
rows.translation: Msingini, mbali na kurudi tena. Taja mfuatano, kisha kadensi inayoumaliza. Sikiliza muziki unapotaka kutulia.

rows.source: In D major, what is I–V–vi–IV?
rows.translation: Katika D meja, I–V–vi–IV ni zipi?

rows.source: In D: I is D, V is A, vi is B minor, IV is G.
rows.translation: Katika D: I ni D, V ni A, vi ni B minori, IV ni G.

rows.source: In which bar does the 12-bar blues first move to IV?
rows.translation: Blues ya vipimo 12 huhamia IV kwa mara ya kwanza katika kipimo kipi?
Kadensi ipi husikika yenye ukamilifu zaidi?

rows.source: V to I is the full stop of music.
