rows.translation: V kwenda I ni nukta ya muziki.

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of I–IV–V–I in G: G, C, D, G.
rows.translation: Piga au imba noti msingi za I–IV–V–I katika G: G, C, D, G.

rows.source: Feel the beat, count it, and tap it in time
rows.translation: Hisi mapigo, yahesabu, na uyagonge kwa wakati

rows.source: Find the pulse, count to four, and tap in time.
rows.translation: Tafuta mapigo, hesabu hadi nne, na ugonge kwa wakati.

rows.source: The beat is a steady pulse
The beat is the steady pulse you tap your foot to. It never rushes or drags, like footsteps on an easy walk. Every rhythm sits on top of it.
rows.translation: Pigo ni mwendo thabiti unaoufuata kwa kugonga mguu. Haliharakishi wala kuchelewa, kama hatua za kutembea kwa utulivu. Kila mdundo hujengwa juu yake.

rows.source: Hold your fingertip just above the screen and tap each time the click sounds. Let it bounce off the glass like a drumstick. Aim to land with the click, not after it.
rows.translation: Weka ncha ya kidole juu kidogo ya skrini, ugonge kila mlio unaposikika. Acha iruke kutoka kwenye kioo kama kijiti cha ngoma. Lenga kutua pamoja na mlio, si baada yake.

rows.source: A beat keeps the same space between pulses, like a clock ticking.
rows.translation: Pigo hudumisha nafasi ileile kati ya midundo, kama saa inayotia tiki.

rows.source: How many clicks did you hear?
Most music groups beats in fours. Count 1, 2, 3, 4 out loud with the click, then start again at 1. Saying the numbers helps your hands keep time.
rows.translation: Muziki mwingi hupanga mapigo katika makundi ya manne. Hesabu 1, 2, 3, 4 kwa sauti pamoja na mlio, kisha anza tena kwenye 1. Kusema namba husaidia mikono kufuata muda.

rows.source: A bar is one group of beats. Here each bar holds four beats, written 4/4. Beat 1 starts every bar, so lean on it a little as you count.
rows.translation: Kipimo ni kundi moja la mapigo. Hapa kila kipimo kina mapigo manne, yakiandikwa 4/4. Pigo 1 huanza kila kipimo, kwa hiyo likazie kidogo unapohesabu.

rows.source: The strong click is beat 1. How many beats are in each bar?
rows.translation: Mlio wenye nguvu ni pigo 1. Kila kipimo kina mapigo mangapi?

rows.source: Counting starts again at 1 at the top of every bar.
rows.translation: Hesabu huanza tena kwenye 1 mwanzoni mwa kila kipimo.

rows.source: A note that lasts one beat is a quarter note. Four of them fill a bar of 4/4, so tapping on every beat means tapping quarter notes.
rows.translation: Noti inayodumu pigo moja ni noti robo. Nne hujaza kipimo cha 4/4, hivyo kugonga kwenye kila pigo ni kugonga noti robo.

rows.source: Now tap only on 1 and 3. Each tap is a half note, two beats long. Keep counting all four; the beats you skip still happen.
rows.translation: Sasa gonga kwenye 1 na 3 tu. Kila mguso ni noti nusu, yenye mapigo mawili. Endelea kuhesabu yote manne; mapigo unayoruka bado yapo.

rows.source: You tap on 1 and 3. What happens on 2 and 4?
rows.translation: Unagonga kwenye 1 na 3. Nini hutokea kwenye 2 na 4?
Unagonga kwa kasi mara mbili zaidi

rows.source: The beat never stops. You count through the beats you don't tap.
rows.translation: Mapigo hayasimami kamwe. Unahesabu kupitia mapigo usiyoyagonga.

rows.source: A whole note lasts all four beats. Tap once on 1 and count 2, 3, 4 under your breath so the next 1 lands on time.
rows.translation: Noti nzima hudumu mapigo yote manne. Gonga mara moja kwenye 1, uhesabu 2, 3, 4 kwa sauti ndogo ili 1 inayofuata itue kwa wakati.

rows.source: Tempo is the speed of the beat
Tempo is how fast the beat goes, counted in beats per minute, or bpm. At 60 bpm the beat comes once a second, like a clock.
rows.translation: Tempo ni kasi ya mapigo, inayohesabiwa kwa mapigo kwa dakika, au bpm. Katika 60 bpm, pigo huja mara moja kwa sekunde, kama saa.

rows.source: At 60 bpm, how often does the beat come?
rows.translation: Katika 60 bpm, pigo huja mara ngapi?

rows.source: 60 beats in 60 seconds is one beat each second.
rows.translation: Mapigo 60 katika sekunde 60 ni pigo moja kila sekunde.

rows.source: Faster tempos need less effort, not more. Keep your hand loose and tap from the knuckle, not the wrist or shoulder.
rows.translation: Tempo za haraka huhitaji juhudi kidogo zaidi, si nyingi zaidi. Mkono ubaki umelegea, ugonge kwa kusogeza kifundo cha kidole, si cha mkono wala bega.

rows.source: The tempo goes up. What should your taps do?
rows.translation: Tempo inaongezeka. Miguso yako inapaswa kufanya nini?
Kuwa mikubwa na yenye nguvu zaidi

rows.source: Wait a little behind the click
Small, relaxed motions are quicker and easier to keep even.
rows.translation: Miwendo midogo iliyolegea ni ya haraka zaidi na rahisi kudumisha kwa usawa.

rows.source: This challenge mixes beats, bars, longer notes and tempo. Count out loud the whole way, and keep your taps small and relaxed.
rows.translation: Changamoto hii huchanganya mapigo, vipimo, noti ndefu zaidi na tempo. Hesabu kwa sauti muda wote, miguso yako ikiwa midogo na isiyo na mkazo.

rows.source: Which note lasts a whole bar of 4/4?
rows.translation: Noti ipi hudumu kipimo kizima cha 4/4?

rows.source: A whole note lasts four beats, the full bar of 4/4.
rows.translation: Noti nzima hudumu mapigo manne, kipimo kizima cha 4/4.

rows.source: bpm counts beats per minute, so 90 bpm is one and a half beats each second.
rows.translation: bpm huhesabu mapigo kwa dakika, hivyo 90 bpm ni pigo moja na nusu kila sekunde.

rows.source: Split each beat in two and count "and."
rows.translation: Gawa kila pigo mara mbili, uhesabu "na."

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in every beat. Eight of them fill a bar of 4/4.
rows.translation: Noti ya nane hudumu nusu ya pigo, hivyo mbili hutimia katika kila pigo. Nane hujaza kipimo cha 4/4.

rows.source: Say the number on each beat and "and" exactly halfway between: 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Tap on every word.
rows.translation: Sema namba kwenye kila pigo na "na" katikati kabisa: 1 na 2 na 3 na 4 na. Gonga kwenye kila neno.

rows.source: An eighth note is half a beat, so two fill each beat.
rows.translation: Noti ya nane ni nusu ya pigo, hivyo mbili hujaza kila pigo.

rows.source: The strong clicks are the beats. How many beats did you hear?
rows.translation: Milio yenye nguvu ndiyo mapigo. Umesikia mapigo mangapi?

rows.source: Now some beats get one tap and some get two. Keep saying every "and," even the ones you don't tap.
rows.translation: Sasa baadhi ya mapigo hupata mguso mmoja na mengine miwili. Endelea kusema kila "na," hata usizozigonga.

rows.source: How do you count this pattern?
Beat 1 has two taps, 1 and. Beats 2, 3 and 4 get one tap each.
rows.translation: Pigo 1 lina miguso miwili, 1 na. Mapigo 2, 3 na 4 hupata mguso mmoja kila moja.

rows.source: In eighths, each tap lands on a number or an "and." Before you tap a new pattern, say its counts once out loud.
rows.translation: Katika noti za nane, kila mguso huangukia namba au "na." Kabla ya kugonga mfumo mpya, sema hesabu zake mara moja kwa sauti.
Hesabu zipi zinalingana na mfumo huu?

rows.source: Beats 1 and 3 have two taps each; beats 2 and 4 have one.
rows.translation: Mapigo 1 na 3 yana miguso miwili kila moja; mapigo 2 na 4 yana mmoja.

rows.source: Beat 1 has one tap, beats 2 and 3 have two, and beat 4 has one.
rows.translation: Pigo 1 lina mguso mmoja, mapigo 2 na 3 yana miwili, na pigo 4 lina mmoja.

rows.source: The "and" should land exactly halfway between beats. If your eighths sound like a gallop, slow down and say the counts as you tap.
rows.translation: "Na" inapaswa kuangukia katikati kabisa ya mapigo. Noti zako za nane zikisikika kama mwendo wa farasi, punguza kasi na useme hesabu unapogonga.

rows.source: Your eighths sound uneven. What helps most?
rows.translation: Noti zako za nane hazisikiki sawa. Nini husaidia zaidi?

rows.source: Slow down and count out loud
rows.translation: Punguza kasi na uhesabu kwa sauti
Gonga kwa nguvu zaidi kwenye kila pigo

rows.source: Speed up until it smooths out
Slowing down gives you time to place each "and" in the middle. Counting keeps it there.
rows.translation: Kupunguza kasi hukupa muda wa kuweka kila "na" katikati. Kuhesabu huidumisha hapo.

rows.source: Hover just above the glass between taps. A short, light motion is easier to keep even at faster tempos.
rows.translation: Kaa juu kidogo tu ya kioo kati ya miguso. Mwendo mfupi mwepesi ni rahisi kudumisha kwa usawa katika tempo za haraka zaidi.

rows.source: This challenge mixes quarters and eighths. Say each pattern's counts once, then tap it with every "and" right in the middle.
rows.translation: Changamoto hii huchanganya noti robo na za nane. Sema hesabu za kila mfumo mara moja, kisha ugonge kila "na" ikiwa katikati kabisa.

rows.source: Leave space on purpose, then tap between the beats.
rows.translation: Acha nafasi kwa makusudi, kisha ugonge kati ya mapigo.

rows.source: A rest is a silence with a set length. You still count it; you just don't tap. A quarter rest lasts one beat.
rows.translation: Pumziko ni ukimya wenye muda maalumu. Bado unauhesabu; hugongi tu. Pumziko robo hudumu pigo moja.

rows.source: What do you do on a rest?
A rest takes up time just like a note. Counting it keeps your place.
rows.translation: Pumziko huchukua muda kama noti. Kulihesabu hukusaidia ujue ulipo.

rows.source: Leaving beat 1 empty is the hardest rest. Nod your head on 1 so you feel it without tapping, then come in on 2.
rows.translation: Kuacha pigo 1 tupu ndilo pumziko gumu zaidi. Tikisa kichwa kwenye 1 ili ulihisi bila kugonga, kisha ingia kwenye 2.

rows.source: An eighth rest lasts half a beat. Count 1 and 2 and, rest on 2, and tap its "and" instead. It feels like a small push into beat 3.
rows.translation: Pumziko la nane hudumu nusu ya pigo. Hesabu 1 na 2 na, pumzika kwenye 2, kisha gonga "na" yake badala yake. Huhisiwa kama msukumo mdogo kuelekea pigo 3.

rows.source: It sits halfway between beats 2 and 3, on the "and" of 2.
rows.translation: Uko katikati ya mapigo 2 na 3, kwenye "na" ya 2.

rows.source: Syncopation puts a strong note between the beats, where your ear doesn't expect one. It makes a rhythm lean forward.
rows.translation: Sinkopa huweka noti yenye mkazo kati ya mapigo, mahali ambapo sikio halitarajii. Huufanya mdundo uhisiwe unaelekea mbele.

rows.source: This pattern lands on 1, the "and" of 2, and 4. Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and, and tap only those three spots.
rows.translation: Mfumo huu huangukia 1, "na" ya 2, na 4. Hesabu 1 na 2 na 3 na 4 na, ugonge sehemu hizo tatu tu.

rows.source: Count the clicks from 1 to 8. Where do the strong ones fall?
rows.translation: Hesabu milio kutoka 1 hadi 8. Yenye nguvu huangukia wapi?
Nini huufanya mdundo uwe na sinkopa?
Noti zenye mkazo kati ya mapigo

rows.source: Syncopation shifts the weight off the beat, onto an "and" or a weak beat.
rows.translation: Sinkopa huhamisha mkazo kutoka pigo kuu hadi "na" au pigo dhaifu.

rows.source: Offbeats are the "and" between beats. Nod on the numbers and tap only the ands, like the chop of a reggae guitar.
rows.translation: Mapigo ya katikati ni "na" kati ya mapigo makuu. Tikisa kichwa kwenye namba, ugonge na tu, kama chop ya gitaa la reggae.

rows.source: The first click is beat 1. Are the strong clicks on the numbers or the ands?
rows.translation: Mlio wa kwanza ni pigo 1. Milio yenye nguvu iko kwenye namba au na?

rows.source: Offbeats fall halfway between the beats, on every "and."
rows.translation: Mapigo ya katikati huangukia katikati kabisa ya mapigo makuu, kwenye kila "na."

rows.source: This challenge mixes rests, the "and" on its own, syncopation and offbeats. Count every eighth out loud, even when you don't tap.
rows.translation: Changamoto hii huchanganya mapumziko, "na" peke yake, sinkopa na mapigo ya katikati. Hesabu kila noti ya nane kwa sauti, hata usipogonga.
Ni ipi kati ya hizi ina sinkopa?

rows.source: Tapping the "and" of 2 and skipping 3 moves the weight off the beat.
rows.translation: Kugonga "na" ya 2 na kuruka 3 huhamisha mkazo kutoka pigo kuu.

rows.source: Hold notes across the beat with ties and dotted rhythms.
rows.translation: Shikilia noti zivuke mapigo kwa viungo vya tie na midundo yenye nukta.

rows.source: A tie is a curved line joining two notes. You play the first and hold it through the second, so the tied note gets no new tap.
rows.translation: Tie ni mstari uliopinda unaounganisha noti mbili. Unapiga ya kwanza na kuishikilia kupitia ya pili, hivyo noti iliyounganishwa haigongwi upya.

rows.source: Beat 2 is tied to beat 3. What do you do on 3?
rows.translation: Pigo 2 limeunganishwa na pigo 3 kwa tie. Unafanya nini kwenye 3?

rows.source: A tie stretches one note. You count 3, but the note from beat 2 keeps sounding.
rows.translation: Tie huongeza muda wa noti moja. Unahesabu 3, lakini noti ya pigo 2 inaendelea kulia.

rows.source: Tie the "and" of 2 into beat 3. Tap on the "and," then let beat 3 pass while the note rings. It's syncopation, written another way.
rows.translation: Unganisha "na" ya 2 na pigo 3 kwa tie. Gonga kwenye "na," kisha acha pigo 3 lipite noti ikiendelea kulia. Ni sinkopa, iliyoandikwa kwa namna nyingine.

rows.source: A dot after a note adds half its length. A half note lasts two beats, so a dotted half lasts three. Tap 1, count 2 and 3, tap 4.
rows.translation: Nukta baada ya noti huongeza nusu ya muda wake. Noti nusu hudumu mapigo mawili, hivyo yenye nukta hudumu matatu. Gonga 1, hesabu 2 na 3, gonga 4.

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. How long is a dotted quarter?
rows.translation: Noti robo hudumu pigo moja. Yenye nukta hudumu kwa muda gani?

rows.source: Half of one beat is a half beat. Add it and you get one and a half.
rows.translation: Nusu ya pigo moja ni nusu pigo. Ukiongeza, unapata moja na nusu.

rows.source: A dotted quarter lasts one and a half beats, so the next note lands on an "and." Count 1 and 2 and: tap 1, then the "and" of 2.
rows.translation: Noti robo yenye nukta hudumu pigo moja na nusu, hivyo noti inayofuata huangukia "na." Hesabu 1 na 2 na: gonga 1, kisha "na" ya 2.

rows.source: You tapped this pattern with a rest in Unit 3. What changes with a dot?
rows.translation: Uligonga mfumo huu wenye pumziko katika Kitengo 3. Nini hubadilika kwa nukta?
Noti ya kwanza hulia kwa muda mrefu zaidi

rows.source: The taps land in the same places. Only the length of the first note changes.
rows.translation: Miguso huangukia sehemu zilezile. Muda wa noti ya kwanza tu ndio hubadilika.
Noti robo yenye nukta, kisha ya nane

rows.source: A dotted quarter plus an eighth fills two beats: long, short. Count 1 and 2 and; tap 1 and the "and" of 2.
rows.translation: Noti robo yenye nukta pamoja na ya nane hujaza mapigo mawili: ndefu, fupi. Hesabu 1 na 2 na; gonga 1 na "na" ya 2.

rows.source: A dotted quarter and an eighth together last how long?
rows.translation: Noti robo yenye nukta na ya nane hudumu kwa muda gani pamoja?

rows.source: One and a half plus a half is two.
rows.translation: Moja na nusu pamoja na nusu ni mbili.

rows.source: Which lasts as long as a dotted quarter?
rows.translation: Ipi hudumu sawa na noti robo yenye nukta?

rows.source: A quarter tied to an eighth
rows.translation: Robo iliyounganishwa na ya nane kwa tie

rows.source: The tie adds half a beat to the quarter, just like the dot does.
rows.translation: Tie huongeza nusu ya pigo kwenye noti robo, kama nukta inavyofanya.

rows.source: This challenge mixes ties and dots. Count every eighth out loud; a held note still takes up its full time.
rows.translation: Changamoto hii huchanganya viungo vya tie na nukta. Hesabu kila noti ya nane kwa sauti; noti inayoshikiliwa bado huchukua muda wake wote.

rows.source: How long is a dotted half note?
rows.translation: Noti nusu yenye nukta hudumu kwa muda gani?

rows.source: A half note is two beats; the dot adds one more.
rows.translation: Noti nusu ni mapigo mawili; nukta huongeza moja zaidi.

rows.source: A tie connects two notes. How many times do you tap?
rows.translation: Tie huunganisha noti mbili. Unagonga mara ngapi?

rows.source: You tap the first note and hold through the second.
rows.translation: Unagonga noti ya kwanza na kuishikilia kupitia ya pili.

rows.source: Split the beat in three, then swing your eighths.
rows.translation: Gawa pigo mara tatu, kisha piga noti za nane kwa swing.

rows.source: Triplets split the beat in three
A triplet fits three even notes into one beat. Count 1-trip-let, 2-trip-let, with each syllable the same length.
rows.translation: Tripleti huweka noti tatu sawa katika pigo moja. Hesabu 1-trip-let, 2-trip-let, kila silabi ikiwa na muda uleule.

rows.source: How many triplet notes fit in one beat?
rows.translation: Noti ngapi za tripleti hutimia katika pigo moja?

rows.source: Triplets split each beat into three equal parts.
rows.translation: Tripleti hugawa kila pigo katika sehemu tatu sawa.

rows.source: Are the clicks in groups of two or three?
rows.translation: Milio iko katika makundi ya mbili au tatu?
Badilishana kati ya mbili na tatu

rows.source: Eighths split the beat in two; triplets split it in three. The beat itself stays put. Only the way you divide it changes.
rows.translation: Noti za nane hugawa pigo mara mbili; tripleti huligawa mara tatu. Pigo lenyewe hubaki palepale. Namna ya kuligawa tu ndiyo hubadilika.

rows.source: You count 1-trip-let, 2-trip-let. What are you tapping?
Three syllables per beat means three notes per beat: triplets.
rows.translation: Silabi tatu kwa pigo humaanisha noti tatu kwa pigo: tripleti.

rows.source: In swing, each pair of eighths turns long-short. The "and" moves late, onto the last part of a triplet. Think doo-ba, doo-ba.
rows.translation: Katika swing, kila jozi ya noti za nane huwa ndefu-fupi. "Na" huchelewa hadi sehemu ya mwisho ya tripleti. Waza doo-ba, doo-ba.
Ruka noti ya katikati ya tripleti

rows.source: Count 1-trip-let and tap only on "1" and "let." The gap in the middle is the swing.
rows.translation: Hesabu 1-trip-let, ugonge kwenye "1" na "let" tu. Nafasi ya katikati ndiyo swing.

rows.source: In swing, where does the "and" land?

rows.translation: Baadaye, kwenye noti ya mwisho ya tripleti

rows.source: Swing delays the "and" to the last triplet, which gives the long-short lilt.
rows.translation: Swing huchelewesha "na" hadi noti ya mwisho ya tripleti, ikileta mwendo wa ndefu-fupi.

rows.source: Jazz drummers play this on the ride cymbal: 1, 2, a swung "and," 3, 4, a swung "and." It sounds like ding, ding-a ding.
rows.translation: Wapiga ngoma wa jazz hupiga huu kwenye toazi la ride: 1, 2, "na" ya swing, 3, 4, "na" ya swing. Husikika kama ding, ding-a ding.

rows.source: How do you tap a swung "and"?
A swung "and" waits for the last triplet of the beat.
rows.translation: "Na" ya swing husubiri noti ya mwisho ya tripleti katika pigo.

rows.source: Straight eighths split the beat evenly; swung eighths go long-short. Tap one, then the other, and feel the difference.
rows.translation: Noti za nane za kawaida hugawa pigo kwa usawa; za swing huwa ndefu-fupi. Gonga za aina moja, kisha nyingine, uhisi tofauti.

rows.source: This challenge mixes triplets, straight eighths and swing. Keep the beat steady while the way you split it changes.
rows.translation: Changamoto hii huchanganya tripleti, noti za nane zilizo sawa na swing. Dumisha mapigo thabiti huku namna ya kuyagawa ikibadilika.

rows.source: Swing turns each pair of eighths into what?
rows.translation: Swing hubadili kila jozi ya noti za nane kuwa nini?

rows.source: The first eighth stretches and the "and" arrives late.
rows.translation: Noti ya kwanza ya nane hudumu zaidi na "na" huja baadaye.

rows.source: Waltz in three, march in two, rock in 6/8, and place the accents.
rows.translation: Waltz kwa matatu, mwendo wa gwaride kwa mawili, yumba kwa 6/8 na uweke mikazo.

rows.source: In 3/4 time each bar has three beats: ONE, two, three. It's the waltz. Count 1, 2, 3 and lean on 1.
rows.translation: Katika 3/4 kila kipimo kina mapigo matatu: MOJA, mbili, tatu. Hiyo ni waltz. Hesabu 1, 2, 3 ukikazia 1.

rows.source: A half note fills two of the three beats. Tap 1, count 2, tap 3. It feels like the big step and small step of a waltz.
rows.translation: Noti nusu hujaza mawili kati ya mapigo matatu. Gonga 1, hesabu 2, gonga 3. Huhisiwa kama hatua kubwa na ndogo za waltz.

rows.source: How many beats are in a bar of 3/4?
The top number of a time signature tells you how many beats are in each bar.
rows.translation: Namba ya juu ya alama ya kipimo hukuambia kila kipimo kina mapigo mangapi.

rows.source: 2/4 has two beats per bar: ONE, two, like marching feet. The bars go by quickly, so beat 1 comes around often.
rows.translation: 2/4 ina mapigo mawili kwa kipimo: MOJA, mbili, kama miguu ya kuandamana. Vipimo hupita haraka, hivyo pigo 1 hurudi mara nyingi.

rows.source: Which meter feels like a march?
rows.translation: Mpangilio upi wa mapigo huhisiwa kama gwaride?

rows.source: Two beats per bar match left, right, left, right.
rows.translation: Mapigo mawili kwa kipimo hulingana na kushoto, kulia, kushoto, kulia.
Noti sita za nane, makundi mawili

rows.source: In 6/8 each bar holds six eighth notes in two groups of three: ONE two three FOUR five six. It feels like two big, rocking beats.
rows.translation: Katika 6/8 kila kipimo kina noti sita za nane katika makundi mawili ya tatu: MOJA mbili tatu NNE tano sita. Huhisiwa kama mapigo mawili makubwa ya kuyumba.

rows.source: The six eighths fall into two groups of three, so you feel two big beats.
rows.translation: Noti sita za nane huangukia makundi mawili ya tatu, hivyo unahisi mapigo mawili makubwa.

rows.source: A favorite 6/8 pattern goes long-short, long-short: tap 1, 3, 4 and 6. It rocks like a lullaby or a sea shanty.
rows.translation: Mfumo maarufu wa 6/8 ni ndefu-fupi, ndefu-fupi: gonga 1, 3, 4 na 6. Huyumba kama wimbo wa kubembeleza au wa mabaharia.

rows.source: Six clicks per bar. Which meter is this?
rows.translation: Milio sita kwa kipimo. Huu ni mpangilio upi wa mapigo?

rows.source: An accent is a note played stronger than the ones around it. Move the accents and the feel changes, even when every note stays the same.
rows.translation: Mkazo ni noti inayopigwa kwa nguvu zaidi kuliko zinazoizunguka. Hamisha mikazo, hisia zitabadilika hata kila noti ikibaki ileile.

rows.source: Count all eight eighths and tap just the accents: 1, the "and" of 2, and 4. This 3-3-2 pattern drives a lot of pop and Latin music.
rows.translation: Hesabu noti zote nane za nane, ugonge mikazo tu: 1, "na" ya 2, na 4. Mfumo huu wa 3-3-2 husukuma muziki mwingi wa pop na Kilatini.
Noti inayopigwa kwa muda mrefu zaidi

rows.source: An accent is about weight, not length. The note is simply played stronger.
rows.translation: Mkazo unahusu nguvu, si muda. Noti hupigwa tu kwa nguvu zaidi.

rows.source: Rock, pop and soul put the accent on beats 2 and 4. This is the backbeat. Count all four and tap only 2 and 4, like a snare drum.
rows.translation: Rock, pop na soul hukazia mapigo 2 na 4. Hii ni backbeat. Hesabu yote manne, ugonge 2 na 4 tu, kama ngoma ya snare.

rows.source: The first click is beat 1. Where are the strong clicks?
rows.translation: Mlio wa kwanza ni pigo 1. Milio yenye nguvu iko wapi?

rows.source: This challenge moves between meters and accents. Before each tap step, count one bar under your breath to find beat 1.
rows.translation: Changamoto hii hubadilishana mipangilio ya mapigo na mikazo. Kabla ya kila zoezi la kugonga, hesabu kipimo kimoja kwa sauti ndogo ili upate pigo 1.

rows.source: Six eighth notes per bar, felt in two groups of three.
rows.translation: Noti sita za nane kwa kipimo, zikihisiwa katika makundi mawili ya tatu.

rows.source: Find your voice and sing in tune
rows.translation: Gundua sauti yako na uimbe kwa usahihi

rows.source: Stand tall, breathe low, hold your first steady note and sing a song.
rows.translation: Simama wima, pumua kwa tumbo, shikilia noti yako ya kwanza thabiti na uimbe wimbo.

rows.source: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and knees soft. Let your shoulders drop and your head float up, as if a string lifts it. Keep your jaw loose.
rows.translation: Simama miguu ikiwa imetengana kwa upana wa nyonga na magoti hayajakaza. Acha mabega yashuke na kichwa kiinuke, kana kwamba uzi unakivuta juu. Taya ibaki imelegea.

rows.source: Rest a hand on your belly and breathe in slowly. Your belly and lower ribs widen while your shoulders stay still. That low breath powers your voice.
rows.translation: Weka mkono tumboni, uvute pumzi polepole. Tumbo na mbavu za chini hupanuka huku mabega yakibaki palepale. Pumzi hiyo ya tumboni huipa sauti nguvu.

rows.source: When you breathe in to sing, what should move?
rows.translation: Unapovuta pumzi ya kuimba, sehemu ipi inapaswa kusogea?
Tumbo na mbavu zako za chini

rows.source: A low breath widens your ribs and belly. Lifting your shoulders tightens your neck and throat.
rows.translation: Pumzi ya tumboni hupanua mbavu na tumbo. Kuinua mabega hukaza shingo na koo.

rows.source: Timbre listens for the note's name, so a C sung low or high both count. Pick the octave that feels easy, never strained.
rows.translation: Timbre husikiliza jina la noti, hivyo C iliyoimbwa chini au juu zote hukubalika. Chagua oktava iliyo rahisi kwako, bila kujikaza kamwe.

rows.source: Breathe low, then sing C on "ah" in a comfortable octave. Hold it steady.
rows.translation: Vuta pumzi tumboni, kisha imba C kwa "ah" katika oktava iliyo rahisi. Dumisha sauti thabiti.

rows.source: Once more: stand tall, breathe low, and let the note ring.
rows.translation: Mara nyingine: simama wima, vuta pumzi tumboni, uache noti iimbike.
Dumisha noti kwa hewa inayotoka sawa

rows.source: To sustain is to hold a note at one steady pitch. Let the air out slowly and evenly, like fogging a mirror without stopping.
rows.translation: Kudumisha ni kushikilia noti katika kimo kimoja thabiti cha sauti. Toa hewa polepole na kwa usawa, kama kutia ukungu kwenye kioo bila kusimama.

rows.source: Sing C on "ah" and hold it steady until it locks in.
rows.translation: Imba C kwa "ah," uidumishe thabiti hadi itulie kwenye kimo sahihi.

rows.source: Your note wobbles and fades. What helps most?
rows.translation: Noti yako inayumba na kupungua sauti. Nini husaidia zaidi?
Hewa ya polepole inayotoka kwa usawa

rows.source: Steady air makes a steady note. Extra volume and tension make it harder to control.
rows.translation: Hewa thabiti huleta noti thabiti. Sauti kubwa zaidi na mkazo hufanya iwe vigumu kuidhibiti.

rows.source: Now E. Same low breath, same easy "ah."
rows.translation: Sasa E. Pumzi ileile ya tumboni, "ah" ileile isiyo na mkazo.

rows.source: Sing "ah" with your jaw dropped and the tip of your tongue resting behind your lower teeth. The sound flows out instead of getting squeezed.
rows.translation: Imba "ah" ukiwa umeshusha taya na ncha ya ulimi ikipumzika nyuma ya meno ya chini. Sauti hutiririka nje badala ya kubanwa.

rows.source: G this time. Drop your jaw and keep the "ah" open.
rows.translation: G sasa. Shusha taya, "ah" ibaki wazi.

rows.source: Matching pitch means singing the same note you hear. Listen, imagine the note for a moment, then sing softly and adjust until it settles.
rows.translation: Kulinganisha kimo cha sauti ni kuimba noti ileile unayoisikia. Sikiliza, iwazie kwa muda, kisha imba kwa sauti ndogo na urekebishe hadi itulie.

rows.source: Sing E softly, then adjust until it settles.
rows.translation: Imba E kwa sauti ndogo, kisha rekebisha hadi itulie.
Chini na juu ya kimo sahihi

rows.source: Flat means under the target pitch; sharp means over it. If you're flat, lift a little. If you're sharp, ease down. Small moves work best.
rows.translation: Kuwa chini ni kuwa chini ya kimo lengwa; kuwa juu ni kukizidi. Ukiwa chini, inua kidogo. Ukiwa juu, shusha kwa upole. Mabadiliko madogo hufaa zaidi.

rows.source: Timbre says you're flat. What do you do?
rows.translation: Timbre inasema sauti yako iko chini. Ufanye nini?

rows.source: Flat means under the note, so lift the pitch slightly.
rows.translation: Kuwa chini ni kuwa chini ya noti, kwa hiyo inua kimo cha sauti kidogo.

rows.source: Two notes this time: D, then G. Take a breath between them.
rows.translation: Noti mbili sasa: D, kisha G. Vuta pumzi katikati yake.

rows.source: Humming with your lips closed is a gentle warm-up. You should feel a light buzz on your lips and nose. Keep it soft and easy.
rows.translation: Kuvuma midomo ikiwa imefungwa ni njia laini ya kujiandaa. Unapaswa kuhisi mtetemo mdogo midomoni na puani. Sauti ibaki ndogo na isiyo na mkazo.

rows.source: Hum C, E and G, one at a time. Keep it light.
rows.translation: Vuma C, E na G, moja baada ya nyingine. Usitumie nguvu nyingi.

rows.source: Close your lips loosely and blow so they flutter like a motorboat, then add your voice. It keeps your throat relaxed while your voice wakes up.
rows.translation: Funga midomo kwa upole, upulize ili itetemeke kama mashua yenye injini, kisha ongeza sauti. Hii hulegeza koo huku sauti ikijiandaa.

rows.source: Lip trill on G, E, then C. If your lips stop, press your cheeks lightly.
rows.translation: Fanya trili ya midomo kwenye G, E, kisha C. Midomo ikiacha kutetemeka, bonyeza mashavu kwa upole.

rows.source: A note feels tight or scratchy. What do you do?
rows.translation: Noti inahisi imebana au inakwaruza. Ufanye nini?

rows.source: Stop, rest, and try it softer
rows.translation: Simama, pumzika, ujaribu kwa sauti ndogo

rows.source: Strain is a signal to ease off. Rest, sip some water, and come back lighter.
rows.translation: Mkazo ni ishara ya kupunguza nguvu. Pumzika, kunywa maji kidogo, kisha urudi kwa upole zaidi.

rows.source: Stand tall, breathe low, and start each note softly. Rest between steps if your voice feels tired.
rows.translation: Simama wima, vuta pumzi tumboni, uanze kila noti kwa sauti ndogo. Pumzika kati ya mazoezi sauti ikihisi kuchoka.

rows.source: E, then G. Hear each one before you sing it.
rows.translation: E, kisha G. Isikie kila moja kabla ya kuiimba.
Chini ya kimo lengwa cha sauti
Juu ya kimo lengwa cha sauti

rows.source: Sharp is over the target pitch; flat is under it.
rows.translation: Kuwa juu ni kuzidi kimo lengwa cha sauti; kuwa chini ni kutokifikia.

rows.source: Sing D softly, then adjust until it settles.
rows.translation: Imba D kwa sauti ndogo, kisha rekebisha hadi itulie.

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: E, D and C, each a step from the next. Sing it where it feels easy; Timbre hears the right note in any octave.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb unahitaji noti tatu: E, D na C, kila moja ikiwa hatua moja kutoka inayofuata. Imba pale palipo rahisi kwako; Timbre husikia noti sahihi katika oktava yoyote.

rows.source: E, D, C: three steps down to home.
rows.translation: E, D, C: hatua tatu kushuka hadi msingi.

rows.source: Ma-ry had a lit-tle lamb: E D C D E E E.
rows.translation: Ma-ry had a lit-tle lamb: E D C D E E E.

rows.source: Hear a note, sing it back, and move by small steps.
rows.translation: Sikia noti, uiimbe tena, na usogee kwa hatua ndogo.

rows.source: Before you sing, hear the note in your head for a second. That pause lets your voice aim for the pitch instead of hunting for it.
rows.translation: Kabla ya kuimba, sikia noti akilini kwa sekunde moja. Pumziko hilo huiruhusu sauti yako ilenge kimo badala ya kukitafuta.

rows.source: Hear D in your head, then sing it.
Hear F in your head, then sing it.
Your first try lands flat. What next?
rows.translation: Jaribio la kwanza linatua chini ya kimo sahihi. Ufanye nini sasa?

rows.source: Small changes find the note fastest. Lift gently and let it settle.
rows.translation: Mabadiliko madogo hupata noti haraka zaidi. Inua kwa upole na uiache itulie.

rows.source: Hear A in your head, then sing it.
Three notes in a row: D, F, A.
rows.translation: Noti tatu mfululizo: D, F, A.

rows.source: Unison means two sounds on exactly the same pitch. When they match, they blend into one; when they're slightly off, you hear a wobble.
rows.translation: Unisoni ni sauti mbili katika kimo kilekile kabisa. Zikilingana, huchanganyika kuwa moja; zikipishana kidogo, unasikia kuyumba.

rows.source: Sing E and hold it in tune.
rows.translation: Imba E na uishikilie katika kimo sahihi.

rows.source: To sing the same note twice, stop the air for a moment, then start again on a soft "da." Don't slide between them.
rows.translation: Kuimba noti ileile mara mbili, simamisha hewa kwa muda mfupi, kisha anza tena kwa "da" laini. Usiteleze kati yake.

rows.source: Sing E three times on "da," with a tiny gap each time.
rows.translation: Imba E mara tatu kwa "da," ukiweka nafasi ndogo kila mara.

rows.source: A step is the next note
A step moves to the next note of a scale, up or down. Steps are the smallest, easiest moves to sing in tune.
rows.translation: Hatua huenda kwenye noti inayofuata ya skeli, juu au chini. Hatua ndiyo miendo midogo na rahisi zaidi kuimba kwa kimo sahihi.
Panda kwa hatua: C, D, E.

rows.source: Did it go up or down?
A half step is the smallest step, like E to F, with no note between. Most neighboring scale notes, like C and D, are a whole step apart: two half steps.
rows.translation: Nusu toni ni hatua ndogo zaidi, kama E hadi F, bila noti katikati. Noti nyingi jirani za skeli, kama C na D, zimetengana kwa toni nzima: nusu toni mbili.

rows.source: E, up a half step to F, and back.
rows.translation: E, panda nusu toni hadi F, kisha urudi.

rows.source: Hear each note in your head first, start softly, and adjust in small moves. Give repeated notes a fresh start.
rows.translation: Sikia kila noti akilini kwanza, anza kwa sauti ndogo, urekebishe kwa mabadiliko madogo. Anza upya kila noti inayorudiwa.

rows.source: Hear G in your head, then sing it.
B, up a half step to C, and back.
rows.translation: B, panda nusu toni hadi C, kisha urudi.

rows.source: E to F has no note between them. C to D and G to A are whole steps.
rows.translation: E hadi F hazina noti katikati yake. C hadi D na G hadi A ni toni nzima.

rows.source: Sing do-re-mi, the major scale, and five-note patterns.
rows.translation: Imba do-re-mi, skeli meja na mifumo ya noti tano.

rows.source: Solfege gives each step of the scale a syllable: do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do. Do is home, wherever the scale starts.
rows.translation: Solfeji huipa kila hatua ya skeli silabi: do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do. Do ni msingi, popote skeli inapoanzia.

rows.source: Sing do, re, mi on C, D, E.
rows.translation: Imba do, re, mi kwenye C, D, E.

rows.source: Which syllable is home, the first step of the scale?
rows.translation: Silabi ipi ni msingi, hatua ya kwanza ya skeli?

rows.source: Do is the first step and the note a scale comes back to.
rows.translation: Do ni hatua ya kwanza na noti ambayo skeli huirudia.

rows.source: Now back down: mi, re, do.
Do, re, mi, fa, sol: the first five steps carry many simple tunes. Sing them up and back down on one breath if it feels easy.
rows.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: hatua tano za kwanza hubeba melodi nyingi rahisi. Ziimbe kupanda na kushuka kwa pumzi moja ikiwa ni rahisi kwako.

rows.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: C up to G.
rows.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: C kupanda hadi G.

rows.source: Between which two steps is there a half step?
rows.translation: Ni hatua zipi mbili zina nusu toni katikati yake?

rows.source: Mi to fa (E to F) is a half step. The other steps from do to sol are whole steps.
rows.translation: Mi hadi fa (E hadi F) ni nusu toni. Hatua nyingine kutoka do hadi sol ni toni nzima.

rows.source: Sol back down to do: G down to C.
rows.translation: Sol kushuka hadi do: G kushuka hadi C.

rows.source: The major scale runs from do up to the next do: eight notes. Mi to fa and ti to do are half steps; every other step is a whole step.
rows.translation: Skeli meja hutoka do kupanda hadi do inayofuata: noti nane. Mi hadi fa na ti hadi do ni nusu toni; kila hatua nyingine ni toni nzima.

rows.source: Do to do: C up to the next C.
rows.translation: Do hadi do: C kupanda hadi C inayofuata.

rows.source: Where are the half steps in a major scale?
rows.translation: Nusu toni ziko wapi katika skeli meja?

rows.source: Mi-fa and ti-do are half steps. That pattern gives the major scale its sound.
rows.translation: Mi-fa na ti-do ni nusu toni. Mpangilio huo huipa skeli meja sauti yake.

rows.source: Take a low breath before you start so you don't run out near the top. Let high notes get lighter, not louder, and keep your jaw loose.
rows.translation: Vuta pumzi tumboni kabla ya kuanza ili hewa isikuishie karibu na juu. Acha noti za juu ziwe nyepesi zaidi, si kubwa zaidi kwa sauti, na taya ibaki imelegea.

rows.source: Back down from C to C. Keep each lower note bright so it doesn't sag flat.
rows.translation: Shuka kutoka C hadi C. Noti za chini zibaki angavu ili zisishuke chini ya kimo sahihi.

rows.source: Short patterns like do-re-mi-re-do build accuracy fast. Sing one, then start it a step higher and let the scale guide you.
rows.translation: Mifumo mifupi kama do-re-mi-re-do hujenga usahihi haraka. Imba mmoja, kisha uanzie hatua moja juu zaidi, skeli ikuongoze.

rows.source: Do up to sol and back: C to G to C.
rows.translation: Do kupanda hadi sol na kurudi: C hadi G hadi C.

rows.source: Sing C-D-E-D-C, then the same shape one step higher. What's the top note now?
rows.translation: Imba C-D-E-D-C, kisha umbo lilelile hatua moja juu. Sasa noti ya juu zaidi ni ipi?

rows.source: One step higher, the shape becomes D, E, F, E, D.
rows.translation: Hatua moja juu, umbo huwa D, E, F, E, D.

rows.source: Breathe low before each scale, keep the top light, and keep lower notes bright on the way down.
rows.translation: Vuta pumzi tumboni kabla ya kila skeli, sauti za juu zibaki nyepesi na za chini angavu unaposhuka.

rows.source: How many notes are in a major scale, do to do?
rows.translation: Skeli meja ina noti ngapi, kutoka do hadi do?

rows.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do: eight notes, with do at both ends.
rows.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do: noti nane, do ikiwa mwanzo na mwisho.

rows.source: Leap by thirds, fifths and octaves, and land in tune.
rows.translation: Ruka kwa umbali wa tatu, tano na oktava, utue kwenye kimo sahihi.
Ruka hatua moja: umbali wa tatu

rows.source: An interval is the distance between two notes. Skip one scale step and you get a third, like do to mi. Hear mi in your head before you leave do.
rows.translation: Umbali wa noti ni nafasi kati ya noti mbili. Ruka hatua moja ya skeli upate umbali wa tatu, kama do hadi mi. Sikia mi akilini kabla ya kuondoka do.

rows.source: Do to mi and back: C, E, C.
rows.translation: Do hadi mi na kurudi: C, E, C.
Umbali mwingine wa tatu: D, F, D.
Jozi ipi ni umbali wa tatu?

rows.source: C to E skips over D, so it spans three scale notes: a third.
rows.translation: C hadi E huruka D, hivyo huhusisha noti tatu za skeli: umbali wa tatu.
Do hadi sol: umbali wa tano

rows.source: Do to sol spans five scale notes, a fifth. It sounds open and strong. Picture the steps in between, then jump straight to sol.
rows.translation: Do hadi sol huhusisha noti tano za skeli, umbali wa tano. Husikika wazi na imara. Wazia hatua za katikati, kisha ruka moja kwa moja hadi sol.

rows.source: Do to sol and back: C, G, C.
rows.translation: Do hadi sol na kurudi: C, G, C.

rows.source: Do, mi, sol: two thirds stack up to a fifth.
rows.translation: Do, mi, sol: umbali wa tatu mara mbili huunda umbali wa tano.

rows.source: Counting both ends, how many scale notes from do to sol?
rows.translation: Ukihesabu mwanzo na mwisho, kuna noti ngapi za skeli kutoka do hadi sol?

rows.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: five notes, so it's a fifth.
rows.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: noti tano, hivyo ni umbali wa tano.

rows.source: An octave leaps from do to the next do, eight scale notes up. The two notes share a name and blend so well they almost sound like one.
rows.translation: Oktava huruka kutoka do hadi do inayofuata, noti nane za skeli juu. Noti mbili zina jina moja na huchanganyika vizuri kiasi cha kukaribia kusikika kama moja.

rows.source: Before an octave leap, breathe low and keep your chin level. Think of the top note as light and easy, not a stretch upward.
rows.translation: Kabla ya kuruka oktava, vuta pumzi tumboni na kidevu kibaki sawa bila kuinuka. Wazia noti ya juu kama nyepesi na rahisi, si kunyoosha mwili juu.

rows.source: C, then G, then the high C. Use the G as a stepping stone.
rows.translation: C, kisha G, kisha C ya juu. Tumia G kama hatua ya kukusaidia.

rows.source: Why do the two notes of an octave blend so well?
rows.translation: Kwa nini noti mbili za oktava huchanganyika vizuri sana?

rows.source: The top one vibrates twice as fast
rows.translation: Ya juu hutetemeka kwa kasi mara mbili

rows.source: The top note vibrates exactly twice as fast as the bottom one, so their waves line up.
rows.translation: Noti ya juu hutetemeka kwa kasi mara mbili kamili kuliko ya chini, hivyo mawimbi yake hulingana.

rows.source: Hear each leap in your head before you sing it. Land lightly on the top note, then step home.
rows.translation: Sikia kila mruko akilini kabla ya kuuimba. Tua kwa upole kwenye noti ya juu, kisha shuka kwa hatua hadi msingi.
Do, mi, sol, do ya juu.

rows.source: High do, sol, mi, do: back down.
rows.translation: Do ya juu, sol, mi, do: kushuka tena.

rows.source: What is the interval from do to the next do?
rows.translation: Kutoka do hadi do inayofuata ni umbali gani wa noti?

rows.source: Do to the next do spans eight scale notes: an octave.
rows.translation: Do hadi do inayofuata huhusisha noti nane za skeli: oktava.

rows.source: Five public-domain tunes, melody only, at an easy pace.
rows.translation: Melodi tano zisizo na hakimiliki, bila usindikizaji, kwa kasi rahisi.

rows.source: This traditional melody leaps up, then steps back down home. Sing it on "loo" and give each repeated note a fresh start.
rows.translation: Melodi hii ya jadi huruka juu, kisha hushuka kwa hatua hadi msingi. Iimbe kwa "loo," ukianza upya kila noti inayorudiwa.

rows.source: The opening leap: C up to G, step to A, back to G.
rows.translation: Mruko wa mwanzo: C kupanda hadi G, hatua hadi A, kurudi G.

rows.source: The middle phrase: does it go up or down?
rows.translation: Kishazi cha katikati: kinapanda au kushuka?

rows.source: This melody from Beethoven's Ninth Symphony moves almost entirely by step. Keep it smooth and even, like walking up and down a staircase.
rows.translation: Melodi hii kutoka Simfoni ya Tisa ya Beethoven husogea karibu yote kwa hatua. Idumishe laini na sawa, kama kupanda na kushuka ngazi.

rows.source: The five notes the tune lives on: F up to C.
rows.translation: Noti tano zinazobeba melodi: F kupanda hadi C.

rows.source: The first phrase ends with a dotted note. How does it feel?
rows.translation: Kishazi cha kwanza huisha kwa noti yenye nukta. Inahisiwaje?

rows.source: The dotted note is held longer, then a short note leads into the last one.
rows.translation: Noti yenye nukta hushikiliwa zaidi, kisha noti fupi huongoza hadi ya mwisho.

rows.source: This traditional Scottish melody starts with a pickup, a note before the first full bar. Sing it lightly, then lean on the next note.
rows.translation: Melodi hii ya jadi ya Scotland huanza kwa noti ya utangulizi, noti kabla ya kipimo cha kwanza kamili. Iimbe kwa upole, kisha kazia inayofuata.

rows.source: The climb in the third bar: F, A, C, up to D.
rows.translation: Mwinuko katika kipimo cha tatu: F, A, C, kupanda hadi D.

rows.source: The loudest note of a song
rows.translation: Noti yenye sauti kubwa zaidi ya wimbo

rows.source: A note before the first full bar
rows.translation: Noti kabla ya kipimo cha kwanza kamili

rows.source: A pickup leads into beat 1 of the first full bar.
rows.translation: Noti ya utangulizi huongoza hadi pigo 1 la kipimo cha kwanza kamili.

rows.source: This American hymn tune from the early 1800s is in 3/4: count 1, 2, 3. Long notes often turn into a quick pair, so keep the pair light.
rows.translation: Melodi hii ya tenzi ya Marekani ya mwanzoni mwa karne iliyoanza 1800 iko katika 3/4: hesabu 1, 2, 3. Noti ndefu mara nyingi hugeuka jozi ya haraka, hivyo jozi ibaki nyepesi.

rows.source: The quick turn: F, up to A, back to F.
rows.translation: Mgeuko wa haraka: F, kupanda hadi A, kurudi F.

rows.source: How many beats are in each bar of this hymn?
rows.translation: Kila kipimo cha tenzi hii kina mapigo mangapi?

rows.source: It's in 3/4: three beats per bar, with the weight on 1.
rows.translation: Iko katika 3/4: mapigo matatu kwa kipimo, mkazo ukiwa kwenye 1.

rows.source: This American folk song from the 1800s moves slowly, with wide leaps. Breathe at each rest, and hear every leap before you sing it.
rows.translation: Wimbo huu wa jadi wa Marekani wa karne iliyoanza 1800 husogea polepole, ukiwa na miruko mipana. Vuta pumzi katika kila pumziko, usikie kila mruko kabla ya kuuimba.

rows.source: The opening leap: low G up to C. Any octave counts.
rows.translation: Mruko wa mwanzo: G ya chini kupanda hadi C. Oktava yoyote inakubalika.

rows.source: The big leap: G up to high C, then step down.
rows.translation: Mruko mkubwa: G kupanda hadi C ya juu, kisha shuka kwa hatua.

rows.source: Where should you breathe in this song?
rows.translation: Unapaswa kuvuta pumzi wapi katika wimbo huu?

rows.source: Never; sing it in one breath
The rests mark the ends of phrases. Breathe there so each line has full support.
rows.translation: Mapumziko huonyesha miisho ya vishazi. Vuta pumzi hapo ili kila mstari upate hewa ya kutosha.

rows.source: Five tunes back to back, one phrase each. Breathe at every rest, and give repeated notes a fresh start.
rows.translation: Melodi tano mfululizo, kishazi kimoja kila moja. Vuta pumzi kwenye kila pumziko, uanze upya kila noti inayorudiwa.

rows.source: Which of these songs is in 3/4?
rows.translation: Ni wimbo upi hapa uko katika 3/4?

rows.source: Amazing Grace counts 1, 2, 3 in every bar.
rows.translation: Neema ya Ajabu huhesabiwa 1, 2, 3 katika kila kipimo.

rows.source: Hold notes steady, shape loud and soft, and warm up well.
rows.translation: Shikilia noti thabiti, dhibiti sauti kubwa na ndogo, na ujiandae vizuri.

rows.source: Pitch drifts when the air behind it changes. Keep a low, even breath and watch the note stay centered from start to finish.
rows.translation: Kimo cha sauti hubadilika hewa inayokiendesha ikibadilika. Dumisha pumzi ya tumboni iliyo sawa, uone noti ikibaki kwenye kimo sahihi mwanzo hadi mwisho.

rows.source: Hold G and keep it centered.
Notes often sag flat as your air runs out. Stop a little before you're empty, then take a fresh low breath.
rows.translation: Noti mara nyingi hushuka chini ya kimo sahihi hewa inapokwisha. Simama kidogo kabla haijaisha, kisha vuta pumzi mpya tumboni.

rows.source: Your long notes go flat at the end. What helps?
rows.translation: Noti zako ndefu hushuka chini ya kimo sahihi mwishoni. Nini husaidia?

rows.source: End the note sooner and breathe
rows.translation: Maliza noti mapema zaidi na uvute pumzi
Imba mwisho kwa sauti kubwa zaidi

rows.source: Pitch sags when you run low on air. Ending a bit early keeps the whole note in tune.
rows.translation: Kimo cha sauti hushuka hewa inapopungua. Kumaliza mapema kidogo huweka noti nzima katika kimo sahihi.

rows.source: Vibrato is a gentle, regular wave in pitch, around five to seven times a second. It grows out of a relaxed throat and steady breath, not out of shaking.
rows.translation: Vibrato ni wimbi laini la kawaida la kimo cha sauti, karibu mara tano hadi saba kwa sekunde. Hutokana na koo lililolegea na pumzi thabiti, si kujitikisa.

rows.source: Where does healthy vibrato come from?
A relaxed throat and steady breath
Vibrato appears when the voice is free and supported. Forcing it from the jaw or belly makes a wobble.
rows.translation: Vibrato hutokea sauti ikiwa huru na inaungwa na pumzi. Kuilazimisha kwa taya au tumbo huleta kuyumba.

rows.source: Learn to hold a straight, steady note before you chase vibrato. When your voice is relaxed and supported, vibrato often appears on its own.
rows.translation: Jifunze kushikilia noti isiyoyumba na thabiti kabla ya kutafuta vibrato. Sauti ikiwa imelegea na inaungwa na pumzi, vibrato mara nyingi hujitokeza yenyewe.

rows.source: A straight, steady A. No wave, just a clear line.
rows.translation: A thabiti isiyoyumba. Bila wimbi, mstari safi tu.

rows.source: What's the best first goal for a new singer?
rows.translation: Lengo lipi la kwanza linafaa zaidi kwa mwimbaji mpya?

rows.source: A steady tone is the foundation. Vibrato that grows from it sounds natural.
rows.translation: Sauti thabiti ndiyo msingi. Vibrato inayotokana nayo husikika ya asili.
Viwango vya sauti: kubwa na ndogo

rows.source: Dynamics are how loud or soft you sing. Get louder with more breath energy, not by squeezing your throat. The pitch should stay put.
rows.translation: Viwango vya sauti ni jinsi unavyoimba kwa sauti kubwa au ndogo. Ongeza sauti kwa nguvu zaidi ya pumzi, si kwa kubana koo. Kimo cha sauti kibaki palepale.

rows.source: Sing E softly, then louder on the same pitch.
rows.translation: Imba E kwa sauti ndogo, kisha kubwa zaidi kwenye kimo kilekile.

rows.source: As you get louder, what can happen to pitch?
rows.translation: Unapoongeza ukubwa wa sauti, nini kinaweza kutokea kwa kimo chake?

rows.source: Extra push tends to raise the pitch, and very soft notes can sag flat. Watch the note either way.
rows.translation: Kusukuma zaidi huelekea kuinua kimo cha sauti, na noti za sauti ndogo sana zinaweza kushuka chini ya lengo. Iangalie noti kwa vyovyote.

rows.source: A swell grows from soft to louder and back on one breath. Start quietly, grow gently, then fade, all on the same pitch.
rows.translation: Sauti huongezeka kutoka ndogo hadi kubwa zaidi, kisha kurudi, kwa pumzi moja. Anza kimya, ongeza kwa upole, kisha punguza, yote katika kimo kilekile.

rows.source: Swell on G: soft, louder, soft. Keep it centered.
rows.translation: Ongeza na upunguze sauti kwenye G: ndogo, kubwa zaidi, ndogo. Idumishe kwenye kimo sahihi.
Ongeza na upunguze sauti ya kila noti

rows.source: A short warm-up eases your voice in: breathe low, hum, lip trill, then sing a scale. Start in the middle of your range and stay comfortable.
rows.translation: Mazoezi mafupi huandaa sauti kwa upole: vuta pumzi tumboni, vuma, fanya trili ya midomo, kisha imba skeli. Anza katikati ya wigo wako wa sauti bila kujikaza.

rows.source: Your voice feels tired after practice. What's best?
rows.translation: Sauti yako inahisi kuchoka baada ya mazoezi. Nini kinafaa zaidi?

rows.source: Rest helps a tired voice recover. If hoarseness lingers for a few weeks, check with a doctor.
rows.translation: Kupumzika husaidia sauti iliyochoka ipone. Ukwaruzo wa sauti ukiendelea kwa wiki kadhaa, muone daktari.

rows.source: Warm up first. Then hold each note steady, shape it soft and loud, and breathe before you run out.
rows.translation: Andaa sauti kwanza. Kisha shikilia kila noti thabiti, ibadilishe kwa sauti ndogo na kubwa, na uvute pumzi kabla hewa haijaisha.
Wimbi la kawaida katika kimo cha sauti
Kuimba chini kidogo ya kimo sahihi

rows.source: Vibrato is a gentle, even wave around the note, a few times a second.
rows.translation: Vibrato ni wimbi laini lenye usawa kuzunguka noti, mara chache kwa sekunde.

rows.source: To sing louder, what do you add?
rows.translation: Kuimba kwa sauti kubwa zaidi, unaongeza nini?

rows.source: Breath energy makes a bigger sound without strain.
rows.translation: Nguvu ya pumzi huleta sauti kubwa zaidi bila kujikaza.

rows.source: Play the melody, or strum the chords and sing
rows.translation: Piga melodi, au piga kodi na uimbe

rows.source: Six famous tunes, one note at a time, on the top strings. Slow tempos, big wins.
rows.translation: Melodi sita maarufu, noti moja baada ya nyingine, kwenye nyuzi za juu. Tempo za polepole, mafanikio makubwa.

rows.source: In 1877, Thomas Edison recited this rhyme to test his new phonograph. The tune uses C and D on string 2, then open E, and G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: Mwaka 1877, Thomas Edison alikariri shairi hili kujaribu fonografu yake mpya. Melodi hutumia C na D kwenye uzi 2, kisha E wazi, na G kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 1.

rows.source: E D C D E E E: open string 1, then string 2 at frets 3 and 1, and back.
rows.translation: E D C D E E E: uzi 1 wazi, kisha uzi 2 kwenye freti 3 na 1, na kurudi.

rows.source: D D D at fret 3 on string 2. Then open E, and G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: D D D kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 2. Kisha E wazi, na G kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 1.

rows.source: This melody was first printed in France in 1761, and Mozart later wrote twelve variations on it. It leaps up, then steps down across strings 2 and 3.
rows.translation: Melodi hii ilichapishwa kwanza Ufaransa mwaka 1761, na baadaye Mozart aliandika matoleo kumi na mawili yake. Huruka juu, kisha hushuka kwa hatua kupitia nyuzi 2 na 3.

rows.source: Open G, a leap up to D at fret 3 on string 2, open E, and back to D.
rows.translation: G wazi, mruko juu hadi D kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 2, E wazi, na kurudi D.

rows.source: Step down in pairs: C at fret 1, open B, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G.
rows.translation: Shuka kwa jozi: C kwenye freti 1, B wazi, A kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 3, G wazi.

rows.source: Which other song uses this same tune?
rows.translation: Wimbo upi mwingine hutumia melodi hiyohiyo?

rows.source: The alphabet song and Baa, Baa, Black Sheep both borrow this French melody.
rows.translation: Wimbo wa alfabeti na Baa, Baa, Black Sheep zote hutumia melodi hii ya Kifaransa.

rows.source: Beethoven finished his Ninth Symphony in 1824, and this melody is now the anthem of the European Union. Here you'll play the whole tune, middle section included.
rows.translation: Beethoven alimaliza Simfoni yake ya Tisa mwaka 1824, na melodi hii sasa ni wimbo rasmi wa Umoja wa Ulaya. Hapa utapiga melodi nzima, pamoja na sehemu ya katikati.

rows.source: The opening: E E F G G F E D, one step at a time.
rows.translation: Mwanzo: E E F G G F E D, hatua moja baada ya nyingine.

rows.source: In the middle section, E and F share a single beat. Count one, two-and, three, four, and play E on two and F on the and.
rows.translation: Katika sehemu ya katikati, E na F hushiriki pigo moja. Hesabu moja, mbili-na, tatu, nne, upige E kwenye mbili na F kwenye na.

rows.source: The middle: quick E F pairs on string 1, then down to open G on string 3.
rows.translation: Katikati: jozi za haraka E F kwenye uzi 1, kisha shuka hadi G wazi kwenye uzi 3.

rows.source: Frère Jacques is a French round, first printed around 1780: a second player starts the same tune two bars later, and the parts fit together.
rows.translation: Frère Jacques ni kanoni ya Kifaransa, iliyochapishwa kwanza karibu 1780: mpigaji wa pili huanza melodi ileile vipimo viwili baadaye, na sehemu zake hulingana.

rows.source: In a round, the second player…
Everyone plays the same melody, each starting a little later. The phrases are built to fit on top of each other.
rows.translation: Kila mtu hupiga melodi ileile, kila mmoja akianza baadaye kidogo. Vishazi vimeundwa vilingane vinapopigwa pamoja.

rows.source: The quick part: D E D C on strings 2 and 1, then B and G.
rows.translation: Sehemu ya haraka: D E D C kwenye nyuzi 2 na 1, kisha B na G.

rows.source: The ending dips from open G to open D on string 4, then comes back.
rows.translation: Mwisho hushuka kutoka G wazi hadi D wazi kwenye uzi 4, kisha hurudi.

rows.source: James Lord Pierpont published this song in 1857 as One Horse Open Sleigh. You'll play its famous chorus, all on strings 1 and 2.
rows.translation: James Lord Pierpont alichapisha wimbo huu mwaka 1857 kwa jina One Horse Open Sleigh. Utapiga kiitikio chake maarufu, chote kwenye nyuzi 1 na 2.

rows.source: Open E, G at fret 3, down to C and D on string 2, then home to E.
rows.translation: E wazi, G kwenye freti 3, shuka hadi C na D kwenye uzi 2, kisha rudi E.

rows.source: In that phrase, C rings for a beat and a half and D slips in on the and of four. Count one, two, three, four-and.
rows.translation: Katika kishazi hicho, C hulia kwa pigo moja na nusu, na D huingia kwenye na ya nne. Hesabu moja, mbili, tatu, nne-na.

rows.source: The second line sits on F at fret 1, then settles onto open E.
rows.translation: Mstari wa pili hukaa kwenye F katika freti 1, kisha hutulia kwenye E wazi.

rows.source: This traditional spiritual became a jazz standard after Louis Armstrong recorded it in 1938. It uses C, D, E, F and G on strings 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Wimbo huu wa kiroho wa jadi ukawa maarufu katika jazz baada ya Louis Armstrong kuurekodi mwaka 1938. Hutumia C, D, E, F na G kwenye nyuzi 2 na 1.

rows.source: The opening: C on string 2, then E, F and G climbing string 1.
rows.translation: Mwanzo: C kwenye uzi 2, kisha E, F na G zikipanda uzi 1.

rows.source: No new notes here: all six tunes from this unit, each a little faster than before. Name the opening by ear, then play.
rows.translation: Hakuna noti mpya hapa: melodi zote sita za kitengo hiki, kila moja haraka zaidi kidogo kuliko awali. Tambua mwanzo kwa sikio, kisha upige.

rows.source: Campfire songs and a sea song, with easy chords to strum on the simplest ones.
rows.translation: Nyimbo za kuimba motoni na wimbo wa baharini, zenye kodi rahisi za kupiga katika zilizo rahisi zaidi.

rows.source: Stephen Foster published this song in 1848, and gold seekers heading to California made it their anthem. The verse sits on strings 3, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Stephen Foster alichapisha wimbo huu mwaka 1848, na watafuta dhahabu walioelekea California wakaufanya wimbo wao. Ubeti uko kwenye nyuzi 3, 2 na 1.

rows.source: Open B, D at fret 3, open E, then back down to open G and A at fret 2.
rows.translation: B wazi, D kwenye freti 3, E wazi, kisha shuka hadi G wazi na A kwenye freti 2.

rows.source: The last bar: B B A A, then home to open G.
rows.translation: Kipimo cha mwisho: B B A A, kisha kurudi G wazi.

rows.source: G sounds like home, and D7 pulls back toward it. The verse is three bars of G, one of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
rows.translation: G husikika kama msingi, na D7 huvutia kurudi kwake. Ubeti ni vipimo vitatu vya G, kimoja cha D7, viwili vya G, kisha D7 na G.

rows.source: Stephen Foster wrote this racing song in 1850, two years after Oh! Susanna. It uses the same notes and the same two chords.
rows.translation: Stephen Foster alitunga wimbo huu wa mbio mwaka 1850, miaka miwili baada ya Oh! Susanna. Hutumia noti zilezile na kodi mbili zilezile.

rows.source: D D B D, up to open E, then D and B. Strings 2 and 1.
rows.translation: D D B D, panda hadi E wazi, kisha D na B. Nyuzi 2 na 1.

rows.source: Twice in the first line, a quick B leads into an A that rings for three beats. Pick the A once and let it ring.
rows.translation: Mara mbili katika mstari wa kwanza, B ya haraka huongoza hadi A inayolia kwa mapigo matatu. Piga A mara moja, uiache ilie.

rows.source: This farmyard song was first printed in 1917, but people sang versions of it long before. Its tune reaches down to D and E on string 4.
rows.translation: Wimbo huu wa shambani ulichapishwa kwanza mwaka 1917, lakini watu waliimba matoleo yake muda mrefu kabla. Melodi yake hushuka hadi D na E kwenye uzi 4.

rows.source: Open G three times, down to open D, E at fret 2 on string 4, back to D.
rows.translation: G wazi mara tatu, shuka hadi D wazi, E kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 4, rudi D.

rows.source: Then up: open B twice, A at fret 2 on string 3, and home to open G.
rows.translation: Kisha juu: B wazi mara mbili, A kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 3, na kurudi G wazi.

rows.source: Here each chord lasts two beats, so the strum counts one, two. The order is G, G, C, G, then G, D7, G, G. Change early.
rows.translation: Hapa kila kodi hudumu mapigo mawili, hivyo upigaji wa nyuzi huhesabiwa moja, mbili. Mpangilio ni G, G, C, G, kisha G, D7, G, G. Badili mapema.

rows.source: British soldiers first sang this tune to mock American colonists. By the end of the Revolution, the Americans had made it their own.
rows.translation: Wanajeshi wa Uingereza waliimba melodi hii kwanza kuwakejeli wakoloni wa Marekani. Kufikia mwisho wa Mapinduzi, Wamarekani walikuwa wameufanya wao.

rows.source: C C D E, C E D, then a drop to open G on string 3.
rows.translation: C C D E, C E D, kisha shuka hadi G wazi kwenye uzi 3.

rows.source: The first half ends on B. How does that feel?
rows.translation: Nusu ya kwanza inaishia kwenye B. Inahisiwaje?

rows.source: B sits just below C and leans toward it. The second half answers by landing on C.
rows.translation: B iko chini tu ya C na huvutia kuielekea. Nusu ya pili hujibu kwa kutua kwenye C.

rows.source: The last line: down from F on string 1, dip to open G, then climb back to C.
rows.translation: Mstari wa mwisho: shuka kutoka F kwenye uzi 1, fika G wazi, kisha panda tena hadi C.

rows.source: The chorus sits low: A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, then F and E on string 4 and C on string 5.
rows.translation: Kiitikio kiko chini: A kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 3, B wazi, kisha F na E kwenye uzi 4 na C kwenye uzi 5.

rows.source: George Poulton published this ballad in 1861. Nearly a century later, its melody became the tune of Love Me Tender.
rows.translation: George Poulton alichapisha baladi hii mwaka 1861. Karibu karne moja baadaye, melodi yake ikawa ya Love Me Tender.

rows.source: Up to C, down to open B and back, then D, a dip to A, and D again.
rows.translation: Panda hadi C, shuka hadi B wazi na urudi, kisha D, shuka hadi A, na D tena.

rows.source: Aura Lee is a slow ballad. Keep each finger down until the next note sounds, so the notes join smoothly.
rows.translation: Aura Lee ni baladi ya polepole. Acha kila kidole chini hadi noti inayofuata isikike, ili noti ziungane kwa ulaini.

rows.source: The high part: open E, F at fret 1, then down to D, A, and D again.
rows.translation: Sehemu ya juu: E wazi, F kwenye freti 1, kisha shuka hadi D, A, na D tena.

rows.source: This song from the north of England is about Bobby Shafto, gone to sea. Its words were in print by 1805, and fiddlers played its tune for dances by 1770.
rows.translation: Wimbo huu kutoka kaskazini mwa Uingereza unamhusu Bobby Shafto, aliyeenda baharini. Maneno yake yalikuwa yamechapishwa kufikia 1805, na wapiga fiddle walipiga melodi yake kwa ngoma kufikia 1770.

rows.source: Open B, D at fret 3, back to B and open G, then B, D and B again.
rows.translation: B wazi, D kwenye freti 3, rudi B na G wazi, kisha B, D na B tena.

rows.source: The second line dips to F sharp: string 4, fret 4, with your little finger. Keep your hand over the first four frets so it's ready.
rows.translation: Mstari wa pili hushuka hadi F diesi: uzi 4, freti 4, kwa kidole kidogo. Weka mkono juu ya freti nne za kwanza ili uwe tayari.

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, C at fret 1 on string 2, A, down to F sharp, and back up.
rows.translation: A kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 3, C kwenye freti 1 ya uzi 2, A, shuka hadi F diesi, na kupanda tena.

rows.source: The first three lines end the same way: two notes of one beat, then one of two beats. Gone to sea, on his knee, marry me.
rows.translation: Mistari mitatu ya kwanza huisha vivyo hivyo: noti mbili za pigo moja, kisha moja ya mapigo mawili. Gone to sea, on his knee, marry me.

rows.source: The verse needs only the two chords from Oh! Susanna: two bars of G, two of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
rows.translation: Ubeti unahitaji kodi mbili tu za Oh! Susanna: vipimo viwili vya G, viwili vya D7, viwili vya G, kisha D7 na G.
Orodha ya nyimbo za kuimba motoni

rows.source: No new notes or chords: all six songs from this unit, one after another, each a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Hakuna noti wala kodi mpya: nyimbo zote sita za kitengo hiki, moja baada ya nyingine, kila moja haraka zaidi kidogo kuliko awali.
Melodi kuu za muziki wa klasiki I

rows.source: Famous themes by Pachelbel, Dvořák, Brahms, Petzold, Grieg and Beethoven, in first position.
rows.translation: Melodi maarufu za Pachelbel, Dvořák, Brahms, Petzold, Grieg na Beethoven, katika nafasi ya kwanza.

rows.source: Johann Pachelbel wrote this canon over 300 years ago. Its bass repeats the same eight notes the whole way through while violins weave melodies above.
rows.translation: Johann Pachelbel alitunga kanoni hii zaidi ya miaka 300 iliyopita. Besi yake hurudia noti nane zilezile muda wote, huku violini zikisuka melodi juu yake.

rows.source: The bass, moved up an octave: D, A, B, F sharp, G, D, G, A.
rows.translation: Besi, iliyopandishwa oktava moja: D, A, B, F diesi, G, D, G, A.

rows.source: What does the bass do all through the Canon?
rows.translation: Besi hufanya nini katika Canon nzima?

rows.source: Plays a new tune each time
A repeating bass like this is called a ground. Everything else in the piece is built on top of it.
rows.translation: Besi inayojirudia hivi huitwa ground. Kila kitu kingine katika kipande hujengwa juu yake.

rows.source: A sharp is one fret above its letter. The melody uses C sharp on string 2, fret 2, and F sharp on string 4, fret 4. Reach that one with your little finger.
rows.translation: Diesi iko freti moja juu ya herufi yake. Melodi hutumia C diesi kwenye uzi 2, freti 2, na F diesi kwenye uzi 4, freti 4. Fikia hiyo kwa kidole kidogo.

rows.source: The first violin line: down from F sharp on string 1, then back up to C sharp.
rows.translation: Mstari wa kwanza wa violini: shuka kutoka F diesi kwenye uzi 1, kisha panda tena hadi C diesi.

rows.source: Antonín Dvořák wrote this theme for English horn in 1893, in his Symphony From the New World, while he was living in New York.
rows.translation: Antonín Dvořák alitunga melodi hii kwa ala ya English horn mwaka 1893, katika Simfoni yake From the New World, alipokuwa akiishi New York.

rows.source: Open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, back to E, then D and C on string 2.
rows.translation: E wazi, G kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 1, rudi E, kisha D na C kwenye uzi 2.

rows.source: Most bars open with a long note and a quick one. Count one, two-and, three: the quick note lands on the and of two.
rows.translation: Vipimo vingi huanza kwa noti ndefu na ya haraka. Hesabu moja, mbili-na, tatu: noti ya haraka huangukia na ya mbili.

rows.source: The ending: D, E, D, then settle on C and let it ring.
rows.translation: Mwisho: D, E, D, kisha tulia kwenye C na uiache ilie.

rows.source: Johannes Brahms wrote this lullaby in 1868 for a friend's newborn son. It sways in three, like a cradle: a long note, then two quick ones.
rows.translation: Johannes Brahms alitunga wimbo huu wa kubembeleza mwaka 1868 kwa mwana mchanga wa rafiki yake. Unayumba kwa mapigo matatu, kama bembea ya mtoto: noti ndefu, kisha mbili za haraka.

rows.source: The opening rocks between open B and D at fret 3 on string 2.
rows.translation: Mwanzo huyumba kati ya B wazi na D kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 2.

rows.source: Open G on string 3, then the same note an octave higher: G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: G wazi kwenye uzi 3, kisha noti ileile oktava moja juu: G kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 1.
Kutoka daftari la familia ya Bach

rows.source: This minuet appears in a 1725 notebook Bach gave his wife, Anna Magdalena. Scholars now credit it to his fellow composer Christian Petzold.
rows.translation: Minuet hii ipo katika daftari la 1725 ambalo Bach alimpa mkewe, Anna Magdalena. Wanazuoni sasa wanamtambua mtunzi mwenzake Christian Petzold kama aliyeitunga.

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, then climb from open G: A, B, C, D. Then two open Gs.
rows.translation: D kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 2, kisha panda kutoka G wazi: A, B, C, D. Kisha G mbili wazi.

rows.source: A minuet is a dance in three. Most bars start with a long beat, then quick pairs: one, two-and, three-and.
rows.translation: Minuet ni ngoma ya mapigo matatu. Vipimo vingi huanza kwa pigo refu, kisha jozi za haraka: moja, mbili-na, tatu-na.

rows.source: Open E, back to C and D on string 2, then E, F sharp and G on string 1.
rows.translation: E wazi, rudi C na D kwenye uzi 2, kisha E, F diesi na G kwenye uzi 1.

rows.source: The ending: A B A G, then F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, and home to G.
rows.translation: Mwisho: A B A G, kisha F diesi kwenye freti 4 ya uzi 4, na kurudi G.

rows.source: The second section starts low: open B, A, open D, then C sharp at fret 4 and B at fret 2 on string 5, and open A.
rows.translation: Sehemu ya pili huanza chini: B wazi, A, D wazi, kisha C diesi freti 4 na B freti 2 kwenye uzi 5, na A wazi.

rows.source: In the Hall of the Mountain King
rows.translation: In the Hall of the Mountain King

rows.source: Grieg wrote this for the play Peer Gynt in 1875. It pictures trolls in their king's hall, and it starts quietly and keeps speeding up.
rows.translation: Grieg alitunga hii kwa tamthilia Peer Gynt mwaka 1875. Inaonyesha troll katika ukumbi wa mfalme wao, inaanza kwa sauti ndogo na kuendelea kuongeza kasi.

rows.source: Climb from open string 6: F sharp at fret 2, G at fret 3, open A, B at fret 2.
rows.translation: Panda kutoka uzi 6 wazi: F diesi kwenye freti 2, G kwenye freti 3, A wazi, B kwenye freti 2.

rows.source: The creeping part: A sharp at fret 1 on string 5, then open A with F at fret 1 on string 6.
rows.translation: Sehemu ya kunyemelea: A diesi kwenye freti 1 ya uzi 5, kisha A wazi na F kwenye freti 1 ya uzi 6.

rows.source: Where is A sharp on string 5?
rows.translation: A diesi iko wapi kwenye uzi 5?

rows.source: A sharp is one fret above A, and A is open string 5. So A sharp is fret 1.
rows.translation: A diesi iko freti moja juu ya A, na A ni uzi 5 wazi. Kwa hiyo A diesi ni freti 1.

rows.source: Beethoven wrote this piano piece in 1810, but it wasn't published until 1867, forty years after he died. This simplified version keeps the famous opening.
rows.translation: Beethoven alitunga kipande hiki cha piano mwaka 1810, lakini hakikuchapishwa hadi 1867, miaka arobaini baada ya kifo chake. Toleo hili lililorahisishwa linahifadhi mwanzo maarufu.

rows.source: Rock between open E and D sharp at fret 4 on string 2, then walk down B, D, C to A.
rows.translation: Yumba kati ya E wazi na D diesi kwenye freti 4 ya uzi 2, kisha shuka B, D, C hadi A.
Noti za haraka kwa makundi ya tatu

rows.source: Each bar has three beats. After the long A comes a short rest, then three quick notes climb: C, E, A. Lift your finger for the rest, but keep counting.
rows.translation: Kila kipimo kina mapigo matatu. Baada ya A ndefu huja pumziko fupi, kisha noti tatu za haraka hupanda: C, E, A. Inua kidole wakati wa pumziko, lakini endelea kuhesabu.

rows.source: A, then C on string 5, E and A. Then B, E, G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, and B.
rows.translation: A, kisha C kwenye uzi 5, E na A. Kisha B, E, G diesi kwenye freti 1 ya uzi 3, na B.

rows.source: The middle: each phrase dips to a low note, then steps down. E G F E, D F E D, C E D C.
rows.translation: Katikati: kila kishazi hushuka hadi noti ya chini, kisha hushuka kwa hatua. E G F E, D F E D, C E D C.

rows.source: No new notes: the six themes from this unit, from Pachelbel to Beethoven, each a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Hakuna noti mpya: melodi kuu sita za kitengo hiki, kutoka Pachelbel hadi Beethoven, kila moja haraka zaidi kidogo kuliko awali.

rows.source: Which of these pieces is in three?
rows.translation: Kipande kipi kati ya hivi kina mapigo matatu?

rows.source: A minuet is a dance in three. The Canon and the trolls' march both count in four.
rows.translation: Minuet ni ngoma ya mapigo matatu. Canon na maandamano ya troll zote huhesabiwa kwa manne.
Tenzi na nyimbo za jadi za Marekani

rows.source: A Gold Rush ballad, two beloved hymns and a Shaker song from America's songbook.
rows.translation: Baladi ya msako wa dhahabu, tenzi mbili pendwa na wimbo wa Shaker kutoka urithi wa nyimbo za Marekani.

rows.source: This American song was published in 1884 and looks back to the California Gold Rush of 1849. It's in three, on strings 3, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Wimbo huu wa Marekani ulichapishwa mwaka 1884 na hukumbuka msako wa dhahabu California wa 1849. Una mapigo matatu, kwenye nyuzi 3, 2 na 1.

rows.source: Clementine starts with two quick notes before beat one. What are they called?
rows.translation: Clementine huanza kwa noti mbili za haraka kabla ya pigo la kwanza. Huitwaje?

rows.source: A pickup is a few notes that lead into the first strong beat. Here they fall on the and of beat three.
rows.translation: Noti za utangulizi ni noti chache zinazoongoza hadi pigo la kwanza lenye mkazo. Hapa huangukia na ya pigo la tatu.

rows.source: The turn in the middle: G at fret 3 on string 1, down to D, then back up to F.
rows.translation: Mgeuko wa katikati: G kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 1, shuka hadi D, kisha panda tena hadi F.

rows.source: John Newton wrote the words in 1779. The tune, called New Britain, was first printed in 1829 and joined to his words in 1835.
rows.translation: John Newton aliandika maneno mwaka 1779. Melodi, inayoitwa New Britain, ilichapishwa kwanza mwaka 1829 na kuunganishwa na maneno yake mwaka 1835.

rows.source: The high line: up to D at fret 3 on string 2, then B G, B A, G E D.
rows.translation: Mstari wa juu: panda hadi D kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 2, kisha B G, B A, G E D.

rows.source: Samuel Francis Smith wrote these American words in 1831, to a tune Britain already sang as God Save the King.
rows.translation: Samuel Francis Smith aliandika maneno haya ya Marekani mwaka 1831, kwa melodi ambayo Uingereza tayari iliimba kama God Save the King.

rows.source: A dot makes a note half again as long. In bar two, F sharp rings for a beat and a half, G slips in on the and of two, and A lands on three.
rows.translation: Nukta huongeza muda wa noti kwa nusu yake. Katika kipimo cha pili, F diesi hulia pigo moja na nusu, G huingia kwenye na ya mbili, na A hutua kwenye tatu.

rows.source: The last line: B C B A G, then B C D, up to open E, and down C B A G.
rows.translation: Mstari wa mwisho: B C B A G, kisha B C D, panda hadi E wazi, na ushuke C B A G.

rows.source: Joseph Brackett wrote Simple Gifts in 1848 for the Shakers, who danced as they sang. Aaron Copland later built part of his ballet Appalachian Spring around it.
rows.translation: Joseph Brackett alitunga Simple Gifts mwaka 1848 kwa Washaker, waliocheza walipoimba. Baadaye Aaron Copland alijenga sehemu ya baleti yake Appalachian Spring juu yake.

rows.source: The second part starts high: G at fret 3 on string 1, then E D, and E F E D C.
rows.translation: Sehemu ya pili huanza juu: G kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 1, kisha E D, na E F E D C.

rows.source: Two notes share each beat in this tune. How do you count them?
rows.translation: Noti mbili hushiriki kila pigo katika melodi hii. Unazihesabuje?

rows.source: Two even notes per beat are eighth notes. Say the number on the first and "and" on the second.
rows.translation: Noti mbili sawa kwa pigo ni noti za nane. Sema namba kwenye ya kwanza na "na" kwenye ya pili.

rows.source: No new ideas: the four songs from this unit, each a little faster than before. Three of them sway in three. Simple Gifts dances in four.
rows.translation: Hakuna mambo mapya: nyimbo nne za kitengo hiki, kila moja haraka zaidi kidogo kuliko awali. Tatu huyumba kwa mapigo matatu. Simple Gifts hucheza kwa manne.

rows.source: What does a dot after a note do?
rows.translation: Nukta baada ya noti hufanya nini?

rows.source: Makes it half again as long
A dotted quarter lasts a beat and a half. The note after it is usually quick, to fill out the beat.
rows.translation: Noti robo yenye nukta hudumu pigo moja na nusu. Noti inayofuata kwa kawaida ni ya haraka, ili kutimiza pigo.

rows.source: Carols and a New Year's song, in two, three, four and six.
rows.translation: Nyimbo za Krismasi na wimbo wa Mwaka Mpya, kwa mapigo mawili, matatu, manne na sita.
Wimbo wa machipuko ukawa wa Krismasi

rows.source: This tune was printed in 1582 in Piae Cantiones, a songbook from Finland, as a song about spring. John Mason Neale gave it Christmas words in 1853.
rows.translation: Melodi hii ilichapishwa mwaka 1582 katika Piae Cantiones, kitabu cha nyimbo cha Finland, kama wimbo wa majira ya machipuko. John Mason Neale aliipa maneno ya Krismasi mwaka 1853.

rows.source: The last line climbs from open D on string 4: E, F sharp at fret 4, open G, then A.
rows.translation: Mstari wa mwisho hupanda kutoka D wazi kwenye uzi 4: E, F diesi kwenye freti 4, G wazi, kisha A.

rows.source: Then from D at fret 3 on string 2, step down to G, touch C, and land on G.
rows.translation: Kisha kutoka D kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 2, shuka kwa hatua hadi G, gusa C, utue G.
Melodi ya Mwaka Mpya ya Wales

rows.source: Deck the Halls comes from Nos Galan, a Welsh New Year's Eve song from the 1700s. The English words came in 1862.
rows.translation: Deck the Halls inatoka Nos Galan, wimbo wa mkesha wa Mwaka Mpya wa Wales wa karne iliyoanza 1700. Maneno ya Kiingereza yalikuja mwaka 1862.

rows.source: The third line climbs: C sharp at fret 2 on string 2, D, then E, F sharp and G on string 1.
rows.translation: Mstari wa tatu hupanda: C diesi kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 2, D, kisha E, F diesi na G kwenye uzi 1.

rows.source: A7 needs two fingers on fret 2: finger 1 on string 4, finger 3 on string 2. Start your strum on string 5. That C sharp on string 2 is the one the melody climbs through.
rows.translation: A7 inahitaji vidole viwili kwenye freti 2: kidole 1 kwenye uzi 4, kidole 3 kwenye uzi 2. Anza kupiga kutoka uzi 5. C diesi hiyo kwenye uzi 2 ndiyo melodi hupitia inapopanda.

rows.source: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
rows.translation: We Wish You a Merry Christmas

rows.source: This carol comes from England's West Country, where singers went door to door on winter nights and hoped for a treat in return.
rows.translation: Wimbo huu wa Krismasi unatoka West Country nchini Uingereza, ambako waimbaji walipita nyumba kwa nyumba usiku wa baridi wakitarajia kupewa kitu kizuri kwa shukrani.

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2 and open string 4 are both D. How far apart are they?
rows.translation: D kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 2 na uzi 4 wazi zote ni D. Zimetengana kwa kiasi gani?

rows.source: An octave is the same letter, eight steps higher or lower. The two Ds blend, but one sounds brighter.
rows.translation: Oktava ni herufi ileile, hatua nane juu au chini. D hizo mbili huchanganyika, lakini moja husikika angavu zaidi.

rows.source: B A G, then leap from D at fret 3 on string 2 down to open D. Then E, A, F sharp, G.
rows.translation: B A G, kisha ruka kutoka D kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 2 hadi D wazi chini. Kisha E, A, F diesi, G.

rows.source: Auld lang syne is Scots for old long since, meaning days gone by. Robert Burns sent the words to a songbook in 1788, and this melody was printed with them in 1799.
rows.translation: Auld lang syne ni usemi wa Kiskoti unaomaanisha siku za kale zilizopita. Robert Burns alituma maneno kwa kitabu cha nyimbo mwaka 1788, na melodi hii ilichapishwa pamoja nayo mwaka 1799.

rows.source: The chorus reaches up: B, D, open E, then G at fret 3 on string 1. Back down: D, B B G.
rows.translation: Kiitikio hufikia juu: B, D, E wazi, kisha G kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 1. Kushuka tena: D, B B G.

rows.source: Lowell Mason arranged this tune in 1839, borrowing phrases from Handel's Messiah. It opens with a G major scale, straight down from G to G.
rows.translation: Lowell Mason alipanga melodi hii mwaka 1839, akitumia vishazi kutoka Messiah ya Handel. Huanza na skeli ya G meja, ikishuka moja kwa moja kutoka G hadi G.

rows.source: This carol counts in two. In bar one, G fills beat one, F sharp takes most of beat two, and E slips in at the very end.
