rows.translation: Wimbo huu wa Krismasi huhesabiwa kwa mbili. Katika kipimo cha kwanza, G hujaza pigo la kwanza, F diesi huchukua sehemu kubwa ya la pili, na E huingia mwishoni kabisa.

rows.source: The middle repeats open B and steps up to D, then repeats A at fret 2 on string 3 and steps up to C.
rows.translation: Katikati hurudia B wazi na kupanda kwa hatua hadi D, kisha hurudia A kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 3 na kupanda hadi C.

rows.source: Franz Xaver Gruber wrote Silent Night in 1818 for Christmas Eve in Oberndorf, Austria. At its first performance, the only accompaniment was a guitar.
rows.translation: Franz Xaver Gruber alitunga Silent Night mwaka 1818 kwa mkesha wa Krismasi huko Oberndorf, Austria. Katika onyesho la kwanza, gitaa pekee ndilo lilisindikiza.
Noti sita za nane kwa kipimo

rows.source: Silent Night is in 6/8: six quick counts per bar, grouped one-two-three, four-five-six. Each group sways like one slow beat.
rows.translation: Silent Night iko katika 6/8: hesabu sita za haraka kwa kipimo, zikipangwa moja-mbili-tatu, nne-tano-sita. Kila kundi huyumba kama pigo moja la polepole.

rows.source: The ending climbs to G at fret 3 on string 1, rings on F sharp, then walks down to open D.
rows.translation: Mwisho hupanda hadi G kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 1, hulia kwenye F diesi, kisha hushuka kwa hatua hadi D wazi.

rows.source: D uses the top four strings. Finger 1 on string 3, fret 2; finger 2 on string 1, fret 2; finger 3 on string 2, fret 3. Strum from open string 4.
rows.translation: D hutumia nyuzi nne za juu. Kidole 1 kwenye uzi 3, freti 2; kidole 2 kwenye uzi 1, freti 2; kidole 3 kwenye uzi 2, freti 3. Piga kutoka uzi 4 wazi.

rows.source: Joseph Mohr (1818), English by John Freeman Young (1859)
rows.translation: Joseph Mohr (1818), Kiingereza na John Freeman Young (1859)

rows.source: No new ideas: six songs in two, three, four and six, each a little faster than before. Feel where every bar begins.
rows.translation: Hakuna mambo mapya: nyimbo sita kwa mapigo mawili, matatu, manne na sita, kila moja haraka zaidi kidogo kuliko awali. Hisi kila kipimo kinapoanza.
Wimbo upi wa Krismasi unaanza hivi?

rows.source: Silent Night is in 6/8. How are its six counts grouped?
rows.translation: Silent Night iko katika 6/8. Hesabu zake sita hupangwa katika makundi gani?

rows.source: 6/8 sways in two big beats, each split into three: one-two-three, four-five-six.
rows.translation: 6/8 huyumba kwa mapigo mawili makubwa, kila moja likigawanywa mara tatu: moja-mbili-tatu, nne-tano-sita.
Melodi kuu za muziki wa klasiki II

rows.source: Two Mozart themes and two old airs: rests, minor keys, a wide range and third position.
rows.translation: Melodi kuu mbili za Mozart na melodi mbili za kale: mapumziko, funguo za minori, wigo mpana na nafasi ya tatu.

rows.source: Mozart finished this serenade for strings in 1787. Its opening leaps up through the notes of a G chord, then answers with the notes of D7.
rows.translation: Mozart alimaliza serenadi hii ya ala za nyuzi mwaka 1787. Mwanzo wake huruka juu kupitia noti za kodi ya G, kisha hujibu kwa noti za D7.

rows.source: A rest is a silent beat. Touch the string with your fretting fingers so the silence is crisp, then come back in exactly on time.
rows.translation: Pumziko ni pigo la ukimya. Gusa uzi kwa vidole vya freti ili ukimya uwe safi, kisha urudi kwa wakati sahihi kabisa.

rows.source: The answer: C at fret 1 on string 2, A at fret 2 on string 3, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, then open D.
rows.translation: Jibu: C kwenye freti 1 ya uzi 2, A kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 3, F diesi kwenye freti 4 ya uzi 4, kisha D wazi.

rows.source: The opening climbs through a chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Mwanzo hupanda kupitia kodi. Meja au minori?

rows.source: Greensleeves was sung in England by the 1580s, and Shakespeare mentions it in The Merry Wives of Windsor. Here it's in E minor, low and dark.
rows.translation: Greensleeves ilikuwa ikiimbwa Uingereza kufikia miaka ya 1580, na Shakespeare anaitaja katika The Merry Wives of Windsor. Hapa iko katika E minori, ya chini na yenye hisia nzito.

rows.source: In E minor, D sharp sits one fret below E and pulls toward it. Find D sharp at string 4, fret 1, and C sharp at string 5, fret 4.
rows.translation: Katika E minori, D diesi iko freti moja chini ya E na huvutia kuielekea. Tafuta D diesi kwenye uzi 4, freti 1, na C diesi kwenye uzi 5, freti 4.

rows.source: Each half ends: G, F sharp, E, then D sharp, C sharp, D sharp, and home to E.
rows.translation: Kila nusu huisha: G, F diesi, E, kisha D diesi, C diesi, D diesi, na kurudi E.

rows.source: The chorus starts high: D at fret 3 on string 2, C sharp at fret 2, open B, then down to open D.
rows.translation: Kiitikio huanza juu: D kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 2, C diesi kwenye freti 2, B wazi, kisha shuka hadi D wazi.

rows.source: Greensleeves is built on this chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Greensleeves imejengwa kwenye kodi hii. Meja au minori?

rows.source: This melody was first printed in George Petrie's collection of Irish music in 1855. The words of Danny Boy were set to it much later, in 1913.
rows.translation: Melodi hii ilichapishwa kwanza katika mkusanyiko wa muziki wa Ireland wa George Petrie mwaka 1855. Maneno ya Danny Boy yaliunganishwa nayo baadaye sana, mwaka 1913.

rows.source: The high point: three As, up to F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, then E E D B D, A F sharp D.
rows.translation: Kilele: A tatu, panda hadi F diesi kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 1, kisha E E D B D, A F diesi D.

rows.source: This tune runs from string 5 to string 1. What keeps every string in reach?
rows.translation: Melodi hii hutoka uzi 5 hadi uzi 1. Nini husaidia kufikia kila uzi?

rows.source: With your thumb low behind the neck, your fingers arch and reach from string 5 to string 1 without straining.
rows.translation: Gumba likiwa chini nyuma ya shingo, vidole hupinda na kufikia kutoka uzi 5 hadi uzi 1 bila kujikaza.

rows.source: Mozart finished his Symphony No. 40 in 1788. It's one of only two symphonies he wrote in a minor key, and it opens with this restless, sighing theme.
rows.translation: Mozart alimaliza Simfoni yake Na. 40 mwaka 1788. Ni mojawapo ya simfoni mbili tu alizotunga katika ufunguo wa minori, na inaanza kwa melodi hii kuu isiyotulia, yenye hisia ya kuugua.

rows.source: Slide your hand up so finger 1 rests at fret 3. Each finger now covers one fret: 3, 4, 5 and 6. Move your thumb up too, behind finger 2.
rows.translation: Telezesha mkono juu ili kidole 1 kikae kwenye freti 3. Sasa kila kidole hushughulikia freti moja: 3, 4, 5 na 6. Sogeza gumba juu pia, nyuma ya kidole 2.

rows.source: In third position, which finger plays fret 3?
rows.translation: Katika nafasi ya tatu, kidole kipi hupiga freti 3?

rows.source: A position is named for where finger 1 sits. In third position, finger 1 plays fret 3 and finger 4 reaches fret 6.
rows.translation: Nafasi hupewa jina kwa mahali kidole 1 kinapokaa. Katika nafasi ya tatu, kidole 1 hupiga freti 3 na kidole 4 hufikia freti 6.

rows.source: E flat at fret 4 and D at fret 3 on string 2, then finger 4 up to B flat at fret 6 on string 1.
rows.translation: E bemoli kwenye freti 4 na D freti 3 ya uzi 2, kisha kidole 4 hadi B bemoli freti 6 ya uzi 1.

rows.source: The last phrase: F sharp, reaching finger 1 back to fret 2. Then E flat, D, C at fret 5 on string 3, and B flat.
rows.translation: Kishazi cha mwisho: F diesi, rudisha kidole 1 freti 2. Kisha E bemoli, D, C freti 5 ya uzi 3, na B bemoli.

rows.source: No new ideas: two Mozart themes, two old airs and third position, each a little faster than before. Breathe between pieces.
rows.translation: Hakuna mambo mapya: melodi kuu mbili za Mozart, melodi mbili za kale na nafasi ya tatu, kila moja haraka zaidi kidogo kuliko awali. Vuta pumzi kati ya vipande.

rows.source: In E minor, which note leans up into E?
rows.translation: Katika E minori, noti ipi huvutia kupanda hadi E?

rows.source: D sharp sits one fret below E. That half step pulls hard toward home, which is why Greensleeves uses it at every cadence.
rows.translation: D diesi iko freti moja chini ya E. Nusu toni hiyo huvutia sana kurudi msingi, ndiyo maana Greensleeves huitumia katika kila kadensi.
Nyimbo asilia katika mitindo ya leo

rows.source: Five new songs on the open chords you know: campfire pop, a ballad, stomp-folk, reggae and country.
rows.translation: Nyimbo tano mpya kwa kodi wazi unazozijua: pop ya motoni, baladi, stomp-folk, reggae na country.

rows.source: Kite Weather is bright, easy pop: four chords on a loop, G, D, E minor and C, at a relaxed 88 beats per minute. Listen for the hook jumping up to F sharp in its second bar.
rows.translation: Kite Weather ni pop angavu rahisi: kodi nne katika mzunguko, G, D, E minori na C, kwa mapigo 88 kwa dakika yaliyo tulivu. Sikiliza kishazi cha kuvutia kikiruka hadi F diesi katika kipimo cha pili.

rows.source: Does the hook climb or fall at first?
rows.translation: Kishazi cha kuvutia huanza kwa kupanda au kushuka?

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B and back, then open E and F sharp at fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: D kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 2, B wazi na kurudi, kisha E wazi na F diesi kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 1.

rows.source: Porchlight drifts along at 70 beats per minute. A ballad is a slow song that tells a story, so give every chord room to ring. Listen for the long note that closes each line.
rows.translation: Porchlight husogea kwa mapigo 70 kwa dakika. Baladi ni wimbo wa polepole unaosimulia hadithi, hivyo ipe kila kodi nafasi ya kulia. Sikiliza noti ndefu inayofunga kila mstari.

rows.source: Does this phrase end at home?
The chorus climbs string 1: open E, F sharp at fret 2, G at fret 3, then steps back down to D.
rows.translation: Kiitikio hupanda uzi 1: E wazi, F diesi kwenye freti 2, G kwenye freti 3, kisha hushuka kwa hatua hadi D.
Folk ya kukanyaga na kupiga makofi

rows.source: Moth and Ember is the kind of song a whole room stomps along to: heavy downstrokes, a chant of a hook, 96 beats per minute. It starts dark in A minor and brightens on D.
rows.translation: Moth and Ember ni wimbo wa watu wote kukanyaga pamoja: mipigo mizito ya chini, kishazi cha kuvutia cha kuimba kwa pamoja, mapigo 96 kwa dakika. Huanza kwa hisia nzito katika A minori na kuwa angavu kwenye D.

rows.source: Climb A minor: A at fret 2 on string 3, C at fret 1 on string 2, open E. Then step back down.
rows.translation: Panda A minori: A kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 3, C kwenye freti 1 ya uzi 2, E wazi. Kisha shuka tena kwa hatua.

rows.source: The hook's second bar copies the first, a few notes higher. What is that called?
rows.translation: Kipimo cha pili cha kishazi cha kuvutia hunakili cha kwanza, noti chache juu. Hiyo huitwaje?

rows.source: A sequence repeats a melodic shape from a new starting note. It makes a hook easy to remember.
rows.translation: Mfuatano wa melodi hurudia umbo la melodi kutoka noti mpya ya kuanzia. Hufanya kishazi cha kuvutia kiwe rahisi kukumbuka.

rows.source: Low Tide Radio is laid-back reggae at 80 beats per minute. The guitar plays only on the and of each beat, a short chop called a skank, while bass and drums hold the beat.
rows.translation: Low Tide Radio ni reggae tulivu kwa mapigo 80 kwa dakika. Gitaa hupiga kwenye na ya kila pigo tu, chop fupi inayoitwa skank, huku besi na ngoma zikidumisha mapigo.

rows.source: Strum down on each and, then ease your fretting fingers off the strings so the chord stops. Chk, chk, chk, chk. The silence between chops is half the groove.
rows.translation: Piga chini kwenye kila na, kisha punguza mgandamizo wa vidole vya freti ili kodi inyamaze. Chk, chk, chk, chk. Ukimya kati ya chop ni nusu ya mdundo.

rows.source: Open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C sharp at fret 2, open B, then A at fret 2 on string 3.
rows.translation: E wazi, D kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 2, C diesi kwenye freti 2, B wazi, kisha A kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 3.

rows.source: Dust on the Dashboard rolls along at 100 beats per minute. Country players split the bar: boom, a bass note on beats one and three, then chick, a strum on two and four.
rows.translation: Dust on the Dashboard husogea kwa mapigo 100 kwa dakika. Wapiga country hugawa kipimo: boom, noti ya besi kwenye mapigo moja na tatu, kisha chick, mpigo wa nyuzi kwenye mbili na nne.
Piga noti msingi, kisha nyuzi pamoja

rows.source: On boom, pick only the chord's lowest note, its root: open string 5 for A, open string 4 for D, open string 6 for E. On chick, brush the thinner strings.
rows.translation: Kwenye boom, piga noti ya chini ya kodi tu, noti msingi: uzi 5 wazi kwa A, uzi 4 wazi kwa D, uzi 6 wazi kwa E. Kwenye chick, pitisha kijiti kwenye nyuzi nyembamba.

rows.source: Which string is the boom for a D chord?
rows.translation: Uzi upi ni boom kwa kodi ya D?

rows.source: D's root is open string 4, the same string a D strum starts from.
rows.translation: Noti msingi ya D ni uzi 4 wazi, uzi uleule ambao mpigo wa nyuzi wa D huanzia.

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, C sharp at fret 2 on string 2, then open E and F sharp at fret 2.
rows.translation: A freti 2 ya uzi 3, B wazi, C diesi freti 2 ya uzi 2, kisha E wazi na F diesi freti 2.

rows.source: No new chords or notes: the five songs from this unit, each a touch faster. Name each hook by ear, then play.
rows.translation: Hakuna kodi wala noti mpya: nyimbo tano za kitengo hiki, kila moja haraka zaidi kidogo. Tambua kila kishazi cha kuvutia kwa sikio, kisha upige.

rows.source: Which song's hook starts like this?
rows.translation: Kishazi cha kuvutia cha wimbo upi huanza hivi?

rows.source: In reggae, where does the guitar chop?
rows.translation: Katika reggae, gitaa hupiga chop wapi?

rows.source: On the and of each beat
The skank lands between the beats, while bass and drums hold the downbeats.
rows.translation: Skank huangukia kati ya mapigo, huku besi na ngoma zikidumisha mapigo makuu.
Uimbaji wa pamoja kwa kodi tatu

rows.source: Five songs on three chords each: a campfire chorus, a country two-step, a waltz, easy reggae and bedroom pop.
rows.translation: Nyimbo tano za kodi tatu kila moja: kiitikio cha motoni, country ya two-step, waltz, reggae rahisi na bedroom pop.

rows.source: Lantern Hill is a campfire song on three chords, G, C and D, at 92 beats per minute. The chorus is made for a crowd, so by the second time around, sing it out.
rows.translation: Lantern Hill ni wimbo wa kuimba motoni kwa kodi tatu, G, C na D, kwa mapigo 92 kwa dakika. Kiitikio kimeundwa kwa kundi, hivyo mara ya pili kikirudi, imba kwa sauti.

rows.source: Open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, open E again, then G at fret 3 on string 1 and back down.
rows.translation: E wazi, D kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 2, E wazi tena, kisha G kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 1 na kushuka tena.

rows.source: Gravel Road Two-Step is dance-hall country in A at 116 beats per minute. Pick the root on one and three, strum on two and four, and add a quick up after each strum.
rows.translation: Gravel Road Two-Step ni country ya ukumbi wa dansi katika A, kwa mapigo 116 kwa dakika. Piga noti msingi kwenye moja na tatu, nyuzi pamoja kwenye mbili na nne, uongeze mpigo wa juu wa haraka baada ya kila mpigo wa nyuzi.

rows.source: In a two-step, where do the bass notes fall?
rows.translation: Katika two-step, noti za besi huangukia wapi?

rows.source: The bass walks with the dancers' feet on one and three; the strums fill two and four.
rows.translation: Besi hufuata miguu ya wachezaji kwenye moja na tatu; mipigo ya nyuzi hujaza mbili na nne.

rows.source: F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, then C sharp at fret 2 and A on string 3.
rows.translation: F diesi kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 1, E wazi, D freti 3 ya uzi 2, kisha C diesi freti 2 na A kwenye uzi 3.

rows.source: First Frost counts in three at 108 beats per minute: one, two, three, with the weight on one. D, G and A carry it all, and every line ends on a long, held note.
rows.translation: First Frost huhesabiwa kwa matatu, mapigo 108 kwa dakika: moja, mbili, tatu, mkazo ukiwa kwenye moja. D, G na A hubeba yote, na kila mstari huisha kwa noti ndefu inayoshikiliwa.

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, D at fret 3 on string 2, twice. Then E, F sharp at fret 2, E, D and A.
rows.translation: G kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 1, D kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 2, mara mbili. Kisha E, F diesi freti 2, E, D na A.

rows.source: Hammock Season is easy reggae in C at 76 beats per minute. The guitar plays only on beats two and four: one short, bright upstroke on the top strings, then silence.
rows.translation: Hammock Season ni reggae rahisi katika C, mapigo 76 kwa dakika. Gitaa hupiga kwenye mapigo mbili na nne tu: mpigo mmoja mfupi angavu wa juu kwenye nyuzi za juu, kisha ukimya.

rows.source: Brush up across strings 1 to 3, then relax your fretting hand so the chord stops at once. Chk on two, chk on four. The quiet beats are what make it sway.
rows.translation: Pitisha kijiti juu kupitia nyuzi 1 hadi 3, kisha legeza mkono wa freti ili kodi inyamaze mara moja. Chk kwenye mbili, chk kwenye nne. Mapigo ya ukimya ndiyo huleta kuyumba.

rows.source: Glow-in-the-Dark Stars is soft bedroom pop at 84 beats per minute: E minor, C and G, strummed light. Most lines start just after the beat, so let them float in.
rows.translation: Glow-in-the-Dark Stars ni bedroom pop laini kwa mapigo 84 kwa dakika: E minori, C na G, nyuzi zikipigwa kwa upole. Mistari mingi huanza baada tu ya pigo, hivyo iache iingie kwa ulaini.

rows.source: Open E twice, G at fret 3 on string 1, open E, G again, then D at fret 3 on string 2.
rows.translation: E wazi mara mbili, G kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 1, E wazi, G tena, kisha D kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 2.

rows.source: E minor, C and G share one note. Which?
rows.translation: E minori, C na G zina noti moja ya pamoja. Ipi?

rows.source: E minor is E, G and B; C is C, E and G; G is G, B and D. G sits in all three, so the changes feel smooth.
rows.translation: E minori ni E, G na B; C ni C, E na G; G ni G, B na D. G iko katika zote tatu, hivyo mabadiliko huhisiwa laini.

rows.source: In reggae, where does the guitar play?
Reggae's guitar answers the beat: a short upstroke on two and four, silence in between.
rows.translation: Gitaa la reggae hujibu pigo: mpigo mfupi wa juu kwenye mbili na nne, ukimya katikati.
Pop za kodi nne za kuimba pamoja

rows.source: The four-chord loop five ways: two summer anthems, a roller-rink bop, a pop song in 6/8 and a stadium chorus.
rows.translation: Mzunguko wa kodi nne kwa namna tano: nyimbo mbili za kiangazi, bop ya kuteleza, pop ya 6/8 na kiitikio cha uwanjani.
Wimbo wa pamoja wa kodi nne

rows.source: Sparkler Season rides the most famous loop in pop: C, G, A minor and F, the one, five, six and four of C. Hundreds of hits share these chords; a new tune and new words make each one its own.
rows.translation: Sparkler Season hutumia mzunguko maarufu zaidi wa pop: C, G, A minori na F, yaani moja, tano, sita na nne za C. Mamia ya nyimbo maarufu hutumia kodi hizi; melodi na maneno mapya huipa kila moja upekee.

rows.source: The mini F covers strings 4 to 1: finger 1 flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1, finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 3 on string 4, fret 3.
rows.translation: F ndogo hutumia nyuzi 4 hadi 1: kidole 1 kimelala juu ya nyuzi 2 na 1 kwenye freti 1, kidole 2 kwenye uzi 3, freti 2, kidole 3 kwenye uzi 4, freti 3.
Pop ya zamani ya viwanja vya sketi

rows.source: Roller Rink is bright dance pop at 120 beats per minute: G, E minor, C and D, the one, six, four and five. Strum even eighths and feel the kick drum land on every beat.
rows.translation: Roller Rink ni pop changamfu ya kucheza, mapigo 120 kwa dakika: G, E minori, C na D, yaani moja, sita, nne na tano. Piga noti za nane kwa usawa na hisi ngoma ya besi katika kila pigo.
Ni kodi ipi ya E minori?

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open E, G at fret 3 on string 1 three times, F sharp at fret 2, open E.
rows.translation: D freti 3 uzi 2, E wazi, G freti 3 uzi 1 mara tatu, F diesi freti 2, E wazi.

rows.source: Echo Canyon plays E minor, C, G and D at 80 beats per minute. Big strum on one, let it ring, then build on three and four. The half-time beat makes it feel huge.
rows.translation: Echo Canyon hutumia E minori, C, G na D, mapigo 80 kwa dakika. Piga kwa nguvu kwenye moja, acha sauti iendelee, kisha ongeza nguvu kwenye tatu na nne. Mdundo wa half-time huupa uzito mkubwa.

rows.source: Kite Weather plays G, D, E minor and C. Echo Canyon plays E minor, C, G and D. What changed?
rows.translation: Kite Weather hutumia G, D, E minori na C. Echo Canyon hutumia E minori, C, G na D. Nini kimebadilika?

rows.source: Same four chords, same key. Starting on E minor puts the sad chord first, so the loop sounds darker.
rows.translation: Kodi zilezile nne, ufunguo uleule. Kuanzia E minori huweka kodi yenye huzuni mbele, hivyo mfuatano unaorudiwa husikika wenye huzuni zaidi.

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1 and open E, twice. Then G again and D at fret 3 on string 2, twice.
rows.translation: G freti 3 uzi 1 na E wazi, mara mbili. Kisha G tena na D freti 3 uzi 2, mara mbili.

rows.source: Open Windows sways in 6/8 at 120 counts a minute: six quick counts felt as two big swings. C, F, A minor and G roll under a chorus that opens wide.
rows.translation: Open Windows huyumba katika 6/8, hesabu 120 kwa dakika: hesabu sita za haraka zinazohisiwa kama miondoko miwili mikubwa. C, F, A minori na G huandamana na kiitikio kinachopanuka.

rows.source: C at fret 1 on string 2, D at fret 3, open E, F at fret 1 on string 1, E, G at fret 3, E, G, then C.
rows.translation: C freti 1 uzi 2, D freti 3, E wazi, F freti 1 uzi 1, E, G freti 3, E, G, kisha C.
Wimbo wa pamoja wa Ijumaa usiku

rows.source: Scoreboard Lights is a stadium anthem in D at 100 beats per minute: D, A, B minor and G, the same one, five, six, four loop in a new key. Drive steady eighths.
rows.translation: Scoreboard Lights ni wimbo wa kuimba pamoja uwanjani, katika D, mapigo 100 kwa dakika: D, A, B minori na G. Ni mfuatano uleule wa moja, tano, sita, nne katika ufunguo mpya. Piga noti za nane bila kuyumba.

rows.source: This B minor uses the top four strings only: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1. The full barre comes later.
rows.translation: B minori hii hutumia nyuzi nne za juu pekee: freti 4 kwenye nyuzi 4 na 3, freti 3 kwenye uzi 2, freti 2 kwenye uzi 1. Bare kamili itakuja baadaye.

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, D at fret 3 on string 2, then G at fret 3 on string 1, F sharp, open E.
rows.translation: A freti 2 uzi 3, B wazi, D freti 3 uzi 2, kisha G freti 3 uzi 1, F diesi, E wazi.
Seti ya nyimbo za pop za pamoja

rows.source: Which of these is the four-chord loop in C?
rows.translation: Ni upi mfuatano wa kodi nne katika C?

rows.source: The one, five, six and four of C are C, G, A minor and F.
rows.translation: Kodi za moja, tano, sita na nne katika C ni C, G, A minori na F.
Kodi za saba, sus na swing

rows.source: Blues, a waltz, 6/8 folk, lo-fi and funk, with seventh chords, sus chords and swung rhythms.
rows.translation: Blues, waltz, folk ya 6/8, lo-fi na funk, kwa kodi za saba, kodi za sus na midundo ya swing.

rows.source: Rust Belt Shuffle is a blues at 80 beats per minute: twelve bars of E7, A7 and B7, strummed long-short. The melody swings the same way, so lean into every long note.
rows.translation: Rust Belt Shuffle ni blues, mapigo 80 kwa dakika: vipimo kumi na viwili vya E7, A7 na B7, kwa mipigo mirefu na mifupi. Melodi ina swing hiyo pia, hivyo sisitiza kila noti ndefu.

rows.source: Open B, D at fret 3, open E and back. Then G and G sharp on string 3, sliding into open B.
rows.translation: B wazi, D freti 3, E wazi, kisha rudi. Halafu G na G diesi kwenye uzi 3, kwa slide kuelekea B wazi.

rows.source: Carousel at Closing Time turns in three, like a fairground ride winding down: oom-pah-pah at 96 beats per minute. Count one, two, three, with the weight on one.
rows.translation: Carousel at Closing Time huzunguka kwa tatu, kama jukwaa la bembea linalopunguza kasi: oom-pah-pah, mapigo 96 kwa dakika. Hesabu moja, mbili, tatu, ukisisitiza moja.

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, A on string 3, then C sharp at fret 2, open E and G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: D freti 3 uzi 2, A uzi 3, kisha C diesi freti 2, E wazi na G freti 3 uzi 1.

rows.source: Cedar Smoke sways in 6/8: six quick counts per bar, felt as two big beats, one-two-three, four-five-six. At 100 counts a minute it rocks like a slow boat.
rows.translation: Cedar Smoke huyumba katika 6/8: hesabu sita za haraka kwa kipimo, zinazohisiwa kama mapigo mawili makubwa, moja-mbili-tatu, nne-tano-sita. Kwa hesabu 100 kwa dakika, huyumba kama mashua ya polepole.

rows.source: Bar four holds Dsus4: a D chord with your little finger on string 1, fret 3. It hangs in the air. Bar eight drops to plain D, and the song lands.
rows.translation: Kipimo cha nne hudumisha Dsus4: kodi ya D yenye kidole kidogo kwenye uzi 1, freti 3. Husikika kana kwamba inasubiri kutua. Kipimo cha nane hurudi D ya kawaida, na wimbo hutua.

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B and back, then open E on string 1, and down again.
rows.translation: D freti 3 uzi 2, B wazi, kisha rudi; halafu E wazi kwenye uzi 1, na shuka tena.

rows.source: Rain on the Skylight is lo-fi: soft seventh chords over a lazy, swung beat at 72 beats per minute. Strum down on one, then down-up on three, the up a little late.
rows.translation: Rain on the Skylight ni lo-fi: kodi laini za saba juu ya mdundo wa swing uliotulia, mapigo 72 kwa dakika. Piga chini kwenye moja, kisha chini-juu kwenye tatu, ukichelewesha juu kidogo.

rows.source: Am7 is A minor with finger 3 lifted. Cmaj7 is C with finger 1 lifted. For Dm7, finger 2 goes on string 3, fret 2, and finger 1 lies flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1.
rows.translation: Am7 ni A minori ukiondoa kidole 3. Cmaj7 ni C ukiondoa kidole 1. Kwa Dm7, kidole 2 kiko kwenye uzi 3, freti 2, na kidole 1 hulala juu ya nyuzi 2 na 1 kwenye freti 1.

rows.source: Neon Laundromat stays on one chord, A7, the whole way through. A vamp like this lives on rhythm: tight, choppy strums at 96 beats per minute and a hook that dodges the beat.
rows.translation: Neon Laundromat hubaki kwenye kodi moja, A7, muda wote. Mfuatano huu unaorudiwa hutegemea mdundo: mipigo mifupi iliyokatika, mapigo 96 kwa dakika, na kishazi cha kuvutia kinachokwepa mapigo makuu.

rows.source: Funk players call beat one the one. Hit it hard, keep your strumming hand swinging in eighths, and ease your fingers off after each strum so it goes chk.
rows.translation: Wapigaji wa funk huliita pigo la kwanza the one. Lipige kwa nguvu, endeleza mkono kwa noti za nane, na legeza vidole baada ya kila mpigo ili usikike chk.

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2, open E, G at fret 3, then back down.
rows.translation: A freti 2 uzi 3, C na C diesi freti 1 na 2 uzi 2, E wazi, G freti 3, kisha shuka tena.
Seti ya swing na kodi za saba

rows.source: How many quick counts fill a bar of 6/8?
rows.translation: Kipimo cha 6/8 kina hesabu ngapi za haraka?

rows.source: 6/8 has six eighth-note counts, felt as two groups of three.
rows.translation: 6/8 ina hesabu sita za noti za nane, zinazohisiwa kama makundi mawili ya tatu.

rows.source: Lo-fi, one-drop reggae, funk, a 6/8 slow dance and bedroom pop, on seventh chords that make a groove glow.
rows.translation: Lo-fi, one-drop reggae, funk, densi ya polepole ya 6/8 na bedroom pop, kwa kodi za saba zinazochangamsha mdundo.

rows.source: Late Checkout is lo-fi at 72 beats per minute: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 and Am7 on a loop. Strum down on one, then down-up on three with the up a little late, and swing the tune the same way.
rows.translation: Late Checkout ni lo-fi, mapigo 72 kwa dakika: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 na Am7 zinajirudia. Piga chini kwenye moja, kisha chini-juu kwenye tatu, ukichelewesha juu kidogo; melodi iwe na swing hiyo pia.

rows.source: G7 is G with string 1 at fret 1 instead of fret 3: fingers 3 and 2 on strings 6 and 5, finger 1 on string 1. It leans hard toward C.
rows.translation: G7 ni G yenye uzi 1 kwenye freti 1 badala ya freti 3: vidole 3 na 2 kwenye nyuzi 6 na 5, kidole 1 kwenye uzi 1. Ina mvuto mkubwa kuelekea C.

rows.source: Saltwater Sunday is reggae in A minor at 76 beats per minute. The guitar plays a double chop on two and four, chk-a, chk-a, while the drums drop their weight on three.
rows.translation: Saltwater Sunday ni reggae katika A minori, mapigo 76 kwa dakika. Gitaa hupiga chop mbili kwenye mbili na nne, chk-a, chk-a, huku ngoma zikisisitiza tatu.

rows.source: D7: finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 1 on string 2, fret 1, finger 3 on string 1, fret 2. Am7 to D7 and back is the sunny, minor-but-bright sound of the whole song.
rows.translation: D7: kidole 2 kwenye uzi 3, freti 2; kidole 1 kwenye uzi 2, freti 1; kidole 3 kwenye uzi 1, freti 2. Kutoka Am7 hadi D7 na kurudi huupa wimbo sauti changamfu: minori lakini yenye mwanga.

rows.source: Pocket Change is funk at 100 beats per minute: a vamp on Em7, with A7 for the chorus. Your strumming hand never stops moving in eighths; only some strokes ring.
rows.translation: Pocket Change ni funk, mapigo 100 kwa dakika: Em7 inayojirudia, na A7 kwenye kiitikio. Mkono wa kupigia hauachi mwendo wa noti za nane; ni baadhi tu ya mipigo inayolia.

rows.source: Between the strokes that ring, lay your fretting fingers lightly across the strings and keep strumming: the muted strokes go chk. Press down only for the hits.
rows.translation: Kati ya mipigo inayolia, laza vidole vya mkono wa freti kwa wepesi juu ya nyuzi na endelea kupiga: mipigo iliyonyamazishwa husikika chk. Bonyeza kwenye mipigo inayotakiwa kulia tu.

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, then C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2. Twice.
rows.translation: A freti 2 uzi 3, kisha C na C diesi freti 1 na 2 kwenye uzi 2. Mara mbili.

rows.source: Kitchen Slow Dance is a soul ballad in 6/8 at 108 counts a minute, two slow sways a bar. Cmaj7, Am7, Dm7 and G7 carry the verse; Fmaj7 and Em7 open up the chorus.
rows.translation: Kitchen Slow Dance ni wimbo wa polepole wa soul katika 6/8, hesabu 108 kwa dakika: miondoko miwili ya polepole kwa kipimo. Cmaj7, Am7, Dm7 na G7 huandamana na ubeti; Fmaj7 na Em7 hupanua kiitikio.

rows.source: Fmaj7 is the mini F with string 1 left open. Em7 takes one finger: finger 2 on string 5, fret 2, every other string open.
rows.translation: Fmaj7 ni F ndogo yenye uzi 1 wazi. Em7 hutumia kidole kimoja: kidole 2 kwenye uzi 5, freti 2, nyuzi nyingine zote wazi.

rows.source: Open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, E, D at fret 3 on string 2, open E again, then open B.
rows.translation: E wazi, G freti 3 uzi 1, E, D freti 3 uzi 2, E wazi tena, kisha B wazi.
Bedroom pop kwa kodi za saba

rows.source: Houseplants is soft bedroom pop at 88 beats per minute: Gmaj7, Em7, Cmaj7 and D. Seventh chords make it dreamy. Strum once on one, then brush soft ups on the ands.
rows.translation: Houseplants ni bedroom pop laini, mapigo 88 kwa dakika: Gmaj7, Em7, Cmaj7 na D. Kodi za saba huleta hisia za ndoto. Piga mara moja kwenye moja, kisha piga juu kwa ulaini kwenye na.

rows.source: Gmaj7 is G with string 1 at fret 2 instead of fret 3. Bm7 puts three fingers at fret 2, on strings 5, 3 and 1, and lets strings 4 and 2 ring open.
rows.translation: Gmaj7 ni G yenye uzi 1 kwenye freti 2 badala ya freti 3. Kwa Bm7, vidole vitatu viko freti 2 kwenye nyuzi 5, 3 na 1; nyuzi 4 na 2 zinalia wazi.

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1 and open E, twice, then D at fret 3 on string 2 and F sharp at fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: G freti 3 uzi 1 na E wazi, mara mbili, kisha D freti 3 uzi 2 na F diesi freti 2 uzi 1.

rows.source: Which chord has a major seventh?
rows.translation: Ni kodi ipi yenye umbali wa saba wa meja?

rows.source: Cmaj7 adds B, a half step under C. G7 and Am7 add a flat seventh, a whole step under the root.
rows.translation: Cmaj7 huongeza B, nusu toni chini ya C. G7 na Am7 huongeza ya saba iliyoshushwa, toni nzima chini ya noti msingi.
Riff, kodi za tano na mitindo ya zamani

rows.source: Punk, garage rock, doo-wop, surf and heartland rock, with power chords, a riff and sus chords.
rows.translation: Punk, garage rock, doo-wop, surf na heartland rock, kwa kodi za tano, riff na kodi za sus.

rows.source: Static on Channel Nine is punk: four power chords, palm-muted eighths, 104 beats per minute. The verse mutters on low notes; the chorus is a gang shout, so dig in.
rows.translation: Static on Channel Nine ni punk: kodi nne za tano, noti za nane zilizofifishwa kwa kiganja, mapigo 104 kwa dakika. Ubeti hunong'ona kwa noti za chini; kiitikio ni shangwe ya kundi, hivyo piga kwa nguvu.

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, down to D at fret 3 on string 2, then F sharp at fret 2 and D again.
rows.translation: G freti 3 uzi 1, shuka hadi D freti 3 uzi 2, kisha F diesi freti 2 na D tena.

rows.source: Basement Weather is garage rock at 92 beats per minute: a riff on the low strings, then power chords that punch back. Rest your palm at the bridge to keep the riff tight.
rows.translation: Basement Weather ni garage rock, mapigo 92 kwa dakika: riff kwenye nyuzi za chini, kisha kodi za tano zinazojibu kwa nguvu. Egemeza kiganja kwenye daraja la nyuzi ili riff iwe fupi na thabiti.

rows.source: Open string 5, C at fret 3 on the same string, then open string 4, and back.
rows.translation: Uzi 5 wazi, C freti 3 kwenye uzi huohuo, kisha uzi 4 wazi, na urudi.

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 6, open A, G again, then open low E.
rows.translation: G freti 3 uzi 6, A wazi, G tena, kisha E ya chini wazi.

rows.source: Answer the riff with power chords on one, the and of two, and four: A5, G5, C5, D5. Between hits, ease your fretting fingers off so the chords stop short.
rows.translation: Jibu riff kwa kodi za tano kwenye moja, na ya mbili, na nne: A5, G5, C5, D5. Kati ya mipigo, legeza vidole vya mkono wa freti ili kodi zikome haraka.

rows.source: Jukebox Moon is a slow dance in 1950s doo-wop style: C, A minor, F and G7, around and around, at 72 beats per minute. Strum every beat, with a quick swung up into each new bar.
rows.translation: Jukebox Moon ni densi ya polepole ya doo-wop ya miaka ya 1950: C, A minori, F na G7 zikijirudia, mapigo 72 kwa dakika. Piga kila pigo, ukiweka mpigo wa juu wa haraka wenye swing kabla ya kila kipimo kipya.

rows.source: Open G, C at fret 1 on string 2, open E, then D and C. Next, A at fret 2 on string 3 and back up.
rows.translation: G wazi, C freti 1 uzi 2, E wazi, kisha D na C. Halafu A freti 2 uzi 3 na upande tena.

rows.source: Boardwalk Comet is surf rock: a twangy melody over A minor, G, F and E, galloping along at 104 beats per minute. Picture reverb, salt spray and a wave about to break.
rows.translation: Boardwalk Comet ni surf rock: melodi yenye mlio mkali juu ya A minori, G, F na E, ikikimbia kwa mapigo 104 kwa dakika. Fikiria mwangwi wa reverb, matone ya maji ya bahari na wimbi linalokaribia kuvunjika.

rows.source: A on string 3, C at fret 1, open E and back down. Then open B, D at fret 3, and up to G on string 1.
rows.translation: A uzi 3, C freti 1, E wazi na shuka tena. Kisha B wazi, D freti 3, na upande hadi G uzi 1.

rows.source: Over the E chord the tune plays G sharp, not G. Where is G sharp on string 3?
rows.translation: Juu ya kodi ya E, melodi hutumia G diesi, si G. G diesi iko wapi kwenye uzi 3?

rows.source: G is open string 3, so G sharp is one fret up. It leans hard toward A, the home note.
rows.translation: G ni uzi 3 wazi, hivyo G diesi iko freti moja juu. Ina mvuto mkubwa kuelekea A, noti msingi.

rows.source: Mile Marker Zero is open-road rock at 100 beats per minute: big ringing chords and a chorus for driving with the windows down. Listen for D lifting to Dsus4 and back.
rows.translation: Mile Marker Zero ni rock ya safari barabarani, mapigo 100 kwa dakika: kodi kubwa zinazolia na kiitikio cha kuimba ukiendesha madirisha wazi. Sikiliza D ikipanda hadi Dsus4 na kurudi.

rows.source: Asus4 is A with your little finger added on string 2, fret 3. Like Dsus4, it leans forward and wants to fall back home.
rows.translation: Asus4 ni A ukiongeza kidole kidogo kwenye uzi 2, freti 3. Kama Dsus4, husikika ikisubiri kurudi kwenye kodi ya msingi.

rows.source: F sharp at fret 2 and G at fret 3 on string 1, then down to D at fret 3 on string 2.
rows.translation: F diesi freti 2 na G freti 3 kwenye uzi 1, kisha shuka hadi D freti 3 uzi 2.

rows.source: Which of these styles swings, long-short?
rows.translation: Ni mtindo upi wenye swing, ndefu-fupi?

rows.source: Doo-wop rides a gentle swing. Punk and surf drive on straight, even eighths.
rows.translation: Doo-wop ina swing laini. Punk na surf hutumia noti za nane zilizo sawa bila swing.
Punk na rock kwa kodi za tano

rows.source: Punk-pop, riff rock, dark 6/8 rock, an indie anthem and desert rock, on power chords and low-string riffs.
rows.translation: Punk-pop, riff rock, rock nzito ya 6/8, indie ya pamoja na desert rock, kwa kodi za tano na riff za nyuzi za chini.

rows.source: Last Bell is punk-pop at 152 beats per minute: C5, G5, A5 and F5, the four-chord loop as power chords. All downstrokes in steady eighths, palm resting on the strings by the bridge.
rows.translation: Last Bell ni punk-pop, mapigo 152 kwa dakika: C5, G5, A5 na F5, mfuatano wa kodi nne kama kodi za tano. Piga chini tu kwa noti za nane bila kuyumba, kiganja kikiegemea nyuzi karibu na daraja la nyuzi.

rows.source: F5 is the G5 shape two frets lower: finger 1 on string 6, fret 1, fingers 3 and 4 on strings 5 and 4 at fret 3.
rows.translation: F5 ni umbo la G5 lililoshushwa freti mbili: kidole 1 kwenye uzi 6, freti 1, vidole 3 na 4 kwenye nyuzi 5 na 4, freti 3.

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1 and open E, twice. Then D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, open E and D.
rows.translation: G freti 3 uzi 1 na E wazi, mara mbili. Kisha D freti 3 uzi 2 mara mbili, E wazi na D.

rows.source: Copper Wire is built on a riff: a short, catchy line on the low strings that the whole band locks onto. It runs at 112 beats per minute in E, with power chords in the chorus.
rows.translation: Copper Wire imejengwa juu ya riff: kishazi kifupi cha kuvutia kwenye nyuzi za chini ambacho bendi nzima hufuata pamoja. Ni katika E, mapigo 112 kwa dakika, na kodi za tano kwenye kiitikio.

rows.source: Open string 6 twice, G at fret 3, open E, open string 5, G again, then open E.
rows.translation: Uzi 6 wazi mara mbili, G freti 3, E wazi, uzi 5 wazi, G tena, kisha E wazi.

rows.source: The second bar turns around: B at fret 2 on string 5, open A, G at fret 3 on string 6, open A.
rows.translation: Kipimo cha pili hugeuka kurudi: B freti 2 uzi 5, A wazi, G freti 3 uzi 6, A wazi.

rows.source: Cold Lake is dark alternative rock in 6/8 at 120 counts a minute: E5, C5, G5 and D5. Keep the verse quiet and low so the chorus can open up.
rows.translation: Cold Lake ni alternative rock yenye huzuni katika 6/8, hesabu 120 kwa dakika: E5, C5, G5 na D5. Ubeti uwe wa sauti ndogo na noti za chini ili kiitikio kiweze kupanuka.

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, open E, G again, then D at fret 3 on string 2. Let each ring.
rows.translation: G freti 3 uzi 1, E wazi, G tena, kisha D freti 3 uzi 2. Acha kila noti iendelee kulia.
Wimbo wa pamoja wa indie rock

rows.source: Parking Lot Cathedral is indie rock at 128 beats per minute: D5, A5, B5 and G5, the four-chord loop again, now as power chords. Big, open, driving eighths.
rows.translation: Parking Lot Cathedral ni indie rock, mapigo 128 kwa dakika: D5, A5, B5 na G5, mfuatano wa kodi nne tena, sasa kama kodi za tano. Piga noti za nane kwa nguvu, sauti wazi na mwendo thabiti.

rows.source: B5 is the A5 shape moved up two frets: finger 1 on string 5, fret 2, fingers 3 and 4 on strings 4 and 3 at fret 4.
rows.translation: B5 ni umbo la A5 lililopandishwa freti mbili: kidole 1 kwenye uzi 5, freti 2, vidole 3 na 4 kwenye nyuzi 4 na 3, freti 4.

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, G at fret 3, open E.
rows.translation: D freti 3 uzi 2 mara mbili, F diesi freti 2 uzi 1, E wazi, G freti 3, E wazi.

rows.source: Halogen is desert rock in D minor at 104 beats per minute: a hypnotic riff on strings 4 and 5, a low, steady voice, then F5, C5 and G5 opening up the chorus.
rows.translation: Halogen ni desert rock katika D minori, mapigo 104 kwa dakika: riff inayovutia kwenye nyuzi 4 na 5, sauti ya chini thabiti, kisha F5, C5 na G5 zinazopanua kiitikio.

rows.source: Open string 4 twice, F at fret 3, open D, open string 3, F again, then open D.
rows.translation: Uzi 4 wazi mara mbili, F freti 3, D wazi, uzi 3 wazi, F tena, kisha D wazi.

rows.source: F at fret 1 on string 1, open E, C at fret 1 on string 2, then G at fret 3 on string 1, E and C.
rows.translation: F freti 1 uzi 1, E wazi, C freti 1 uzi 2, kisha G freti 3 uzi 1, E na C.

rows.source: Which song's riff starts like this?
rows.translation: Ni wimbo upi ambao riff yake huanza hivi?

rows.source: A power chord is a root and its fifth, with no third, so it is neither major nor minor.
rows.translation: Kodi ya tano ina noti msingi na ya tano, bila ya tatu, hivyo si meja wala minori.
Nyimbo za hadithi na zinazojenga hisia

rows.source: A ballad, a sea story in 6/8, a music-box waltz, a bright folk strummer and a dark song in A minor.
rows.translation: Wimbo wa polepole, hadithi ya bahari ya 6/8, waltz ya kisanduku cha muziki, folk changamfu na wimbo mzito wa A minori.

rows.source: Letters in a Shoebox tells a story in C at 72 beats per minute. The verse walks C, G, A minor, E minor, F, C, F and G, a chain of chords that has carried ballads for centuries.
rows.translation: Letters in a Shoebox husimulia hadithi katika C, mapigo 72 kwa dakika. Ubeti hupitia C, G, A minori, E minori, F, C, F na G, mfuatano ulioandamana na nyimbo za polepole kwa karne nyingi.

rows.source: C at fret 1 on string 2, D at fret 3, open E, F at fret 1 on string 1, G at fret 3, then D again.
rows.translation: C freti 1 uzi 2, D freti 3, E wazi, F freti 1 uzi 1, G freti 3, kisha D tena.

rows.source: Keeper's Daughter is a story song in 6/8 at 120 counts a minute: E minor, D, C and B7. Three verses tell the story, and the chorus answers each one.
rows.translation: Keeper's Daughter ni wimbo wa hadithi katika 6/8, hesabu 120 kwa dakika: E minori, D, C na B7. Beti tatu husimulia hadithi, na kiitikio hujibu kila ubeti.

rows.source: Open B, open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, open E, then C at fret 1 on string 2, E and C.
rows.translation: B wazi, E wazi, G freti 3 uzi 1, E wazi, kisha C freti 1 uzi 2, E na C.

rows.source: Snow Globe Town is a quick waltz in G at 120 beats per minute, like a music box: one strong beat, two light ones. G, D, E minor and C, with B7 in the bridge.
rows.translation: Snow Globe Town ni waltz ya haraka katika G, mapigo 120 kwa dakika, kama kisanduku cha muziki: pigo moja lenye nguvu, mawili mepesi. G, D, E minori na C, pamoja na B7 kwenye daraja.

rows.source: Open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C at fret 1, D, C, then open B: a slow fall, like snow.
rows.translation: E wazi, D freti 3 uzi 2, C freti 1, D, C, kisha B wazi: kushuka polepole, kama theluji.

rows.source: Thistle and Thread is a bright folk strummer in A at 116 beats per minute. Asus4 and Asus2 decorate the A chord: change one finger and the chord sparkles.
rows.translation: Thistle and Thread ni folk changamfu ya kupiga kodi katika A, mapigo 116 kwa dakika. Asus4 na Asus2 hupamba kodi ya A: badili kidole kimoja na kodi inang'aa.

rows.source: From A, put finger 4 on string 2, fret 3 for Asus4. Lift the finger off string 2 and let it ring open for Asus2. Both fall back to A.
rows.translation: Kutoka A, weka kidole 4 kwenye uzi 2, freti 3 kwa Asus4. Ondoa kidole kwenye uzi 2, uuache ulie wazi kwa Asus2. Zote mbili hurudi A.

rows.source: F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, E twice, C sharp, open B, then A.
rows.translation: F diesi freti 2 uzi 1, E wazi, D freti 3 uzi 2, E mara mbili, C diesi, B wazi, kisha A.

rows.source: Ghost Light is a slow, dark ballad in A minor at 70 beats per minute. The verse sinks from A minor through F and C to E major, which pulls hard back to A minor.
rows.translation: Ghost Light ni wimbo wa polepole wenye huzuni katika A minori, mapigo 70 kwa dakika. Ubeti hushuka kutoka A minori kupitia F na C hadi E meja, yenye mvuto mkubwa wa kurudi A minori.

rows.source: E major in A minor brings one new note. Which?
rows.translation: E meja katika A minori huleta noti moja mpya. Ipi?

rows.source: A minor's own notes have G. E major needs G sharp, a half step under A, so it leans hard toward home.
rows.translation: Noti za A minori zina G. E meja huhitaji G diesi, nusu toni chini ya A, hivyo ina mvuto mkubwa kuelekea noti msingi.

rows.source: F at fret 1 on string 1, open E, G at fret 3, then D at fret 3 on string 2. Hold each long.
rows.translation: F freti 1 uzi 1, E wazi, G freti 3, kisha D freti 3 uzi 2. Shikilia kila noti kwa muda mrefu.

rows.source: How many beats fill a bar of 3/4?
3/4 counts one, two, three, with the weight on one: the waltz.
rows.translation: 3/4 huhesabiwa moja, mbili, tatu, ukisisitiza moja: waltz.

rows.source: Indie pop, a power ballad, highlife, neo-soul and an anthem with a key change, with F and B minor barres.
rows.translation: Indie pop, power ballad, highlife, neo-soul na wimbo wa pamoja unaobadili ufunguo, kwa bare za F na B minori.

rows.source: Late Bus Home is indie pop for the ride back through a sleeping city: D, B minor, G and A at 100 beats per minute. Each line starts just after the beat, so wait a breath.
rows.translation: Late Bus Home ni indie pop kwa safari ya kurudi kupitia jiji lililolala: D, B minori, G na A, mapigo 100 kwa dakika. Kila mstari huanza baada kidogo ya pigo, hivyo subiri kidogo.

rows.source: Play the full B minor barre at fret 2 if you can. If not, use the top four strings: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: Piga bare kamili ya B minori kwenye freti 2 ukiweza. La sivyo, tumia nyuzi nne za juu: freti 4 kwenye nyuzi 4 na 3, freti 3 kwenye uzi 2, freti 2 kwenye uzi 1.

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, D at fret 3 on string 2, then open E and F sharp at fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: A freti 2 uzi 3, D freti 3 uzi 2, kisha E wazi na F diesi freti 2 uzi 1.

rows.source: Glass Satellites is a slow, soaring ballad at 76 beats per minute: A minor, F, C and G. Strum big on one and let it ring, then build on three and four.
rows.translation: Glass Satellites ni wimbo wa polepole unaopaa, mapigo 76 kwa dakika: A minori, F, C na G. Piga kwa nguvu kwenye moja na acha sauti iendelee, kisha ongeza nguvu kwenye tatu na nne.

rows.source: Lay finger 1 flat across all six strings at fret 1 and build an E shape in front of it. Not there yet? Use the mini F on the top four strings for now.
rows.translation: Laza kidole 1 juu ya nyuzi zote sita kwenye freti 1, kisha tengeneza umbo la E mbele yake. Bado hujaweza? Kwa sasa, tumia F ndogo kwenye nyuzi nne za juu.

rows.source: C at fret 1 on string 2, open E twice, D at fret 3, C again, then A at fret 2 on string 3.
rows.translation: C freti 1 uzi 2, E wazi mara mbili, D freti 3, C tena, kisha A freti 2 uzi 3.

rows.source: Market Day borrows from highlife, the bright guitar pop of Ghana and Nigeria: G, B minor, C and D at 104 beats per minute. The hook bounces off the beat, so keep your body moving.
rows.translation: Market Day imechota kutoka highlife, pop changamfu ya gitaa ya Ghana na Nigeria: G, B minori, C na D, mapigo 104 kwa dakika. Kishazi chake cha kuvutia hutua kati ya mapigo, hivyo endelea kutikisa mwili.

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B, D again, open E, then back to D and B.
rows.translation: D freti 3 uzi 2, B wazi, D tena, E wazi, kisha rudi D na B.

rows.source: Bar two keeps bar one's rhythm but swaps one note. Why?
rows.translation: Kipimo cha pili hurudia mdundo wa cha kwanza lakini hubadili noti moja. Kwa nini?

rows.source: Bar two moves E up to F sharp, a note of B minor. Same rhythm, new chord, new note.
rows.translation: Kipimo cha pili hupandisha E hadi F diesi, noti ya B minori. Mdundo uleule, kodi mpya, noti mpya.

rows.source: Velvet Hour is neo-soul at 74 beats per minute: four lush seventh chords stepping down, Fmaj7, Em7, Dm7 and Cmaj7. Strum once on one, then brush soft ups on the ands.
rows.translation: Velvet Hour ni neo-soul, mapigo 74 kwa dakika: kodi nne za saba zenye sauti tele zinazoshuka, Fmaj7, Em7, Dm7 na Cmaj7. Piga mara moja kwenye moja, kisha piga juu kwa ulaini kwenye na.

rows.source: Fmaj7 is the mini F with string 1 left open. Em7 takes one finger: finger 2 on string 5, fret 2, every other string open. Dm7 and Cmaj7 you know from Rain on the Skylight.
rows.translation: Fmaj7 ni F ndogo yenye uzi 1 wazi. Em7 hutumia kidole kimoja: kidole 2 kwenye uzi 5, freti 2, nyuzi nyingine zote wazi. Tayari unajua Dm7 na Cmaj7 kutoka Rain on the Skylight.

rows.source: The chords walk down F, E, D. Where does the loop land?
rows.translation: Kodi hushuka F, E, D. Mfuatano unaorudiwa hutua wapi?

rows.source: Each chord sits one step below the last, and the walk ends on C, the home chord.
rows.translation: Kila kodi iko hatua moja chini ya iliyotangulia, na mfuatano huishia C, kodi ya msingi.

rows.source: An anthem with a key change
Rooftop Choir is a stadium-sized anthem at 92 beats per minute. You play the chorus in C, then one bar of A lifts everything a whole step, and the chorus returns in D.
rows.translation: Rooftop Choir ni wimbo mkubwa wa kuimba pamoja uwanjani, mapigo 92 kwa dakika. Unapiga kiitikio katika C, kisha kipimo kimoja cha A hupandisha kila kitu toni nzima, na kiitikio hurudi katika D.

rows.source: A key change up a whole step moves every note up…
rows.translation: Kubadili ufunguo toni nzima juu hupandisha kila noti kwa…

rows.source: A whole step is two half steps, and each fret is a half step. C becomes D, and G becomes A.
rows.translation: Toni nzima ni nusu toni mbili, na kila freti ni nusu toni. C huwa D, na G huwa A.

rows.source: Which chord lifts Rooftop Choir from C into D?
rows.translation: Ni kodi ipi inayopandisha Rooftop Choir kutoka C hadi D?

rows.source: A leads home to D. Landing on it turns the whole song toward the new key.
rows.translation: A huongoza kurudi D. Kutua kwenye A huelekeza wimbo mzima kwenye ufunguo mpya.

rows.source: Synth-pop, gospel-pop, dark pop, indie pop and a 6/8 finale, with five new barre chords.
rows.translation: Synth-pop, gospel-pop, pop nzito, indie pop na mwisho wa 6/8, kwa kodi tano mpya za bare.

rows.source: Slow Motion Strobe is synth-pop at 118 beats per minute: F sharp minor, D, A and E. The strum is pushed: two of its hits land on the and, just before the beat.
rows.translation: Slow Motion Strobe ni synth-pop, mapigo 118 kwa dakika: F diesi minori, D, A na E. Mipigo yake hutangulia: miwili hutua kwenye na, kabla kidogo ya pigo kuu.

rows.source: Barre finger 1 across all six strings at fret 2, then put fingers 3 and 4 on strings 5 and 4 at fret 4: the E minor shape, moved up two frets.
rows.translation: Laza kidole 1 juu ya nyuzi zote sita kwenye freti 2, kisha weka vidole 3 na 4 kwenye nyuzi 5 na 4, freti 4: umbo la E minori lililopandishwa freti mbili.

rows.source: Bright Side of the Block is a gospel-pop sing-along in D at 100 beats per minute: D, F sharp minor, G and A. Clap on two and four and sing the chorus like the whole street joins in.
rows.translation: Bright Side of the Block ni gospel-pop ya kuimba pamoja katika D, mapigo 100 kwa dakika: D, F diesi minori, G na A. Piga makofi kwenye mbili na nne, uimbe kiitikio kana kwamba mtaa mzima unaimba nawe.

rows.source: Barre finger 1 across strings 5 to 1 at fret 2, then build an A minor shape two frets up with fingers 2, 3 and 4. Leave string 6 silent.
rows.translation: Laza kidole 1 juu ya nyuzi 5 hadi 1 kwenye freti 2, kisha tengeneza umbo la A minori freti mbili juu kwa vidole 2, 3 na 4. Uzi 6 usilie.

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, F sharp at fret 2, E, G, then E.
rows.translation: D freti 3 uzi 2, E wazi, G freti 3 uzi 1, F diesi freti 2, E, G, kisha E.

rows.source: Over You Soon is dark pop in B minor at 84 beats per minute: B minor, G, D and A. Strum once on one, then soft ups on the ands, and keep it hushed.
rows.translation: Over You Soon ni pop yenye huzuni katika B minori, mapigo 84 kwa dakika: B minori, G, D na A. Piga mara moja kwenye moja, kisha juu kwa ulaini kwenye na, na udumishe sauti ndogo.

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, F sharp at fret 2, D at fret 3 on string 2, then F sharp, open E and D.
rows.translation: G freti 3 uzi 1, F diesi freti 2, D freti 3 uzi 2, kisha F diesi, E wazi na D.

rows.source: Spray Paint Sunrise is indie pop at 124 beats per minute: E, B, C sharp minor and A, the four-chord loop with two barres. Drive steady eighths and let it run.
rows.translation: Spray Paint Sunrise ni indie pop, mapigo 124 kwa dakika: E, B, C diesi minori na A, mfuatano wa kodi nne wenye bare mbili. Piga noti za nane bila kuyumba na udumishe mwendo.

rows.source: B is an A shape barred at fret 2: finger 1 across strings 5 to 1, three fingers at fret 4. C sharp minor is an A minor shape barred at fret 4.
rows.translation: B ni umbo la A lenye bare kwenye freti 2: kidole 1 juu ya nyuzi 5 hadi 1, vidole vitatu kwenye freti 4. C diesi minori ni umbo la A minori lenye bare kwenye freti 4.

rows.source: G sharp at fret 4 on string 1, F sharp, open E, open B, then D sharp at fret 4 on string 2, C sharp, D sharp.
rows.translation: G diesi freti 4 uzi 1, F diesi, E wazi, B wazi, kisha D diesi freti 4 uzi 2, C diesi, D diesi.

rows.source: Constellation Prize closes the course: an anthem in 6/8 at 126 counts a minute, in F. F and B flat are both barres, with C and D minor between them.
rows.translation: Constellation Prize hufunga kozi: wimbo wa pamoja wa 6/8, hesabu 126 kwa dakika, katika F. F na B bemoli zote ni bare, huku C na D minori zikiwa katikati.
B bemoli, bare ya umbo la A

rows.source: Barre finger 1 across strings 5 to 1 at fret 1, then put fingers 2, 3 and 4 on strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 3. Leave string 6 silent.
rows.translation: Laza kidole 1 juu ya nyuzi 5 hadi 1 kwenye freti 1, kisha weka vidole 2, 3 na 4 kwenye nyuzi 4, 3 na 2, freti 3. Uzi 6 usilie.

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, F at fret 1 on string 1 twice, G at fret 3, F twice, open E, then F.
rows.translation: D freti 3 uzi 2, F freti 1 uzi 1 mara mbili, G freti 3, F mara mbili, E wazi, kisha F.

rows.source: F sharp minor is which shape, barred at fret 2?
rows.translation: F diesi minori ni umbo lipi lenye bare kwenye freti 2?

rows.source: Barre at fret 2 and the E minor shape sits in front of your first finger: F sharp minor.
rows.translation: Weka bare kwenye freti 2, umbo la E minori mbele ya kidole cha kwanza: F diesi minori.

rows.source: Famous tunes everyone knows, start to finish
rows.translation: Melodi maarufu zinazojulikana na wote, mwanzo hadi mwisho

rows.source: Folk songs and a spiritual everyone can sing, with simple chord charts to strum.
rows.translation: Nyimbo za folk na spiritual ambazo wote wanaweza kuimba, zenye chati rahisi za kodi za kupiga.

rows.source: This tune began as a spiritual. In the 1890s railroad crews in the Midwest gave it new words, and Carl Sandburg printed it in 1927. It climbs from low B up to D on string 2.
rows.translation: Melodi hii ilianza kama spiritual. Katika miaka ya 1890, wafanyakazi wa reli wa Midwest waliipa maneno mapya, na Carl Sandburg akaichapisha mwaka 1927. Hupanda kutoka B ya chini hadi D kwenye uzi 2.

rows.source: The first line: open D, E, four open Gs, a dip to B on string 5, then home to G.
rows.translation: Mstari wa kwanza: D wazi, E, G wazi nne, shuka hadi B kwenye uzi 5, kisha rudi G.

rows.source: The words She'll be come before beat one. What are they?
rows.translation: Maneno She'll be hutangulia pigo la kwanza. Ni nini?

rows.source: A pickup is a few notes that lead into the first strong beat. Here they run up to the word com-.
rows.translation: Noti za utangulizi ni noti chache zinazoongoza hadi pigo la kwanza lenye nguvu. Hapa hupanda hadi silabi com-.

rows.source: Three chords: G, C and D7
rows.translation: Kodi tatu: G, C na D7

rows.source: Most of the song sits on G. D7 comes at the end of the second line, and C colors the fourth. Change on the word that starts the bar.
rows.translation: Wimbo mwingi hubaki kwenye G. D7 huja mwisho wa mstari wa pili, na C hupamba wa nne. Badili kwenye neno linaloanza kipimo.

rows.source: This African American spiritual is older than the Civil War and was first printed in 1918. Its line ain't gonna study war no more became a song of the peace movement.
rows.translation: Spiritual hii ya Waamerika Weusi ilikuwepo kabla ya Vita vya Wenyewe kwa Wenyewe vya Marekani; ilichapishwa kwa mara ya kwanza mwaka 1918. Mstari wake ain't gonna study war no more ukawa wimbo wa harakati za amani.

rows.source: Lay down my burden: open B, a drop to open D, then up through E, G and A to B.
rows.translation: Lay down my burden: B wazi, shuka hadi D wazi, kisha panda kupitia E, G na A hadi B.

rows.source: A sharp sits between A and B, at fret 3 on string 3. It slides up into open B, the bluesy lift that gives gospel its sound.
rows.translation: A diesi iko kati ya A na B, kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 3. Hupanda kwa slide hadi B wazi, mwendo wa blues unaoipa gospel sauti yake.

rows.source: Down by the riverside: B, B, A sharp at fret 3, B, then A and G.
rows.translation: Down by the riverside: B, B, A diesi freti 3, B, kisha A na G.

rows.source: The high road and the low road
rows.translation: Njia ya juu na njia ya chini

rows.source: This Scottish song was first printed in 1841. The low road is often heard as the road a soldier's spirit takes home, faster than the living on the high road.
rows.translation: Wimbo huu wa Scotland ulichapishwa kwa mara ya kwanza mwaka 1841. Njia ya chini mara nyingi hueleweka kama njia ambayo roho ya askari hufuata kurudi nyumbani, kwa kasi kuliko walio hai kwenye njia ya juu.

rows.source: By yon bonnie banks: open D, then G, G, A, B and back down to G.
rows.translation: By yon bonnie banks: D wazi, kisha G, G, A, B na shuka tena hadi G.

rows.source: This tune moves in quarter notes and pairs of eighths. Count one, two-and, three, four-and, and the lilt comes by itself.
rows.translation: Melodi hii hutumia noti za robo na jozi za noti za nane. Hesabu moja, mbili-na, tatu, nne-na, na myumbo wake utatokea wenyewe.

rows.source: This song was printed in 1876 and credited in 1884 to James Yorkston of Edinburgh. It is now Dublin's unofficial anthem, and Molly and her cart stand as a statue in the city.
rows.translation: Wimbo huu ulichapishwa mwaka 1876, na mwaka 1884 ukahusishwa na James Yorkston wa Edinburgh. Sasa ni wimbo usio rasmi wa Dublin, na sanamu ya Molly na mkokoteni wake ipo jijini.

rows.source: In Dublin's fair city: open D, four open Gs, up to open B and back to G.
rows.translation: In Dublin's fair city: D wazi, G wazi nne, panda hadi B wazi na urudi G.

rows.source: Count one, two, three and lean on one. In many bars the middle note is long: one, two, and a quick note just before the next one.
rows.translation: Hesabu moja, mbili, tatu na usisitize moja. Katika vipimo vingi, noti ya katikati ni ndefu: moja, mbili, kisha noti ya haraka kabla kidogo ya moja inayofuata.
Wimbo wa kale wa hadithi wa Uingereza

rows.source: Cecil Sharp collected and published this ballad in 1906, from verses that go back to the 1700s. Play it slowly and let every long note ring.
rows.translation: Cecil Sharp alikusanya na kuchapisha wimbo huu wa hadithi mwaka 1906, kutoka beti za karne iliyoanza mwaka 1700. Upige polepole na uache kila noti ndefu iendelee kulia.

rows.source: The water is wide, I cannot get o'er: up from open D to B, then gently back down to D.
rows.translation: The water is wide, I cannot get o'er: panda kutoka D wazi hadi B, kisha shuka kwa ulaini hadi D.

rows.source: Wide rings for two beats and two for two and a half. Keep counting while the string rings, so the next word lands on time.
rows.translation: Wide hulia kwa mapigo mawili, na two kwa mawili na nusu. Endelea kuhesabu uzi unapolia, ili neno linalofuata litue kwa wakati.

rows.source: Which word holds over two notes in the first verse?
rows.translation: Ni neno lipi linaloimbwa kwenye noti mbili katika ubeti wa kwanza?

rows.source: Fly starts on C and slides down to a long A. Singers call one syllable over several notes a melisma.
rows.translation: Fly huanza kwenye C na hushuka hadi A ndefu. Kuimba silabi moja kwenye noti kadhaa huitwa melisma.

rows.source: No new notes: the five songs from this unit, one after another, a little faster than before. Name each one from its first notes.
rows.translation: Hakuna noti mpya: nyimbo tano za kitengo hiki, moja baada ya nyingine, kwa kasi zaidi kidogo kuliko awali. Tambua kila wimbo kwa noti zake za mwanzo.
Nyimbo za hadithi na za Krismasi

rows.source: A Welsh lullaby, a Highland boat song and three carols, in German, Latin and English.
rows.translation: Wimbo wa kubembeleza wa Wales, wa mashua wa Nyanda za Juu, na tatu za Krismasi: Kijerumani, Kilatini na Kiingereza.

rows.source: The tune Ar Hyd y Nos was printed in Wales in 1784, and Harold Boulton wrote these English words in 1884. One phrase comes three times, with a higher one in the middle.
rows.translation: Melodi Ar Hyd y Nos ilichapishwa Wales mwaka 1784, na Harold Boulton aliandika maneno haya ya Kiingereza mwaka 1884. Kishazi kimoja huja mara tatu, na kingine cha juu zaidi katikati.

rows.source: Sleep, my child, and peace attend thee: open G, down to F sharp and E, then G, A, G, F sharp and D.
rows.translation: Sleep, my child, and peace attend thee: G wazi, shuka F diesi na E, kisha G, A, G, F diesi na D.

rows.source: Which phrase of the verse climbs highest?
rows.translation: Ni kishazi kipi cha ubeti kinachopanda juu zaidi?

rows.source: The third phrase, soft the drowsy hours, rises to C, D and E. The other three phrases share one tune.
rows.translation: Kishazi cha tatu, soft the drowsy hours, hupanda hadi C, D na E. Vishazi vingine vitatu vina melodi moja.

rows.source: Harold Boulton set these words in 1884 to a Highland rowing tune collected by Anne MacLeod. They tell of Bonnie Prince Charlie escaping to the Isle of Skye in 1746.
rows.translation: Harold Boulton aliweka maneno haya mwaka 1884 kwenye melodi ya kupiga makasia ya Nyanda za Juu, iliyokusanywa na Anne MacLeod. Yanasimulia kutoroka kwa Bonnie Prince Charlie hadi kisiwa cha Skye mwaka 1746.

rows.source: This song rocks in six-eight: two big beats a bar, each split in three. Count one-two-three, four-five-six, like oars pulling and coming back.
rows.translation: Wimbo huu huyumba kwa sita kwa nane: mapigo mawili makubwa kwa kipimo, kila moja likigawanywa mara tatu. Hesabu moja-mbili-tatu, nne-tano-sita, kama makasia yanayovutwa na kurudishwa.

rows.source: Speed, bonnie boat, like a bird on the wing: open D, E, D, three open Gs, then A, B, A and up to D.
rows.translation: Speed, bonnie boat, like a bird on the wing: D wazi, E, D, G wazi tatu, kisha A, B, A na panda hadi D.
Wimbo wa Krismasi wa Ujerumani wa 1824

rows.source: Ernst Anschütz wrote these words in Leipzig in 1824, to a much older folk tune. You'll sing them in German, the language they were written in.
rows.translation: Ernst Anschütz aliandika maneno haya Leipzig mwaka 1824, kwa melodi ya folk ya zamani zaidi. Utayaimba kwa Kijerumani, lugha ambayo yaliandikwa.

rows.source: O Tannenbaum, o Tannenbaum: open D, three open Gs, then A at fret 2 and three open Bs.
rows.translation: O Tannenbaum, o Tannenbaum: D wazi, G wazi tatu, kisha A freti 2 na B wazi tatu.

rows.source: Tan-nen is a dotted note and a very short one, then baum rings on. Say the words as you tap, and the rhythm follows.
rows.translation: Tan-nen ni noti yenye nukta na nyingine fupi sana, kisha baum hulia kwa muda. Tamka maneno huku ukigonga, na mdundo utafuata.

rows.source: The Latin hymn Adeste Fideles was printed with this tune in 1751, and Frederick Oakeley's English words followed in 1841. You'll sing a verse in each language.
rows.translation: Wimbo wa ibada wa Kilatini Adeste Fideles ulichapishwa na melodi hii mwaka 1751; maneno ya Kiingereza ya Frederick Oakeley yakafuata mwaka 1841. Utaimba ubeti katika kila lugha.

rows.source: O come, all ye faithful: open G twice, down to open D, back to G, A, and D again.
rows.translation: O come, all ye faithful: G wazi mara mbili, shuka D wazi, rudi G, A, na D tena.

rows.source: How many times does the refrain sing O come, let us adore him?
rows.translation: Kiitikio huimba O come, let us adore him mara ngapi?

rows.source: Three times, each a little higher, before Christ the Lord brings the tune home.
rows.translation: Mara tatu, kila mara juu zaidi kidogo, kabla ya Christ the Lord kurudisha melodi kwenye msingi wake.

rows.source: Latin hymn (1751); English words Frederick Oakeley (1841)
rows.translation: Wimbo wa ibada wa Kilatini (1751); maneno ya Kiingereza: Frederick Oakeley (1841)

rows.source: This carol was first printed in 1823, in a collection of old Christmas carols. Its tune walks up the scale and back, which is why it is so easy to remember.
rows.translation: Wimbo huu ulichapishwa kwa mara ya kwanza mwaka 1823 katika mkusanyiko wa nyimbo za kale za Krismasi. Melodi yake hupanda skeli na kushuka tena, ndiyo maana ni rahisi kukumbuka.

rows.source: Up the D scale: F sharp and E, open D, then E, F sharp, open G, A, open B, C sharp at fret 2 and D.
rows.translation: Panda skeli ya D: F diesi na E, D wazi, kisha E, F diesi, G wazi, A, B wazi, C diesi freti 2 na D.

rows.source: The tune starts with two quick notes, F sharp and E, before beat one. Then a long D and a run of eighths climb to A.
rows.translation: Melodi huanza kwa noti mbili za haraka, F diesi na E, kabla ya pigo la kwanza. Kisha D ndefu na mfuatano wa noti za nane hupanda hadi A.

rows.source: Five songs from this unit: two ballads and three carols. No new notes, just one after another, each a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Nyimbo tano za kitengo hiki: mbili za hadithi na tatu za Krismasi. Hakuna noti mpya; moja baada ya nyingine tu, kila moja kwa kasi zaidi kidogo kuliko awali.

rows.source: Which of these counts in six?
rows.translation: Ni wimbo upi hapa unaohesabiwa kwa sita?

rows.source: The Skye Boat Song rocks in six-eight. O Christmas Tree is in three, and All Through the Night in four.
rows.translation: The Skye Boat Song huyumba kwa sita kwa nane. O Christmas Tree ina mapigo matatu, na All Through the Night ina manne.

rows.source: A pipe march, a Russian folk dance, the Blue Danube and the can-can.
rows.translation: Muziki wa gwaride wa bagpipe, densi ya folk ya Urusi, The Blue Danube na can-can.

rows.source: This Scottish march was in print by 1878, and pipe bands play it all over the world. Pipers play it without words, and so will you.
rows.translation: Muziki huu wa gwaride wa Scotland ulikuwa umechapishwa kufikia 1878, na bendi za bagpipe huupiga duniani kote. Wapigaji wa bagpipe huupiga bila maneno, nawe utafanya hivyo.

rows.source: A dotted note and a quick one give a march its snap: long, then short. In the first bar, the second D is long and E slips in just before beat two.
rows.translation: Noti yenye nukta na noti ya haraka huupa muziki wa gwaride mdundo mkali: ndefu, kisha fupi. Katika kipimo cha kwanza, D ya pili ni ndefu na E huja kabla kidogo ya pigo la pili.

rows.source: Up the D chord: open D twice, E, F sharp at fret 4, D, F sharp, A, then D on string 2.
rows.translation: Panda kodi ya D: D wazi mara mbili, E, F diesi freti 4, D, F diesi, A, kisha D kwenye uzi 2.

rows.source: Nikolay Nekrasov's poem about traveling peddlers was printed in 1861, and this folk tune was published with it in 1898. A video game made it famous worldwide almost a century later.
rows.translation: Shairi la Nikolay Nekrasov kuhusu wachuuzi wanaosafiri lilichapishwa mwaka 1861, na melodi hii ya folk ikachapishwa nalo mwaka 1898. Karibu karne moja baadaye, mchezo wa video uliifanya ijulikane duniani kote.

rows.source: The opening: open B, down to F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, up G and A, then G, F sharp, E.
rows.translation: Mwanzo: B wazi, shuka F diesi freti 4 uzi 4, panda G na A, kisha G, F diesi, E.

rows.source: The second half reaches higher: A, C at fret 1 on string 2, open E, then down D, C, B and G.
rows.translation: Nusu ya pili hupanda juu zaidi: A, C freti 1 uzi 2, E wazi, kisha shuka D, C, B na G.

rows.source: This tune is in E minor. Which note sounds like home?
rows.translation: Melodi hii iko katika E minori. Ni noti ipi inayosikika kama msingi?

rows.source: Both halves end on E, the home note of E minor. You hear it as the place the tune settles.
rows.translation: Nusu zote mbili huishia E, noti msingi ya E minori. Unaisikia kama mahali ambapo melodi hutulia.

rows.source: Johann Strauss II first performed this waltz in Vienna in 1867, and Vienna still plays it every New Year's Day. Its tune climbs a chord, then answers with two high notes.
rows.translation: Johann Strauss II alipiga waltz hii kwa mara ya kwanza Vienna mwaka 1867, na Vienna bado huipiga kila Siku ya Mwaka Mpya. Melodi yake hupanda kodi, kisha hujibu kwa noti mbili za juu.

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 6 twice, B on string 5, open D, then leap up to D at fret 3 on string 2 and down to open B.
rows.translation: G freti 3 uzi 6 mara mbili, B uzi 5, D wazi, kisha ruka hadi D freti 3 uzi 2 na shuka B wazi.

rows.source: Each phrase starts low on the bass strings and leaps up an octave. Look at the high note before you play the low ones, so your hand knows where it's going.
rows.translation: Kila kishazi huanza chini kwenye nyuzi za besi na kuruka oktava moja juu. Tazama noti ya juu kabla ya kupiga za chini, ili mkono ujue unakoenda.

rows.source: Jacques Offenbach wrote this galop for his 1858 operetta Orpheus in the Underworld. Paris dance halls later made it the music of the can-can.
rows.translation: Jacques Offenbach aliandika galop hii kwa opereta yake Orpheus in the Underworld ya 1858. Baadaye, kumbi za densi za Paris ziliifanya muziki wa can-can.

rows.source: A long open G, then A, C, B, A, and two Ds at fret 3 on string 2.
rows.translation: G wazi ndefu, kisha A, C, B, A, na D mbili kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 2.

rows.source: Most of the tune runs in eighth notes. Keep the pick small and alternate down and up, so you never fall behind.
rows.translation: Melodi nyingi huenda kwa noti za nane. Sogeza kijiti cha kupigia kwa mwendo mdogo, ukibadilisha chini na juu, ili usibaki nyuma.

rows.source: The big run: open G, leap to G at fret 3 on string 1, then step all the way down to A.
rows.translation: Mfuatano mkubwa: G wazi, ruka hadi G freti 3 uzi 1, kisha shuka hatua kwa hatua hadi A.

rows.source: Four tunes from this unit: a pipe march, a Russian folk song, a Viennese waltz and a French galop. Each one a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Melodi nne za kitengo hiki: gwaride la bagpipe, folk ya Urusi, waltz ya Vienna na galop ya Ufaransa. Kila moja kwa kasi zaidi kidogo kuliko awali.

rows.source: Which of these is a waltz, in three?
rows.translation: Ni melodi ipi hapa ni waltz ya mapigo matatu?

rows.source: A waltz counts one, two, three. The can-can and the pipe march both count in four.
rows.translation: Waltz huhesabiwa moja, mbili, tatu. Can-can na muziki wa gwaride wa bagpipe huhesabiwa kwa nne.

rows.source: Joplin, Sousa, Bizet and Grieg: syncopation, six-eight and key changes.
rows.translation: Joplin, Sousa, Bizet na Grieg: sinkopa, sita kwa nane na kubadili ufunguo.

rows.source: Scott Joplin published The Entertainer in 1902, and a 1973 film made it famous again. In ragtime the tune leans off the beat while the bass keeps steady time.
rows.translation: Scott Joplin alichapisha The Entertainer mwaka 1902, na filamu ya 1973 ikaifanya maarufu tena. Katika ragtime, melodi husisitiza kati ya mapigo huku besi ikidumisha muda thabiti.

rows.source: Open D, D sharp at fret 1, E at fret 2 on string 4, then leap to C at fret 1 on string 2 and back, three times.
rows.translation: D wazi, D diesi freti 1, E freti 2 uzi 4, kisha ruka hadi C freti 1 uzi 2 na urudi, mara tatu.

rows.source: Syncopation puts the accent between the beats. In the opening, each C lands on an and. Count one-and-two-and and feel the C pull ahead.
rows.translation: Sinkopa huweka mkazo kati ya mapigo. Mwanzoni, kila C hutua kwenye na. Hesabu moja-na-mbili-na na uhisi C ikitangulia.

rows.source: The ending run circles C, D and E on strings 2 and 1, then lands through B and D on C.
rows.translation: Mfuatano wa mwisho huzunguka C, D na E kwenye nyuzi 2 na 1, kisha hutua C kupitia B na D.

rows.source: John Philip Sousa published The Liberty Bell in 1893, and a British TV comedy later made it its theme. It's in six-eight: two big beats a bar, like left, right.
rows.translation: John Philip Sousa alichapisha The Liberty Bell mwaka 1893, na baadaye kipindi cha vichekesho cha TV cha Uingereza kikautumia kama melodi yake kuu. Ni sita kwa nane: mapigo mawili makubwa kwa kipimo, kama kushoto, kulia.

rows.source: Many beats start with a short silence. Stop the string with your fretting hand, then come back in on the next eighth.
rows.translation: Mapigo mengi huanza kwa ukimya mfupi. Zima uzi kwa mkono wa freti, kisha ingia tena kwenye noti ya nane inayofuata.

rows.source: Open B three times, A sharp at fret 3 on string 3, B again, then up to G on string 1 and down D, D, B.
rows.translation: B wazi mara tatu, A diesi freti 3 uzi 3, B tena, kisha panda G uzi 1 na shuka D, D, B.

rows.source: Georges Bizet's opera Carmen opened in Paris in 1875. Its prelude starts with this festive march, then plays the tune of the famous Toreador Song.
rows.translation: Opera Carmen ya Georges Bizet ilionyeshwa kwa mara ya kwanza Paris mwaka 1875. Utangulizi wake huanza kwa muziki huu wa gwaride la sherehe, kisha hupiga melodi ya Wimbo wa Toreador maarufu.

rows.source: Four As at fret 2 on string 3, then down to E at fret 2 on string 4, open D and E.
rows.translation: A nne kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 3, kisha shuka hadi E freti 2 uzi 4, D wazi na E.

rows.source: The march is in A major, with C sharp and G sharp. The Toreador tune moves to F major, with B flat at fret 3 on string 3. Watch for the change.
rows.translation: Muziki wa gwaride uko katika A meja, wenye C diesi na G diesi. Melodi ya Toreador huhamia F meja, yenye B bemoli kwenye freti 3 ya uzi 3. Jihadhari na mabadiliko hayo.

rows.source: What happens at the end of the Toreador tune?
rows.translation: Nini hutokea mwishoni mwa melodi ya Toreador?

rows.source: It climbs to a long E
It climbs to a long high E, the note that leads back home to A major for the march.
rows.translation: Hupanda hadi E ndefu ya juu, noti inayoongoza kurudi A meja kwa muziki wa gwaride.

rows.source: Edvard Grieg wrote Morning Mood in 1875 for the play Peer Gynt. The flute plays the theme, the oboe answers, and the music climbs like the rising sun.
rows.translation: Edvard Grieg aliandika Morning Mood mwaka 1875 kwa tamthilia Peer Gynt. Fluti hupiga melodi kuu, oboe hujibu, na muziki hupanda kama jua linalochomoza.

rows.source: The theme uses just G, A, B, D and E. A five-note scale like this is called pentatonic, and it sounds calm and open.
rows.translation: Melodi kuu hutumia G, A, B, D na E tu. Skeli ya noti tano kama hii huitwa pentatoniki, na husikika tulivu na wazi.

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G, then back up A and B.
rows.translation: D freti 3 uzi 2, B wazi, A freti 2 uzi 3, G wazi, kisha panda tena A na B.

rows.source: How many different notes does the theme use?
rows.translation: Melodi kuu hutumia noti ngapi tofauti?

rows.source: G, A, B, D and E: a pentatonic scale. There is no C and no F sharp in the whole theme.
rows.translation: G, A, B, D na E: skeli ya pentatoniki. Hakuna C wala F diesi katika melodi kuu yote.

rows.source: The four pieces from this unit, back to back: ragtime, a march, an opera prelude and a sunrise. Each a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Vipande vinne vya kitengo hiki, kimoja baada ya kingine: ragtime, gwaride, utangulizi wa opera na kuchomoza kwa jua. Kila kimoja kwa kasi zaidi kidogo kuliko awali.

rows.source: Which of these pieces uses only five notes in its theme?
rows.translation: Ni kipande kipi hapa kinachotumia noti tano tu katika melodi kuu?

rows.source: Morning Mood's theme is pentatonic: G, A, B, D and E. The others use many more.
rows.translation: Melodi kuu ya Morning Mood ni pentatoniki: G, A, B, D na E. Vipande vingine hutumia noti nyingi zaidi.
Nyimbo za Krismasi kwa mwanga wa mishumaa

rows.source: Four Christmas carols to sing by candlelight: Wesley and Mendelssohn, a lullaby, and two tunes from America.
rows.translation: Nyimbo nne za Krismasi kwa mwanga wa mishumaa: Wesley na Mendelssohn, wimbo wa kubembeleza na melodi mbili za Marekani.

rows.source: Charles Wesley wrote the words in 1739. In 1856 an English organist set them to a tune from a choral piece by Felix Mendelssohn, and the carol has been sung that way since.
rows.translation: Charles Wesley aliandika maneno mwaka 1739. Mwaka 1856, mpiga kinanda cha kanisa wa Uingereza aliyaweka kwenye melodi ya kipande cha kwaya cha Felix Mendelssohn. Tangu hapo wimbo huu wa Krismasi umeimbwa hivyo.

rows.source: Open D, open G twice, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, G, then open B twice and A at fret 2 on string 3.
rows.translation: D wazi, G wazi mara mbili, F diesi freti 4 uzi 4, G, kisha B wazi mara mbili na A freti 2 uzi 3.

rows.source: Her-ald is long-short: her- lands on three and holds, and -ald slips in on the and of four. Count one, two, three, four-and.
rows.translation: Her-ald ni ndefu-fupi: her- hutua kwenye tatu na kuendelea, kisha -ald huja kwenye na ya nne. Hesabu moja, mbili, tatu, nne-na.

rows.source: The chorus moves C, A minor, D7 and G. Change on the word that starts each half bar, and keep the strum light under the high E.
rows.translation: Kiitikio hutumia C, A minori, D7 na G. Badili kwenye neno linaloanza kila nusu ya kipimo, na upige kwa wepesi chini ya E ya juu.

rows.source: These words first appeared in an American children's book in 1885, and James R. Murray gave them this gentle tune in 1887. It rocks in three, like a cradle.
rows.translation: Maneno haya yalitokea kwanza katika kitabu cha watoto cha Marekani mwaka 1885, na James R. Murray akayapa melodi hii laini mwaka 1887. Huyumba kwa mapigo matatu, kama kitanda cha mtoto cha kubembea.

rows.source: It starts high: D at fret 3 on string 2, then steps down C, B, A, G and F sharp all the way to open D.
rows.translation: Huanza juu: D freti 3 uzi 2, kisha hushuka C, B, A, G na F diesi hadi D wazi.

rows.source: The first line walks down from high D to low D. How far is that?
rows.translation: Mstari wa kwanza hushuka kutoka D ya juu hadi D ya chini. Huo ni umbali gani?

rows.source: D down to D is an octave: eight steps of the scale, the same note name, one register lower.
rows.translation: Kutoka D hadi D chini ni oktava: hatua nane za skeli, jina lilelile la noti, oktava moja chini.

rows.source: Hold G for most of a line, C for crib for a bed, and D7 to lead home. In three, strum down on one and lightly on two and three.
rows.translation: Dumisha G kwa sehemu kubwa ya mstari, C kwenye crib for a bed, na D7 kurudi kwenye msingi. Kwa mapigo matatu, piga chini kwenye moja na kwa wepesi kwenye mbili na tatu.
